import { isPhoneDevice } from './istrong/utils/device';
import { blockBrowserZoomInputs } from './istrong/utils/zoomCompensation';
import { NexumMenu } from './nexum/NexumMenu';

type Screen = 'menu' | 'work';

export default function App() {
  const isDark = useHtmlDark();
  const [screen, setScreen] = useState<Screen>('menu');
  const [tool, setTool] = useState<ToolId>('toOsa');
  const [libraryOpen, setLibraryOpen] = useState(false);
  const [sourceOpen, setSourceOpen] = useState(false);
  const [settingsOpen, setSettingsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [licenseOpen, setLicenseOpen] = useState(false);
  const [phoneNotice, setPhoneNotice] = useState(false);
  const [handed, setHanded] = useState<{ files: SourceFile[]; at: number } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => blockBrowserZoomInputs(), []);

  const onPc = useCallback((run: () => void) => { if (isPhoneDevice()) setPhoneNotice(true); else run(); }, []);
  const openConverter = useCallback(() => onPc(() => setScreen('work')), [onPc]);
  const openLibrary = useCallback(() => onPc(() => setLibraryOpen(true)), [onPc]);

  return (
    <ToastProvider>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 flex flex-col bg-[var(--surface-canvas)] text-[var(--text-primary)] font-sans overflow-hidden">
        {screen === 'menu' ? (
          <NexumMenu isDark={isDark} onConverter={openConverter} onLibrary={openLibrary}
            onSource={() => setSourceOpen(true)} onLicense={() => setLicenseOpen(true)} onSettings={() => setSettingsOpen(true)} />
        ) : (
          <Workspace tool={tool} setTool={setTool} isDark={isDark} handed={handed}
            onLibrary={() => setLibraryOpen(true)} onSource={() => setSourceOpen(true)}
            onSettings={() => setSettingsOpen(true)} onMenu={() => setScreen('menu')} />
        )}
      </div>

      {libraryOpen && (
        <LibraryWindow isDark={isDark} onClose={() => setLibraryOpen(false)}
          onConvert={(files) => { setHanded({ files, at: Date.now() }); setTool('toOsa'); setScreen('work'); setLibraryOpen(false); }} />
      )}
      {sourceOpen && <SourceWindow onClose={() => setSourceOpen(false)} />}
      {settingsOpen && <SettingsWindow onClose={() => setSettingsOpen(false)} />}
      {licenseOpen && <LicenseWindow onClose={() => setLicenseOpen(false)} />}
      {phoneNotice && (
        <Modal title="iStrong Nexum" icon={<MonitorSmartphone size={18} strokeWidth={1.5} absoluteStrokeWidth />} size="sm" onClose={() => setPhoneNotice(false)}
          footer={close => <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => close()}>OK</Button>}>
          <p className="k-modal-text">iStrong Nexum needs a bigger screen. Open it on a computer to convert tanks and to browse the library.</p>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </ToastProvider>
  );
}
import { lbCurveLeft } from '../../utils/lbAnim';

export const CARD_FADE_MS = 105;
const SNAP_PX = 0.01;
const STANDS_PX = 3;

export interface CardPlace<T> { x: number; y: number; h: number; data: T }
export interface MovingCard<T> {
  key: string;
  data: T;
  role: 'stay' | 'leave' | 'enter';
  rx: number; ry: number;
  cx: number; cy: number;
  f: number; alpha: number;
}
export interface CardMotion<T> { last: number; hold: number; cards: MovingCard<T>[] }

const _shown = (f: number) => f * f * (3 - 2 * f);
const _inBand = (y: number, h: number, top: number, vh: number, margin: number) => y + h > top - margin && y < top + vh + margin;

export function planCardMotion<T>(
  before: ReadonlyMap<string, CardPlace<T>>, after: ReadonlyMap<string, CardPlace<T>>,
  yOld: number, yNew: number, vh: number, margin: number, cur: CardMotion<T> | null, now: number, holdMs: number = 0,
): CardMotion<T> | null {
  const shift = yNew - yOld;
  const curBy = new Map<string, MovingCard<T>>();
  if (cur) for (const c of cur.cards) curBy.set(c.key, c);
  const keys = new Set<string>();
  for (const [k, p] of before) if (_inBand(p.y, p.h, yOld, vh, margin)) keys.add(k);
  for (const [k, p] of after) if (_inBand(p.y, p.h, yNew, vh, margin)) keys.add(k);
  for (const k of curBy.keys()) keys.add(k);
  const cards: MovingCard<T>[] = [];
  let change = false;
  for (const k of keys) {
    const c = curBy.get(k), o = before.get(k), n = after.get(k);
    let shown: boolean, dx = 0, dy = 0, f = 0, h = 0, data: T | null = null;
    if (c) { shown = c.f > 0; dx = c.cx; dy = c.cy + shift; f = c.f; data = c.data; h = n ? n.h : o ? o.h : 0; }
    else if (o && _inBand(o.y, o.h, yOld, vh, margin)) { shown = true; dx = o.x; dy = o.y + shift; f = 1; data = o.data; h = o.h; }
    else shown = false;
    const inNew = !!n && _inBand(n.y, n.h, yNew, vh, margin);
    if (shown && inNew) {
      cards.push({ key: k, data: n!.data, role: 'stay', rx: n!.x, ry: n!.y, cx: dx, cy: dy, f, alpha: _shown(f) });
      if (Math.abs(n!.x - dx) > 0.5 || Math.abs(n!.y - dy) > 0.5 || f < 1) change = true;
    } else if (shown) {
      cards.push({ key: k, data: data!, role: 'leave', rx: dx, ry: dy, cx: dx, cy: dy, f, alpha: _shown(f) });
      if (_inBand(dy, h, yNew, vh, 0)) change = true;
    } else if (inNew) {
      const f0 = c ? c.f : 0;
      cards.push({ key: k, data: n!.data, role: 'enter', rx: n!.x, ry: n!.y, cx: n!.x, cy: n!.y, f: f0, alpha: _shown(f0) });
      if (_inBand(n!.y, n!.h, yNew, vh, 0)) change = true;
    }
  }
  if (!change && !cur) return null;
  return { last: now, hold: Math.max(now + holdMs, cur ? cur.hold : 0), cards };
}

export function stepCardMotion<T>(m: CardMotion<T>, now: number): boolean {
  const dt = now > m.last ? now - m.last : 0;
  if (now > m.last) m.last = now;
  const df = dt / CARD_FADE_MS;
  const cards = m.cards;
  let out = false, moving = false, stands = true, fading = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
    const c = cards[i];
    if (c.role !== 'leave' || c.f <= 0) continue;
    c.f = c.f > df ? c.f - df : 0;
    if (c.f > 0) out = true;
  }
  if (now < m.hold) out = true;
  if (!out) {
    const k = lbCurveLeft(dt / 1000);
    for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
      const c = cards[i];
      if (c.role === 'leave' || (c.cx === c.rx && c.cy === c.ry)) continue;
      const gx = (c.cx - c.rx) * k, gy = (c.cy - c.ry) * k;
      if (Math.abs(gx) < SNAP_PX && Math.abs(gy) < SNAP_PX) { c.cx = c.rx; c.cy = c.ry; continue; }
      c.cx = c.rx + gx; c.cy = c.ry + gy;
      moving = true;
      if (Math.abs(gx) > STANDS_PX || Math.abs(gy) > STANDS_PX) stands = false;
    }
    if (stands) {
      for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
        const c = cards[i];
        if (c.role === 'leave' || c.f >= 1) continue;
        c.f = c.f + df < 1 ? c.f + df : 1;
        if (c.f < 1) fading = true;
      }
    } else {
      for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) if (cards[i].role !== 'leave' && cards[i].f < 1) { fading = true; break; }
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) cards[i].alpha = _shown(cards[i].f);
  return out || moving || fading;
}
import React, { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useSwapStage, useGlideSize, FoldMemoryContext } from './motion';

export const FOLD_MS = 140;
export const FOLD_FADE_MS = 105;

type Phase = 'open' | 'closed' | 'grow' | 'fadeIn' | 'fadeOut' | 'shrink';

let lastFadeOutAt = -1e9;

const reducedMotion = motionOff;

const CENTRE_SLACK = 0.1;
export function bringIntoView(top: HTMLElement, bottom: HTMLElement = top): void {
  const MARGIN = 12;
  let t = Math.min(top.getBoundingClientRect().top, bottom.getBoundingClientRect().top);
  let b = bottom.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
  if (!(b > t)) return;
  for (let sc = bottom.parentElement; sc && sc !== document.body && sc !== document.documentElement; sc = sc.parentElement) {
    if (!/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(sc).overflowY) || sc.scrollHeight <= sc.clientHeight + 1) continue;
    const v = sc.getBoundingClientRect();
    const k = sc.offsetHeight > 0 ? v.height / sc.offsetHeight : 1;
    const m = MARGIN * k;
    let by = 0;
    const room = v.height - 2 * m;
    if (b - t >= room) by = t - (v.top + m);
    else {
      by = (t + b) / 2 - (v.top + v.height / 2);
      if (t >= v.top + m && b <= v.bottom - m && Math.abs(by) < v.height * CENTRE_SLACK) by = 0;
    }
    by = Math.max(-sc.scrollTop * k, Math.min((sc.scrollHeight - sc.clientHeight - sc.scrollTop) * k, by));
    if (Math.abs(by) > 0.5) scrollGlide(sc, sc.scrollTop + by / k);
    t = Math.max(t - by, v.top); b = Math.min(b - by, v.bottom);
    if (!(b > t)) return;
  }
}

export interface FoldHandle {
  readonly el: HTMLElement | null;
  isOpen(): boolean;
  open(): void;
}

export function useFoldHandle(handle: React.MutableRefObject<FoldHandle | null> | undefined, el: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, isOpen: boolean, open: () => void): void {
  const live = useRef({ isOpen, open });
  live.current = { isOpen, open };
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!handle) return;
    const h: FoldHandle = {
      get el() { return el.current; },
      isOpen: () => live.current.isOpen,
      open: () => { if (!live.current.isOpen) live.current.open(); },
    };
    handle.current = h;
    return () => { if (handle.current === h) handle.current = null; };
  }, [handle, el]);
}

function scrollRest(el: HTMLElement, limitMs = 1000): Promise<void> {
  const boxes: HTMLElement[] = [];
  for (let sc = el.parentElement; sc && sc !== document.body && sc !== document.documentElement; sc = sc.parentElement) {
    if (/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(sc).overflowY)) boxes.push(sc);
  }
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    let last = boxes.map(b => b.scrollTop).join(',');
    let still = 0;
    const step = () => {
      const now = boxes.map(b => b.scrollTop).join(',');
      still = now === last ? still + 1 : 0;
      last = now;
      if (still >= 3 || performance.now() - t0 > limitMs) { resolve(); return; }
      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  });
}

export async function revealFold(h: FoldHandle): Promise<void> {
  const el = h.el;
  if (!el || !el.isConnected) return;
  bringIntoView(el);
  await scrollRest(el);
  if (h.isOpen()) return;
  h.open();
  await new Promise(r => window.setTimeout(r, FOLD_MS + 20));
  const now = h.el;
  if (now && now.isConnected) bringIntoView(now);
}

let _pressAt = -1e9;
let _pressTarget: Element | null = null;
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  const note = (e: Event) => { _pressAt = performance.now(); _pressTarget = e.target instanceof Element ? e.target : null; };
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', note, true);
  window.addEventListener('keydown', note, true);
}
function openedByHim(fold: HTMLElement, prev: Element | null): boolean {
  const t = _pressTarget;
  if (!t || !t.isConnected || performance.now() - _pressAt > 1500) return false;
  if (prev && prev !== fold && prev.contains(t)) return true;
  const card = fold.parentElement?.closest('.k-group');
  return !!card && card.contains(t);
}

export const Collapse: React.FC<{
  open: boolean; children: React.ReactNode; className?: string;
  onBusyChange?: (busy: boolean) => void;
  gapInside?: boolean;
  gapPx?: number;
  reveal?: 'parent' | 'prev' | 'self' | 'none';
  onClosed?: () => void;
  ownAct?: boolean;
  dataKey?: string;
}> = ({ open, children, className, onBusyChange, gapInside, gapPx, reveal = 'parent', onClosed, ownAct, dataKey }) => {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(open);
  const outer = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const inner = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const phase = useRef<Phase>(open ? 'open' : 'closed');
  const timer = useRef(0);
  const first = useRef(true);
  const pendingGrow = useRef(false);
  const gapDone = useRef(false);
  const busyCb = useRef(onBusyChange); busyCb.current = onBusyChange;
  const closedCb = useRef(onClosed); closedCb.current = onClosed;
  const revealRef = useRef(reveal); revealRef.current = reveal;
  const ownActRef = useRef(ownAct); ownActRef.current = ownAct;
  const busyNow = useRef(false);
  const setBusy = (b: boolean) => { if (busyNow.current !== b) { busyNow.current = b; busyCb.current?.(b); } };
  const kept = useRef(children);
  if (open) kept.current = children;

  const applyGap = () => {
    if (!gapInside || gapDone.current) return;
    const o = outer.current, i = inner.current;
    if (!o || !i) return;
    gapDone.current = true;
    const m = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(o).marginTop) || 0;
    if (m <= 0) return;
    o.style.marginTop = '0px';
    if ((parseFloat(getComputedStyle(o).marginTop) || 0) > 0) { o.style.marginTop = ''; return; }
    i.style.paddingTop = `${m}px`;
  };

  const settle = (p: 'open' | 'closed') => {
    phase.current = p;
    setBusy(false);
    const o = outer.current, i = inner.current;
    if (o) { o.style.height = ''; o.style.overflow = ''; o.classList.remove('k-fold-moving'); if (p === 'open') o.inert = false; }
    if (i) i.style.opacity = '';
    if (p === 'closed') { gapDone.current = false; setMounted(false); closedCb.current?.(); }
  };

  const grow = () => {
    const o = outer.current, i = inner.current;
    if (!o || !i) return;
    applyGap();
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current);
    const fresh = phase.current !== 'fadeOut' && phase.current !== 'shrink';
    noteMotion(FOLD_MS + FOLD_FADE_MS);
    phase.current = 'grow';
    o.inert = false;
    setBusy(true);
    const from = o.style.height ? o.offsetHeight : 0;
    if (fresh) { i.style.transition = 'none'; i.style.opacity = '0'; void i.offsetWidth; i.style.transition = ''; }
    else i.style.opacity = '0';
    o.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    o.classList.add('k-fold-moving');
    o.style.height = `${from}px`;
    void o.offsetHeight;
    o.style.height = `${i.offsetHeight}px`;
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      phase.current = 'fadeIn';
      o.style.height = '';
      o.style.overflow = '';
      o.classList.remove('k-fold-moving');
      i.style.opacity = '1';
      const rv = revealRef.current;
      if (rv !== 'none') {
        const par = o.parentElement ?? o;
        let prev: Element | null = o.previousElementSibling;
        while (prev && prev.getClientRects().length === 0) prev = prev.previousElementSibling;
        if (!(prev instanceof HTMLElement)) prev = o;
        if (ownActRef.current || openedByHim(o, rv === 'parent' ? par : prev)) bringIntoView(rv === 'parent' ? par : rv === 'prev' ? (prev as HTMLElement) : o, rv === 'parent' ? par : o);
      }
      timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => settle('open'), FOLD_FADE_MS);
    }, FOLD_MS);
  };

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (first.current) { first.current = false; return; }
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current);
    if (reducedMotion()) {
      if (open) { setMounted(true); settle('open'); } else settle('closed');
      return;
    }
    if (open) {
      if (phase.current === 'open' || phase.current === 'grow' || phase.current === 'fadeIn') return;
      if (outer.current) grow();
      else { pendingGrow.current = true; setMounted(true); }
      return;
    }
    if (phase.current === 'closed' || phase.current === 'shrink' || phase.current === 'fadeOut') return;
    const o = outer.current, i = inner.current;
    if (!o || !i) { pendingGrow.current = false; settle('closed'); return; }
    noteMotion(FOLD_FADE_MS + FOLD_MS);
    phase.current = 'fadeOut';
    lastFadeOutAt = performance.now();
    setBusy(true);
    o.style.height = `${o.offsetHeight}px`;
    o.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    o.classList.add('k-fold-moving');
    o.inert = true;
    leaveStarts(o);
    i.style.opacity = '0';
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      phase.current = 'shrink';
      void o.offsetHeight;
      o.style.height = '0px';
      timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => settle('closed'), FOLD_MS);
    }, FOLD_FADE_MS);
  }, [open]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (mounted) applyGap();
    if (mounted && pendingGrow.current) {
      pendingGrow.current = false;
      const wait = FOLD_FADE_MS - (performance.now() - lastFadeOutAt);
      const o = outer.current, i = inner.current;
      if (wait > 8 && o && i) {
        noteMotion(wait + FOLD_MS + FOLD_FADE_MS);
        phase.current = 'grow';
        setBusy(true);
        i.style.transition = 'none'; i.style.opacity = '0'; void i.offsetWidth; i.style.transition = '';
        o.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        o.style.height = '0px';
        timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => { phase.current = 'closed'; grow(); }, wait);
      } else grow();
    }
  }, [mounted]);

  useEffect(() => () => { window.clearTimeout(timer.current); if (busyNow.current) busyCb.current?.(false); }, []);

  if (!mounted) return null;
  return (
    <div ref={outer} data-ll={dataKey} className={className ? `k-fold ${className}` : 'k-fold'}>
      <div ref={inner} className="k-fold-in" style={gapPx ? { paddingTop: gapPx } : undefined}>{open ? children : kept.current}</div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const Reveal: React.FC<{ when: unknown; children: React.ReactNode | (() => React.ReactNode); className?: string }> = ({ when, children, className }) => (
  <Collapse open={!!when} gapInside reveal="prev" className={className}>
    {typeof children === 'function' ? (when ? (children as () => React.ReactNode)() : null) : children}
  </Collapse>
);

export interface ListEntry { key: string; el: React.ReactNode; leaving: boolean; opened: boolean; reveal: boolean }
export const EMPTY_KEY = '\u0000empty';

export function mergeEntries(prev: readonly ListEntry[], next: readonly { key: string; el: React.ReactNode }[]): ListEntry[] {
  const nextKeys = new Set(next.map(n => n.key));
  const at = new Map(prev.map((p, i) => [p.key, i]));
  const out: ListEntry[] = [];
  let pi = 0;
  const flushTo = (end: number) => {
    for (; pi < end; pi++) { const q = prev[pi]; if (!nextKeys.has(q.key)) out.push(q.leaving ? q : { ...q, leaving: true }); }
  };
  for (const n of next) {
    const i = at.get(n.key);
    if (i === undefined) { out.push({ key: n.key, el: n.el, leaving: false, opened: false, reveal: false }); continue; }
    flushTo(i);
    if (pi <= i) pi = i + 1;
    const p = prev[i];
    out.push({ key: n.key, el: n.el, leaving: false, opened: p.opened, reveal: p.reveal });
  }
  flushTo(prev.length);
  return out;
}

export const MotionList: React.FC<{
  gap?: number;
  empty?: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
}> = ({ gap = 0, empty, className, children }) => {
  const [, bump] = useState(0);
  const list = useRef<ListEntry[] | null>(null);
  const next: { key: string; el: React.ReactNode }[] = [];
  let auto = 0;
  React.Children.forEach(children, (c) => {
    if (!React.isValidElement(c)) return;
    next.push({ key: c.key != null ? String(c.key) : `\u0000i${auto++}`, el: c });
  });
  if (next.length === 0 && empty != null) next.push({ key: EMPTY_KEY, el: empty });
  const merged = list.current
    ? mergeEntries(list.current, next)
    : next.map(n => ({ key: n.key, el: n.el, leaving: false, opened: true, reveal: false }));
  list.current = merged;

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const fresh = list.current!.filter(e => !e.opened && !e.leaving);
    if (fresh.length === 0) return;
    const one = fresh.length === 1 && fresh[0].key !== EMPTY_KEY;
    for (const e of fresh) { e.opened = true; e.reveal = one; }
    bump(n => n + 1);
  });
  const drop = (key: string) => {
    const L = list.current;
    if (!L) return;
    const i = L.findIndex(e => e.key === key && e.leaving);
    if (i < 0) return;
    list.current = L.slice(0, i).concat(L.slice(i + 1));
    bump(n => n + 1);
  };

  return (
    <div className={className} style={{ display: 'flow-root' }}>
      <div style={gap ? { marginTop: -gap } : undefined}>
        {merged.map(e => (
          <Collapse key={e.key} open={e.opened && !e.leaving} gapPx={gap} reveal={e.reveal ? 'self' : 'none'} onClosed={() => drop(e.key)}>
            {e.el}
          </Collapse>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

function holdScrollThrough(el: HTMLElement | null, ms: number): void {
  let sc: HTMLElement | null = el?.parentElement ?? null;
  while (sc && sc !== document.body && !(/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(sc).overflowY) && sc.scrollHeight > sc.clientHeight + 1)) sc = sc.parentElement;
  if (!sc || sc === document.body || scrollGlideRuns(sc)) return;
  const box = sc, top = box.scrollTop, until = performance.now() + ms;
  let his = false;
  const mine = () => { his = true; };
  box.addEventListener('wheel', mine, { passive: true, once: true });
  box.addEventListener('pointerdown', mine, { once: true });
  box.addEventListener('keydown', mine, { once: true });
  const offGlide = onScrollGlideStart(g => { if (g === box) his = true; });
  const tick = () => {
    if (his || performance.now() > until) {
      box.removeEventListener('wheel', mine); box.removeEventListener('pointerdown', mine); box.removeEventListener('keydown', mine);
      offGlide();
      return;
    }
    if (Math.abs(box.scrollTop - top) > 0.5 && box.scrollHeight - box.clientHeight >= top) box.scrollTop = top;
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}

const SwapStage: React.FC<{ swapKey: unknown; className?: string; children?: React.ReactNode; hold?: boolean }> = ({ swapKey, className, children, hold = true }) => {
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const stage = useSwapStage(swapKey, { glide: true, box });
  const captureSize = useGlideSize(box, stage.shown, true, true);
  const lastKey = useRef(swapKey);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (Object.is(lastKey.current, swapKey)) return;
    lastKey.current = swapKey;
    lastFadeOutAt = performance.now();
    captureSize();
    if (hold) holdScrollThrough(box.current, 900);
  }, [swapKey]);
  const kept = useRef(children);
  const live = Object.is(stage.shown, swapKey);
  if (live) kept.current = children;
  return <div ref={box} inert={stage.inert} className={[className, stage.swapClass].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || undefined}>{live ? children : kept.current}</div>;
};

export const SwapBox: React.FC<{ swapKey: unknown; className?: string; children?: React.ReactNode }> = ({ swapKey, className, children }) => (
  <Collapse open={React.Children.toArray(children).length > 0} gapInside reveal="none">
    <SwapStage swapKey={swapKey} className={className}>{children}</SwapStage>
  </Collapse>
);

export const SwapInPlace = SwapStage;

export const SwapText: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode; className?: string }> = ({ children, className }) => {
  const key = typeof children === 'string' || typeof children === 'number' ? children : textKey(children);
  return <SwapStage swapKey={key} hold={false} className={className ? `k-swap-text ${className}` : 'k-swap-text'}>{children}</SwapStage>;
};
function textKey(n: React.ReactNode): string {
  if (n == null || typeof n === 'boolean') return '';
  if (typeof n === 'string' || typeof n === 'number') return String(n);
  if (Array.isArray(n)) return n.map(textKey).join('\u0001');
  if (React.isValidElement(n)) return '<' + (typeof n.type === 'string' ? n.type : 'c') + '>' + textKey((n.props as { children?: React.ReactNode }).children);
  return '';
}

export const Fade: React.FC<{ when: unknown; children: React.ReactNode | (() => React.ReactNode); className?: string; title?: string;
  keep?: boolean;
  delay?: number }> = ({ when, children, className, title, keep, delay = 0 }) => {
  const on = !!when;
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const [mountedRaw, setMounted] = useState(on);
  const mounted = keep || mountedRaw;
  const first = useRef(true);
  const kept = useRef<React.ReactNode>(null);
  if (on || (keep && kept.current === null)) kept.current = typeof children === 'function' ? (children as () => React.ReactNode)() : children;
  const inDelay = () => Math.max(delay, FOLD_FADE_MS - (performance.now() - lastFadeOutAt));
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (first.current) { first.current = false; if (el && !on) el.style.opacity = '0'; return; }
    if (on) { if (!mounted) setMounted(true); else if (el) glide(el, 'opacity', '1', FOLD_FADE_MS, { delay: inDelay() }); return; }
    if (!el) { setMounted(false); return; }
    leaveStarts(el);
    lastFadeOutAt = performance.now();
    glide(el, 'opacity', '0', FOLD_FADE_MS, { done: () => { if (!keep) setMounted(false); } });
  }, [on]);
  const wasMounted = useRef(mounted);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (mounted && !wasMounted.current && ref.current) glide(ref.current, 'opacity', '1', FOLD_FADE_MS, { from: '0', delay: inDelay() });
    wasMounted.current = mounted;
  }, [mounted]);
  if (!mounted) return null;
  return <span ref={ref} className={className} title={title} inert={!on || undefined} aria-hidden={!on || undefined}>{kept.current}</span>;
};

interface RowEntry { key: string; el: React.ReactElement; leaving: boolean }
const MotionRowItem: React.FC<{ grow?: boolean; className?: string; children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => <>{children}</>;
const MotionRowBase: React.FC<{ className?: string; style?: React.CSSProperties; children?: React.ReactNode;
  glideWidth?: boolean }> = ({ className, style, children, glideWidth }) => {
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [, bump] = useState(0);
  const list = useRef<RowEntry[] | null>(null);
  const fadeEnds = useRef(0);
  const timer = useRef(0);
  const committed = useRef(false);
  const next: { key: string; el: React.ReactElement }[] = [];
  React.Children.forEach(children, c => { if (React.isValidElement(c)) next.push({ key: String(c.key ?? next.length), el: c }); });
  const first = !committed.current;
  if (first) list.current = next.map(n => ({ ...n, leaving: false }));
  else {
    const prev = list.current!;
    const nextKeys = new Set(next.map(n => n.key));
    const prevAt = new Map<string, number>(prev.map((p, i) => [p.key, i] as [string, number]));
    const out: RowEntry[] = [];
    let pi = 0;
    const flushTo = (end: number) => { for (; pi < end; pi++) { const q = prev[pi]; if (!nextKeys.has(q.key)) out.push(q.leaving ? q : { ...q, leaving: true }); } };
    for (const n of next) {
      const i = prevAt.get(n.key);
      if (i !== undefined) { flushTo(i); if (pi <= i) pi = i + 1; }
      out.push({ key: n.key, el: n.el, leaving: false });
    }
    flushTo(prev.length);
    list.current = out;
  }
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const row = box.current;
    if (first) { committed.current = true; return; }
    if (!row) return;
    const els = new Map<string, HTMLElement>();
    row.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(':scope > [data-krow]').forEach(e => els.set(e.dataset.krow!, e));
    const now = performance.now();
    let work = false;
    for (const e of list.current!) {
      const el = els.get(e.key);
      if (!el) continue;
      if (e.leaving && el.dataset.on === '1') {
        el.dataset.on = 'f'; el.inert = true;
        leaveStarts(el);
        glide(el, 'opacity', '0', FOLD_FADE_MS);
        fadeEnds.current = Math.max(fadeEnds.current, now + FOLD_FADE_MS);
      } else if (!e.leaving && el.dataset.on === 'f') {
        el.dataset.on = '1'; el.inert = false;
        glide(el, 'opacity', '1', FOLD_FADE_MS);
      }
      if ((e.leaving && el.dataset.on === 'f') || (!e.leaving && el.dataset.on === 'new')) work = true;
    }
    if (!work) return;
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current);
    const reflow = () => {
      const opening: HTMLElement[] = [];
      let dropped = false;
      const moved = flowChange(row, () => {
        for (const e of list.current!) {
          const el = els.get(e.key);
          if (!el || !el.isConnected) continue;
          if (e.leaving && el.dataset.on === 'f') { el.dataset.on = '0'; el.style.display = 'none'; dropped = true; }
          else if (!e.leaving && el.dataset.on === 'new') { el.dataset.on = '1'; el.style.display = ''; el.style.opacity = '0'; opening.push(el); }
        }
      }, FOLD_MS, glideWidth);
      for (const el of opening) glide(el, 'opacity', '1', FOLD_FADE_MS, { from: '0', delay: moved ? FOLD_MS : 0 });
      if (dropped) { list.current = list.current!.filter(e => !(e.leaving && els.get(e.key)?.dataset.on === '0')); bump(n => n + 1); }
    };
    const wait = fadeEnds.current - now;
    if (wait > 4) timer.current = window.setTimeout(reflow, wait); else reflow();
  });
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), []);
  return (
    <div ref={box} className={className} style={style}>
      {list.current!.map(e => {
        const p = e.el.props as { grow?: boolean; className?: string; children?: React.ReactNode };
        return (
          <div key={e.key} data-krow={e.key} className={[p.grow ? 'flex flex-1 min-w-0' : 'flex shrink-0', p.className].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}
            ref={el => { if (el && el.dataset.on === undefined) { if (first) el.dataset.on = '1'; else { el.dataset.on = 'new'; el.style.display = 'none'; } } }}>
            {p.children}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};
export const MotionRow = Object.assign(MotionRowBase, { Item: MotionRowItem });

const PAGE_TRAIL_MAX = 24;
export const PageSwap: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactElement | null }> = ({ children }) => {
  const key = children ? children.key : null;
  const stage = useSwapStage<React.Key | null>(key);
  const kept = useRef<React.ReactElement | null>(children);
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const trail = useRef<{ key: React.Key | null; top: number }[]>([]);
  const leaving = useRef<{ key: React.Key | null; top: number } | null>(null);
  const memories = useRef(new Map<React.Key | null, Map<string, boolean>>());
  const memFor = useRef<React.Key | null | undefined>(undefined);
  const prevShown = useRef<React.Key | null>(stage.shown);
  const pver = usePanelsVersion();
  const memVer = useRef(pver);
  if (memVer.current !== pver) {
    memVer.current = pver;
    memories.current.forEach(m => m.clear());
    trail.current = [];
  }
  const viewport = (): HTMLElement | null => {
    const root = box.current?.firstElementChild;
    if (!root) return null;
    for (let c = root.lastElementChild; c; c = c.previousElementSibling) {
      const oy = getComputedStyle(c).overflowY;
      if (oy === 'auto' || oy === 'scroll') return c as HTMLElement;
    }
    return null;
  };
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (Object.is(key, stage.shown)) return;
    if (!leaving.current || !Object.is(leaving.current.key, stage.shown)) leaving.current = { key: stage.shown, top: viewport()?.scrollTop ?? 0 };
  }, [key]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (Object.is(prevShown.current, stage.shown)) return;
    prevShown.current = stage.shown;
    const t = trail.current;
    let i = -1;
    for (let j = t.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) if (Object.is(t[j].key, stage.shown)) { i = j; break; }
    const vp = viewport();
    if (i >= 0) {
      if (vp) vp.scrollTop = t[i].top;
      t.length = i;
    } else {
      if (leaving.current) { t.push(leaving.current); if (t.length > PAGE_TRAIL_MAX) t.shift(); }
      if (vp) vp.scrollTop = 0;
    }
    leaving.current = null;
  }, [stage.shown]);
  const live = Object.is(stage.shown, key);
  if (live) kept.current = children;
  const page = live ? children : kept.current;
  if (!page) return null;
  if (!Object.is(memFor.current, page.key)) {
    memFor.current = page.key;
    const back = trail.current.some(e => Object.is(e.key, page.key));
    if (!back || !memories.current.has(page.key)) memories.current.set(page.key, new Map());
    for (const k of memories.current.keys()) {
      if (Object.is(k, page.key) || (leaving.current && Object.is(leaving.current.key, k))) continue;
      if (!trail.current.some(e => Object.is(e.key, k))) memories.current.delete(k);
    }
  }
  const mem = memories.current.get(page.key)!;
  const props = page.props as { className?: string };
  const shownPage = stage.swapClass
    ? React.cloneElement(page as React.ReactElement<{ className?: string }>, { className: [props.className, stage.swapClass].filter(Boolean).join(' ') })
    : page;
  return <div ref={box} inert={stage.inert} style={{ display: 'contents' }}><FoldMemoryContext.Provider value={mem}>{shownPage}</FoldMemoryContext.Provider></div>;
};

export function usePanelSwap<K>(key: K): { hiddenOf: (k: K) => boolean; classOf: (k: K) => string; inertOf: (k: K) => boolean } {
  const stage = useSwapStage<K>(key);
  return {
    hiddenOf: (k: K) => !Object.is(stage.shown, k),
    classOf: (k: K) => (Object.is(stage.shown, k) ? stage.swapClass : ''),
    inertOf: (k: K) => Object.is(stage.shown, k) && stage.inert,
  };
}
import React, { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Skeleton } from './kit';
import { SnapshotSkeleton, useSkeletonCapture } from './SkeletonSnapshot';
import { arriveAfterWait, motionOff } from './presence';

const cx = (...c: (string | false | null | undefined)[]) => c.filter(Boolean).join(' ');

export function useAfterFirstPaint(): boolean {
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    let raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => { raf = 0; setReady(true); });
    return () => { if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf); };
  }, []);
  return ready;
}

export function usePresence(show: boolean, outMs = 120): { mounted: boolean; leaving: boolean } {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(show);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (show) { setMounted(true); return; }
    if (outMs <= 0) { setMounted(false); return; }
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setMounted(false), outMs);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [show, outMs]);
  return { mounted: show || (mounted && outMs > 0), leaving: !show && mounted && outMs > 0 };
}

export function useFadePresence(show: boolean, ms = 700): { mounted: boolean; style: React.CSSProperties } {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(show);
  const [on, setOn] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (show) {
      setMounted(true);
      let r2 = 0;
      const r1 = requestAnimationFrame(() => { r2 = requestAnimationFrame(() => setOn(true)); });
      return () => { cancelAnimationFrame(r1); cancelAnimationFrame(r2); };
    }
    setOn(false);
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setMounted(false), ms);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [show, ms]);
  const dur = reducedMotion() ? 1 : ms;
  return { mounted: show || mounted, style: { opacity: show && on ? 1 : 0, transition: `opacity ${dur}ms cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1)`, pointerEvents: show ? undefined : 'none' } };
}

const reducedMotion = motionOff;

export function useArrival(box: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, skel: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, ready: boolean, on = true): boolean {
  const bornAt = useRef(0);
  if (bornAt.current === 0) bornAt.current = performance.now();
  const seen = useRef<boolean | null>(null);
  if (ready && seen.current === null) seen.current = on && performance.now() - bornAt.current > 150;
  const [gone, setGone] = useState(false);
  const waitedH = useRef(0);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = box.current;
    if (!el || !on) return;
    if (!ready) { waitedH.current = el.offsetHeight; return; }
    if (!seen.current) return;
    const cancel = arriveAfterWait(el, skel.current, waitedH.current, () => setGone(true));
    return () => { cancel(); setGone(true); };
  }, [ready, on]);
  return on && (!ready || (!!seen.current && !gone));
}

export function useCameLate(ready: boolean): boolean {
  const bornAt = useRef(0);
  if (bornAt.current === 0) bornAt.current = performance.now();
  const late = useRef<boolean | null>(null);
  if (ready && late.current === null) late.current = performance.now() - bornAt.current > 150;
  return !!late.current;
}

const heights = new Map<string, number>();

interface DeferredProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  id?: string;
  estimate?: number;
  skeleton: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  skeletonClassName?: string;
  snapshot?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

export function Deferred({ children, id, estimate = 240, skeleton, className, skeletonClassName, style, snapshot }: DeferredProps) {
  const ready = useAfterFirstPaint();
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const skelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const skelOn = useArrival(boxRef, skelRef, ready);
  useLayoutEffect(() => { if (ready && id && boxRef.current) heights.set(id, boxRef.current.scrollHeight); }, [ready, id]);
  const waitH = (id && heights.get(id)) || estimate;
  useSkeletonCapture(snapshot ?? null, boxRef, ready && !skelOn);
  const skelEl = snapshot || ready
    ? <div ref={skelRef} className="k-skel-delay absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden" aria-hidden={ready || undefined}>{snapshot
      ? <SnapshotSkeleton id={snapshot} fallback={<div className={cx('h-full', skeletonClassName)}>{skeleton}</div>} />
      : <div className={cx('h-full', skeletonClassName)}>{skeleton}</div>}</div>
    : <div className={cx('k-skel-delay', skeletonClassName)}>{skeleton}</div>;
  return (
    <div ref={boxRef} className={cx(className, skelOn && (snapshot || ready) && 'relative')} aria-busy={ready ? undefined : true}
      style={ready ? style : { ...style, minHeight: waitH }}>
      {ready && children}
      {skelOn && skelEl}
    </div>
  );
}

export function PanelSkeleton({ cards = 3, rows = 3 }: { cards?: number; rows?: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3" aria-hidden>
      {Array.from({ length: cards }, (_, c) => (
        <div key={c} className="k-skel-card">
          <Skeleton w={`${34 + ((c * 17) % 22)}%`} h={12} r={4} />
          <div className="mt-4 space-y-3.5">
            {Array.from({ length: rows }, (_, r) => (
              <div key={r} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <Skeleton w={`${40 + ((c * 7 + r * 13) % 28)}%`} h={10} r={4} />
                <Skeleton w={r % 2 ? 36 : 64} h={r % 2 ? 20 : 24} r={r % 2 ? 10 : 6} />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
export interface DropZoneReg {
  el: () => HTMLElement | null;
  accepts: () => boolean;
  onDrop: (dt: DataTransfer) => void;
}

const WATCHDOG_MS = 300;

let _active = false;
let _x = 0, _y = 0;
let _lastOver = 0;
let _timer = 0;
let _installed = false;
let _version = 0;
const _zones = new Set<DropZoneReg>();
const _subs = new Set<() => void>();
let _onStray: (() => void) | null = null;

function emit(): void { _version++; _subs.forEach(f => f()); }

function isFiles(e: DragEvent): boolean {
  const t = e.dataTransfer?.types;
  if (!t) return false;
  for (let i = 0; i < t.length; i++) if (t[i] === 'Files') return true;
  return false;
}

function zoneAt(x: number, y: number): DropZoneReg | null {
  const hit = typeof document.elementFromPoint === 'function' ? document.elementFromPoint(x, y) : null;
  if (!hit) return null;
  for (const z of _zones) {
    const el = z.el();
    if (el && el.contains(hit) && z.accepts()) return z;
  }
  return null;
}

function end(): void {
  if (_timer) { window.clearInterval(_timer); _timer = 0; }
  if (!_active) return;
  _active = false;
  emit();
}

function install(): void {
  if (_installed || typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  _installed = true;
  const over = (e: DragEvent) => {
    if (!isFiles(e)) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const z = zoneAt(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    if (e.dataTransfer) e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = z ? 'copy' : 'none';
    _lastOver = performance.now();
    const moved = e.clientX !== _x || e.clientY !== _y;
    _x = e.clientX; _y = e.clientY;
    if (!_active) {
      _active = true;
      _timer = window.setInterval(() => { if (performance.now() - _lastOver > WATCHDOG_MS) end(); }, 100);
      emit();
    } else if (moved) emit();
  };
  const drop = (e: DragEvent) => {
    if (!isFiles(e)) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const z = zoneAt(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    end();
    if (z && e.dataTransfer) z.onDrop(e.dataTransfer);
    else _onStray?.();
  };
  window.addEventListener('dragenter', over, true);
  window.addEventListener('dragover', over, true);
  window.addEventListener('drop', drop, true);
  window.addEventListener('dragend', end, true);
}

export const dragWatch = {
  install,
  active(): boolean { return _active; },
  point(): { x: number; y: number } { return { x: _x, y: _y }; },
  version(): number { return _version; },
  subscribe(f: () => void): () => void { _subs.add(f); return () => { _subs.delete(f); }; },
  register(z: DropZoneReg): () => void { install(); _zones.add(z); return () => { _zones.delete(z); }; },
  over(z: DropZoneReg): boolean { return _active && zoneAt(_x, _y) === z; },
  setOnStray(fn: (() => void) | null): void { _onStray = fn; },
  _testEvent(type: 'over' | 'drop' | 'end', x: number, y: number, files = true, now?: number): void {
    const ev = { clientX: x, clientY: y, preventDefault() {}, dataTransfer: { types: files ? ['Files'] : ['text/plain'], dropEffect: 'none' } } as unknown as DragEvent;
    if (now !== undefined) _lastOver = now;
    if (type === 'end') { end(); return; }
    if (!isFiles(ev)) return;
    _x = x; _y = y; _lastOver = now ?? performance.now();
    if (type === 'over' && !_active) { _active = true; emit(); }
    else if (type === 'drop') end();
    else emit();
  },
  _testWatch(now: number): void { if (_active && now - _lastOver > WATCHDOG_MS) end(); },
};

export const DropMenu: React.FC<DropMenuProps> = ({ menu, className, role = 'menu', label, matchTriggerWidth, children }) => {
  const backdrop = useBackdropClose(menu.close);
  if (!menu.isOpen) return null;
  const width = matchTriggerWidth ? (menu.triggerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect().width ?? 0) / (menu.popupZoom || 1) : 0;
  return createPortal(
    <>
      <div className={`fixed inset-0 z-[9998]${menu.leaving ? ' pointer-events-none' : ''}`} {...backdrop} />
      <div
        ref={menu.popupRef as React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>}
        role={role}
        aria-label={label}
        className={`${className} z-[9999] ${menu.dropClass}`}
        style={width > 0 ? { ...menu.popupStyle, width } : menu.popupStyle}
      >
        <div className="k-drop-in">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </>,
    document.body,
  );
};
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { dragWatch, type DropZoneReg } from './dragWatch';
import { Upload, EMPTY_LINE } from '../ui/icons';

export const DROP_GRACE_MS = 150;

interface LatchTimers { set(f: () => void, ms: number): number; clear(t: number): void }

export class GraceLatch {
  private shown = false;
  private timer = 0;
  constructor(
    private onChange: (shown: boolean) => void,
    private timers: LatchTimers = { set: (f, ms) => window.setTimeout(f, ms), clear: t => window.clearTimeout(t) },
  ) {}
  set(over: boolean): void {
    if (over) {
      if (this.timer) { this.timers.clear(this.timer); this.timer = 0; }
      if (!this.shown) { this.shown = true; this.onChange(true); }
    } else if (this.shown && !this.timer) {
      this.timer = this.timers.set(() => { this.timer = 0; this.shown = false; this.onChange(false); }, DROP_GRACE_MS);
    }
  }
  dispose(): void { if (this.timer) { this.timers.clear(this.timer); this.timer = 0; } }
}

export function useDropTarget(box: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, enabled: boolean, onDrop: (dt: DataTransfer) => void): boolean {
  const on = useRef({ enabled, onDrop }); on.current = { enabled, onDrop };
  const reg = useMemo<DropZoneReg>(() => ({
    el: () => box.current,
    accepts: () => on.current.enabled,
    onDrop: (dt) => on.current.onDrop(dt),
  }), []);
  useEffect(() => dragWatch.register(reg), [reg]);
  const overNow = useCallback(() => dragWatch.over(reg), [reg]);
  const over = useSyncExternalStore(dragWatch.subscribe, overNow, () => false);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);
  const latch = useMemo(() => new GraceLatch(setShown), []);
  useEffect(() => { latch.set(over); }, [latch, over]);
  useEffect(() => () => latch.dispose(), [latch]);
  return shown;
}

);

export const DropZone: React.FC<{
  enabled: boolean;
  onDrop: (dt: DataTransfer) => void;
  label?: string;
  sub?: string;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
  boxRef?: React.MutableRefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}> = ({ enabled, onDrop, label, sub, className, style, boxRef, children }) => {
  const own = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const box = boxRef ?? own;
  const shown = useDropTarget(box, enabled, onDrop);
  return (
    <div ref={box} className={`relative ${className ?? ''}`} style={style}>
      {children}
      <DropOverlay shown={shown} label={label} sub={sub} />
    </div>
  );
};
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useLeave } from './presence';
import { useWindowLayer } from './windowStack';

const FOCUSABLE = 'button:not([disabled]), [href], input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
const FLOATING = '.k-drop, .k-ctx, .k-toast, .k-edit-value, .k-type-sheet, [role="tooltip"], [data-k-float]';

const stack: HTMLElement[] = [];
const top = (): HTMLElement | null => stack.length > 0 ? stack[stack.length - 1] : null;
let installed = false;

function tabbables(el: HTMLElement): HTMLElement[] {
  const out: HTMLElement[] = [];
  el.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE).forEach(x => { if (x.getClientRects().length > 0 && !x.closest('[inert]')) out.push(x); });
  return out;
}

function install(): void {
  if (installed || typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  installed = true;
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const w = top();
    if (!w || e.key !== 'Tab' || e.defaultPrevented) return;
    const t = e.target instanceof Element ? e.target : null;
    if (t && !w.contains(t) && t.closest(FLOATING)) return;
    const all = tabbables(w);
    if (all.length === 0) { e.preventDefault(); w.focus({ preventScroll: true }); return; }
    const first = all[0], last = all[all.length - 1], at = document.activeElement;
    const inside = !!at && w.contains(at);
    if (!inside) { e.preventDefault(); (e.shiftKey ? last : first).focus(); return; }
    if (e.shiftKey && (at === first || at === w)) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
    else if (!e.shiftKey && (at === last || at === w)) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
  }, true);
  document.addEventListener('focusin', (e) => {
    const w = top();
    const t = e.target instanceof Element ? e.target : null;
    if (!w || !t || w.contains(t) || t.closest(FLOATING)) return;
    w.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, true);
}

export function useFocusScope(ref: { readonly current: HTMLElement | null }): void {
  const firstBefore = useRef<Element | null | undefined>(undefined);
  if (firstBefore.current === undefined) firstBefore.current = typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.activeElement : null;
  const tracked = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const before = useRef<Element | null>(null);
  const firstCommit = useRef(true);
  const release = () => {
    const el = tracked.current;
    if (!el) return;
    tracked.current = null;
    const i = stack.lastIndexOf(el);
    if (i >= 0) stack.splice(i, 1);
    const b = before.current as HTMLElement | null;
    const now = document.activeElement;
    if (b && b !== document.body && b.isConnected && typeof b.focus === 'function' && (!now || now === document.body || el.contains(now)))
      b.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  };
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    const atFirst = firstCommit.current;
    firstCommit.current = false;
    if (el === tracked.current) return;
    release();
    if (!el) return;
    install();
    tracked.current = el;
    before.current = atFirst ? firstBefore.current ?? null : document.activeElement;
    stack.push(el);
    if (!el.contains(document.activeElement)) el.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  });
  useLayoutEffect(() => release, []);
}

export function useWindowFrame(f: { scrim: { readonly current: HTMLElement | null }; card: { readonly current: HTMLElement | null };
  focus?: { readonly current: HTMLElement | null }; closing: boolean }): void {
  useFocusScope(f.focus ?? f.card);
  const layer = useWindowLayer(!f.closing);
  useLeave(f.card, f.closing || layer.covered, 'pop');
  useLeave(f.scrim, f.closing, 'fade');
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = f.scrim.current;
    if (el) { el.classList.toggle('k-scrim-over', layer.over); el.classList.toggle('k-scrim-covered', layer.covered); }
  });
}

export function focusScopes(): readonly HTMLElement[] { return stack; }

const cx = (...c: (string | false | null | undefined)[]) => c.filter(Boolean).join(' ');

export type ButtonVariant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'danger';
export type ButtonSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
const BTN_VARIANT: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = { primary: 'k-btn-primary', secondary: 'k-btn-secondary', ghost: 'k-btn-ghost', danger: 'k-btn-danger' };
const BTN_SIZE: Record<ButtonSize, string> = { sm: 'k-btn-sm', md: 'k-btn-md', lg: 'k-btn-lg' };
const ICON_BTN_SIZE = { sm: 'k-icon-btn-sm', md: 'k-icon-btn-md', lg: 'k-icon-btn-lg' } as const;
interface ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  iconRight?: React.ReactNode;
  block?: boolean;
}
export const Button = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(function Button(
  { variant = 'secondary', size = 'md', icon, iconRight, block, className, children, type = 'button', ...rest }, ref,
) {
  return (
    <button ref={ref} type={type} className={cx('k-btn', BTN_VARIANT[variant], BTN_SIZE[size], block && 'w-full', className)} {...rest}>
      {icon && <span className="k-btn-icon">{icon}</span>}
      {children != null && <span className="truncate">{children}</span>}
      {iconRight && <span className="k-btn-icon">{iconRight}</span>}
    </button>
  );
});

interface IconButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  label: string;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  active?: boolean;
}
export const IconButton = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, IconButtonProps>(function IconButton(
  { label, size = 'md', active, className, children, type = 'button', ...rest }, ref,
) {
  return (
    <button ref={ref} type={type} aria-label={label} title={label} className={cx('k-icon-btn', ICON_BTN_SIZE[size], active && 'k-icon-btn-active', className)} {...rest}>
      {children}
    </button>
  );
});

interface GroupProps {
  title?: string;
  foldKey?: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  count?: string | number;
  right?: React.ReactNode;
  collapsible?: boolean;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  open?: boolean;
  onToggle?: (open: boolean) => void;
  level?: 2 | 3;
  flush?: boolean;
  hidden?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  boxRef?: React.Ref<HTMLElement>;
  handle?: React.MutableRefObject<FoldHandle | null>;
  inert?: boolean;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
}
const PanelFoldContext = React.createContext(false);
export const PanelFold: React.FC<{ on: boolean; children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ on, children }) => (
  <PanelFoldContext.Provider value={on}>{children}</PanelFoldContext.Provider>
);
export const CardNestContext = React.createContext(false);

export const Group: React.FC<GroupProps> = ({ title, foldKey, icon, count, right, collapsible: collapsibleProp, defaultOpen = true, open, onToggle, level = 2, flush, hidden, className, boxRef, handle, inert, children }: GroupProps) => {
  const panelFold = useContext(PanelFoldContext);
  const collapsible = collapsibleProp ?? (panelFold && title != null && title !== '');
  const foldMem = useContext(FoldMemoryContext);
  const memKey = foldKey ?? (typeof title === 'string' && title !== '' ? title : null);
  const scope = usePanelScope();
  const projKey = scope && memKey && collapsible ? scope + '/' + memKey : null;
  const nested = useContext(CardNestContext);
  const startOpen = (): boolean => (!nested && collapsible ? cardStartsOpen(scope, memKey) : undefined) ?? defaultOpen;
  const kept = (): boolean => {
    if (memKey && foldMem?.has(memKey)) return foldMem.get(memKey)!;
    const p = projKey ? panelMemory.fold(projKey) : undefined;
    return p ?? startOpen();
  };
  const [own, setOwn] = useState(kept);
  const pver = usePanelsVersion();
  const seenVer = useRef(pver);
  useEffect(() => { if (seenVer.current !== pver) { seenVer.current = pver; if (open === undefined) setOwn(kept()); } });
  const isOpen = open ?? own;
  const foldBusy = useRef(false);
  const toggle = () => { if (foldBusy.current) return; const n = !isOpen; if (open === undefined) { setOwn(n); if (memKey) foldMem?.set(memKey, n); if (projKey) panelMemory.setFold(projKey, n); } onToggle?.(n); };
  const selfEl = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const boxRefNow = useRef(boxRef);
  boxRefNow.current = boxRef;
  const setBox = useCallback((n: HTMLElement | null) => {
    selfEl.current = n;
    const r = boxRefNow.current;
    if (typeof r === 'function') r(n); else if (r) (r as React.MutableRefObject<HTMLElement | null>).current = n;
  }, []);
  useFoldHandle(handle, selfEl, !collapsible || isOpen, toggle);
  const countMark = <Fade when={count != null} className="k-count">{() => <SwapText>{count}</SwapText>}</Fade>;
  const rightMark = <Fade when={right != null} className="flex items-center gap-2">{right}</Fade>;
  const head = title != null && (
    <div className="k-group-head">
      <span className="k-group-title">
        {icon && <span className="k-group-icon">{icon}</span>}
        <span className="truncate"><SwapText className="truncate">{title}</SwapText></span>
        {countMark}
      </span>
      <span className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
        {rightMark}
        {collapsible && <ChevronDown size={14} className={cx('k-chevron', isOpen && 'k-chevron-open')} />}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
  const barWithActions = collapsible && right !== undefined && title != null && (
    <div className="k-group-bar">
      <button type="button" className="k-group-hit" aria-expanded={isOpen} onClick={toggle}><span className="sr-only">{title}</span></button>
      <span className="k-group-title">
        {icon && <span className="k-group-icon">{icon}</span>}
        <span className="truncate"><SwapText className="truncate">{title}</SwapText></span>
        {countMark}
      </span>
      <span className="k-group-right">
        {rightMark}
        <ChevronDown size={14} className={cx('k-chevron', isOpen && 'k-chevron-open')} />
      </span>
    </div>
  );
  return (
    <section ref={setBox} inert={inert || undefined} className={cx('k-group', level === 3 ? 'k-l3' : 'k-l2', head && 'k-titled', hidden && 'hidden', className)} hidden={hidden || undefined}>
      {barWithActions || (head && (collapsible
        ? <button type="button" className="k-group-toggle" aria-expanded={isOpen} onClick={toggle}>{head}</button>
        : head))}
      {children != null && (collapsible
        ? <Collapse open={isOpen} onBusyChange={b => { foldBusy.current = b; }}><div className={cx('k-group-main', !flush && 'k-group-body')}><CardNestContext.Provider value={true}>{children}</CardNestContext.Provider></div></Collapse>
        : <div className={cx('k-group-main', !flush && 'k-group-body')}><CardNestContext.Provider value={true}>{children}</CardNestContext.Provider></div>)}
    </section>
  );
};

export function headerIcon(I: AppIcon): React.ReactNode { return <I size={12} strokeWidth={2.006} />; }

interface RowTextProps {
  label: React.ReactNode; description?: React.ReactNode; help?: string; icon?: React.ReactNode; hidden?: boolean;
  mark?: React.ReactNode;
  locked?: boolean;
  note?: React.ReactNode;
  why?: string;
}
const WhyOffContext = React.createContext<string | undefined>(undefined);
function withWhy(why: string | undefined, tip: React.ReactNode): React.ReactNode {
  if (!why) return tip;
  if (tip == null || tip === false || tip === '') return why;
  return typeof tip === 'string' ? `${why} ${tip}` : <>{why}<br />{tip}</>;
}
export function useWhyTip(tip: string | undefined, own?: string): string | undefined {
  const block = useContext(WhyOffContext);
  return withWhy(own || block, tip) as string | undefined;
}
export const Dim: React.FC<{ when: unknown; why?: string; className?: string; children?: React.ReactNode }> = ({ when, why, className, children }) => {
  const outer = useContext(WhyOffContext);
  const on = !!when;
  return (
    <div className={cx(className, on && 'k-row-disabled')}>
      <WhyOffContext.Provider value={on ? (why ?? outer) : outer}>{children}</WhyOffContext.Provider>
    </div>
  );
};
function joinTip(description: React.ReactNode, help?: string): React.ReactNode {
  if (description == null || description === false || description === '') return help;
  if (typeof description === 'string') {
    if (!help) return description;
    const d = description.trim();
    return /[.!?:]$/.test(d) ? `${d} ${help}` : `${d}. ${help}`;
  }
  return help ? <>{description}<br />{help}</> : description;
}
export const LOCK_MARK = <Lock size={14} />;
function RowText({ label, description, help, icon, mark, note, locked, why, off }: RowTextProps & { off?: boolean }) {
  const keepLine = !!icon && description != null && description !== false && description !== '';
  const blockWhy = useContext(WhyOffContext);
  const tip = withWhy((off && why) || blockWhy, keepLine ? help : joinTip(description, help));
  const lead = mark ?? (locked ? LOCK_MARK : undefined);
  return (
    <span className="k-row-text">
      <span className="k-row-label">
        {icon && <span className="k-row-icon">{icon}</span>}
        <Fade when={tip || lead} className="k-row-lead">{() => (tip ? <HelpTooltip text={tip} icon={lead} /> : lead)}</Fade>
        <span className="k-row-label-text">{label}</span>
      </span>
      {keepLine && <span className="k-row-desc">{description}</span>}
      <Collapse open={note != null && note !== false && note !== ''} reveal="none" className="k-row-note">
        <span className="k-row-desc block">{note}</span>
      </Collapse>
    </span>
  );
}

export function RowLabel({ label, help, className }: { label: React.ReactNode; help?: string; className?: string }) {
  const tip = useWhyTip(help);
  return (
    <span className={cx('k-row-label', className)}>
      <Fade when={tip} className="k-row-lead">{() => <HelpTooltip text={tip!} />}</Fade>
      <span className="k-row-label-text">{label}</span>
    </span>
  );
}

}

      <RowText {...text} off={disabled} />

interface SliderRowProps extends RowTextProps {
  value: number; onChange: (v: number) => void; min: number; max: number; step?: SliderStep;
  keepFraction?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean; unit?: string; display?: string; minLabel?: string; maxLabel?: string;
  onCommit?: (v: number) => void;
  deferred?: boolean;
  format?: (v: number) => string;
  inputMin?: number;
  inputMax?: number;
  action?: React.ReactNode;
  logScale?: boolean;
}
export const SliderRow: React.FC<SliderRowProps> = ({ value, onChange, min, max, keepFraction, step = 1, disabled: off, unit, display, minLabel, maxLabel, onCommit, deferred, format, inputMin, inputMax, action, hidden, logScale, ...text }: SliderRowProps) => {
  const disabled = off || text.locked;
  const [drag, setDrag] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const dragging = useRef(false);
  const latest = useRef(value);
  const shown = deferred && drag !== null ? drag : value;
  const { lo, hi } = sliderDomain(min, max, shown, step);
  const tr = (x: number) => (logScale ? Math.log(Math.max(1e-9, x)) : x);
  const un = (x: number) => (logScale ? Math.exp(x) : x);
  const tStep: SliderStep = logScale ? 0.01 : step;
  const endDrag = () => {
    if (!dragging.current) return;
    dragging.current = false;
    const final = latest.current;
    setDrag(null);
    if (final !== value) onChange(final);
  };
  const shownText = format ? format(shown) : display;
  return (
    <div className={cx('k-slider-row', text.locked ? 'k-row-locked' : disabled && 'k-row-disabled', hidden && 'hidden')} hidden={hidden || undefined}>
      <div className="k-row">
        <RowText {...text} off={off} />
        <span className="k-value">
          <EditableValue value={shown} onChange={onCommit ? (v) => { onChange(v); onCommit(v); } : onChange} min={inputMin ?? lo} max={inputMax ?? hi} step={step} keepFraction={keepFraction} disabled={disabled} displayValue={shownText} className="k-value-field" />
          {unit && <span className="k-unit">{unit}</span>}
          {action}
        </span>
      </div>
      {deferred ? (
        <input type="range" min={tr(lo)} max={tr(hi)} step={tStep} value={tr(shown)} disabled={disabled}
          onPointerDown={() => { dragging.current = true; latest.current = value; setDrag(value); }}
          onChange={e => { const v = un(parseFloat(e.target.value)); if (dragging.current) { latest.current = v; setDrag(v); } else onChange(v); }}
          onPointerUp={endDrag} onLostPointerCapture={endDrag}
          style={sliderFillStyle(tr(shown), tr(lo), tr(hi))} className="w-full" />
      ) : (
        <input type="range" min={tr(lo)} max={tr(hi)} step={tStep} value={tr(value)} disabled={disabled}
          onChange={e => onChange(un(parseFloat(e.target.value)))}
          onPointerUp={onCommit ? (e) => onCommit(un(parseFloat((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value))) : undefined}
          onKeyUp={onCommit ? (e) => { if (/^(Arrow|Home|End|Page)/.test(e.key)) onCommit(un(parseFloat((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value))); } : undefined}
          style={sliderFillStyle(tr(value), tr(lo), tr(hi))} className="w-full" />
      )}
      {(minLabel || maxLabel) && <div className="k-slider-ends"><span>{minLabel}</span><span>{maxLabel}</span></div>}
    </div>
  );
};

interface PickRowProps { title: React.ReactNode; meta?: React.ReactNode; selected?: boolean; onPick: () => void; actions?: React.ReactNode; icon?: React.ReactNode;
  onContextMenu?: React.MouseEventHandler<HTMLDivElement>;
  tags?: TagItem[];
  onRename?: () => void;
  renaming?: React.ReactNode;
  facts?: { key: string; text: string }[] }
export const PickRow: React.FC<PickRowProps> = ({ title, meta, selected, onPick, actions, icon, onContextMenu, tags, onRename, renaming, facts }) => {
  return (
    <div role="button" tabIndex={0} aria-pressed={!!selected} className={cx('k-pick', selected && 'k-pick-on')} onClick={onPick} onContextMenu={onContextMenu}
      onDoubleClick={onRename ? (e => { if ((e.target as Element).closest('.k-pick-title')) onRename(); }) : undefined}
      onKeyDown={e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget && (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')) { e.preventDefault(); onPick(); } }}>
      {icon && <span className="k-pick-icon">{icon}</span>}
      <span className="k-pick-text">
        <SwapInPlace swapKey={renaming != null} hold={false} className="min-w-0">
        {renaming ?? (tags
          ? <TagTitle title={title} tags={tags} />
          : <span className="k-pick-title">{title}</span>)}
        </SwapInPlace>
        {meta && <span className="k-pick-meta">{meta}</span>}
        {facts && <span className="k-pick-facts k-fade"><InlineMotion items={facts.map(f => ({ key: f.key, node: <Chip>{f.text}</Chip> }))} /></span>}
      </span>
      {actions && <span className="k-pick-actions" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>{actions}</span>}
    </div>
  );
};

interface ChipProps {
  children: React.ReactNode; active?: boolean; onClick?: () => void; title?: string;
  unusable?: string;
}
export const Chip: React.FC<ChipProps> = ({ children, active, onClick, title, unusable }: ChipProps) => {
  if (onClick && unusable) {
    return <button type="button" data-tip={unusable} aria-disabled="true" className="k-chip k-chip-click">{children}</button>;
  }
  return onClick
    ? <button type="button" title={title} onClick={onClick} className={cx('k-chip k-chip-click', active && 'k-chip-on')}>{children}</button>
    : <span title={title} className={cx('k-chip', active && 'k-chip-on')}>{children}</span>;
};

interface SkeletonProps { w?: number | string; h?: number | string; r?: number | string; className?: string; style?: React.CSSProperties }
export const Skeleton: React.FC<SkeletonProps> = ({ w = '100%', h = 12, r = 6, className, style }) => (
  <span aria-hidden className={cx('skeleton-shimmer k-skel', className)} style={{ width: w, height: h, borderRadius: r, ...style }} />
);
export function SkeletonText({ lines = 1, lineHeight = 16, size = 10, lastWidth = '60%' }: { lines?: number; lineHeight?: number; size?: number; lastWidth?: number | string }) {
  return (
    <span aria-hidden className="flex flex-col" style={{ gap: lineHeight - size }}>
      {Array.from({ length: lines }, (_, i) => <Skeleton key={i} h={size} r={4} w={i === lines - 1 && lines > 1 ? lastWidth : '100%'} />)}
    </span>
  );
}
export function useLoadingAfter(loading: boolean, ms = 150): boolean {
  const [held, setHeld] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loading) { setHeld(false); return; }
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setHeld(true), ms);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [loading, ms]);
  return loading && held;
}
export function Loadable({ ready, skeleton, children, className }: { ready: boolean; skeleton: React.ReactNode; children: React.ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  return ready ? <div className={cx('k-fade-in', className)}>{children}</div> : <div className={className} aria-busy="true">{skeleton}</div>;
}
import React, { useCallback, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Collapse, EMPTY_KEY, mergeEntries, type ListEntry } from './Collapse';
import { nearestScrollTop, scrollGlide } from './presence';

const OVERSCAN = 480;
const MARGIN = 160;
const FIRST_ROWS = 20;

function scrollerOf(el: HTMLElement | null): HTMLElement | null {
  for (let p = el?.parentElement ?? null; p && p !== document.body; p = p.parentElement) {
    if (/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(p).overflowY)) return p;
  }
  return null;
}
function topsOf(keys: readonly string[], heights: ReadonlyMap<string, number>, estimate: number): Float64Array {
  const t = new Float64Array(keys.length + 1);
  let y = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) { t[i] = y; y += heights.get(keys[i]) ?? estimate; }
  t[keys.length] = y;
  return t;
}
function rowAt(t: Float64Array, n: number, y: number): number {
  let lo = 0, hi = n - 1;
  while (lo < hi) { const mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1; if (t[mid] <= y) lo = mid; else hi = mid - 1; }
  return lo;
}
const zoomOf = (s: HTMLElement, r: DOMRect): number => (s.offsetHeight > 0 && r.height > 0 ? r.height / s.offsetHeight : 1);

export interface RowWindow {
  a: number; b: number;
  above: number; below: number;
  keys: readonly string[];
  all: ReadonlySet<string>;
  box: React.MutableRefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  rows: React.MutableRefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  reveal: (key: string) => void;
}

export function useRowWindow(count: number, rowKey: (i: number) => string, estimate: number): RowWindow {
  const box = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const rows = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const scroller = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const heights = useRef(new Map<string, number>());
  const [range, setRange] = useState({ a: 0, b: FIRST_ROWS });
  const rangeNow = useRef(range);
  const raf = useRef(0);
  const ro = useRef<ResizeObserver | null>(null);
  const observed = useRef(new Set<Element>());

  const keys: string[] = new Array(count);
  const all = new Set<string>();
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) { const k = rowKey(i); keys[i] = k; all.add(k); }
  const tops = topsOf(keys, heights.current, estimate);
  const a = Math.min(range.a, count), b = Math.max(a, Math.min(range.b, count));

  const live = useRef({ keys, tops, estimate, all, dirty: false });
  live.current.keys = keys; live.current.tops = tops; live.current.estimate = estimate; live.current.all = all; live.current.dirty = false;
  const freshTops = () => {
    const L = live.current;
    if (L.dirty) { L.tops = topsOf(L.keys, heights.current, L.estimate); L.dirty = false; }
    return L.tops;
  };

  const check = useCallback(() => {
    raf.current = 0;
    const el = box.current, s = scroller.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const n = live.current.keys.length;
    const was = rangeNow.current;
    if (!s) {
      if (was.a !== 0 || was.b < n) { const r = { a: 0, b: n }; rangeNow.current = r; setRange(r); }
      return;
    }
    const t = freshTops();
    const sr = s.getBoundingClientRect(), lr = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const top = (sr.top - lr.top) / zoomOf(s, sr) + s.clientTop, bot = top + s.clientHeight;
    const A = Math.min(was.a, n), B = Math.min(was.b, n);
    if ((A === 0 || top - t[A] >= MARGIN) && (B >= n || t[B] - bot >= MARGIN)) return;
    const na = n === 0 ? 0 : rowAt(t, n, top - OVERSCAN);
    const nb = n === 0 ? 0 : Math.min(n, rowAt(t, n, bot + OVERSCAN) + 1);
    if (na !== A || nb !== B) { const r = { a: na, b: nb }; rangeNow.current = r; setRange(r); }
  }, []);
  const soon = useCallback(() => { if (!raf.current) raf.current = requestAnimationFrame(check); }, [check]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const s = scrollerOf(box.current);
    scroller.current = s;
    const seenSize = new ResizeObserver(soon);
    if (s) {
      s.addEventListener('scroll', soon, { passive: true });
      seenSize.observe(s);
      if (s.firstElementChild) seenSize.observe(s.firstElementChild);
    }
    ro.current = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
      for (const e of entries) {
        const r = e.target as HTMLElement, k = r.dataset.ll;
        if (k === undefined || !r.isConnected || !live.current.all.has(k)) continue;
        const h = r.offsetHeight;
        if (h > 0 && heights.current.get(k) !== h) { heights.current.set(k, h); live.current.dirty = true; }
      }
      if (live.current.dirty) soon();
    });
    return () => {
      if (raf.current) cancelAnimationFrame(raf.current);
      raf.current = 0;
      if (s) s.removeEventListener('scroll', soon);
      seenSize.disconnect();
      ro.current?.disconnect();
    };
  }, [soon]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const host = rows.current;
    if (host) {
      for (let c = host.firstElementChild; c; c = c.nextElementSibling) {
        const r = c as HTMLElement, k = r.dataset.ll;
        if (k === undefined || !all.has(k)) continue;
        const h = r.offsetHeight;
        if (h > 0 && heights.current.get(k) !== h) { heights.current.set(k, h); live.current.dirty = true; }
        if (!observed.current.has(r)) { observed.current.add(r); ro.current?.observe(r); }
      }
      if (observed.current.size > (b - a) + 16) observed.current.forEach(el => { if (!el.isConnected) { ro.current?.unobserve(el); observed.current.delete(el); } });
      if (heights.current.size > count * 2 + 64) heights.current.forEach((_h, k) => { if (!all.has(k)) heights.current.delete(k); });
    }
    check();
  });

  const reveal = useCallback((key: string) => {
    const s = scroller.current, el = box.current;
    if (!s || !el) return;
    const i = live.current.keys.indexOf(key);
    if (i < 0) return;
    const t = freshTops();
    const sr = s.getBoundingClientRect(), lr = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const at = (lr.top - sr.top) / zoomOf(s, sr) - s.clientTop + s.scrollTop + t[i];
    const to = nearestScrollTop(s, at, t[i + 1] - t[i], 8);
    if (to != null) scrollGlide(s, Math.max(0, to));
  }, []);

  return { a, b, above: tops[a], below: tops[count] - tops[b], keys, all, box, rows, reveal };
}

export interface LongListProps {
  count: number;
  rowKey: (index: number) => string;
  renderRow: (index: number) => React.ReactNode;
  gap?: number;
  estimate?: number;
  empty?: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  reveal?: string | null;
}

export const LongList: React.FC<LongListProps> = ({ count, rowKey, renderRow, gap = 0, estimate = 56, empty, className, reveal }) => {
  const win = useRowWindow(count, rowKey, estimate + gap);
  const [, bump] = useState(0);
  const list = useRef<ListEntry[] | null>(null);
  const known = useRef<ReadonlySet<string> | null>(null);
  const next: { key: string; el: React.ReactNode }[] = [];
  for (let i = win.a; i < win.b; i++) next.push({ key: win.keys[i], el: renderRow(i) });
  if (count === 0 && empty != null) next.push({ key: EMPTY_KEY, el: empty });
  let merged: ListEntry[];
  if (!list.current || !known.current) {
    merged = next.map(n => ({ key: n.key, el: n.el, leaving: false, opened: true, reveal: false }));
  } else {
    const inNext = new Set(next.map(n => n.key));
    const stays = list.current.filter(e => inNext.has(e.key) || e.key === EMPTY_KEY || !win.all.has(e.key));
    merged = mergeEntries(stays, next);
    for (const e of merged) if (!e.opened && !e.leaving && known.current.has(e.key)) e.opened = true;
  }
  list.current = merged;
  known.current = win.all;

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const fresh = list.current!.filter(e => !e.opened && !e.leaving);
    if (fresh.length === 0) return;
    const one = fresh.length === 1 && fresh[0].key !== EMPTY_KEY;
    for (const e of fresh) { e.opened = true; e.reveal = one; }
    bump(n => n + 1);
  });
  const drop = (key: string) => {
    const L = list.current;
    if (!L) return;
    const i = L.findIndex(e => e.key === key && e.leaving);
    if (i < 0) return;
    list.current = L.slice(0, i).concat(L.slice(i + 1));
    bump(n => n + 1);
  };
  const lastReveal = useRef<string | null | undefined>(undefined);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (reveal === lastReveal.current) return;
    lastReveal.current = reveal;
    if (reveal != null) win.reveal(reveal);
  }, [reveal]);

  const space = (h: number): React.CSSProperties => ({ height: h, ['--vl-row' as string]: `${estimate}px` });
  return (
    <div ref={el => { win.box.current = el; }} className={className} style={{ display: 'flow-root' }}>
      <div ref={el => { win.rows.current = el; }} style={gap ? { marginTop: -gap } : undefined}>
        {win.above > 0 ? <div key={'\u0000above'} className="k-vl-skel" style={space(win.above)} aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
        {merged.map(e => (
          <Collapse key={e.key} dataKey={e.key} open={e.opened && !e.leaving} gapPx={gap} reveal={e.reveal ? 'self' : 'none'} onClosed={() => drop(e.key)}>
            {e.el}
          </Collapse>
        ))}
        {win.below > 0 ? <div key={'\u0000below'} className="k-vl-skel" style={space(win.below)} aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export function titleIcon(icon: React.ReactNode): React.ReactNode {
  if (!React.isValidElement(icon) || typeof icon.type === 'string') return icon;
  return React.cloneElement(icon as React.ReactElement<{ strokeWidth?: number; absoluteStrokeWidth?: boolean }>, { strokeWidth: 1.5, absoluteStrokeWidth: true });
}
