export function Backdrop({ onClose, z = 60, className, closing, children }: { onClose: () => void; z?: number; className?: string; closing?: boolean; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const backdropProps = useBackdropClose(onClose);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useLeave(ref, !!closing, 'fade');
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={cx('k-backdrop animate-fadeIn', closing && 'pointer-events-none', className)} style={{ zIndex: z }} {...backdropProps}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export type ModalSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';
const WIDTH: Record<ModalSize, number> = { sm: 380, md: 560, lg: 880, xl: 1180 };

interface ModalProps {
  title: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  onClose: () => void;
  size?: ModalSize;
  width?: number;
  headerRight?: React.ReactNode;
  subtitle?: React.ReactNode;
  footer?: React.ReactNode | ((close: (after?: () => void) => void) => React.ReactNode);
  children: React.ReactNode;
  bodyClassName?: string;
  fit?: boolean;
  z?: number;
  closeLabel?: string;
  themeSwitch?: boolean;
  surface?: 'panel' | 'content';
  defer?: boolean;
  waitHeight?: number;
  phoneFull?: boolean;
}

const ModalCloseContext = React.createContext<((after?: () => void) => void) | null>(null);
export function useModalClose(): (after?: () => void) => void {
  const c = React.useContext(ModalCloseContext);
  return c ?? ((after?: () => void) => { after?.(); });
}

const bodyHeights = new Map<string, number>();

export function Modal({ title, icon, onClose, size = 'md', width, headerRight, subtitle, footer, children, bodyClassName, fit, z = 60, closeLabel = 'Close', themeSwitch, surface = 'panel', defer, waitHeight = 240, phoneFull }: ModalProps) {
  const [closing, setClosing] = useState(false);
  const closingRef = useRef(false);
  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useBlurOnUnmount(dialogRef);
  const close = useCallback((after?: unknown) => {
    if (closingRef.current) return;
    closingRef.current = true;
    blurFocusedField(dialogRef.current);
    setClosing(true);
    window.setTimeout(typeof after === 'function' ? (after as () => void) : onClose, CLOSE_MS);
  }, [onClose]);
  useEscapeOwner(close);
  useFocusScope(dialogRef);
  const layer = useWindowLayer(!closing);
  useLeave(dialogRef, closing || layer.covered, 'pop');
  const menuScale = usePortalMenuScale();
  const full = !!phoneFull && isPhoneUi();
  const maxH = useModalMaxHeight(full ? 0 : undefined);
  const maxW = useModalMaxWidth(full ? 0 : undefined);
  const deferOn = defer ?? size !== 'sm';
  const painted = useAfterFirstPaint();
  const ready = painted || !deferOn;
  const bodyRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const skelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const arriving = useArrival(bodyRef, skelRef, ready, deferOn);
  const skelOn = !ready || arriving;
  useLayoutEffect(() => { if (ready && deferOn && bodyRef.current) bodyHeights.set(title, bodyRef.current.scrollHeight); }, [ready, deferOn, title]);
  const waitH = Math.min(bodyHeights.get(title) ?? waitHeight, Math.max(120, maxH - 140));
  useSkeletonCapture(deferOn ? 'modal:' + title : null, bodyRef, ready);
  const flush = !!bodyClassName?.includes('k-modal-body-flush');
  return createPortal(
    <Backdrop onClose={close} z={z} closing={closing} className={layer.over ? 'k-scrim-over' : undefined}>
      <div style={{ zoom: menuScale }}>
        <div ref={dialogRef} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={title} tabIndex={-1}
          className={cx('k-modal animate-scaleUp', surface === 'content' && 'k-modal-content', full && 'k-modal-full', (closing || layer.covered) && 'pointer-events-none')}
          style={full ? { width: maxW, height: maxH } : { width: Math.min(width ?? WIDTH[size], maxW), maxHeight: maxH }} onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
          <header className="k-modal-head">
            {icon && <span className="k-modal-icon">{titleIcon(icon)}</span>}
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <h2 className="k-modal-title truncate"><SwapText className="truncate">{title}</SwapText></h2>
              {subtitle && <div className="k-modal-sub truncate"><SwapText className="truncate">{subtitle}</SwapText></div>}
            </div>
            {headerRight}
            {(themeSwitch ?? size !== 'sm') && <ThemeSwitch />}
            <IconButton label={closeLabel} onClick={close}><X size={18} /></IconButton>
          </header>
          <div ref={bodyRef} className={cx('k-modal-body', fit ? 'overflow-hidden' : 'overflow-y-auto popup-scrollbar', bodyClassName, skelOn && 'relative')}
            style={ready ? undefined : { minHeight: waitH }} aria-busy={ready ? undefined : true}>
            <ModalCloseContext.Provider value={close}><PanelFold on={false}>{ready && children}</PanelFold></ModalCloseContext.Provider>
            {skelOn && (
              <div ref={skelRef} className="k-skel-delay absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden" aria-hidden={ready || undefined}>
                <SnapshotSkeleton id={'modal:' + title} fallback={<div className={flush ? 'p-4' : 'px-5 py-4'}><PanelSkeleton /></div>} />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          {footer && <footer className="k-modal-foot">{typeof footer === 'function' ? footer(close) : footer}</footer>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Backdrop>,
    document.body,
  );
}

export function ConfirmDialog({ title, icon, message, confirmLabel, cancelLabel = 'Cancel', onConfirm, onClose }: {
  title: string; icon?: React.ReactNode; message: React.ReactNode; confirmLabel: string; cancelLabel?: string; onConfirm: () => void; onClose: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <Modal title={title} icon={icon} onClose={onClose} size="sm"
      footer={close => <>
        <button type="button" className="k-btn k-btn-secondary k-btn-md flex-1" onClick={() => close()}>{cancelLabel}</button>
        <button type="button" className="k-btn k-btn-primary k-btn-md flex-1" onClick={() => close(() => { onConfirm(); onClose(); })}>{confirmLabel}</button>
      </>}>
      <p className="k-modal-text">{message}</p>
    </Modal>
  );
}
import { createContext, useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { whenFoldsSettle, glide as glideProp, takeOver, isMoving, motionOff, noteMotion } from './presence';

export const MENU_OUT_MS = 120;

export interface MenuStage<K extends string> {
  shown: K | null;
  leaving: boolean;
  fresh: boolean;
  next: K | null;
}

export function useMenuStage<K extends string>(key: K | null): MenuStage<K> {
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<K | null>(key);
  const [leaving, setLeaving] = useState(false);
  const [fresh, setFresh] = useState(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (key === shown) { setLeaving(false); return; }
    if (shown === null) { setShown(key); setFresh(true); setLeaving(false); return; }
    setLeaving(true);
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => { setShown(key); setFresh(false); setLeaving(false); }, MENU_OUT_MS);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
  }, [key]);
  return { shown, leaving, fresh, next: key };
}

export const FoldMemoryContext = createContext<Map<string, boolean> | null>(null);

export const SWAP_OUT_MS = 100;
export const SWAP_IN_MS = 140;
const reducedMotion = motionOff;
export type SwapPhase = 'idle' | 'out' | 'hold' | 'in';
const swapClassOf = (p: SwapPhase) => (p === 'out' || p === 'hold' ? 'k-swap-out' : p === 'in' ? 'k-swap-in' : '');

export const GLIDE_MS = 160;

export function useSwapStage<K>(key: K, opts?: { glide?: boolean; box?: { readonly current: HTMLElement | null } }): { shown: K; swapClass: string; busy: boolean; phase: SwapPhase; inert: boolean } {
  const glide = !!opts?.glide;
  const boxOpt = opts?.box;
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<K>(key);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<SwapPhase>('idle');
  const shownRef = useRef<K>(key), latest = useRef<K>(key), phaseRef = useRef<SwapPhase>('idle'), t = useRef(0);
  const cancelSettle = useRef<() => void>(() => {});
  latest.current = key;
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (Object.is(key, shownRef.current) && phaseRef.current !== 'out') return;
    if (reducedMotion()) { shownRef.current = key; setShown(key); return; }
    if (phaseRef.current === 'out') return;
    noteMotion(SWAP_OUT_MS + (glide ? GLIDE_MS : 0) + SWAP_IN_MS);
    phaseRef.current = 'out'; setPhase('out');
    window.clearTimeout(t.current);
    const fadeIn = () => {
      phaseRef.current = 'in'; setPhase('in');
      t.current = window.setTimeout(() => { phaseRef.current = 'idle'; setPhase('idle'); }, SWAP_IN_MS);
    };
    t.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      shownRef.current = latest.current; setShown(latest.current);
      if (glide) {
        phaseRef.current = 'hold'; setPhase('hold');
        t.current = window.setTimeout(() => { cancelSettle.current = whenFoldsSettle(boxOpt?.current ?? null, fadeIn); }, GLIDE_MS);
      } else fadeIn();
    }, SWAP_OUT_MS);
  }, [key]);
  useEffect(() => () => { window.clearTimeout(t.current); cancelSettle.current(); }, []);
  return { shown, swapClass: swapClassOf(phase), busy: phase !== 'idle', phase, inert: phase === 'out' || phase === 'hold' };
}

export function useGlideHeight(ref: { readonly current: HTMLElement | null }, key: unknown): void {
  useGlideSize(ref, key, false);
}

export function useGlideSize(ref: { readonly current: HTMLElement | null }, key: unknown, width = true,
  manual = false): () => void {
  const lastH = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const lastW = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const prevKey = useRef<unknown>(key);
  const observed = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const ro = useRef<ResizeObserver | null>(null);
  const capture = useCallback(() => {
    const b = ref.current;
    if (!b) return;
    if (!isMoving(b, 'height')) lastH.current = b.offsetHeight;
    if (!isMoving(b, 'width')) lastW.current = b.offsetWidth;
  }, [ref]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (manual) return;
    const el = ref.current;
    if (el === observed.current) return;
    ro.current?.disconnect();
    observed.current = el;
    if (!el || typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return;
    lastH.current = el.offsetHeight; lastW.current = el.offsetWidth;
    if (!ro.current) ro.current = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      const b = ref.current;
      if (!b) return;
      if (!isMoving(b, 'height')) lastH.current = b.offsetHeight;
      if (!isMoving(b, 'width')) lastW.current = b.offsetWidth;
    });
    ro.current.observe(el);
  });
  useEffect(() => () => { ro.current?.disconnect(); }, []);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (Object.is(prevKey.current, key)) return;
    prevKey.current = key;
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || motionOff()) return;
    const axes: ('height' | 'width')[] = width ? ['height', 'width'] : ['height'];
    const from: Record<string, number | null> = {};
    for (const ax of axes) {
      from[ax] = isMoving(el, ax) ? parseFloat(takeOver(el, ax)) : (ax === 'height' ? lastH.current : lastW.current);
      el.style[ax] = '';
    }
    const settle = () => {
      if (isMoving(el, 'height') || isMoving(el, 'width')) return;
      el.style.overflow = '';
      lastH.current = el.offsetHeight; lastW.current = el.offsetWidth;
    };
    for (const ax of axes) {
      const f = from[ax];
      const to = ax === 'height' ? el.offsetHeight : el.offsetWidth;
      if (f == null || !Number.isFinite(f) || Math.abs(to - f) < 1) continue;
      el.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      glideProp(el, ax, `${to}px`, GLIDE_MS, { from: `${f}px`, done: () => { el.style[ax] = ''; settle(); } });
    }
  });  return capture;
}

export function useSwapFade(opts?: { glide?: boolean }): { swapClass: string; run: (fn: () => void) => void; busy: boolean; phase: SwapPhase; inert: boolean } {
  const glide = !!opts?.glide;
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<SwapPhase>('idle');
  const pending = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null), phaseRef = useRef<SwapPhase>('idle'), t = useRef(0);
  const run = useCallback((fn: () => void) => {
    if (reducedMotion()) { fn(); return; }
    pending.current = fn;
    if (phaseRef.current === 'out') return;
    noteMotion(SWAP_OUT_MS + (glide ? GLIDE_MS : 0) + SWAP_IN_MS);
    phaseRef.current = 'out'; setPhase('out');
    window.clearTimeout(t.current);
    const fadeIn = () => {
      phaseRef.current = 'in'; setPhase('in');
      t.current = window.setTimeout(() => { phaseRef.current = 'idle'; setPhase('idle'); }, SWAP_IN_MS);
    };
    t.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      const f = pending.current; pending.current = null;
      if (f) f();
      if (glide) { phaseRef.current = 'hold'; setPhase('hold'); t.current = window.setTimeout(fadeIn, GLIDE_MS); } else fadeIn();
    }, SWAP_OUT_MS);
  }, [glide]);
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(t.current), []);
  return { swapClass: swapClassOf(phase), run, busy: phase !== 'idle', phase, inert: phase === 'out' || phase === 'hold' };
}

export function blurFocusedField(inside?: HTMLElement | null): void {
  const a = document.activeElement;
  if (!(a instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
  if (inside) { if (!inside.contains(a)) return; }
  else if (!(a instanceof HTMLInputElement || a instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement || a.isContentEditable)) return;
  a.blur();
}
const _noBox: { readonly current: HTMLElement | null } = { current: null };
export function useBlurOnUnmount(box: { readonly current: HTMLElement | null }): void {
  useLayoutEffect(() => () => {
    const el = box.current, a = document.activeElement;
    if (el && a instanceof HTMLElement && el.contains(a)) {
      a.blur();
      queueMicrotask(() => document.body.dispatchEvent(new FocusEvent('focusout', { bubbles: true })));
    }
  }, [box]);
}

export function useClosing(onClose: () => void, box?: { readonly current: HTMLElement | null }): { closing: boolean; close: () => void } {
  const [closing, setClosing] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef(false);
  const cb = useRef(onClose); cb.current = onClose;
  const boxRef = box ?? _noBox;
  useBlurOnUnmount(boxRef);
  const close = useCallback(() => {
    if (ref.current) return;
    ref.current = true;
    blurFocusedField(boxRef.current);
    setClosing(true);
    window.setTimeout(() => cb.current(), MENU_OUT_MS);
  }, [boxRef]);
  return { closing, close };
}

export function useClosingWith(): { closing: boolean; closeWith: (fn: () => void) => void } {
  const [closing, setClosing] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef(false);
  const closeWith = useCallback((fn: () => void) => {
    if (ref.current) return;
    ref.current = true;
    blurFocusedField();
    setClosing(true);
    window.setTimeout(fn, MENU_OUT_MS);
  }, []);
  return { closing, closeWith };
}
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { textBoxToStart } from '../shell/textFade';

const cx = (...c: (string | false | null | undefined)[]) => c.filter(Boolean).join(' ');

const SPIN_HOLD_MS = 400;
const SPIN_REPEAT_MS = 60;

function decimalsOf(x: number): number {
  const s = String(x);
  const e = s.indexOf('e-');
  if (e >= 0) return Math.min(12, parseInt(s.slice(e + 2), 10) + ((s.slice(0, e).split('.')[1] ?? '').length));
  return Math.min(12, (s.split('.')[1] ?? '').length);
}

export function stepNumber(cur: number | null, dir: number, step: number, min?: number, max?: number): number {
  const lo = min ?? -Infinity, hi = max ?? Infinity;
  const base = Number.isFinite(lo) ? lo : 0;
  const s = step > 0 ? step : 1;
  if (cur == null || !Number.isFinite(cur)) return Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, base));
  if ((dir > 0 && cur >= hi) || (dir < 0 && cur <= lo)) return cur;
  const n = (cur - base) / s;
  const k = dir > 0 ? Math.floor(n + 1e-9) + 1 : Math.ceil(n - 1e-9) - 1;
  const next = parseFloat((base + k * s).toFixed(Math.max(decimalsOf(s), decimalsOf(base))));
  return Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, next));
}

export function useSpin(stepBy: (dir: number) => void, off?: boolean): (e: React.PointerEvent, dir: number) => void {
  const live = useRef(stepBy);
  live.current = stepBy;
  const timer = useRef(0);
  const stop = useCallback(() => { window.clearTimeout(timer.current); window.clearInterval(timer.current); timer.current = 0; }, []);
  useEffect(() => stop, [stop]);
  return useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent, dir: number) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (off || e.button !== 0) return;
    stop();
    live.current(dir);
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => { timer.current = window.setInterval(() => live.current(dir), SPIN_REPEAT_MS); }, SPIN_HOLD_MS);
    const end = () => { stop(); window.removeEventListener('pointerup', end); window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', end); };
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', end);
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', end);
  }, [off, stop]);
}

const SpinMark: React.FC<{ up?: boolean }> = ({ up }) => (
  <svg width="8" height="5" viewBox="0 0 8 5" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d={up ? 'M1 4.2 L4 0.8 L7 4.2 Z' : 'M1 0.8 L4 4.2 L7 0.8 Z'} fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="0.8" strokeLinejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

export const SpinArrows: React.FC<{ onSpin: (e: React.PointerEvent, dir: number) => void }> = ({ onSpin }) => (
  <span className="k-spin" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()} onMouseDown={e => e.preventDefault()}>
    <button type="button" tabIndex={-1} aria-label="Up" onPointerDown={e => onSpin(e, 1)}><SpinMark up /></button>
    <button type="button" tabIndex={-1} aria-label="Down" onPointerDown={e => onSpin(e, -1)}><SpinMark /></button>
  </span>
);

function typeInto(el: HTMLInputElement, v: string): void {
  Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value')?.set?.call(el, v);
  el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
}

export interface NumberBoxProps extends Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'type' | 'step' | 'min' | 'max'> {
  step?: number;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  arrows?: boolean;
}

export const NumberBox = React.forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, NumberBoxProps>(function NumberBox(
  { className, step, min, max, arrows = true, disabled, onKeyDown, inputMode, ...rest }, ref,
) {
  const own = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const setRef = useCallback((el: HTMLInputElement | null) => {
    own.current = el;
    if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(el);
    else if (ref) (ref as React.MutableRefObject<HTMLInputElement | null>).current = el;
  }, [ref]);
  const stepBy = useCallback((dir: number, arrow = false) => {
    const el = own.current;
    if (!el || el.disabled) return;
    if (document.activeElement !== el) el.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    const cur = parseFloat(el.value.replace(/,/g, ''));
    const next = stepNumber(Number.isFinite(cur) ? cur : null, dir, step ?? 1, min, max);
    if (String(next) !== el.value) typeInto(el, String(next));
    if (arrow) textBoxToStart(el);
  }, [step, min, max]);
  const spin = useSpin((dir: number) => stepBy(dir, true), disabled);
  const keyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if ((e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') && !e.altKey && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      stepBy(e.key === 'ArrowUp' ? 1 : -1);
    }
    onKeyDown?.(e);
  };
  const input = (cls: string | undefined) => (
    <input
      {...rest}
      ref={setRef}
      type="text"
      inputMode={inputMode ?? 'decimal'}
      autoComplete="off"
      spellCheck={false}
      disabled={disabled}
      onKeyDown={keyDown}
      className={cls}
    />
  );
  if (!arrows) return input(className);
  const padDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (e.target !== e.currentTarget || disabled) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    own.current?.focus();
  };
  return (
    <span className={cx('k-numbox', className)} data-off={disabled ? '' : undefined} data-kfade-row="" onMouseDown={padDown}>
      {input('k-numbox-in')}
      {!disabled && <SpinArrows onSpin={spin} />}
    </span>
  );
});

  'tool:settings': { closed: ['Developer'] },
};

export function cardStartsOpen(scope: string | null, card: string | null): boolean | undefined {
  if (!scope || !card) return undefined;
  const r = PANEL_CARD_FOLDS[scope];
  if (!r) return undefined;
  if (r.open) return r.open.includes(card);
  return !(r.closed ?? []).includes(card);
}
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import type { PanelsData } from '../../game/project/sections';

let folds: Record<string, boolean> = {};
let values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
let scrolls: Record<string, number> = {};
let applied = 0;
const subs = new Set<() => void>();
let onChange: () => void = () => {};

function notifyChange(): void { onChange(); }

export const panelMemory = {
  setOnChange(fn: () => void): void { onChange = fn; },
  version(): number { return applied; },
  subscribe(fn: () => void): () => void { subs.add(fn); return () => { subs.delete(fn); }; },
  fold(key: string): boolean | undefined { return folds[key]; },
  setFold(key: string, open: boolean): void { if (folds[key] === open) return; folds = { ...folds, [key]: open }; notifyChange(); },
  value(key: string): unknown { return values[key]; },
  setValue(key: string, v: unknown): void { if (values[key] === v) return; values = { ...values, [key]: v }; notifyChange(); },
  capture(tool: string): PanelsData {
    const scroll: Record<string, number> = { ...scrolls };
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-tool-layer]').forEach(layer => {
        const sc = layer.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.tool-scrollbar');
        const t = layer.dataset.toolLayer;
        if (sc && t && sc.clientHeight > 0) scroll[t] = Math.round(sc.scrollTop);
      });
    }
    scrolls = scroll;
    return { tool, folds: { ...folds }, values: { ...values }, scroll };
  },
  apply(p: PanelsData): void {
    folds = { ...p.folds };
    values = { ...p.values };
    scrolls = { ...p.scroll };
    applied++;
    subs.forEach(f => f());
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-tool-layer]').forEach(layer => {
          const t = layer.dataset.toolLayer;
          const sc = layer.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.tool-scrollbar');
          if (t && sc) sc.scrollTop = typeof scrolls[t] === 'number' ? scrolls[t] : 0;
        });
      }));
    }
  },
};

export const PanelScope = createContext<string | null>(null);

export function usePanelsVersion(): number {
  return useSyncExternalStore(panelMemory.subscribe, panelMemory.version, panelMemory.version);
}

export function usePanelMemory<T>(key: string, initial: T, valid?: (v: unknown) => boolean): [T, (v: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const ver = usePanelsVersion();
  const read = (): T => { const v = panelMemory.value(key); return v === undefined || (valid && !valid(v)) ? initial : (v as T); };
  const [val, setVal] = useState<T>(read);
  const cur = useRef(val);
  cur.current = val;
  const seen = useRef(ver);
  useEffect(() => { if (seen.current !== ver) { seen.current = ver; setVal(read()); } });
  const set = useCallback((v: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
    const n = typeof v === 'function' ? (v as (prev: T) => T)(cur.current) : v;
    cur.current = n;
    setVal(n);
    panelMemory.setValue(key, n);
  }, [key]);
  return [val, set];
}

export const EASE = 'cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)';

export function motionOff(): boolean {
  return typeof window !== 'undefined' && !!window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
}

const _busyUntil = new WeakMap<Element, number>();
export const SWITCH_SLIDE_MS = 250;
let _cause: Element | null = null;

const CONTROL = 'button, [role="button"], [role="switch"], [role="tab"], [role="menuitem"], [role="menuitemradio"], [role="menuitemcheckbox"], [role="option"], [role="checkbox"], input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"], label, summary, a[href], [data-guard]';
let _propsKey: string | null = null;
function _hasOnClick(el: Element): boolean {
  if (_propsKey === null) {
    for (const k of Object.keys(el)) if (k.startsWith('__reactProps$')) { _propsKey = k; break; }
    if (_propsKey === null) return false;
  }
  const p = (el as unknown as Record<string, { onClick?: unknown } | undefined>)[_propsKey];
  return !!p && typeof p.onClick === 'function';
}
let _viaLabel = false;
export function controlOf(t: EventTarget | null): Element | null {
  _viaLabel = false;
  if (!(t instanceof Element)) return null;
  let el: Element | null = t.closest(CONTROL);
  for (let n: Element | null = t; n && n !== el && n !== document.body; n = n.parentElement) {
    if (n instanceof HTMLCanvasElement || n.hasAttribute('data-guard-off')) return null;
    if (_hasOnClick(n)) { el = n; break; }
  }
  if (el instanceof HTMLLabelElement && el.control) { _viaLabel = true; return el.control; }
  return el;
}
export function noteMotion(ms: number): void {
  if (_cause === null || !(ms > 0)) return;
  holdControl(_cause, ms);
}
export function motionCause(): Element | null { return _cause; }
export function holdControl(el: Element | null, ms: number): void {
  if (!el) return;
  const until = performance.now() + ms;
  if ((_busyUntil.get(el) ?? 0) < until) _busyUntil.set(el, until);
}
export function controlBusy(el: Element | null): boolean {
  return !!el && performance.now() < (_busyUntil.get(el) ?? 0);
}
let _labelPass: Element | null = null;
function _guardClick(e: MouseEvent): void {
  const t = e.target;
  const el = controlOf(t);
  if (!el) return;
  const viaLabel = _viaLabel;
  if (el === _labelPass && t === el) { _labelPass = null; return; }
  if (controlBusy(el)) { e.stopImmediatePropagation(); e.preventDefault(); return; }
  _cause = el;
  if (viaLabel) {
    _labelPass = el;
    window.setTimeout(() => { if (_labelPass === el) _labelPass = null; }, 0);
  }
  if (el instanceof HTMLInputElement && el.type === 'checkbox' && el.closest('.toggle-ios')) holdControl(el, SWITCH_SLIDE_MS);
  let frames = 2;
  const tick = () => { if (--frames <= 0) { if (_cause === el) _cause = null; } else requestAnimationFrame(tick); };
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}
export function installSpamGuard(): () => void {
  window.addEventListener('click', _guardClick, true);
  return () => window.removeEventListener('click', _guardClick, true);
}

type Prop = 'opacity' | 'width' | 'height' | 'top' | 'left' | 'transform' | 'translate' | 'clip-path';
const camel = (p: Prop): string => (p === 'clip-path' ? 'clipPath' : p);

function moves(a: Animation, prop: Prop): boolean {
  const t = a as Animation & { transitionProperty?: string };
  if (typeof t.transitionProperty === 'string') return t.transitionProperty === prop || t.transitionProperty === 'all';
  const fx = a.effect as KeyframeEffect | null;
  if (!fx || typeof fx.getKeyframes !== 'function') return false;
  const key = camel(prop);
  return fx.getKeyframes().some(k => key in k);
}

export function isMoving(el: HTMLElement, prop: Prop): boolean {
  return typeof el.getAnimations === 'function' && el.getAnimations().some(a => moves(a, prop));
}

export function takeOver(el: HTMLElement, prop: Prop): string {
  const now = getComputedStyle(el).getPropertyValue(prop);
  if (typeof el.getAnimations === 'function') for (const a of el.getAnimations()) if (moves(a, prop)) a.cancel();
  return now;
}

export interface GlideOpts {
  from?: string | number;
  delay?: number;
  easing?: string;
  done?: () => void;
}

export function glide(el: HTMLElement, prop: Prop, to: string | number, ms: number, o: GlideOpts = {}): Animation | null {
  const from = o.from ?? takeOver(el, prop);
  if (o.from !== undefined) takeOver(el, prop);
  const key = camel(prop);
  (el.style as unknown as Record<string, string>)[key] = String(to);
  if (motionOff() || ms <= 0 || typeof el.animate !== 'function' || String(from) === String(to)) { o.done?.(); return null; }
  noteMotion(ms + (o.delay ?? 0));
  const a = el.animate([{ [key]: String(from) }, { [key]: String(to) }], { duration: ms, delay: o.delay ?? 0, easing: o.easing ?? EASE, fill: 'backwards' });
  if (o.done) { const cb = o.done; a.onfinish = () => cb(); }
  return a;
}

export type LeaveKind = 'pop' | 'fade' | 'tip' | 'menu' | 'toast';
const LEAVE_TO: Record<LeaveKind, Keyframe> = {
  pop: { opacity: 0, transform: 'translateY(6px) scale(0.98)' },
  fade: { opacity: 0 },
  tip: { opacity: 0, transform: 'scale(0.95)' },
  menu: { opacity: 0 },
  toast: { opacity: 0, transform: 'translateY(0.75rem)' },
};
export const LEAVE_MS = 120;

const _leaveWatch = new Set<(box: Element) => void>();
export function onLeaveStart(cb: (box: Element) => void): () => void {
  _leaveWatch.add(cb);
  return () => { _leaveWatch.delete(cb); };
}
export function leaveStarts(box: Element | null): void {
  if (!box || _leaveWatch.size === 0) return;
  _leaveWatch.forEach(cb => cb(box));
}

export function leaveFrom(el: HTMLElement, kind: LeaveKind, ms = LEAVE_MS, hold: Prop[] = kind === 'menu' ? ['clip-path'] : []): void {
  if (kind !== 'tip') leaveStarts(el);
  const to = LEAVE_TO[kind];
  const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
  const from: Keyframe = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(to)) from[k] = cs.getPropertyValue(k) || (k === 'opacity' ? '1' : 'none');
  const held: [string, string][] = hold.map(p => [camel(p), cs.getPropertyValue(p)]);
  el.style.animation = 'none';
  for (const [k, v] of held) if (v) (el.style as unknown as Record<string, string>)[k] = v;
  if (typeof el.getAnimations === 'function') for (const a of el.getAnimations()) a.cancel();
  if (motionOff() || typeof el.animate !== 'function') { Object.assign(el.style, to); return; }
  noteMotion(ms);
  el.animate([from, to], { duration: ms, easing: EASE, fill: 'forwards' });
}

export function useLeave(ref: { readonly current: HTMLElement | null }, leaving: boolean, kind: LeaveKind, ms = LEAVE_MS): void {
  const played = useRef(false);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!leaving) {
      if (played.current && el) comeBack(el, kind, ms);
      played.current = false;
      return;
    }
    if (!el || played.current) return;
    played.current = true;
    leaveFrom(el, kind, ms);
  });
}

export function comeBack(el: HTMLElement, kind: LeaveKind, ms = LEAVE_MS): void {
  const to = LEAVE_TO[kind];
  const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
  const from: Keyframe = {};
  const rest: Keyframe = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(to)) { from[k] = cs.getPropertyValue(k); rest[k] = k === 'opacity' ? '1' : 'none'; }
  if (typeof el.getAnimations === 'function') for (const a of el.getAnimations()) a.cancel();
  if (motionOff() || typeof el.animate !== 'function') {
    if (SMALL_FIX.GH290 !== 0) for (const k of Object.keys(to)) el.style.removeProperty(k);
    return;
  }
  noteMotion(ms);
  el.animate([from, rest], { duration: ms, easing: EASE });
}

const FLOW_MS = 160;
export function flowChange(parent: HTMLElement, apply: () => void, ms = FLOW_MS, width = false): boolean {
  const kids = Array.from(parent.children).filter((c): c is HTMLElement => c instanceof HTMLElement && !c.hidden);
  const before = new Map<HTMLElement, DOMRect>();
  for (const k of kids) before.set(k, k.getBoundingClientRect());
  const h0 = parseFloat(takeOver(parent, 'height')) || parent.offsetHeight;
  const w0 = width ? (parseFloat(takeOver(parent, 'width')) || parent.offsetWidth) : 0;
  if (width) parent.style.width = '';
  for (const k of kids) {
    takeOver(k, 'left'); takeOver(k, 'top'); k.style.left = ''; k.style.top = '';
    if (isMoving(k, 'width') && k.style.flex === '0 0 auto') { takeOver(k, 'width'); k.style.width = ''; k.style.flex = ''; }
  }
  parent.style.height = '';
  apply();
  if (motionOff()) return false;
  const h1 = parent.offsetHeight;
  let moved = false;
  const zoom = parent.offsetWidth > 0 ? parent.getBoundingClientRect().width / parent.offsetWidth : 1;
  for (const k of kids) {
    const a = before.get(k)!;
    if (!k.isConnected || a.width === 0) continue;
    const b = k.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (b.width === 0) continue;
    const dx = (a.left - b.left) / zoom, dy = (a.top - b.top) / zoom, dw = (a.width - b.width) / zoom;
    if (Math.abs(dx) >= 0.5 || Math.abs(dy) >= 0.5) {
      if (getComputedStyle(k).position === 'static') k.style.position = 'relative';
      glide(k, 'left', '0px', ms, { from: `${dx}px` });
      glide(k, 'top', '0px', ms, { from: `${dy}px` });
      moved = true;
    }
    if (Math.abs(dw) >= 0.5) {
      const w1 = b.width / zoom;
      k.style.flex = '0 0 auto';
      glide(k, 'width', `${w1}px`, ms, { from: `${w1 + dw}px`, done: () => { k.style.width = ''; k.style.flex = ''; } });
      moved = true;
    }
  }
  if (Math.abs(h1 - h0) >= 0.5) {
    glide(parent, 'height', `${h1}px`, ms, { from: `${h0}px`, done: () => { parent.style.height = ''; } });
    moved = true;
  }
  if (width) {
    const w1 = parent.offsetWidth;
    if (Math.abs(w1 - w0) >= 0.5) {
      glide(parent, 'width', `${w1}px`, ms, { from: `${w0}px`, done: () => { parent.style.width = ''; } });
      moved = true;
    }
  }
  return moved;
}

export function whenFoldsSettle(box: HTMLElement | null, cb: () => void, maxMs = 500): () => void {
  let raf = 0;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const check = () => {
    raf = 0;
    if (!box || !box.isConnected || !box.querySelector('.k-fold-moving') || performance.now() - t0 > maxMs) { cb(); return; }
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(check);
  };
  if (!box || !box.querySelector('.k-fold-moving')) { cb(); return () => {}; }
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(check);
  return () => { if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf); };
}

export function finishLeaving(el: HTMLElement | null, steps: { sel?: string; to: Keyframe; ms: number; delay?: number }[]): void {
  leaveStarts(el);
  if (!el || !el.isConnected || motionOff() || typeof el.animate !== 'function') return;
  const copy = el.cloneNode(true) as HTMLElement;
  const pairs: [HTMLElement, HTMLElement][] = [[el, copy]];
  for (const s of steps) if (s.sel) { const a = el.querySelector<HTMLElement>(s.sel), b = copy.querySelector<HTMLElement>(s.sel); if (a && b) pairs.push([a, b]); }
  for (const [a, b] of pairs) {
    const cs = getComputedStyle(a);
    b.style.opacity = cs.opacity; b.style.clipPath = cs.clipPath; b.style.transition = 'none';
  }
  copy.inert = true;
  copy.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  copy.removeAttribute('id');
  document.body.appendChild(copy);
  let end = 0;
  for (const s of steps) {
    const target = s.sel ? copy.querySelector<HTMLElement>(s.sel) : copy;
    if (!target) continue;
    const cs = getComputedStyle(target);
    const from: Keyframe = {};
    for (const k of Object.keys(s.to)) from[k] = (cs as unknown as Record<string, string>)[k];
    target.animate([from, s.to], { duration: s.ms, delay: s.delay ?? 0, easing: EASE, fill: 'forwards' });
    end = Math.max(end, (s.delay ?? 0) + s.ms);
  }
  window.setTimeout(() => copy.remove(), end + 30);
}

export const ARRIVE_FADE_MS = 105;
export const ARRIVE_GLIDE_MS = 180;
export function arriveAfterWait(box: HTMLElement, skel: HTMLElement | null, h0: number, skelGone: () => void): () => void {
  if (motionOff() || typeof box.animate !== 'function') { skelGone(); return () => {}; }
  const anims: Animation[] = [];
  let t = 0;
  if (skel) {
    const a = skel.animate([{ opacity: getComputedStyle(skel).opacity }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: ARRIVE_FADE_MS, easing: EASE, fill: 'forwards' });
    a.onfinish = skelGone;
    anims.push(a);
    t = ARRIVE_FADE_MS;
  } else skelGone();
  const h1 = box.offsetHeight;
  if (h0 > 0 && Math.abs(h1 - h0) >= 2) {
    box.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    const g = box.animate([{ height: `${h0}px` }, { height: `${h1}px` }], { duration: ARRIVE_GLIDE_MS, delay: t, easing: EASE, fill: 'backwards' });
    g.onfinish = g.oncancel = () => { box.style.overflow = ''; };
    anims.push(g);
    t += ARRIVE_GLIDE_MS;
  }
  for (const c of Array.from(box.children)) {
    if (c === skel || !(c instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
    anims.push(c.animate([{ opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1 }], { duration: ARRIVE_FADE_MS, delay: t, easing: EASE, fill: 'backwards' }));
  }
  return () => { for (const a of anims) a.cancel(); };
}

export function easeToward(x: number, target: number, dtSec: number): number {
  const d = x - target;
  if (d === 0 || !(dtSec > 0)) return d === 0 ? target : x;
  return target + Math.sign(d) * hudEase(Math.abs(d), dtSec / 0.7);
}

interface ScrollGlide { raf: number; x: number; last: number; rest: number; missing: number; wrote: number; detach: () => void }
const GLIDE_FLOOR_PX_S = 200;
function screenScaleOf(el: HTMLElement): number {
  const h = el.offsetHeight;
  const r = typeof el.getBoundingClientRect === 'function' ? el.getBoundingClientRect().height : 0;
  const k = h > 0 && r > 0 ? r / h : 1;
  return Number.isFinite(k) && k > 0.05 ? k : 1;
}
const scrollGlides = new WeakMap<HTMLElement, ScrollGlide>();
const SCROLL_STOP_EVENTS = ['wheel', 'touchstart', 'keydown', 'pointerdown'] as const;

export function stopScrollGlide(el: HTMLElement): void {
  const g = scrollGlides.get(el);
  if (!g) return;
  cancelAnimationFrame(g.raf);
  g.detach();
  scrollGlides.delete(el);
}

const glideStartFns = new Set<(el: HTMLElement) => void>();
export function onScrollGlideStart(fn: (el: HTMLElement) => void): () => void {
  glideStartFns.add(fn);
  return () => { glideStartFns.delete(fn); };
}
export function scrollGlideRuns(el: HTMLElement): boolean { return scrollGlides.has(el); }

export function scrollGlide(el: HTMLElement, to: number | (() => number | null), o: { follow?: number; done?: () => void } = {}): void {
  glideStartFns.forEach(fn => fn(el));
  const aim = typeof to === 'function' ? to : () => to;
  const prev = scrollGlides.get(el);
  const startX = prev ? prev.x : el.scrollTop;
  if (prev) { cancelAnimationFrame(prev.raf); prev.detach(); }
  const clamp = (v: number) => Math.min(Math.max(0, el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight), Math.max(0, v));
  if (motionOff() || typeof requestAnimationFrame !== 'function') {
    const v = aim();
    if (v != null) el.scrollTop = clamp(v);
    scrollGlides.delete(el);
    o.done?.();
    return;
  }
  const stop = () => stopScrollGlide(el);
  for (const ev of SCROLL_STOP_EVENTS) el.addEventListener(ev, stop, { passive: true });
  const g: ScrollGlide = {
    raf: 0, x: startX, last: -1, rest: 0, missing: 0, wrote: -1,
    detach: () => { for (const ev of SCROLL_STOP_EVENTS) el.removeEventListener(ev, stop); },
  };
  const follow = o.follow ?? 0;
  const floorPxS = SMALL_FIX.R889B !== 0 ? GLIDE_FLOOR_PX_S / screenScaleOf(el) : 0;
  const step = (now: number) => {
    const want = aim();
    if (want == null) {
      if (++g.missing > 5) { stop(); return; }
      g.raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      return;
    }
    if (SMALL_FIX.R889 !== 0 && g.wrote >= 0) { const moved = el.scrollTop - g.wrote; if (Math.abs(moved) > 0.01) g.x += moved; }
    const T = clamp(want);
    const dt = g.last < 0 ? 1 / 60 : Math.min(0.1, (now - g.last) / 1000);
    g.last = now;
    const eased = easeToward(g.x, T, dt);
    const left = T - g.x, least = floorPxS * dt;
    g.x = least > 0 && Math.abs(eased - g.x) < least ? g.x + Math.sign(left) * Math.min(least, Math.abs(left)) : eased;
    if (Math.abs(T - g.x) < 0.5) g.x = T;
    el.scrollTop = g.x;
    if (SMALL_FIX.R889 !== 0) g.wrote = el.scrollTop;
    if (g.x === T) {
      if (g.rest++ >= follow) { stop(); o.done?.(); return; }
    } else g.rest = 0;
    g.raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };
  scrollGlides.set(el, g);
  g.raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
}

export function nearestScrollTop(el: HTMLElement, top: number, height: number, margin = 0): number | null {
  if (top - margin < el.scrollTop) return top - margin;
  if (top + height + margin > el.scrollTop + el.clientHeight) return top + height + margin - el.clientHeight;
  return null;
}

export function glideIntoView(el: HTMLElement | null, margin = 8): void {
  if (!el) return;
  for (let sc = el.parentElement; sc && sc !== document.body && sc !== document.documentElement; sc = sc.parentElement) {
    if (!/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(sc).overflowY) || sc.scrollHeight <= sc.clientHeight + 1) continue;
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), v = sc.getBoundingClientRect();
    const k = sc.offsetHeight > 0 ? v.height / sc.offsetHeight : 1;
    const top = (r.top - v.top) / k + sc.scrollTop;
    const to = nearestScrollTop(sc, top, r.height / k, margin);
    if (to != null) scrollGlide(sc, to);
    return;
  }
}

export function useHeld<T>(value: T | null | undefined): T | null | undefined {
  const last = useRef(value);
  if (value != null) last.current = value;
  return value ?? last.current;
}

interface Snap { v: 2; w: number; h: number; b: number[] }

const OLD_STORES = ['istrong_skel1:'];
const MAX_BOXES = 320;

const masks = new Map<string, string>();

const radiusOf = (cs: CSSStyleDeclaration) => Math.min(999, Math.round(parseFloat(cs.borderTopLeftRadius) || 0));

function readSnap(id: string): Snap | null {
  if (mem.has(id)) return mem.get(id) ?? null;
  let s: Snap | null = null;
  try { const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORE + id); if (raw) { const p = JSON.parse(raw); if (p && p.v === 2 && Array.isArray(p.b)) s = p as Snap; } } catch { }

}

const CARD_SEL = '.k-group, .k-info-card, .k-skel-card, .k-mode-card, .k-card';
const BLOCK_SEL = 'input:not([type=hidden]), textarea, select, [role=switch], .toggle-ios, .k-select-trigger, .k-stepper, .k-seg, canvas, img, svg, video, .k-badge, .k-count, .k-chip, .k-kbd, kbd, .k-swatch';
const PRESS_SEL = 'button, [role=button], [role=tab]';

function visible(el: Element, hidden?: boolean): boolean {
  const cv = (el as Element & { checkVisibility?: (o?: object) => boolean }).checkVisibility;
  return cv ? cv.call(el, { checkOpacity: !hidden, checkVisibilityCSS: true }) : el.getClientRects().length > 0;
}

const clearColour = (c: string) => c === 'transparent' || /rgba([^)]*,s*0(.0+)?)$/.test(c);
function showsBox(cs: CSSStyleDeclaration, el: Element): boolean {
  if (parseFloat(cs.borderTopWidth) > 0 && cs.borderTopStyle !== 'none' && !clearColour(cs.borderTopColor)) return true;
  if (cs.boxShadow && cs.boxShadow !== 'none') return true;
  return !clearColour(cs.backgroundColor) && !el.matches(':hover');
}

export function captureSkeleton(id: string, root: HTMLElement, maxH?: number, hidden?: boolean): void {
  if (!root.isConnected || (!hidden && !visible(root))) return;
  const rr = root.getBoundingClientRect();
  const scale = root.offsetWidth > 0 ? rr.width / root.offsetWidth : 1;
  if (!(scale > 0) || rr.width <= 0) return;
  const W = root.offsetWidth, H = Math.min(maxH ?? root.clientHeight, 4000);
  const b: number[] = [];
  const push = (r: DOMRect, kind: number, rad: number) => {
    let x = (r.left - rr.left) / scale, y = (r.top - rr.top) / scale, w = r.width / scale, h = r.height / scale;
    if (w < 2 || h < 2 || y > H || y + h < 0 || x > W || x + w < 0) return;
    if (kind === TEXT) { const th = Math.max(6, Math.min(h * 0.62, 14)); y += (h - th) / 2; h = th; }
    else if (kind === BLOCK && w >= 12 && h >= 12) { x += 1; y += 1; w -= 2; h -= 2; }
    b.push(Math.round(x), Math.round(y), Math.round(w), Math.round(h), kind, rad);
  };
  const range = document.createRange();
  const walk = (el: Element) => {
    if (b.length >= MAX_BOXES * 6) return;
    for (let n = el.firstChild; n; n = n.nextSibling) {
      if (n.nodeType === 3) {
        if (!(n.nodeValue && n.nodeValue.trim())) continue;
        range.selectNodeContents(n);
        const rs = range.getClientRects();
        for (let i = 0; i < rs.length; i++) push(rs[i], TEXT, 4);
        continue;
      }
      if (n.nodeType !== 1) continue;
      const c = n as Element;
      if (c.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true' && !(c instanceof SVGElement)) continue;
      const rects = c.getClientRects();
      if (rects.length === 0) { if (getComputedStyle(c).display === 'contents') walk(c); continue; }
      const r = c.getBoundingClientRect();
      if ((r.top - rr.top) / scale > H) continue;
      if (!visible(c, hidden)) continue;
      if (hidden && !(c instanceof SVGElement) && getComputedStyle(c).opacity === '0') continue;
      if (c.matches('input[type=range]')) { const t = new DOMRect(r.left, r.top + r.height / 2 - 3 * scale, r.width, 6 * scale); push(t, BLOCK, 3); continue; }
      if (c.matches(CARD_SEL)) {
        if (!c.parentElement?.closest('.k-group, .k-info-card')) push(r, CARD, 14);
        walk(c);
        continue;
      }
      if (c.matches(BLOCK_SEL)) {
        const round = c.matches('[role=switch], .toggle-ios, .k-badge, .k-count, .k-chip') ? 999 : c instanceof SVGElement ? 4 : radiusOf(getComputedStyle(c));
        push(r, BLOCK, round);
        continue;
      }
      if (c.matches(PRESS_SEL)) {
        const cs = getComputedStyle(c);
        if (showsBox(cs, c)) push(r, BLOCK, radiusOf(cs)); else walk(c);
        continue;
      }
      walk(c);
    }
  };
  walk(root);
  if (b.length === 0) return;
  const snap: Snap = { v: 2, w: Math.round(W), h: Math.round(H), b };
  mem.set(id, snap);
  masks.delete(id);
  keep(id, snap);
}

const KEPT_MAX = 48;
let oldCleared = false;
function keep(id: string, snap: Snap): void {
  try {
    if (!oldCleared) {
      oldCleared = true;
      for (let i = localStorage.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const k = localStorage.key(i); if (k && OLD_STORES.some(o => k.startsWith(o))) localStorage.removeItem(k); }
    }
    let names: string[] = [];
    try { const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORE + '#order'); const p = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null; if (Array.isArray(p)) names = p.filter(n => typeof n === 'string'); } catch { }
    names = names.filter(n => n !== id);
    names.push(id);
    while (names.length > KEPT_MAX) localStorage.removeItem(STORE + names.shift());
    localStorage.setItem(STORE + id, JSON.stringify(snap));
    localStorage.setItem(STORE + '#order', JSON.stringify(names));
  } catch { }
}

export function useSkeletonCapture(id: string | null, ref: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, when: boolean, maxH?: () => number): void {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id || !when) return;
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    let t = 0, idle = 0;
    const ric: (cb: () => void) => number = typeof requestIdleCallback === 'function'
      ? (cb) => requestIdleCallback(cb, { timeout: 2000 }) : (cb) => window.setTimeout(cb, 0);
    const cancelIdle = (h: number) => { if (typeof cancelIdleCallback === 'function') cancelIdleCallback(h); else window.clearTimeout(h); };
    const later = (ms: number) => {
      window.clearTimeout(t); if (idle) cancelIdle(idle);
      t = window.setTimeout(() => { idle = ric(() => { idle = 0; const r = ref.current; if (r) captureSkeleton(id, r, maxH ? maxH() : undefined); }); }, ms);
    };
    later(700);
    const onUp = () => later(1500);
    el.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
    return () => { window.clearTimeout(t); if (idle) cancelIdle(idle); el.removeEventListener('pointerup', onUp); };
  }, [id, when, ref, maxH]);
}

function maskOf(id: string, s: Snap): string {
  let m = masks.get(id);
  if (m) return m;
  let r = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < s.b.length; i += 6) {
    if (s.b[i + 4] === CARD) continue;
    r += `<rect x="${s.b[i]}" y="${s.b[i + 1]}" width="${s.b[i + 2]}" height="${s.b[i + 3]}" rx="${Math.min(s.b[i + 5], s.b[i + 3] / 2)}"/>`;
  }
  m = `url("data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${s.w}" height="${s.h}" viewBox="0 0 ${s.w} ${s.h}" preserveAspectRatio="none">${r}</svg>`)}")`;
  masks.set(id, m);
  return m;
}

export function SnapshotSkeleton({ id, fallback, width, className }: { id: string | null; fallback: React.ReactNode; width?: number; className?: string }) {
  const snap = id ? readSnap(id) : null;
  const sx = snap && width && width > 0 ? width / snap.w : 1;
  const usable = !!snap && sx > 0.75 && sx < 1.33;
  const nodes = useMemo(() => {
    if (!snap || !usable) return null;
    const out: React.ReactNode[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < snap.b.length; i += 6) {
      if (snap.b[i + 4] !== CARD) continue;
      out.push(<div key={i} className="k-snap-card" style={{ left: snap.b[i] * sx, top: snap.b[i + 1], width: snap.b[i + 2] * sx, height: snap.b[i + 3], borderRadius: Math.min(snap.b[i + 5], snap.b[i + 3] / 2) }} />);
    }
    return out;
  }, [snap, usable, sx]);
  if (!snap || !usable || !nodes) return <>{fallback}</>;
  const mask = maskOf(id!, snap);
  return (
    <div className={className ? `k-snap ${className}` : 'k-snap'} style={{ height: snap.h }} aria-hidden>
      {nodes}
      <div className="k-snap-boxes" style={{ WebkitMaskImage: mask, maskImage: mask, WebkitMaskSize: '100% 100%', maskSize: '100% 100%' }} />
      <div className="k-snap-sweep" style={{ WebkitMaskImage: mask, maskImage: mask, WebkitMaskSize: '100% 100%', maskSize: '100% 100%' }} />
    </div>
  );
}
import React, { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { glide, takeOver, motionOff, flowChange } from './presence';

export const TAG_FADE_MS = 120;
export const TAG_SIZE_MS = 160;
const EXIT_MS = TAG_FADE_MS + TAG_SIZE_MS;

function openWidth(inner: HTMLElement | null): number {
  if (!inner) return 0;
  const cs = getComputedStyle(inner);
  return inner.offsetWidth + (parseFloat(cs.marginLeft) || 0) + (parseFloat(cs.marginRight) || 0);
}

interface SlotItem { key: string; node: React.ReactNode; optional?: boolean }
interface Slot extends SlotItem { leaving: boolean; since: number }

function usePresence(items: SlotItem[]): Slot[] {
  const last = useRef<Slot[]>([]);
  const [, bump] = useState(0);
  const now = typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : Date.now();
  const at = new Map<string, number>();
  items.forEach((it, i) => at.set(it.key, i));
  const out: Slot[] = [];
  let k = 0;
  for (const s of last.current) {
    const p = at.get(s.key);
    if (p !== undefined) {
      while (k <= p) { out.push({ ...items[k], leaving: false, since: 0 }); k++; }
    } else {
      const since = s.leaving ? s.since : now;
      if (now - since < EXIT_MS + 40) out.push({ ...s, leaving: true, since });
    }
  }
  while (k < items.length) { out.push({ ...items[k], leaving: false, since: 0 }); k++; }
  useLayoutEffect(() => { last.current = out; });
  const anyLeaving = out.some(s => s.leaving);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!anyLeaving) return;
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => bump(n => n + 1), EXIT_MS + 60);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  });
  return out;
}

function restWidth(el: HTMLElement, w: number): () => void {
  return () => { if (el.dataset.on === '1' && el.dataset.w === String(w)) el.style.width = 'auto'; };
}

function setSlot(el: HTMLElement, show: boolean, animate: boolean, openDelay: number): void {
  const inner = el.firstElementChild as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!inner) return;
  const w = openWidth(inner);
  const was = el.dataset.on;
  const want = show ? '1' : '0';
  const lastW = Number(el.dataset.w || 0);
  el.dataset.txt = inner.textContent ?? '';
  if (was === want && (!show || w === lastW)) return;
  el.dataset.on = want;
  el.dataset.w = String(w);
  el.setAttribute('aria-hidden', show ? 'false' : 'true');
  if (!animate || motionOff()) {
    takeOver(el, 'width'); takeOver(el, 'opacity');
    el.style.width = show ? 'auto' : '0px';
    el.style.opacity = show ? '1' : '0';
    return;
  }
  const restingAuto = el.style.width === 'auto' && el.getAnimations().length === 0;
  const fromW = was === undefined ? '0px' : restingAuto ? `${lastW}px` : takeOver(el, 'width');
  const fromO = was === undefined ? '0' : takeOver(el, 'opacity');
  if (was === want) {
    glide(el, 'width', `${w}px`, TAG_SIZE_MS, { from: fromW, done: restWidth(el, w) });
  } else if (show) {
    glide(el, 'width', `${w}px`, TAG_SIZE_MS, { from: fromW, delay: openDelay, done: restWidth(el, w) });
    glide(el, 'opacity', '1', TAG_FADE_MS, { from: fromO, delay: openDelay + TAG_SIZE_MS });
  } else {
    glide(el, 'opacity', '0', TAG_FADE_MS, { from: fromO });
    glide(el, 'width', '0px', TAG_SIZE_MS, { from: fromW, delay: TAG_FADE_MS });
  }
}

function applySlots(box: HTMLElement | null, slots: Slot[], shown: (s: Slot) => boolean, animate: boolean): void {
  if (!box) return;
  const els = new Map<string, HTMLElement>();
  box.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(':scope > [data-kslot]').forEach(el => els.set(el.dataset.kslot!, el));
  let closing = false;
  for (const s of slots) { const el = els.get(s.key); if (el && el.dataset.on === '1' && !shown(s)) closing = true; }
  const delay = closing ? TAG_FADE_MS : 0;
  for (const s of slots) { const el = els.get(s.key); if (el) setSlot(el, shown(s), animate, delay); }
}

const SlotEl: React.FC<{ k: string; side: 'l' | 'r'; children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ k, side, children }) => (
  <span data-kslot={k} className={side === 'l' ? 'k-tslot k-tslot-l' : 'k-tslot k-tslot-r'} style={{ width: 0, opacity: 0 }}>{children}</span>
);

export interface TagItem {
  key: string;
  text: string;
  optional?: boolean;
}

interface TagTitleProps {
  lead?: React.ReactNode;
  title: React.ReactNode;
  titleTip?: string;
  tags: TagItem[];
}

export const TagTitle: React.FC<TagTitleProps> = ({ lead, title, titleTip, tags }) => {
  const row = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const name = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const leadEl = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const drawn = useRef(false);
  const slots = usePresence(tags.map(t => ({ key: t.key, node: t.text, optional: t.optional })));
  const slotsRef = useRef(slots);
  slotsRef.current = slots;

  const layout = (animate: boolean): boolean => {
    const box = row.current, nm = name.current;
    if (!box || !nm || box.clientWidth <= 0) return false;
    const list = slotsRef.current;
    const tagW = new Map<string, number>();
    box.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(':scope > [data-kslot]').forEach(el => {
      tagW.set(el.dataset.kslot!, openWidth(el.firstElementChild as HTMLElement | null));
    });
    const room = box.clientWidth;
    let used = Math.ceil(nm.scrollWidth) + openWidth(leadEl.current);
    const on = new Set<string>();
    for (const s of list) if (!s.leaving && !s.optional) { on.add(s.key); used += tagW.get(s.key) ?? 0; }
    let fits = true;
    for (const s of list) {
      if (s.leaving || !s.optional || !fits) continue;
      const w = tagW.get(s.key) ?? 0;
      if (used + w <= room + 0.5) { on.add(s.key); used += w; } else fits = false;
    }
    applySlots(box, list, s => on.has(s.key), animate);
    return true;
  };
  const relayout = () => { if (layout(drawn.current)) drawn.current = true; };

  useLayoutEffect(relayout);
  useEffect(() => {
    const box = row.current;
    if (!box || typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(relayout);
    ro.observe(box);
    let live = true;
    document.fonts?.ready.then(() => { if (live) relayout(); });
    return () => { live = false; ro.disconnect(); };
  }, []);

  return (
    <span ref={row} className="k-tagline">
      {lead != null && <span ref={leadEl} className="k-tagline-lead">{lead}</span>}
      <span ref={name} className="k-pick-title k-fade" data-tip={titleTip}>{title}</span>
      {slots.map(s => <SlotEl key={s.key} k={s.key} side="l"><span className="k-ttag">{s.node}</span></SlotEl>)}
    </span>
  );
};

export interface InlineItem { key: string; node: React.ReactNode }

export const InlineMotion: React.FC<{ items: InlineItem[]; side?: 'l' | 'r' }> = ({ items, side = 'r' }) => {
  const anchor = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const drawn = useRef(false);
  const slots = usePresence(items);
  const timer = useRef(0);
  const fadeEnds = useRef(0);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const parent = anchor.current?.parentElement ?? null;
    if (!parent) return;
    if (!drawn.current || motionOff()) { applySlots(parent, slots, s => !s.leaving, false); drawn.current = true; return; }
    const els = new Map<string, HTMLElement>();
    parent.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(':scope > [data-kslot]').forEach(el => els.set(el.dataset.kslot!, el));
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current);
    const now = performance.now();
    for (const s of slots) {
      const el = els.get(s.key);
      if (!el) continue;
      if (s.leaving && el.dataset.on === '1') {
        el.dataset.on = 'f'; el.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        glide(el, 'opacity', '0', TAG_FADE_MS);
        fadeEnds.current = Math.max(fadeEnds.current, now + TAG_FADE_MS);
      } else if (!s.leaving && el.dataset.on === 'f') {
        el.dataset.on = '1'; el.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
        glide(el, 'opacity', '1', TAG_FADE_MS);
      } else if (!s.leaving && el.dataset.on === '1') {
        const inner = el.firstElementChild as HTMLElement | null;
        if ((inner?.textContent ?? '') !== el.dataset.txt) setSlot(el, true, true, 0);
      }
    }
    const reflow = () => {
      const opening: HTMLElement[] = [];
      const moved = flowChange(parent, () => {
        for (const s of slots) {
          const el = els.get(s.key);
          if (!el || !el.isConnected) continue;
          if (s.leaving && el.dataset.on === 'f') { el.dataset.on = '0'; el.style.width = '0px'; }
          else if (!s.leaving && el.dataset.on !== '1' && el.dataset.on !== 'f') {
            el.dataset.on = '1'; el.dataset.w = String(openWidth(el.firstElementChild as HTMLElement | null));
            el.dataset.txt = el.firstElementChild?.textContent ?? '';
            el.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
            takeOver(el, 'opacity'); el.style.opacity = '0'; el.style.width = 'auto';
            opening.push(el);
          }
        }
      }, TAG_SIZE_MS);
      for (const el of opening) glide(el, 'opacity', '1', TAG_FADE_MS, { from: '0', delay: moved ? TAG_SIZE_MS : 0 });
    };
    const wait = fadeEnds.current - now;
    if (wait > 4) timer.current = window.setTimeout(reflow, wait); else reflow();
  });
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), []);
  return (
    <>
      <span ref={anchor} hidden />
      {slots.map(s => <SlotEl key={s.key} k={s.key} side={side}>{s.node}</SlotEl>)}
    </>
  );
};

};
import React, { useCallback, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { FOLD_MS, FOLD_FADE_MS } from './Collapse';
import { EASE, motionOff, isMoving, takeOver as takeOverProp, scrollGlide, stopScrollGlide, nearestScrollTop } from './presence';

const EMPTY_GHOST = '\u0000empty';
const FRESH_KEEP_MS = 1500;
interface Ghost { id: number; key: string; node: React.ReactNode; top: number; h: number; w: number; started: boolean; fadeEnds: number }
let ghostSeq = 0;
interface Drawn {
  empty: boolean; keys: string[]; tops: Float64Array; natural: number; frameH: number; frameW: number; rowW: number;
  shown: Map<string, { node: React.ReactNode; top: number; h: number }>;
}

const reducedMotion = motionOff;
function takeOver(el: HTMLElement, prop: 'top' | 'height'): number | null {
  if (!isMoving(el, prop)) return null;
  const v = parseFloat(takeOverProp(el, prop));
  return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null;
}
function glideScroll(el: HTMLElement, to: number): void { scrollGlide(el, to); }

export interface VirtualListProps {
  count: number;
  rowHeight: number | ((index: number) => number);
  maxHeight?: number;
  maxRows?: number;
  overscan?: number;
  renderRow: (index: number) => React.ReactNode;
  rowKey: (index: number) => string;
  stickToEnd?: boolean;
  revealNew?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  empty?: React.ReactNode;
  boxRef?: React.MutableRefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  boxProps?: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>;
}

function rowTops(count: number, h: number | ((i: number) => number)): Float64Array {
  const tops = new Float64Array(count + 1);
  if (typeof h === 'number') { for (let i = 0; i <= count; i++) tops[i] = i * h; return tops; }
  let y = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) { tops[i] = y; y += h(i); }
  tops[count] = y;
  return tops;
}
function rowAt(tops: Float64Array, count: number, y: number): number {
  let lo = 0, hi = count - 1;
  if (count <= 0) return 0;
  while (lo < hi) { const mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1; if (tops[mid] <= y) lo = mid; else hi = mid - 1; }
  return lo;
}

export function virtualRowAtPoint(box: HTMLDivElement | null, clientY: number): number {
  if (!box) return -1;
  const rows = box.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(':scope > .k-vl-row');
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const r = rows[i].getBoundingClientRect();
    if (clientY >= r.top && clientY < r.bottom) return Number(rows[i].dataset.vlIndex);
  }
  return -1;
}

export function scrollVirtualRowIntoView(box: HTMLDivElement | null, top: number, height: number): void {
  if (!box) return;
  const to = nearestScrollTop(box, top, height);
  if (to != null) scrollGlide(box, to);
}

export const VirtualList: React.FC<VirtualListProps> = ({ count, rowHeight, maxHeight, maxRows = 8, overscan = 160, renderRow, rowKey, stickToEnd, revealNew, className, empty, boxRef, boxProps }) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const frameRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const tops = useMemo(() => rowTops(count, rowHeight), [count, rowHeight]);
  const total = tops[count];
  const boxH = Math.min(total, maxHeight ?? maxRows * (typeof rowHeight === 'number' ? rowHeight : 40));
  const natural = Math.min(total, boxH + 2);
  const [view, setView] = useState({ top: 0, h: boxH });
  const raf = useRef(0);
  const atEnd = useRef(true);
  const lastTotal = useRef(total);
  const seen = useRef<Set<string> | null>(null);
  const fresh = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const unbuilt = useRef<Map<string, number>>(new Map());
  const drawn = useRef<Drawn | null>(null);
  const ghosts = useRef<Ghost[]>([]);
  const building = useRef<Drawn['shown']>(new Map());
  const keysNow = useRef<string[]>([]);
  const scrollAtRender = useRef(0);
  const lastEmpty = useRef<React.ReactNode>(null);
  const [, setTick] = useState(0);
  const timers = useRef<number[]>([]);

  const measure = useCallback(() => {
    raf.current = 0;
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const top = el.scrollTop, h = Math.max(el.clientHeight || 0, boxH);
    atEnd.current = top + el.clientHeight >= el.scrollHeight - 2;
    setView(prev => (prev.top === top && prev.h === h ? prev : { top, h }));
  }, [boxH]);
  const onScroll = useCallback(() => { if (!raf.current) raf.current = requestAnimationFrame(measure); }, [measure]);

  const isEmpty = count === 0 && !!empty;

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current, frame = frameRef.current;
    const before = drawn.current;
    const keys = keysNow.current;
    const grew = total > lastTotal.current;
    lastTotal.current = total;
    const stickTo = el && stickToEnd && grew && atEnd.current ? Math.max(0, total - natural) : null;
    const emptyEl = frame ? frame.querySelector<HTMLElement>(':scope > .k-vl-empty') : null;
    const later = (fn: () => void, ms: number) => {
      const id = window.setTimeout(() => { const at = timers.current.indexOf(id); if (at >= 0) timers.current.splice(at, 1); fn(); }, ms);
      timers.current.push(id);
    };
    if (frame && before && !reducedMotion()) {
      const now = performance.now();
      const leaving = ghosts.current.filter(g => !g.started);
      for (const g of leaving) {
        g.started = true;
        g.fadeEnds = now + FOLD_FADE_MS;
        const gel = frame.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-vl-ghost="${g.id}"]`);
        gel?.animate([{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: FOLD_FADE_MS, easing: EASE, fill: 'forwards' });
        later(() => {
          ghosts.current = ghosts.current.filter(x => x !== g);
          setTick(t => t + 1);
        }, FOLD_FADE_MS + FOLD_MS);
      }
      let fadesEnd = now;
      for (const g of ghosts.current) if (g.started) fadesEnd = Math.max(fadesEnd, g.fadeEnds);
      const delayMove = Math.max(0, fadesEnd - now);
      let moved = false;
      if (before.empty !== isEmpty) {
        const from = takeOver(frame, 'height') ?? before.frameH;
        const to = isEmpty ? (emptyEl ? emptyEl.offsetHeight : 0) : natural;
        if (Math.abs(from - to) > 0.5) {
          frame.animate([{ height: `${from}px`, overflow: 'hidden' }, { height: `${to}px`, overflow: 'hidden' }],
            { duration: FOLD_MS, delay: delayMove, easing: EASE, fill: 'backwards' });
          moved = true;
        }
      }
      const entering: HTMLElement[] = [];
      if (!isEmpty && el) {
        let changed = before.keys.length !== keys.length || before.natural !== natural || el.scrollTop !== scrollAtRender.current;
        for (let i = 0; !changed && i < keys.length; i++) changed = before.keys[i] !== keys[i] || before.tops[i] !== tops[i];
        if (changed) {
          const was = new Map<string, number>();
          for (let i = 0; i < before.keys.length; i++) was.set(before.keys[i], i);
          const scrollNow = el.scrollTop;
          const rowsEls = el.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(':scope > .k-vl-row');
          for (let r = 0; r < rowsEls.length; r++) {
            const row = rowsEls[r];
            const k = row.dataset.vlKey ?? '';
            const i = Number(row.dataset.vlIndex);
            if (fresh.current.has(k)) { entering.push(row); continue; }
            const pi = was.get(k);
            if (pi === undefined) continue;
            const dy = (before.tops[pi] - scrollAtRender.current) - (tops[i] - scrollNow) + (takeOver(row, 'top') ?? 0);
            if (Math.abs(dy) < 0.5) continue;
            row.animate([{ top: `${dy}px` }, { top: '0px' }], { duration: FOLD_MS, delay: delayMove, easing: EASE, fill: 'backwards' });
            moved = true;
          }
          if (!before.empty && before.natural !== natural) {
            const from = takeOver(el, 'height') ?? before.natural;
            el.animate([
              { height: `${from}px`, maxHeight: 'none', overflowY: 'hidden' },
              { height: `${natural}px`, maxHeight: 'none', overflowY: 'hidden' },
            ], { duration: FOLD_MS, delay: delayMove, easing: EASE, fill: 'backwards' });
            moved = true;
          }
        }
      }
      if (stickTo !== null && el && stickTo > el.scrollTop + 0.5) {
        const target = stickTo;
        if (delayMove > 0) later(() => glideScroll(el, target), delayMove);
        else glideScroll(el, target);
        moved = true;
      }
      if (el && unbuilt.current.size > 0) {
        const rowsEls = el.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(':scope > .k-vl-row');
        for (let r = 0; r < rowsEls.length; r++) {
          const k = rowsEls[r].dataset.vlKey ?? '';
          if (unbuilt.current.has(k)) { unbuilt.current.delete(k); if (!entering.includes(rowsEls[r])) entering.push(rowsEls[r]); }
        }
      }
      const delayIn = delayMove + (moved ? FOLD_MS : 0);
      for (const row of entering) row.animate([{ opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1 }], { duration: FOLD_FADE_MS, delay: delayIn, easing: EASE, fill: 'backwards' });
      if (isEmpty && !before.empty && emptyEl) emptyEl.animate([{ opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1 }], { duration: FOLD_FADE_MS, delay: delayIn, easing: EASE, fill: 'backwards' });
    } else if (stickTo !== null && el) {
      el.scrollTop = stickTo;
    }
    const firstRow = el ? el.querySelector<HTMLElement>(':scope > .k-vl-row') : null;
    drawn.current = {
      empty: isEmpty, keys, tops, natural,
      frameH: isEmpty ? (emptyEl ? emptyEl.offsetHeight : 0) : natural,
      frameW: frame ? frame.clientWidth : 0,
      rowW: firstRow ? firstRow.offsetWidth : (frame ? frame.clientWidth : 0),
      shown: building.current,
    };
    if (fresh.current.size > 0) {
      const t = performance.now();
      fresh.current.forEach(k => { if (!building.current.has(k)) unbuilt.current.set(k, t); });
    }
    if (unbuilt.current.size > 0) {
      const t = performance.now();
      unbuilt.current.forEach((at, k) => { if (t - at > FRESH_KEEP_MS || !seen.current?.has(k)) unbuilt.current.delete(k); });
    }
    if (el && revealNew && fresh.current.size > 0) {
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        if (!fresh.current.has(keys[i])) continue;
        scrollVirtualRowIntoView(el, tops[i], tops[i + 1] - tops[i]);
        break;
      }
    }
    measure();
  });
  useLayoutEffect(() => () => {
    if (raf.current) cancelAnimationFrame(raf.current);
    for (const t of timers.current) window.clearTimeout(t);
    if (ref.current) stopScrollGlide(ref.current);
  }, []);

  const keys: string[] = new Array(count);
  const first = seen.current === null;
  const nowSeen = new Set<string>();
  fresh.current = new Set();
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const k = rowKey(i);
    keys[i] = k;
    nowSeen.add(k);
    if (!first && !seen.current!.has(k)) fresh.current.add(k);
  }
  seen.current = nowSeen;
  keysNow.current = keys;
  const scrollNow = ref.current ? ref.current.scrollTop : 0;
  scrollAtRender.current = scrollNow;
  const prev = drawn.current;
  if (prev && !reducedMotion()) {
    prev.shown.forEach((d, k) => {
      if (!nowSeen.has(k) && !ghosts.current.some(g => g.key === k)) {
        ghosts.current.push({ id: ++ghostSeq, key: k, node: d.node, top: d.top - scrollNow, h: d.h, w: prev.rowW, started: false, fadeEnds: 0 });
      }
    });
    if (prev.empty && !isEmpty && lastEmpty.current && !ghosts.current.some(g => g.key === EMPTY_GHOST)) {
      ghosts.current.push({ id: ++ghostSeq, key: EMPTY_GHOST, node: lastEmpty.current, top: 0, h: prev.frameH, w: prev.frameW, started: false, fadeEnds: 0 });
    }
  }
  building.current = new Map();

  let content: React.ReactNode;
  if (isEmpty) {
    lastEmpty.current = empty;
    content = <div className="k-vl-empty">{empty}</div>;
  } else {
    const vTop = Math.min(view.top, Math.max(0, total - natural));
    const a = Math.max(0, rowAt(tops, count, vTop - overscan));
    const b = Math.min(count, rowAt(tops, count, vTop + view.h + overscan) + 1);
    const rows: React.ReactNode[] = [];
    for (let i = a; i < b; i++) {
      const k = keys[i];
      const node = renderRow(i);
      const h = tops[i + 1] - tops[i];
      building.current.set(k, { node, top: tops[i], h });
      rows.push(<div key={k} data-vl-index={i} data-vl-key={k} className="k-vl-row" style={{ height: h }}>{node}</div>);
    }
    const fixedH = typeof rowHeight === 'number' ? rowHeight : 40;
    const vars = { ['--vl-row' as string]: `${fixedH}px` } as React.CSSProperties;
    content = (
      <div {...boxProps} ref={(el) => { ref.current = el; if (boxRef) boxRef.current = el; }} onScroll={onScroll}
        className={className ? ['k-vl custom-scrollbar', className].join(' ') : 'k-vl custom-scrollbar'}
        style={{ ...vars, maxHeight: boxH + 2, ...(boxProps?.style ?? {}) }}>
        <div className="k-vl-skel" style={{ height: tops[a] }} aria-hidden="true" />
        {rows}
        <div className="k-vl-skel" style={{ height: total - tops[b] }} aria-hidden="true" />
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div ref={frameRef} className="k-vl-frame">
      {content}
      {ghosts.current.length > 0 && (
        <div className="k-vl-ghosts" aria-hidden="true">
          {ghosts.current.map(g => (
            <div key={'ghost:' + g.id} data-vl-ghost={g.id} className="k-vl-ghost" style={{ top: g.top, height: g.h, width: g.w }}>{g.node}</div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
import { useLayoutEffect, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { isTouchScreen } from '../../utils/device';

const _stack: number[] = [];
let _seq = 0;
let _version = 0;
const _subs = new Set<() => void>();
function emit(): void { _version++; for (const f of _subs) f(); }
function subscribe(f: () => void): () => void { _subs.add(f); return () => { _subs.delete(f); }; }
const version = (): number => _version;

export interface WindowLayer { covered: boolean; over: boolean; }

export function useWindowLayer(open = true): WindowLayer {
  const [id] = useState(() => ++_seq);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    _stack.push(id);
    emit();
    return () => {
      const i = _stack.indexOf(id);
      if (i >= 0) _stack.splice(i, 1);
      emit();
    };
  }, [id, open]);
  useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, version, version);
  if (!open || !isTouchScreen()) return NONE;
  const i = _stack.indexOf(id);
  if (i < 0) return NONE;
  return { covered: i < _stack.length - 1, over: i > 0 };
}
const NONE: WindowLayer = { covered: false, over: false };

export function useOpenWindowCount(): number {
  useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, version, version);
  return _stack.length;
}

export function openWindowIds(): readonly number[] { return _stack; }
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export function useHtmlDark(): boolean {
  const read = () => typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
  const [dark, setDark] = useState(read);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = document.documentElement;
    const mo = new MutationObserver(() => setDark(read()));
    mo.observe(el, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    setDark(read());
    return () => mo.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return dark;
}
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { getEffectiveDPR } from '../../utils/zoomCompensation';
import { SmokeSim, smokeGridFor, SMOKE_CELLS, SMOKE_HZ } from './smokeSim';

const ROWS_TARGET = 90;
const CELL_MIN_CSS = 9;
const CELL_MAX_CSS = 16;
const CELL_ASPECT = 0.6;
const FONT_FILL = 0.74;
const FONT = '"JetBrains Mono", Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace';
const MAX_DPR = 2;

const RAMP = ['.', ':', ';', '+', '*', '%', '#', '@'] as const;
const EDGES = ['-', '\\', '|', '/'] as const;

const LIGHT_INK = [0x0a / 255, 0x0a / 255, 0x0a / 255] as const;
const DARK_INK = [0xfa / 255, 0xfa / 255, 0xfa / 255] as const;
const LIGHT_ALPHA: readonly [number, number] = [0.037, 0.443];
const DARK_ALPHA: readonly [number, number] = [0.045, 0.59];
const COVER_MIN = 0.035;
const WHITE = 0.6;
const TONE_GAMMA = 1.0;
const EDGE_GRAD = 0.3;
const DETAIL = 0.8;
const STEP = 1 / SMOKE_HZ;
const MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME = 3;
const WARM_SECONDS = 6;
const WARM_BUDGET_MS = 3;
const FALLBACK_INTERVAL_MS = 1000 / 30;

const STIR_RADIUS_CSS = 34;
const STIR_RADIUS_MIN = 1.8;
const DRAG_THRESHOLD = 6;
const GRID_TIERS = [1, 0.62, 0.4] as const;
const DEGRADE_STEP_MS = 3;
const DEGRADE_GRACE_STEPS = SMOKE_HZ * 3;

const VERT = `attribute vec2 aPos; void main() { gl_Position = vec4(aPos, 0.0, 1.0); }`;
const FRAG = `
#ifdef GL_FRAGMENT_PRECISION_HIGH
precision highp float;
#else
precision mediump float;
#endif
uniform sampler2D uField;
uniform sampler2D uAtlas;
uniform vec2 uView;
uniform vec2 uOrigin;
uniform vec2 uCell;
uniform vec2 uGrid;
uniform vec2 uFieldA;
uniform vec2 uFieldB;
uniform vec2 uAtlasInv;
uniform float uMix;
uniform vec3 uInk;
uniform vec4 uTone;
#define RAMP_N ${RAMP.length}.0
#define DETAIL ${DETAIL.toFixed(3)}
#define TONE_GAMMA ${TONE_GAMMA.toFixed(3)}
#define WHITE ${WHITE.toFixed(3)}
float cov(vec2 uv) { vec2 s = texture2D(uField, uv).rg; return mix(s.g * s.g, s.r * s.r, uMix); }
float ink(float slot, vec2 local) { return texture2D(uAtlas, (vec2(slot * uCell.x, 0.0) + local + 0.5) * uAtlasInv).a; }
void main() {
  vec2 p = vec2(gl_FragCoord.x, uView.y - gl_FragCoord.y) - uOrigin;
  vec2 cell = floor(p / uCell);
  if (cell.x < 0.0 || cell.y < 0.0 || cell.x >= uGrid.x || cell.y >= uGrid.y) discard;
  vec2 local = clamp(floor(p - cell * uCell), vec2(0.0), uCell - 1.0);
  vec2 uv = (uOrigin + (cell + 0.5) * uCell) * uFieldA + uFieldB;
  float c = cov(uv);
  if (c < uTone.x) discard;
  vec2 st = uCell * uFieldA;
  float cr = cov(uv + vec2(st.x, 0.0));
  float cl = cov(uv - vec2(st.x, 0.0));
  float cd = cov(uv + vec2(0.0, st.y));
  float cu = cov(uv - vec2(0.0, st.y));
  float cs = c + DETAIL * (c - 0.25 * (cr + cl + cd + cu));
  float span = 1.0 / (WHITE - uTone.x);
  float lv = pow(clamp((cs - uTone.x) * span, 0.0, 1.0), TONE_GAMMA);
  float g = lv * (RAMP_N - 0.001);
  float k = floor(g);
  float body = mix(ink(k, local), ink(min(k + 1.0, RAMP_N - 1.0), local), smoothstep(0.6, 1.0, g - k));
  float gx = (cr - cl) * span;
  float gy = (cd - cu) * span;
  float edge = smoothstep(uTone.w, uTone.w * 2.0, length(vec2(gx, gy))) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.15, 0.35, lv));
  float glyph = body;
  if (edge > 0.0) {
    float ang = atan(gx, -gy);
    if (ang < 0.0) ang += 3.14159265;
    float o = ang * 1.27323954 + 0.5;
    float oi = mod(floor(o), 4.0);
    float stroke = mix(ink(RAMP_N + oi, local), ink(RAMP_N + mod(oi + 1.0, 4.0), local), smoothstep(0.75, 1.0, fract(o)));
    glyph = mix(body, stroke, edge);
  }
  float a = mix(uTone.y, uTone.z, lv) * glyph * smoothstep(0.0, 0.12, lv);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(uInk * a, a);
}`;

class GlPainter {
  private readonly gl: WebGLRenderingContext;
  private prog: WebGLProgram | null = null;
  private fieldTex: WebGLTexture | null = null;
  private atlasTex: WebGLTexture | null = null;
  private fieldW = 0;
  private fieldH = 0;
  private uView: WebGLUniformLocation | null = null;
  private uOrigin: WebGLUniformLocation | null = null;
  private uCell: WebGLUniformLocation | null = null;
  private uGrid: WebGLUniformLocation | null = null;
  private uFieldA: WebGLUniformLocation | null = null;
  private uFieldB: WebGLUniformLocation | null = null;
  private uAtlasInv: WebGLUniformLocation | null = null;
  private uMix: WebGLUniformLocation | null = null;
  private uInk: WebGLUniformLocation | null = null;
  private uTone: WebGLUniformLocation | null = null;
  ok = false;

  constructor(gl: WebGLRenderingContext) {
    this.gl = gl;
    this.init();
  }

  init(): void {
    const gl = this.gl;
    this.ok = false;
    this.fieldW = 0;
    this.fieldH = 0;
    const vs = compile(gl, gl.VERTEX_SHADER, VERT);
    const fs = compile(gl, gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, FRAG);
    if (!vs || !fs) return;
    const prog = gl.createProgram();
    if (!prog) return;
    gl.attachShader(prog, vs);
    gl.attachShader(prog, fs);
    gl.bindAttribLocation(prog, 0, 'aPos');
    gl.linkProgram(prog);
    if (!gl.getProgramParameter(prog, gl.LINK_STATUS)) {
      console.error('AsciiFluidBackground: link failed', gl.getProgramInfoLog(prog));
      return;
    }
    this.prog = prog;
    gl.useProgram(prog);
    const buf = gl.createBuffer();
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buf);
    gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array([-1, -1, 3, -1, -1, 3]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
    gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
    this.uView = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'uView');
    this.uOrigin = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'uOrigin');
    this.uCell = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'uCell');
    this.uGrid = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'uGrid');
    this.uFieldA = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'uFieldA');
    this.uFieldB = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'uFieldB');
    this.uAtlasInv = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'uAtlasInv');
    this.uMix = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'uMix');
    this.uInk = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'uInk');
    this.uTone = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'uTone');
    gl.uniform1i(gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'uField'), 0);
    gl.uniform1i(gl.getUniformLocation(prog, 'uAtlas'), 1);
    this.fieldTex = makeTexture(gl, 0, gl.LINEAR);
    this.atlasTex = makeTexture(gl, 1, gl.NEAREST);
    gl.disable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);
    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);
    this.ok = true;
  }

  setAtlas(atlas: HTMLCanvasElement): void {
    if (!this.ok) return;
    const gl = this.gl;
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE1);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, this.atlasTex);
