    gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL, false);
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, atlas);
  }

  setField(sim: SmokeSim): void {
    if (!this.ok) return;
    const gl = this.gl;
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, this.fieldTex);
    if (sim.w !== this.fieldW || sim.h !== this.fieldH) {
      this.fieldW = sim.w;
      this.fieldH = sim.h;
      gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, sim.w, sim.h, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, sim.texels);
    } else {
      gl.texSubImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, 0, 0, sim.w, sim.h, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, sim.texels);
    }
  }

  draw(v: SmokeView, sim: SmokeSim, mix: number): void {
    const gl = this.gl;
    gl.viewport(0, 0, v.pxW, v.pxH);
    gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
    if (!this.ok || this.fieldW === 0) return;
    const ink = v.dark ? DARK_INK : LIGHT_INK;
    const alpha = v.dark ? DARK_ALPHA : LIGHT_ALPHA;
    const fw = this.fieldW;
    const fh = this.fieldH;
    gl.uniform2f(this.uView, v.pxW, v.pxH);
    gl.uniform2f(this.uOrigin, v.originX, v.originY);
    gl.uniform2f(this.uCell, v.cellW, v.cellH);
    gl.uniform2f(this.uGrid, v.cols, v.rows);
    gl.uniform2f(this.uFieldA, (sim.viewR - sim.viewL) / (fw * v.pxW), (sim.viewB - sim.viewT) / (fh * v.pxH));
    gl.uniform2f(this.uFieldB, (sim.viewL + 0.5) / fw, (sim.viewT + 0.5) / fh);
    gl.uniform2f(this.uAtlasInv, 1 / v.atlasW, 1 / v.atlasH);
    gl.uniform1f(this.uMix, mix);
    gl.uniform3f(this.uInk, ink[0], ink[1], ink[2]);
    gl.uniform4f(this.uTone, COVER_MIN, alpha[0], alpha[1], EDGE_GRAD);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 3);
  }
}

function compile(gl: WebGLRenderingContext, type: number, src: string): WebGLShader | null {
  const sh = gl.createShader(type);
  if (!sh) return null;
  gl.shaderSource(sh, src);
  gl.compileShader(sh);
  if (!gl.getShaderParameter(sh, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
    if (!gl.isContextLost()) console.error('AsciiFluidBackground: shader failed', gl.getShaderInfoLog(sh));
    return null;
  }
  return sh;
}

function makeTexture(gl: WebGLRenderingContext, unit: number, filter: number): WebGLTexture | null {
  const tex = gl.createTexture();
  gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0 + unit);
  gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, filter);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, filter);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
  return tex;
}

const FALLBACK_TIERS = 6;

class CanvasPainter {
  private readonly ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D;
  private atlas: HTMLCanvasElement | null = null;
  private tableCols = 0;
  private tableRows = 0;
  private tableSim: SmokeSim | null = null;
  private colJ = new Int32Array(0);
  private colF = new Float32Array(0);
  private rowJ = new Int32Array(0);
  private rowF = new Float32Array(0);
  private atlasDark = false;

  constructor(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D) {
    this.ctx = ctx;
  }

  private buildAtlas(v: SmokeView): void {
    const cols = RAMP.length * FALLBACK_TIERS;
    const atlas = this.atlas ?? document.createElement('canvas');
    atlas.width = v.cellW * cols;
    atlas.height = v.cellH;
    const ctx = atlas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, atlas.width, atlas.height);
    const ink = v.dark ? DARK_INK : LIGHT_INK;
    const alpha = v.dark ? DARK_ALPHA : LIGHT_ALPHA;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.round(ink[0] * 255)}, ${Math.round(ink[1] * 255)}, ${Math.round(ink[2] * 255)})`;
    ctx.font = `${Math.round(v.cellH * FONT_FILL)}px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
      const lv = (c + 0.5) / cols;
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha[0] + (alpha[1] - alpha[0]) * lv;
      ctx.fillText(RAMP[Math.floor(c / FALLBACK_TIERS)], c * v.cellW + v.cellW * 0.5, v.cellH * 0.52);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    this.atlas = atlas;
    this.atlasDark = v.dark;
  }

  rebuild(v: SmokeView): void {
    this.buildAtlas(v);
    this.tableCols = 0;
  }

  draw(v: SmokeView, sim: SmokeSim, mix: number): void {
    const ctx = this.ctx;
    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, v.pxW, v.pxH);
    if (!this.atlas || this.atlasDark !== v.dark) this.buildAtlas(v);
    const atlas = this.atlas;
    if (!atlas) return;
    const { cols, rows, cellW, cellH, originX, originY } = v;
    const fw = sim.w;
    if (this.tableCols !== cols || this.tableRows !== rows || this.tableSim !== sim) {
      this.colJ = new Int32Array(cols);
      this.colF = new Float32Array(cols);
      this.rowJ = new Int32Array(rows);
      this.rowF = new Float32Array(rows);
      for (let x = 0; x < cols; x++) {
        const s = sim.cellX((originX + (x + 0.5) * cellW) / v.pxW);
        const j = Math.min(fw - 2, Math.max(0, Math.floor(s)));
        this.colJ[x] = j;
        this.colF[x] = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, s - j));
      }
      for (let y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
        const s = sim.cellY((originY + (y + 0.5) * cellH) / v.pxH);
        const j = Math.min(sim.h - 2, Math.max(0, Math.floor(s)));
        this.rowJ[y] = j;
        this.rowF[y] = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, s - j));
      }
      this.tableCols = cols;
      this.tableRows = rows;
      this.tableSim = sim;
    }
    const tx = sim.texels;
    const tiers = RAMP.length * FALLBACK_TIERS;
    const inv = 1 / (255 * 255);
    for (let y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
      const r0 = this.rowJ[y] * fw;
      const fy = this.rowF[y];
      const dy = originY + y * cellH;
      for (let x = 0; x < cols; x++) {
        const j = (r0 + this.colJ[x]) * 4;
        const fx = this.colF[x];
        const jr = j + 4;
        const jd = j + fw * 4;
        const je = jd + 4;
        const cNow = lerp2(tx[j] * tx[j], tx[jr] * tx[jr], tx[jd] * tx[jd], tx[je] * tx[je], fx, fy);
        const cOld = lerp2(tx[j + 1] * tx[j + 1], tx[jr + 1] * tx[jr + 1], tx[jd + 1] * tx[jd + 1], tx[je + 1] * tx[je + 1], fx, fy);
        const c = (cOld + (cNow - cOld) * mix) * inv;
        if (c < COVER_MIN) continue;
        let col = (((c - COVER_MIN) / (1 - COVER_MIN)) * tiers) | 0;
        if (col >= tiers) col = tiers - 1;
        ctx.drawImage(atlas, col * cellW, 0, cellW, cellH, originX + x * cellW, dy, cellW, cellH);
      }
    }
  }
}

function lerp2(a: number, b: number, c: number, e: number, fx: number, fy: number): number {
  const top = a + (b - a) * fx;
  return top + (c + (e - c) * fx - top) * fy;
}

class SmokeView {
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement;
  private gl: GlPainter | null = null;
  private cpu: CanvasPainter | null = null;
  private sim: SmokeSim | null = null;
  private host: HTMLElement | null = null;
  private abort: AbortController | null = null;
  private readonly resizeObs: ResizeObserver;
  private readonly screenObs: IntersectionObserver | null;
  private readonly atlas: HTMLCanvasElement;
  private readonly loop: (now: number) => void;
  private rafId = 0;
  private onScreen = true;
  private reduced = false;
  private glLost = false;
  private fontAsked = false;
  dark = false;

  private cssW = 0;
  private cssH = 0;
  private dpr = 1;
  pxW = 0;
  pxH = 0;
  cellW = 0;
  cellH = 0;
  cols = 0;
  rows = 0;
  originX = 0;
  originY = 0;
  atlasW = 1;
  atlasH = 1;

  private lastNow = 0;
  private acc = 0;
  private warmLeft = 0;
  private lastPaint = 0;
  private stillDrawn = false;
  private tier = 0;
  private costEma = 0;
  private stepsSinceTier = 0;

  private rect: DOMRect | null = null;
  private ptrKnown = false;
  private ptrClientX = 0;
  private ptrClientY = 0;
  private downId = -1;
  private downX = 0;
  private downY = 0;
  private dragged = false;

  constructor() {
    let canvas = makeCanvas();
    this.canvas = canvas;
    this.atlas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl', {
      alpha: true, premultipliedAlpha: true, antialias: false, depth: false, stencil: false,
      preserveDrawingBuffer: false, failIfMajorPerformanceCaveat: true,
    });
    if (gl) {
      this.gl = new GlPainter(gl);
      canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); this.glLost = true; });
      canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextrestored', () => {
        this.glLost = false;
        if (!this.gl) return;
        this.gl.init();
        this.uploadAtlas();
        if (this.sim) this.gl.setField(this.sim);
        this.stillDrawn = false;
        this.kick();
      });
      if (!this.gl.ok) this.gl = null;
    }
    if (!this.gl) {
      if (gl) { canvas = makeCanvas(); this.canvas = canvas; }
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      if (ctx) this.cpu = new CanvasPainter(ctx);
    }
    canvas.dataset.smokePath = this.gl ? 'webgl' : this.cpu ? 'canvas' : 'none';
    this.resizeObs = new ResizeObserver(() => this.onResize());
    this.screenObs = typeof IntersectionObserver === 'function'
      ? new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
          const e = entries[entries.length - 1];
          this.onScreen = e ? e.isIntersecting : true;
          this.kick();
        })
      : null;
    this.loop = (now: number) => this.frame(now);
  }

  attach(host: HTMLElement, dark: boolean): void {
    if (this.host && this.host !== host) this.detachInternal();
    this.host = host;
    this.dark = dark;
    host.appendChild(this.canvas);
    this.reduced = typeof window.matchMedia === 'function' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    this.abort = new AbortController();
    this.installInput(this.abort.signal);
    this.resizeObs.observe(this.canvas);
    this.screenObs?.observe(this.canvas);
    this.cssW = 0;
    this.cssH = 0;
    this.rebuild();
    this.askFont();
    this.lastNow = 0;
    this.kick();
  }

  detach(host: HTMLElement): void {
    if (this.host !== host) return;
    this.detachInternal();
  }

  private detachInternal(): void {
    cancelAnimationFrame(this.rafId);
    this.rafId = 0;
    this.abort?.abort();
    this.abort = null;
    this.resizeObs.disconnect();
    this.screenObs?.disconnect();
    this.canvas.remove();
    this.host = null;
    this.resetPointer();
    this.canvas.width = 1;
    this.canvas.height = 1;
    this.cssW = 0;
    this.cssH = 0;
  }

  setTheme(dark: boolean): void {
    if (this.dark === dark) return;
    this.dark = dark;
    this.stillDrawn = false;
    this.kick();
  }

  private onResize(): void {
    this.rect = null;
    if (this.sim && Math.abs(this.canvas.clientWidth - this.cssW) <= 4 && Math.abs(this.canvas.clientHeight - this.cssH) <= 4) return;
    this.rebuild();
    this.kick();
  }

  private rebuild(): void {
    const w = this.canvas.clientWidth;
    const h = this.canvas.clientHeight;
    this.cssW = w;
    this.cssH = h;
    this.rect = null;
    if (w < 32 || h < 32) return;
    this.dpr = Math.min(getEffectiveDPR(), MAX_DPR);
    this.pxW = Math.round(w * this.dpr);
    this.pxH = Math.round(h * this.dpr);
    this.canvas.width = this.pxW;
    this.canvas.height = this.pxH;
    const cellCss = Math.min(CELL_MAX_CSS, Math.max(CELL_MIN_CSS, h / ROWS_TARGET));
    const cellH = Math.max(6, Math.round(cellCss * this.dpr));
    const cellW = Math.max(4, Math.round(cellH * CELL_ASPECT));
    const atlasChanged = cellH !== this.cellH || cellW !== this.cellW;
    this.cellH = cellH;
    this.cellW = cellW;
    this.cols = Math.max(1, Math.floor(this.pxW / cellW));
    this.rows = Math.max(1, Math.floor(this.pxH / cellH));
    this.originX = Math.floor((this.pxW - this.cols * cellW) / 2);
    this.originY = Math.floor((this.pxH - this.rows * cellH) / 2);
    this.ensureSim(w / h);
    if (atlasChanged) this.uploadAtlas();
    this.cpu?.rebuild(this);
    this.stillDrawn = false;
  }

  private ensureSim(aspect: number): void {
    const { w, h } = smokeGridFor(aspect, SMOKE_CELLS * GRID_TIERS[this.tier]);
    const old = this.sim;
    if (old && old.w === w && old.h === h) return;
    const next = new SmokeSim(w, h, (Math.random() * 4294967296) >>> 0);
    if (old) next.resampleFrom(old);
    else this.warmLeft = WARM_SECONDS;
    this.sim = next;
    this.costEma = 0;
    this.stepsSinceTier = 0;
    this.gl?.setField(next);
  }

  private uploadAtlas(): void {
    if (!this.gl || this.cellW === 0) return;
    const slots = RAMP.length + EDGES.length;
    const atlas = this.atlas;
    atlas.width = this.cellW * slots;
    atlas.height = this.cellH;
    this.atlasW = atlas.width;
    this.atlasH = atlas.height;
    const ctx = atlas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, atlas.width, atlas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = `${Math.round(this.cellH * FONT_FILL)}px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    for (let s = 0; s < slots; s++) {
      const ch = s < RAMP.length ? RAMP[s] : EDGES[s - RAMP.length];
      ctx.fillText(ch, s * this.cellW + this.cellW * 0.5, this.cellH * 0.52);
    }
    this.gl.setAtlas(atlas);
  }

  private askFont(): void {
    if (this.fontAsked || typeof document === 'undefined' || !document.fonts) return;
    this.fontAsked = true;
    document.fonts.load(`400 ${Math.max(12, this.cellH)}px "JetBrains Mono"`).then(() => {
      this.uploadAtlas();
      this.cpu?.rebuild(this);
      this.stillDrawn = false;
      this.kick();
    }, () => undefined);
  }

  private running(): boolean {
    return !!this.host && this.onScreen && !document.hidden && !this.glLost && !!this.sim && (!!this.gl || !!this.cpu);
  }

  private kick(): void {
    if (this.rafId || !this.running()) return;
    this.lastNow = 0;
    this.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(this.loop);
  }

  private frame(now: number): void {
    this.rafId = 0;
    if (!this.running()) return;
    const sim = this.sim;
    if (!sim) return;
    let stepped = false;
    if (this.warmLeft > 0) {
      const t0 = performance.now();
      while (this.warmLeft > 0 && performance.now() - t0 < WARM_BUDGET_MS) {
        sim.step(STEP);
        this.warmLeft -= STEP;
      }
      stepped = true;
      this.acc = 0;
    } else if (this.reduced) {
      if (this.stillDrawn) return;
    } else {
      const dt = this.lastNow > 0 ? Math.min(0.25, (now - this.lastNow) / 1000) : 0;
      this.acc += dt;
      let n = 0;
      while (this.acc >= STEP && n < MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME) {
        this.feedPointer(sim);
        const t0 = performance.now();
        sim.step(STEP);
        this.watchCost(performance.now() - t0);
        this.acc -= STEP;
        n++;
        stepped = true;
      }
      if (this.acc >= STEP) this.acc = 0;
    }
    this.lastNow = now;
    const mix = this.reduced || this.warmLeft > 0 ? 1 : Math.min(1, this.acc / STEP);
    if (this.gl) {
      if (stepped || !this.stillDrawn) this.gl.setField(sim);
      this.gl.draw(this, sim, mix);
    } else if (this.cpu && (stepped || !this.stillDrawn || this.reduced) && now - this.lastPaint >= FALLBACK_INTERVAL_MS - 1) {
      this.lastPaint = now;
      this.cpu.draw(this, sim, mix);
    }
    this.stillDrawn = true;
    if (this.reduced && this.warmLeft <= 0) return;
    this.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(this.loop);
  }

  private watchCost(ms: number): void {
    this.costEma = this.stepsSinceTier === 0 ? ms : this.costEma * 0.97 + ms * 0.03;
    this.stepsSinceTier++;
    if (this.costEma > DEGRADE_STEP_MS && this.stepsSinceTier > DEGRADE_GRACE_STEPS && this.tier < GRID_TIERS.length - 1) {
      this.tier++;
      if (this.cssW > 0 && this.cssH > 0) this.ensureSim(this.cssW / this.cssH);
    }
  }

  private installInput(signal: AbortSignal): void {
    const opts: AddEventListenerOptions = { passive: true, signal };
    window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => this.onPointerMove(e), opts);
    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => this.onPointerDown(e), opts);
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', (e) => this.onPointerUp(e), opts);
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', (e) => this.onPointerCancel(e), opts);
    window.addEventListener('blur', () => this.resetPointer(), { signal });
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => { this.rect = null; }, opts);
    window.addEventListener('pointerout', (e) => { if (!e.relatedTarget && e.pointerType === 'mouse') this.ptrKnown = false; }, opts);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => this.kick(), { signal });
  }

  private boxRect(): DOMRect | null {
    if (!this.rect) {
      const r = this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!r.width || !r.height) return null;
      this.rect = r;
    }
    return this.rect;
  }

  private onPointerMove(e: PointerEvent): void {
    if (e.pointerType && e.pointerType !== 'mouse' && this.downId !== e.pointerId) return;
    this.ptrKnown = true;
    this.ptrClientX = e.clientX;
    this.ptrClientY = e.clientY;
    if (this.downId === e.pointerId && !this.dragged) {
      const dx = e.clientX - this.downX;
      const dy = e.clientY - this.downY;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy >= DRAG_THRESHOLD * DRAG_THRESHOLD) this.dragged = true;
    }
  }

  private onPointerDown(e: PointerEvent): void {
    if (e.isPrimary === false) return;
    this.downId = e.pointerId;
    this.downX = e.clientX;
    this.downY = e.clientY;
    this.dragged = false;
    this.ptrKnown = true;
    this.ptrClientX = e.clientX;
    this.ptrClientY = e.clientY;
  }

  private onPointerUp(e: PointerEvent): void {
    if (this.downId !== e.pointerId) return;
    const wasDrag = this.dragged;
    this.downId = -1;
    this.dragged = false;
    if (e.pointerType && e.pointerType !== 'mouse') this.ptrKnown = false;
    if (wasDrag || this.reduced) return;
    const target = e.target as Element | null;
    if (target && typeof target.closest === 'function' &&
        target.closest('button, a, input, select, textarea, [role="slider"], [role="dialog"]')) return;
    const sim = this.sim;
    const r = this.boxRect();
    if (!sim || !r) return;
    const fx = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width;
    const fy = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height;
    if (fx < 0 || fy < 0 || fx > 1 || fy > 1) return;
    sim.puff(sim.cellX(fx), sim.cellY(fy), Math.random() * 1000);
  }

  private onPointerCancel(e: PointerEvent): void {
    if (this.downId !== e.pointerId) return;
    this.resetPointer();
  }

  private resetPointer(): void {
    this.downId = -1;
    this.dragged = false;
    this.ptrKnown = false;
  }

  private feedPointer(sim: SmokeSim): void {
    const r = this.ptrKnown && !this.reduced ? this.boxRect() : null;
    if (!r) { sim.setPointer(false, 0, 0, 0, 0); return; }
    const fx = (this.ptrClientX - r.left) / r.width;
    const fy = (this.ptrClientY - r.top) / r.height;
    if (fx < 0 || fy < 0 || fx > 1 || fy > 1) { sim.setPointer(false, 0, 0, 0, 0); return; }
    const cellCss = this.cssW / (sim.viewR - sim.viewL);
    const radius = Math.max(STIR_RADIUS_MIN, STIR_RADIUS_CSS / cellCss);
    sim.setPointer(true, sim.cellX(fx), sim.cellY(fy), radius, this.dragged ? 1 : 0);
  }
}

function makeCanvas(): HTMLCanvasElement {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  canvas.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;pointer-events:none;';
  return canvas;
}

let _view: SmokeView | null = null;
function smokeView(): SmokeView {
  if (!_view) _view = new SmokeView();
  return _view;
}

interface Props {
  isDark: boolean;
}

export const AsciiFluidBackground: React.FC<Props> = ({ isDark }) => {
  const hostRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const darkRef = useRef(isDark);
  darkRef.current = isDark;

  useEffect(() => {
    const host = hostRef.current;
    if (!host) return;
    const view = smokeView();
    view.attach(host, darkRef.current);
    return () => view.detach(host);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    _view?.setTheme(isDark);
  }, [isDark]);

  return <div ref={hostRef} aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none" />;
};
export const SMOKE_CELLS = 9600;
export const SMOKE_HZ = 40;
export const SMOKE_MARGIN_X = 6;
export const SMOKE_MARGIN_BOTTOM = 10;

const PRESSURE_SWEEPS = 10;
const SOR_OMEGA = 1.72;
const BUOYANCY = 95;
const SMOKE_WEIGHT = 2.2;
const VORTICITY = 6;
const VELOCITY_KEEP = 0.25;
const SMOKE_FADE = 0.065;
const SMOKE_CUT = 0.03;
const HEAT_FADE = 0.08;
const VISCOSITY = 1;
const TOP_FADE_BAND = 0.1;
const TOP_FADE = 1.2;

const PLUME_SPACING = 18;
const PLUME_RADIUS = 1.5;
const PLUME_SMOKE = 5.0;
const PLUME_HEAT = 4.5;
const PLUME_JET = 40;
const PLUME_SWAY = 8;
const DRAFT_WAVES = 3;
const DRAFT_FORCE = 0.8;
const STIR_FOLLOW = 0.42;
const STIR_MAX_SPEED = 70;
const STIR_SMOKE = 0.075;
const STIR_HEAT = 0.06;
const STIR_SPACING = 0.6;
const STIR_JUMP = 24;
const PUFF_POOL = 6;
const PUFF_LIFE = 0.55;
const PUFF_REACH = 9;
const PUFF_PUSH = 70;
const PUFF_SMOKE = 1.6;
const PUFF_THICK = 1.6;

function makeRandom(seed: number): () => number {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = a;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

export function smokeGridFor(aspect: number, cells: number = SMOKE_CELLS): { w: number; h: number } {
  const a = aspect > 0.2 ? (aspect < 5 ? aspect : 5) : 0.2;
  const vh = Math.max(20, Math.round(Math.sqrt(cells / a)));
  const vw = Math.max(20, Math.round(cells / vh));
  return { w: vw + 2 * SMOKE_MARGIN_X + 2, h: vh + SMOKE_MARGIN_BOTTOM + 2 };
}

export class SmokeSim {
  readonly w: number;
  readonly h: number;
  readonly n: number;
  readonly d: Float32Array;
  readonly texels: Uint8Array;
  time = 0;
  readonly viewL: number;
  readonly viewR: number;
  readonly viewT: number;
  readonly viewB: number;

  private readonly u: Float32Array;
  private readonly v: Float32Array;
  private readonly u0: Float32Array;
  private readonly v0: Float32Array;
  private readonly d0: Float32Array;
  private readonly dHat: Float32Array;
  private readonly heat: Float32Array;
  private readonly heat0: Float32Array;
  private readonly p: Float32Array;
  private readonly div: Float32Array;
  private readonly curl: Float32Array;
  private readonly plumeCount: number;
  private readonly plumeBase: Float32Array;
  private readonly plumePhase: Float32Array;
  private readonly plumeRate: Float32Array;
  private readonly draftKx = new Float32Array(DRAFT_WAVES);
  private readonly draftKy = new Float32Array(DRAFT_WAVES);
  private readonly draftW = new Float32Array(DRAFT_WAVES);
  private readonly draftPhase = new Float32Array(DRAFT_WAVES);
  private readonly draftCosX: Float32Array;
  private readonly draftSinX: Float32Array;
  private readonly draftCosY: Float32Array;
  private readonly draftSinY: Float32Array;
  private readonly draftFu = new Float32Array(DRAFT_WAVES);
  private readonly draftFv = new Float32Array(DRAFT_WAVES);

  private ptrActive = false;
  private ptrHasPrev = false;
  private ptrX = 0;
  private ptrY = 0;
  private ptrPrevX = 0;
  private ptrPrevY = 0;
  private ptrRadius = 2;
  private ptrBoost = 0;

  private readonly puffX = new Float32Array(PUFF_POOL);
  private readonly puffY = new Float32Array(PUFF_POOL);
  private readonly puffT = new Float32Array(PUFF_POOL).fill(-1);
  private readonly puffSeed = new Float32Array(PUFF_POOL);
  private puffNext = 0;

  constructor(w: number, h: number, seed: number) {
    this.w = w;
    this.h = h;
    this.n = w * h;
    const n = this.n;
    this.viewL = 0.5 + SMOKE_MARGIN_X;
    this.viewR = w - 1.5 - SMOKE_MARGIN_X;
    this.viewT = 0.5;
    this.viewB = h - 1.5 - SMOKE_MARGIN_BOTTOM;
    this.d = new Float32Array(n);
    this.d0 = new Float32Array(n);
    this.dHat = new Float32Array(n);
    this.u = new Float32Array(n);
    this.v = new Float32Array(n);
    this.u0 = new Float32Array(n);
    this.v0 = new Float32Array(n);
    this.heat = new Float32Array(n);
    this.heat0 = new Float32Array(n);
    this.p = new Float32Array(n);
    this.div = new Float32Array(n);
    this.curl = new Float32Array(n);
    this.texels = new Uint8Array(n * 4);
    const rnd = makeRandom(seed);
    this.plumeCount = Math.max(2, Math.min(6, Math.round((this.viewR - this.viewL) / PLUME_SPACING)));
    this.plumeBase = new Float32Array(this.plumeCount);
    this.plumePhase = new Float32Array(this.plumeCount * 4);
    this.plumeRate = new Float32Array(this.plumeCount * 4);
    for (let k = 0; k < this.plumeCount; k++) {
      this.plumeBase[k] = (k + 0.5 + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.3) / this.plumeCount;
      for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
        this.plumePhase[k * 4 + j] = rnd() * Math.PI * 2;
        this.plumeRate[k * 4 + j] = 0.6 + rnd() * 0.8;
      }
    }
    this.draftCosX = new Float32Array(DRAFT_WAVES * w);
    this.draftSinX = new Float32Array(DRAFT_WAVES * w);
    this.draftCosY = new Float32Array(DRAFT_WAVES * h);
    this.draftSinY = new Float32Array(DRAFT_WAVES * h);
    for (let k = 0; k < DRAFT_WAVES; k++) {
      const len = h * (0.7 + 0.8 * rnd());
      const dir = rnd() * Math.PI * 2;
      const kk = (Math.PI * 2) / len;
      this.draftKx[k] = kk * Math.cos(dir);
      this.draftKy[k] = kk * Math.sin(dir);
      this.draftW[k] = (Math.PI * 2) / (28 + 34 * rnd());
      this.draftPhase[k] = rnd() * Math.PI * 2;
      for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
        this.draftCosX[k * w + x] = Math.cos(this.draftKx[k] * x);
        this.draftSinX[k * w + x] = Math.sin(this.draftKx[k] * x);
      }
    }
    this.time = rnd() * 100;
  }

  resampleFrom(old: SmokeSim): void {
    this.time = old.time;
    const ow = old.w;
    const oh = old.h;
    const sx = (old.viewR - old.viewL) / (this.viewR - this.viewL);
    const sy = (old.viewB - old.viewT) / (this.viewB - this.viewT);
    for (let y = 0; y < this.h; y++) {
      let py = old.viewT + (y - this.viewT) * sy;
      if (py < 0) py = 0; else if (py > oh - 1.001) py = oh - 1.001;
      const y0 = py | 0;
      const fy = py - y0;
      for (let x = 0; x < this.w; x++) {
        let px = old.viewL + (x - this.viewL) * sx;
        if (px < 0) px = 0; else if (px > ow - 1.001) px = ow - 1.001;
        const x0 = px | 0;
        const fx = px - x0;
        const j = x0 + y0 * ow;
        const i = x + y * this.w;
        this.d[i] = bilerp(old.d, j, ow, fx, fy);
        this.heat[i] = bilerp(old.heat, j, ow, fx, fy);
        this.u[i] = bilerp(old.u, j, ow, fx, fy) / sx;
        this.v[i] = bilerp(old.v, j, ow, fx, fy) / sy;
      }
    }
    this.encode(true);
  }

  cellX(fx: number): number { return this.viewL + fx * (this.viewR - this.viewL); }
  cellY(fy: number): number { return this.viewT + fy * (this.viewB - this.viewT); }

  setPointer(active: boolean, x: number, y: number, radius: number, boost: number): void {
    if (!active) { this.ptrActive = false; this.ptrHasPrev = false; return; }
    if (!this.ptrActive) { this.ptrHasPrev = false; }
    this.ptrActive = true;
    this.ptrX = x;
    this.ptrY = y;
    this.ptrRadius = radius;
    this.ptrBoost = boost;
  }

  puff(x: number, y: number, seed: number): void {
    const k = this.puffNext;
    this.puffNext = (k + 1) % PUFF_POOL;
    this.puffX[k] = x;
    this.puffY[k] = y;
    this.puffT[k] = this.time;
    this.puffSeed[k] = seed;
  }

  step(dt: number): void {
    const { u, v, u0, v0 } = this;
    this.time += dt;
    u0.set(u);
    v0.set(v);
    this.advectVelocity(dt);
    this.smoothVel(dt);
    this.addPlumes(dt);
    this.addDraft(dt);
    this.addPointer(dt);
    this.addPuffs(dt);
    this.addBuoyancyAndCurl(dt);
    this.project();
    this.d0.set(this.d);
    this.heat0.set(this.heat);
    this.advectScalars(dt);
    this.fade(dt);
    this.encode(false);
  }

  private addPlumes(dt: number): void {
    const { time } = this;
    const sy = this.viewB + SMOKE_MARGIN_BOTTOM * 0.6;
    for (let k = 0; k < this.plumeCount; k++) {
      const ph = this.plumePhase;
      const rt = this.plumeRate;
      const q = k * 4;
      const drift = 0.04 * Math.sin(time * 0.045 * rt[q] + ph[q]) + 0.02 * Math.sin(time * 0.13 * rt[q + 1] + ph[q + 1]);
      const sx = this.cellX(this.plumeBase[k] + drift);
      const b1 = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 0.11 * rt[q + 2] + ph[q + 2]);
      const breath = 0.55 + 0.45 * b1;
      const sway = Math.sin(time * 1.1 * rt[q + 3] + ph[q + 3]) + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 2.7 * rt[q] + ph[q + 1]);
      this.splat(sx, sy, PLUME_RADIUS, PLUME_SWAY * sway * dt, -PLUME_JET * breath * dt,
        PLUME_SMOKE * breath * dt, PLUME_HEAT * breath * dt);
    }
  }

  private addDraft(dt: number): void {
    const { w, h, u, v, time, draftCosY, draftSinY, draftFu, draftFv } = this;
    const gust = 0.65 + 0.35 * Math.sin(time * 0.021 + this.draftPhase[0]);
    for (let k = 0; k < DRAFT_WAVES; k++) {
      const kx = this.draftKx[k];
      const ky = this.draftKy[k];
      const kk = Math.sqrt(kx * kx + ky * ky);
      draftFu[k] = (DRAFT_FORCE * gust * dt * ky) / kk;
      draftFv[k] = (-DRAFT_FORCE * gust * dt * kx) / kk;
      const ph = this.draftW[k] * time + this.draftPhase[k];
      for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        draftCosY[k * h + y] = Math.cos(ky * y + ph);
        draftSinY[k * h + y] = Math.sin(ky * y + ph);
      }
    }
    const cx = this.draftCosX;
    const sx = this.draftSinX;
    const fu0 = draftFu[0], fu1 = draftFu[1], fu2 = draftFu[2];
    const fv0 = draftFv[0], fv1 = draftFv[1], fv2 = draftFv[2];
    for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) {
      const c0 = draftCosY[y], s0 = draftSinY[y];
      const c1 = draftCosY[h + y], s1 = draftSinY[h + y];
      const c2 = draftCosY[2 * h + y], s2 = draftSinY[2 * h + y];
      let i = y * w + 1;
      for (let x = 1; x < w - 1; x++, i++) {
        const a0 = cx[x] * c0 - sx[x] * s0;
        const a1 = cx[w + x] * c1 - sx[w + x] * s1;
        const a2 = cx[2 * w + x] * c2 - sx[2 * w + x] * s2;
        u[i] += fu0 * a0 + fu1 * a1 + fu2 * a2;
        v[i] += fv0 * a0 + fv1 * a1 + fv2 * a2;
      }
    }
  }

  private addPointer(dt: number): void {
    if (!this.ptrActive) return;
    const x1 = this.ptrX;
    const y1 = this.ptrY;
    if (!this.ptrHasPrev) {
      this.ptrHasPrev = true;
      this.ptrPrevX = x1;
      this.ptrPrevY = y1;
      return;
    }
    const x0 = this.ptrPrevX;
    const y0 = this.ptrPrevY;
    this.ptrPrevX = x1;
    this.ptrPrevY = y1;
    const dx = x1 - x0;
    const dy = y1 - y0;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (dist < 1e-4 || dist > STIR_JUMP) return;
    let vx = dx / dt;
    let vy = dy / dt;
    const sp = dist / dt;
    if (sp > STIR_MAX_SPEED) { const k = STIR_MAX_SPEED / sp; vx *= k; vy *= k; }
    const boost = this.ptrBoost * (sp < 40 ? sp / 40 : 1);
    const r = this.ptrRadius * (1 + boost);
    const travel = dist < 6 ? dist : 6;
    const stamps = Math.max(1, Math.min(32, Math.ceil(dist / STIR_SPACING)));
    const smoke = (STIR_SMOKE * (1 + 1.5 * boost) * travel) / stamps;
    const heat = (STIR_HEAT * travel) / stamps;
    for (let s = 1; s <= stamps; s++) {
      const f = s / stamps;
      this.stir(x0 + dx * f, y0 + dy * f, r, vx, vy, STIR_FOLLOW / Math.sqrt(stamps), smoke, heat);
    }
  }

  private addPuffs(dt: number): void {
    const { w, h, u, v, d } = this;
    for (let k = 0; k < PUFF_POOL; k++) {
      const t0 = this.puffT[k];
      if (t0 < 0) continue;
      const age = this.time - t0;
      if (age > PUFF_LIFE) { this.puffT[k] = -1; continue; }
      const prog = age / PUFF_LIFE;
      const left = 1 - prog;
      const eased = 1 - left * left * left;
      const radius = 0.6 + eased * PUFF_REACH;
      const cx = this.puffX[k];
      const cy = this.puffY[k];
      const seed = this.puffSeed[k];
      const reach = radius + PUFF_THICK * 2.5;
      const x0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cx - reach));
      const x1 = Math.min(w - 2, Math.ceil(cx + reach));
      const y0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cy - reach));
      const y1 = Math.min(h - 2, Math.ceil(cy + reach));
      const push = PUFF_PUSH * left * left * dt;
      const smoke = PUFF_SMOKE * left * dt / PUFF_LIFE;
      const invT = 1 / (PUFF_THICK * PUFF_THICK);
      for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) {
        const ry = y - cy;
        for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) {
          const rx = x - cx;
          const dist = Math.sqrt(rx * rx + ry * ry);
          if (dist < 1e-3) continue;
          const ang = Math.atan2(ry, rx);
          const wave = 1 + 0.18 * Math.sin(5 * ang + seed) + 0.1 * Math.sin(9 * ang - seed * 1.7);
          const off = dist - radius * wave;
          const g = Math.exp(-off * off * invT);
          if (g < 0.01) continue;
          const i = x + y * w;
          const inv = 1 / dist;
          u[i] += rx * inv * push * g;
          v[i] += ry * inv * push * g;
          d[i] += smoke * g * wave;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private splat(cx: number, cy: number, r: number, du: number, dv: number, dd: number, dh: number): void {
    const { w, h, u, v, d, heat } = this;
    const reach = r * 2.6;
    const x0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cx - reach));
    const x1 = Math.min(w - 2, Math.ceil(cx + reach));
    const y0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cy - reach));
    const y1 = Math.min(h - 2, Math.ceil(cy + reach));
    const inv = 1 / (r * r);
    for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) {
      const ry = y - cy;
      for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) {
        const rx = x - cx;
        const g = Math.exp(-(rx * rx + ry * ry) * inv);
        const i = x + y * w;
        u[i] += du * g;
        v[i] += dv * g;
        d[i] += dd * g;
        heat[i] += dh * g;
      }
    }
  }

  private stir(cx: number, cy: number, r: number, vx: number, vy: number, follow: number, dd: number, dh: number): void {
    const { w, h, u, v, d, heat } = this;
    const reach = r * 2.4;
    const x0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cx - reach));
    const x1 = Math.min(w - 2, Math.ceil(cx + reach));
    const y0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cy - reach));
    const y1 = Math.min(h - 2, Math.ceil(cy + reach));
    const inv = 1 / (r * r);
    for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) {
      const ry = y - cy;
      for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) {
        const rx = x - cx;
        const g = Math.exp(-(rx * rx + ry * ry) * inv);
        const i = x + y * w;
        const k = follow * g;
        u[i] += (vx - u[i]) * k;
        v[i] += (vy - v[i]) * k;
        d[i] += dd * g;
        heat[i] += dh * g;
      }
    }
  }

  private addBuoyancyAndCurl(dt: number): void {
    const { w, h, u, v, d, heat, curl } = this;
    for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) {
      let i = y * w + 1;
      for (let x = 1; x < w - 1; x++, i++) {
        curl[i] = 0.25 * ((v[i + 1 - w] + v[i + 1] - v[i - 1 - w] - v[i - 1]) - (u[i + w - 1] + u[i + w] - u[i - w - 1] - u[i - w]));
      }
    }
    const eps = VORTICITY * dt;
    for (let y = 2; y < h - 2; y++) {
      let i = y * w + 2;
      for (let x = 2; x < w - 2; x++, i++) {
        const c = curl[i];
        const cr = curl[i + 1], cl = curl[i - 1], cd = curl[i + w], cu = curl[i - w];
        const gx = 0.5 * ((cr < 0 ? -cr : cr) - (cl < 0 ? -cl : cl));
        const gy = 0.5 * ((cd < 0 ? -cd : cd) - (cu < 0 ? -cu : cu));
        const k = (eps * c) / (Math.sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy) + 1e-5);
        const fx = 0.5 * gy * k;
        const fy = 0.5 * (-gx * k + dt * (SMOKE_WEIGHT * d[i] - BUOYANCY * heat[i]));
        u[i - 1] += fx;
        u[i] += fx;
        v[i - w] += fy;
        v[i] += fy;
      }
    }
  }

  private smoothVel(dt: number): void {
    const { w, h, u, v, u0, v0 } = this;
    const k = 1 - Math.exp(-VISCOSITY * dt);
    u0.set(u);
    v0.set(v);
    for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) {
      let i = y * w + 1;
      for (let x = 1; x < w - 2; x++, i++) {
        u[i] += k * ((u0[i - 1] + u0[i + 1] + u0[i - w] + u0[i + w]) * 0.25 - u0[i]);
      }
    }
    for (let y = 1; y < h - 2; y++) {
      let i = y * w + 1;
      for (let x = 1; x < w - 1; x++, i++) {
        v[i] += k * ((v0[i - 1] + v0[i + 1] + v0[i - w] + v0[i + w]) * 0.25 - v0[i]);
      }
    }
    this.boundVel();
  }

  private project(): void {
    const { w, h, u, v, p, div } = this;
    this.boundVel();
    for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) {
      let i = y * w + 1;
      for (let x = 1; x < w - 1; x++, i++) {
        div[i] = -(u[i] - u[i - 1] + v[i] - v[i - w]);
      }
    }
    for (let it = 0; it < PRESSURE_SWEEPS; it++) {
      for (let color = 0; color < 2; color++) {
        for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) {
          const row = y * w;
          for (let x = 1 + ((y + color) & 1); x < w - 1; x += 2) {
            const i = row + x;
            const gs = (div[i] + p[i - 1] + p[i + 1] + p[i - w] + p[i + w]) * 0.25;
            p[i] += SOR_OMEGA * (gs - p[i]);
          }
        }
      }
      this.boundPressure();
    }
    for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) {
      let i = y * w + 1;
      for (let x = 1; x < w - 2; x++, i++) u[i] -= p[i + 1] - p[i];
    }
    for (let y = 0; y < h - 2; y++) {
      let i = y * w + 1;
      for (let x = 1; x < w - 1; x++, i++) v[i] -= p[i + w] - p[i];
    }
    this.boundVel();
  }

  private advectVelocity(dt: number): void {
    const { w, h, u, v, u0, v0 } = this;
    const maxFace = w - 2.001;
    const maxRowU = h - 2.001;
    for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) {
      let i = y * w + 1;
      for (let x = 1; x < w - 2; x++, i++) {
        const vu = 0.25 * (v0[i - w] + v0[i - w + 1] + v0[i] + v0[i + 1]);
        let px = x - dt * u0[i];
        let py = y - dt * vu;
        if (px < 0) px = 0; else if (px > maxFace) px = maxFace;
        if (py < 1) py = 1; else if (py > maxRowU) py = maxRowU;
        const x0 = px | 0;
        const y0 = py | 0;
        const fx = px - x0;
        const fy = py - y0;
        const j = x0 + y0 * w;
        const a = u0[j], b = u0[j + 1], c = u0[j + w], e = u0[j + w + 1];
        const top = a + (b - a) * fx;
        u[i] = top + (c + (e - c) * fx - top) * fy;
      }
    }
    const maxColV = w - 2.001;
    const maxRowV = h - 2.001;
    for (let y = 0; y < h - 2; y++) {
      let i = y * w + 1;
      for (let x = 1; x < w - 1; x++, i++) {
        const uv = 0.25 * (u0[i - 1] + u0[i] + u0[i - 1 + w] + u0[i + w]);
        let px = x - dt * uv;
        let py = y - dt * v0[i];
        if (px < 1) px = 1; else if (px > maxColV) px = maxColV;
        if (py < 0) py = 0; else if (py > maxRowV) py = maxRowV;
        const x0 = px | 0;
        const y0 = py | 0;
        const fx = px - x0;
        const fy = py - y0;
        const j = x0 + y0 * w;
        const a = v0[j], b = v0[j + 1], c = v0[j + w], e = v0[j + w + 1];
        const top = a + (b - a) * fx;
        v[i] = top + (c + (e - c) * fx - top) * fy;
      }
    }
    this.boundVel();
  }

  private advectScalars(dt: number): void {
    const { w, h, u, v, d, d0, dHat, heat, heat0 } = this;
    const lo = this.div;
    const hi = this.curl;
    const maxX = w - 1.501;
    const maxY = h - 1.501;
    for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) {
      let i = y * w + 1;
      for (let x = 1; x < w - 1; x++, i++) {
        let px = x - dt * 0.5 * (u[i - 1] + u[i]);
        let py = y - dt * 0.5 * (v[i - w] + v[i]);
        if (px < 0.5) px = 0.5; else if (px > maxX) px = maxX;
        if (py < 0.5) py = 0.5; else if (py > maxY) py = maxY;
        const x0 = px | 0;
        const y0 = py | 0;
        const fx = px - x0;
        const fy = py - y0;
        const j = x0 + y0 * w;
        let a = d0[j], b = d0[j + 1], c = d0[j + w], e = d0[j + w + 1];
        let top = a + (b - a) * fx;
        dHat[i] = top + (c + (e - c) * fx - top) * fy;
        lo[i] = Math.min(a, b, c, e);
        hi[i] = Math.max(a, b, c, e);
        a = heat0[j]; b = heat0[j + 1]; c = heat0[j + w]; e = heat0[j + w + 1];
        top = a + (b - a) * fx;
        heat[i] = top + (c + (e - c) * fx - top) * fy;
      }
    }
    this.boundScalar(dHat);
    for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) {
      let i = y * w + 1;
      for (let x = 1; x < w - 1; x++, i++) {
        let qx = x + dt * 0.5 * (u[i - 1] + u[i]);
        let qy = y + dt * 0.5 * (v[i - w] + v[i]);
        if (qx < 0.5) qx = 0.5; else if (qx > maxX) qx = maxX;
        if (qy < 0.5) qy = 0.5; else if (qy > maxY) qy = maxY;
        const x0 = qx | 0;
        const y0 = qy | 0;
        const fx = qx - x0;
        const fy = qy - y0;
        const j = x0 + y0 * w;
        const a = dHat[j], b = dHat[j + 1], c = dHat[j + w], e = dHat[j + w + 1];
        const top = a + (b - a) * fx;
        const back = top + (c + (e - c) * fx - top) * fy;
        const r = dHat[i] + 0.5 * (d0[i] - back);
        const mn = lo[i];
        const mx = hi[i];
        d[i] = r < mn ? mn : r > mx ? mx : r;
      }
    }
    this.boundScalar(d);
    this.boundScalar(heat);
  }

  private fade(dt: number): void {
    const { w, h, u, v, d, heat, n } = this;
    const kd = Math.exp(-SMOKE_FADE * dt);
    const kh = Math.exp(-HEAT_FADE * dt);
    const kv = Math.exp(-VELOCITY_KEEP * dt);
    const cut = SMOKE_CUT * dt;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const dv = d[i] * kd - cut;
      d[i] = dv > 0 ? dv : 0;
      heat[i] *= kh;
      u[i] *= kv;
      v[i] *= kv;
    }
    const band = Math.max(2, Math.round(h * TOP_FADE_BAND));
    for (let y = 1; y < band; y++) {
      const q = (band - y) / band;
      const k = Math.exp(-TOP_FADE * dt * q * q * 4);
      let i = y * w;
      for (let x = 0; x < w; x++, i++) d[i] *= k;
    }
  }

  private encode(both: boolean): void {
    const { d, texels, n } = this;
    for (let i = 0, j = 0; i < n; i++, j += 4) {
      const dv = d[i];
      const c = dv > 0 ? Math.sqrt(1 - Math.exp(-dv)) : 0;
      const q = (c * 255 + 0.5) | 0;
      texels[j + 1] = both ? q : texels[j];
      texels[j] = q;
    }
  }

  private boundVel(): void {
    const { w, h, u, v } = this;
    for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
      const r = y * w;
      u[r] = 0;
      u[r + w - 2] = 0;
      u[r + w - 1] = 0;
      v[r] = v[r + 1];
      v[r + w - 1] = v[r + w - 2];
    }
    const bot = (h - 1) * w;
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      u[x] = u[x + w];
      u[bot + x] = u[bot - w + x];
      v[bot - w + x] = 0;
      v[bot + x] = 0;
    }
  }

  private boundScalar(s: Float32Array): void {
    const { w, h } = this;
    for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) {
      const r = y * w;
      s[r] = s[r + 1];
      s[r + w - 1] = s[r + w - 2];
    }
    const bot = (h - 1) * w;
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      s[x] = 0;
      s[bot + x] = s[bot - w + x];
    }
  }

  private boundPressure(): void {
    const { w, h, p } = this;
    for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) {
      const r = y * w;
      p[r] = p[r + 1];
      p[r + w - 1] = p[r + w - 2];
    }
    const bot = (h - 1) * w;
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      p[x] = 0;
      p[bot + x] = p[bot - w + x];
    }
  }
}

function bilerp(s: Float32Array, j: number, w: number, fx: number, fy: number): number {
  const a = s[j], b = s[j + 1], c = s[j + w], e = s[j + w + 1];
  const top = a + (b - a) * fx;
  return top + (c + (e - c) * fx - top) * fy;
}
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { ChevronDown, Check, Plus } from '../ui/icons';
import { useFloatingPopup } from './useFloatingPopup';
import { useBackdropClose } from './useBackdropClose';
import { getVisualScale } from '../../utils/zoomCompensation';
import { SwapInPlace } from '../kit/Collapse';
import { useRowWindow } from '../kit/LongList';
import { scrollGlide, nearestScrollTop } from '../kit/presence';

export type SelectOption = { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean; swatch?: string };
export type SelectGroup = { label: string; options: SelectOption[] };

interface CustomSelectProps {
  value: string;
  onChange: (val: string) => void;
  options?: Record<string, string> | SelectOption[];
  placeholder?: string;
  className?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  groups?: SelectGroup[];
  addLabel?: string;
}

const SWATCH_CLS = 'inline-block w-3 h-3 rounded-sm border border-[var(--alpha-card-border)] mr-2 align-[-1px]';

function normalizeOptions(options?: Record<string, string> | SelectOption[]): SelectOption[] {
  if (!options) return [];
  if (Array.isArray(options)) return options;
  return Object.entries(options).map(([k, v]) => ({ value: k, label: v }));
}

const OptionItem: React.FC<{
  opt: SelectOption;
  selected: boolean;
  onSelect: (val: string) => void;
  active?: boolean;
  innerRef?: (el: HTMLButtonElement | null) => void;
}> = ({ opt, selected, onSelect, active, innerRef }) => (
  <button
    type="button"
    ref={innerRef}
    data-kfade-row=""
    disabled={opt.disabled}
    tabIndex={-1}
    onMouseDown={e => e.preventDefault()}
    onClick={() => { if (!opt.disabled) onSelect(opt.value); }}
    className={`w-full text-left px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-[12.5px] transition-colors flex items-center justify-between gap-2 ${
      opt.disabled
        ? 'text-[var(--text-tertiary)] opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed'
        : selected
        ? 'bg-[var(--alpha-selected)] text-[var(--text-primary)] [font-weight:var(--fw-head)] cursor-pointer'
        : active
        ? 'bg-[var(--alpha-hover)] text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer'
        : 'text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:bg-[var(--alpha-hover)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] cursor-pointer'
    }`}
  >
    <span className="truncate min-w-0">
      {opt.swatch && <span aria-hidden="true" className={SWATCH_CLS} style={{ background: opt.swatch }} />}
      {opt.label}
    </span>
    {selected && !opt.disabled && <Check size={14} className="shrink-0 text-[var(--accent)]" />}
  </button>
);

const LONG_LIST = 40;
type LongRow = { key: string; head: string; first: boolean } | { key: string; opt: SelectOption; idx: number };
const LongOptions: React.FC<{ groups?: SelectGroup[]; options: SelectOption[]; value: string; activeIndex: number; onSelect: (v: string) => void }> = ({ groups, options, value, activeIndex, onSelect }) => {
  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    const out: LongRow[] = [];
    let idx = -1;
    if (groups) groups.forEach((g, gi) => { out.push({ key: `h${gi}`, head: g.label, first: gi === 0 }); for (const opt of g.options) { idx++; out.push({ key: `o${idx}`, opt, idx }); } });
    else for (const opt of options) { idx++; out.push({ key: `o${idx}`, opt, idx }); }
    return out;
  }, [groups, options]);
  const win = useRowWindow(rows.length, i => rows[i].key, 30);
  useEffect(() => { if (activeIndex >= 0) win.reveal(`o${activeIndex}`); }, [activeIndex]);
  const space = (h: number): React.CSSProperties => ({ height: h, ['--vl-row' as string]: '30px' });
  return (
    <div ref={el => { win.box.current = el; win.rows.current = el; }}>
      {win.above > 0 ? <div key="above" className="k-vl-skel" style={space(win.above)} aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
      {rows.slice(win.a, win.b).map(r => ('head' in r
        ? <div key={r.key} data-ll={r.key}>{!r.first && <div className="border-t border-[var(--alpha-divider)] my-1" />}<div className="px-3 py-1 eyebrow">{r.head}</div></div>
        : <div key={r.key} data-ll={r.key}><OptionItem opt={r.opt} selected={r.opt.value === value} onSelect={onSelect} active={r.idx === activeIndex} /></div>))}
      {win.below > 0 ? <div key="below" className="k-vl-skel" style={space(win.below)} aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
    </div>
  );
};

export const CustomSelect: React.FC<CustomSelectProps> = ({
  value, onChange, options, placeholder, className, disabled, groups, addLabel,
}) => {
  const normalizedOptions = useMemo(() => normalizeOptions(options), [options]);

  const [menuWidth, setMenuWidth] = useState<number | undefined>(undefined);

  const { triggerRef, popupRef, isOpen, toggle, close, popupStyle, leaving, dropClass, moving } = useFloatingPopup({
    claimsEscape: true,
    estimatedHeight: 256,
    estimatedWidth: menuWidth,
  });

  const toggleAt = (el: HTMLElement) => {
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!isOpen) setMenuWidth(rect.width / (getVisualScale(el) || 1));
    toggle(rect);
  };

  const selectedLabel = useMemo(() => {
    if (groups) {
      for (const g of groups) {
        const found = g.options.find(o => o.value === value);
        if (found) return found.label;
      }
      return placeholder || '';
    }
    const found = normalizedOptions.find(o => o.value === value);
    return found?.label || placeholder || '';
  }, [value, normalizedOptions, groups, placeholder]);

  const selectedSwatch = useMemo(
    () => (groups ? undefined : normalizedOptions.find(o => o.value === value)?.swatch),
    [value, normalizedOptions, groups]);

  const handleSelect = (val: string) => {
    if (moving()) return;
    onChange(val);
    close();
  };

  const backdropProps = useBackdropClose(close);

  const flatOptions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!groups) return normalizedOptions;
    const out: SelectOption[] = [];
    for (const g of groups) for (const o of g.options) out.push(o);
    return out;
  }, [groups, normalizedOptions]);

  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(-1);
  const optionEls = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);
  const typeAhead = useRef('');
  const typeAheadAt = useRef(0);

  const step = (from: number, dir: 1 | -1): number => {
    let i = from;
    for (;;) {
      const next = i + dir;
      if (next < 0 || next >= flatOptions.length) return i < 0 ? from : i;
      i = next;
      if (!flatOptions[i].disabled) return i;
    }
  };

  const firstSelectable = (dir: 1 | -1): number => {
    const start = dir === 1 ? -1 : flatOptions.length;
    return step(start, dir);
  };

  const openMenu = (preferIndex: number) => {
    const el = triggerRef.current as HTMLElement | null;
    if (!el) return;
    setActiveIndex(preferIndex);
    toggleAt(el);
  };

  const selectedIndex = () => flatOptions.findIndex(o => o.value === value);

  const onTriggerKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (disabled) return;
    const k = e.key;

    if (k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      const dir = k === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1;
      if (moving()) return;
      if (!isOpen) {
        const sel = selectedIndex();
        openMenu(sel >= 0 ? sel : firstSelectable(dir));
      } else {
        setActiveIndex(prev => (prev < 0 ? firstSelectable(dir) : step(prev, dir)));
      }
      return;
    }

    if (k === 'Home' || k === 'End') {
      if (!isOpen) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      setActiveIndex(firstSelectable(k === 'Home' ? 1 : -1));
      return;
    }

    if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ' || k === 'Spacebar') {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (moving()) return;
      if (!isOpen) {
        const sel = selectedIndex();
        openMenu(sel >= 0 ? sel : firstSelectable(1));
      } else if (!leaving && activeIndex >= 0 && activeIndex < flatOptions.length && !flatOptions[activeIndex].disabled) {
        handleSelect(flatOptions[activeIndex].value);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (k.length === 1 && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey) {
      const now = Date.now();
      typeAhead.current = (now - typeAheadAt.current > 800 ? '' : typeAhead.current) + k.toLowerCase();
      typeAheadAt.current = now;
      const term = typeAhead.current;
      const hit = flatOptions.findIndex(o => !o.disabled && o.label.toLowerCase().startsWith(term));
      if (hit < 0) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (!isOpen) openMenu(hit); else setActiveIndex(hit);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || activeIndex < 0 || flatOptions.length > LONG_LIST) return;
    const el = optionEls.current[activeIndex];
    const box = popupRef.current as HTMLDivElement | null;
    if (!el || !box) return;
    const to = nearestScrollTop(box, el.offsetTop, el.offsetHeight);
    if (to != null) scrollGlide(box, to);
  }, [activeIndex, isOpen, popupRef]);

  useEffect(() => { if (!isOpen) setActiveIndex(-1); }, [isOpen]);

  let flatCursor = -1;

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <button
        ref={triggerRef as React.RefObject<HTMLButtonElement>}
        type="button"
        onClick={(e) => { if (!disabled) toggleAt(e.currentTarget); }}
        onKeyDown={onTriggerKeyDown}
        onBlur={() => { if (isOpen) close(); }}
        disabled={disabled}
        className={addLabel ? 'k-btn k-btn-secondary k-btn-sm w-full' : 'k-select-trigger'}
        data-kfade-row=""
      >
        {addLabel ? <><span className="k-btn-icon"><Plus size={13} /></span><span className="truncate">{addLabel}</span></> : <>
        <SwapInPlace swapKey={value} hold={false} className="k-swap-text min-w-0">
        <span className={`block truncate ${!value && placeholder ? 'text-[var(--text-tertiary)]' : ''}`}>
          {selectedSwatch && <span aria-hidden="true" className={SWATCH_CLS} style={{ background: selectedSwatch }} />}
          {selectedLabel}
        </span>
        </SwapInPlace>
        <ChevronDown
          size={14}
          className={`text-[var(--text-tertiary)] shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200 ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`}
        />
        </>}
      </button>

      {isOpen && createPortal(
        <>
          <div className={`fixed inset-0 z-[9998]${leaving ? ' pointer-events-none' : ''}`} {...backdropProps} />
          <div
            ref={popupRef as React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>}
            className={`fixed z-[9999] k-drop-glass rounded-lg border border-[var(--alpha-card-border)] p-1 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto ${flatOptions.length > LONG_LIST ? 'popup-scrollbar' : 'custom-scrollbar'} ${dropClass}`}
            style={{ ...popupStyle, width: menuWidth }}
          >
            <div className="k-drop-in">
            {flatOptions.length > LONG_LIST
              ? <LongOptions groups={groups} options={normalizedOptions} value={value} activeIndex={activeIndex} onSelect={handleSelect} />
              : groups
              ? groups.map((g, gi) => (
                  <div key={gi}>
                    {gi > 0 && <div className="border-t border-[var(--alpha-divider)] my-1" />}
                    <div className="px-3 py-1 eyebrow">
                      {g.label}
                    </div>
                    {g.options.map(o => {
                      const idx = ++flatCursor;
                      return (
                        <OptionItem
                          key={o.value} opt={o} selected={o.value === value} onSelect={handleSelect}
                          active={idx === activeIndex}
                          innerRef={el => { optionEls.current[idx] = el; }}
                        />
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                ))
              : normalizedOptions.map(o => {
                  const idx = ++flatCursor;
                  return (
                    <OptionItem
                      key={o.value} opt={o} selected={o.value === value} onSelect={handleSelect}
                      active={idx === activeIndex}
                      innerRef={el => { optionEls.current[idx] = el; }}
                    />
                  );
                })
            }
            </div>
          </div>
        </>,
        document.body
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
import { SMALL_FIX } from '../../game/smallFixSwitch';
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useEscapeOwner } from './escapeStack';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { useBackdropClose } from './useBackdropClose';
import { getVisualScale, onZoomChange } from '../../utils/zoomCompensation';
import { useMenuStage, MENU_OUT_MS } from '../kit/motion';
import { useLeave, holdControl, motionOff } from '../kit/presence';
import { NumberBox, SpinArrows, useSpin, stepNumber } from '../kit/NumberBox';
import { labelOfBox, openTypeSheet } from '../../utils/typeSheet';

const EDIT_IN_MS = 105;

function formatDisplay(val: number): string {
  return String(parseFloat(val.toFixed(4)));
}

interface EditableValueProps {
  value: number;
  onChange: (v: number) => void;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  className?: string;
  displayValue?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  step?: number | 'any';
  keepFraction?: boolean;
}

function spinStepOf(step: number | 'any' | undefined, min: number, max: number): number {
  if (typeof step === 'number' && step > 0) return step;
  const range = Math.abs(max - min);
  return range > 0 ? Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(range / 100))) : 1;
}

export const EditableValue: React.FC<EditableValueProps> = ({
  value,
  onChange,
  min,
  max,
  className = '',
  displayValue,
  disabled,
  step,
  keepFraction,
}) => {
  const spinStep = spinStepOf(step, min, max);
  const live = useRef({ value, onChange });
  live.current = { value, onChange };
  const startSpin = useSpin((dir: number) => {
    const { value: v, onChange: change } = live.current;
    const next = stepNumber(v, dir, spinStep, min, max);
    if (next !== v) change(next);
  }, disabled);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const spanRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [popupPos, setPopupPos] = useState({ top: 0, left: 0, flipUp: false, zoom: 1 });
  const movingUntil = useRef(0);
  const holdFor = (ms: number) => {
    if (motionOff()) return;
    movingUntil.current = performance.now() + ms;
    holdControl(spanRef.current, ms);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!editing) return;
    return onZoomChange(() => setEditing(false));
  }, [editing]);

  const startEditing = () => {
    if (disabled || editing || performance.now() < movingUntil.current) return;
    if (openTypeSheet({ label: labelOfBox(spanRef.current), start: String(value), done: commitText })) { holdFor(EDIT_IN_MS); return; }
    setText(String(value));
    if (spanRef.current) {
      const pz = getVisualScale(spanRef.current) || 1;
      const rect = spanRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const top = rect.top / pz;
      const bottom = rect.bottom / pz;
      const right = rect.right / pz;
      const viewH = window.innerHeight / pz;
      const viewW = window.innerWidth / pz;
      const POPUP_H = 74;
      const POPUP_W = 136;
      const MARGIN = 8;
      const flipUp = bottom + 4 + POPUP_H > viewH - MARGIN && top - 4 - POPUP_H >= MARGIN;
      setPopupPos({
        top: flipUp ? top : Math.min(bottom + 4, Math.max(MARGIN, viewH - MARGIN - POPUP_H)),
        left: Math.max(MARGIN, Math.min(right - POPUP_W, viewW - MARGIN - POPUP_W)),
        flipUp,
        zoom: pz,
      });
    }
    holdFor(EDIT_IN_MS);
    setEditing(true);
  };

  const commit = () => {
    if (!editing) return;
    holdFor(MENU_OUT_MS);
    setEditing(false);
    commitText(text);
  };

  function commitText(text: string): void {
    const parsed = parseFloat(text);
    if (isNaN(parsed) || text.trim() === '') return;
    if (SMALL_FIX.R805 && text === String(value)) return;
    let clamped = Math.min(max, Math.max(min, parsed));
    if (SMALL_FIX.R819 && !keepFraction && typeof step === 'number' && Number.isInteger(step) && step >= 1) clamped = Math.min(max, min + Math.round((clamped - min) / step) * step);
    onChange(clamped);
  }

  useEscapeOwner(() => setEditing(false), editing);
  const editStage = useMenuStage<'edit'>(editing ? 'edit' : null);
  const editBoxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useLeave(editBoxRef, editStage.leaving, 'fade');
  useEffect(() => {
    if (editing && inputRef.current) {
      const el = inputRef.current;
      el.focus();
      const n = el.value.length;
      el.setSelectionRange(n, n);
    }
  }, [editing, editStage.shown]);

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      commit();
    }
  };

  const shown = displayValue ?? formatDisplay(value);

  const backdropProps = useBackdropClose(() => { if (performance.now() >= movingUntil.current) commit(); });

  return (
    <span
      ref={spanRef}
      data-guard
      onClick={startEditing}
      className={`${className} ${disabled ? 'cursor-default opacity-50' : 'cursor-text border-b border-dashed [border-color:color-mix(in_srgb,var(--text-tertiary)_50%,transparent)] hover:bg-[var(--surface-hover)]'} transition-colors k-value-box`}
      data-kfade-row=""
      title={disabled ? undefined : 'Click to edit'}
    >
      <span className="k-value-text k-fade">{shown}</span>
      {!disabled && (
        <SpinArrows onSpin={startSpin} />
      )}
      {editStage.shown === 'edit' && createPortal(
        <>
          <div className={`fixed inset-0 z-[9998]${editStage.leaving ? ' pointer-events-none' : ''}`} {...backdropProps} />
          <div
            ref={editBoxRef}
            className={`k-edit-value fixed z-[9999] k-fade-in ${editStage.leaving ? 'pointer-events-none' : ''}`}
            style={{
              top: popupPos.flipUp ? undefined : popupPos.top,
              bottom: popupPos.flipUp ? (window.innerHeight / popupPos.zoom - popupPos.top + 4) : undefined,
              left: popupPos.left,
              ...(popupPos.zoom !== 1 ? { zoom: popupPos.zoom } : null),
            }}
          >
            <div className="k-edit-value-title">Edit Value</div>
            <NumberBox
              ref={inputRef}
              step={spinStep}
              min={min}
              max={max}
              aria-label="Edit Value"
              value={text}
              onChange={e => setText(e.target.value)}
              onBlur={commit}
              onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
              className="k-field k-edit-value-input"
            />
          </div>
        </>,
        document.body
      )}
    </span>
  );
};
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

interface EscapeOwner {
  token: symbol;
  handler: () => void;
}

const stack: EscapeOwner[] = [];
let listening = false;

function onKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
  if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
  const top = stack[stack.length - 1];
  if (!top) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopPropagation();
  top.handler();
}

function sync(): void {
  const want = stack.length > 0;
  if (want === listening) return;
  listening = want;
  if (want) window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown, true);
  else window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown, true);
}

export function useEscapeOwner(handler: () => void, enabled: boolean = true): void {
  const tokenRef = useRef<symbol | null>(null);
  if (tokenRef.current === null) tokenRef.current = Symbol('escape-owner');
  const handlerRef = useRef(handler);
  handlerRef.current = handler;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const token = tokenRef.current!;
    const entry: EscapeOwner = { token, handler: () => handlerRef.current() };
    stack.push(entry);
    sync();
    return () => {
      const i = stack.findIndex(o => o.token === token);
      if (i >= 0) stack.splice(i, 1);
      sync();
    };
  }, [enabled]);
}

export function escapeIsOwned(): boolean {
  return stack.length > 0;
}
import React from 'react';
import { useGameDark } from '../../utils/useGameTheme';
import { cmHex, CM, CM_USE } from '../../utils/colorMap';

export function gameGridLine(dark: boolean): string {
  const n = parseInt(cmHex(CM.GRID, dark, CM_USE.GENERAL).slice(1), 16);
  return `rgba(${(n >> 16) & 255},${(n >> 8) & 255},${n & 255},${dark ? 0.07 : 0.09})`;
}

export const GameFloor: React.FC<{ className?: string; style?: React.CSSProperties; cell?: number; children?: React.ReactNode }> = ({ className, style, cell = 14, children }) => {
  const dark = useGameDark();
  const floor = cmHex(CM.BACKGROUND, dark, CM_USE.GENERAL);
  const line = gameGridLine(dark);
  return (
    <div className={className} style={{
      backgroundColor: floor,
      backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(${line} 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, ${line} 1px, transparent 1px)`,
      backgroundSize: `${cell}px ${cell}px`, backgroundPosition: 'center center', ...style,
    }}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
};
import React, { useState, useCallback, useRef, useEffect, useLayoutEffect } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';

import { useEscapeOwner } from './escapeStack';
