const MARGIN = 8;
const MAX_TIP_WIDTH = 320;
export const TIP_Z = 100000;

const TIP_CHARS_PER_LINE = 38;
const TIP_LINE_HEIGHT = 15.2;
const TIP_VERTICAL_PADDING = 18;
const TIP_MIN_HEIGHT = 33;

function estimateTipHeight(content: React.ReactNode): number {
  const text = typeof content === 'string' ? content : 'x'.repeat(160);
  const lines = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((text ? text.length : 0) / TIP_CHARS_PER_LINE));
  return Math.max(TIP_MIN_HEIGHT, lines * TIP_LINE_HEIGHT + TIP_VERTICAL_PADDING);
}

const TIP_GAP = 6;
const ARROW_INSET = 10;
export type TipSide = 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right';
const OPPOSITE: Record<TipSide, TipSide> = { top: 'bottom', bottom: 'top', left: 'right', right: 'left' };
function hugLines(el: HTMLElement): void {
  el.style.width = '';
  const t = el.querySelector<HTMLElement>(':scope > .k-tip-text');
  if (!t) return;
  const lines = t.getClientRects();
  if (lines.length < 2) return;
  let widest = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) widest = Math.max(widest, lines[i].width);
  const drawn = el.getBoundingClientRect().width;
  const toLocal = drawn > 0 ? el.offsetWidth / drawn : 1;
  const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
  const frame = (parseFloat(cs.paddingLeft) || 0) + (parseFloat(cs.paddingRight) || 0) + (parseFloat(cs.borderLeftWidth) || 0) + (parseFloat(cs.borderRightWidth) || 0);
  const w = Math.ceil(widest * toLocal + frame + 0.5);
  if (w < el.offsetWidth) el.style.width = `${w}px`;
}
const TooltipPopup: React.FC<{ text: React.ReactNode; rect: DOMRect; zoom: number; position: 'below' | 'above' | TipSide; leaving?: boolean }> = ({ text: liveText, rect, zoom, position, leaving }) => {
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [pos, setPos] = useState<{ left: number; top: number; side: TipSide; arrow: number } | null>(null);
  const want: TipSide = position === 'below' ? 'bottom' : position === 'above' ? 'top' : position;
  const [text, setText] = useState(liveText);
  const swapped = useRef(false);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (Object.is(liveText, text)) return;
    const el = boxRef.current;
    if (!el || leaving || !pos || motionOff()) { setText(liveText); return; }
    const from = getComputedStyle(el).opacity;
    el.style.animation = 'none';
    glide(el, 'opacity', '0', SWAP_OUT_MS, { from, done: () => { swapped.current = true; setText(liveText); } });
  }, [liveText]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!swapped.current) return;
    swapped.current = false;
    const el = boxRef.current;
    if (el) glide(el, 'opacity', '1', SWAP_IN_MS, { from: '0' });
  }, [text]);
  useLeave(boxRef, !!leaving, 'tip');

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = boxRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    hugLines(el);
    const vw = window.innerWidth / zoom;
    const vh = window.innerHeight / zoom;
    const w = el.offsetWidth || MAX_TIP_WIDTH;
    const h = el.offsetHeight || estimateTipHeight(text);
    const cx = (rect.left + rect.width / 2) / zoom;
    const cy = (rect.top + rect.height / 2) / zoom;
    const rTop = rect.top / zoom, rBottom = rect.bottom / zoom, rLeft = rect.left / zoom, rRight = rect.right / zoom;
    const room: Record<TipSide, number> = {
      bottom: vh - MARGIN - (rBottom + TIP_GAP), top: (rTop - TIP_GAP) - MARGIN,
      right: vw - MARGIN - (rRight + TIP_GAP), left: (rLeft - TIP_GAP) - MARGIN,
    };
    const need = (s: TipSide) => (s === 'top' || s === 'bottom' ? h : w);
    const other = OPPOSITE[want];
    const side: TipSide = need(want) <= room[want] ? want : need(other) <= room[other] ? other : room[want] >= room[other] ? want : other;
    let left: number, top: number;
    if (side === 'top' || side === 'bottom') {
      left = cx - w / 2;
      top = side === 'bottom' ? rBottom + TIP_GAP : rTop - h - TIP_GAP;
    } else {
      left = side === 'right' ? rRight + TIP_GAP : rLeft - w - TIP_GAP;
      top = cy - h / 2;
    }
    if (left + w > vw - MARGIN) left = vw - MARGIN - w;
    if (left < MARGIN) left = MARGIN;
    if (top + h > vh - MARGIN) top = vh - MARGIN - h;
    if (top < MARGIN) top = MARGIN;
    const arrow = side === 'top' || side === 'bottom'
      ? Math.max(ARROW_INSET, Math.min(w - ARROW_INSET, cx - left))
      : Math.max(ARROW_INSET, Math.min(h - ARROW_INSET, cy - top));
    setPos(p => (p && p.left === left && p.top === top && p.side === side && p.arrow === arrow ? p : { left, top, side, arrow }));
  }, [rect, zoom, want, text]);

  const origin = !pos ? undefined
    : pos.side === 'bottom' ? `${pos.arrow}px top` : pos.side === 'top' ? `${pos.arrow}px bottom`
    : pos.side === 'right' ? `left ${pos.arrow}px` : `right ${pos.arrow}px`;
  const inClass = !pos ? '' : { bottom: 'k-tip-in-below', top: 'k-tip-in-above', right: 'k-tip-in-right', left: 'k-tip-in-left' }[pos.side];
  const arrowClass = !pos ? '' : { bottom: 'k-tip-arrow-top', top: 'k-tip-arrow-bottom', right: 'k-tip-arrow-left', left: 'k-tip-arrow-right' }[pos.side];
  const arrowStyle = !pos ? undefined : (pos.side === 'top' || pos.side === 'bottom') ? { left: pos.arrow } : { top: pos.arrow };

  return createPortal(
    <div
      ref={boxRef}
      role="tooltip"
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        left: pos ? pos.left : -9999,
        top: pos ? pos.top : -9999,
        zIndex: TIP_Z,
        pointerEvents: 'none',
        visibility: pos ? undefined : 'hidden',
        transformOrigin: origin,
        ...(zoom !== 1 ? { zoom } : null),
      }}
      className={`k-tip ${pos ? inClass : ''}`}
    >
      {typeof text === 'string' ? <span className="k-tip-text">{text}</span> : text}
      {pos && <span aria-hidden className={`k-tip-arrow ${arrowClass}`} style={arrowStyle} />}
    </div>,
    document.body,
  );
};

const TIP_OUT_MS = 120;
const TIP_IN_MS = 150;
const TIP_DELAY_MS = 300;
type HoverTip = { id: number; el: Element; text: string; rect: DOMRect; zoom: number; side: TipSide };

function useTipHover(): { show: boolean; enter: (now?: boolean) => void; leave: () => void; closeNow: () => void } {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  const showing = useRef(false);
  const shownAt = useRef(0);
  const timer = useRef(0);
  const wait = useRef(0);
  const closeNow = useCallback(() => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current); timer.current = 0;
    window.clearTimeout(wait.current); wait.current = 0;
    showing.current = false; setShow(false);
  }, []);
  const enter = useCallback((now = false) => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current); timer.current = 0;
    if (showing.current || wait.current) return;
    const go = () => { wait.current = 0; showing.current = true; shownAt.current = performance.now(); setShow(true); };
    if (now) go(); else wait.current = window.setTimeout(go, TIP_DELAY_MS);
  }, []);
  const leave = useCallback(() => {
    if (wait.current) { window.clearTimeout(wait.current); wait.current = 0; return; }
    if (!showing.current || timer.current) return;
    const left = TIP_IN_MS - (performance.now() - shownAt.current);
    if (left <= 0) closeNow(); else timer.current = window.setTimeout(closeNow, left);
  }, [closeNow]);
  useEffect(() => () => { window.clearTimeout(timer.current); window.clearTimeout(wait.current); }, []);
  return { show, enter, leave, closeNow };
}

function useTipHost(ref: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, open: boolean, close: () => void): void {
  const cb = useRef(close); cb.current = close;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const off = onLeaveStart(box => { const el = ref.current; if (el && box.contains(el)) cb.current(); });
    let raf = 0;
    const at = ref.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const tick = () => {
      raf = 0;
      const el = ref.current;
      if (!el || !el.isConnected || el.closest('[inert]') || !hostShown(el, el.getBoundingClientRect(), at)) { cb.current(); return; }
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => { off(); if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf); };
  }, [open, ref]);
}
const TIP_SELECTOR = '[title]:not([title=""]),[data-tip]:not([data-tip=""]),[data-k-tip-hold]';

function reactTitle(el: Element): { known: boolean; title?: string } {
  for (const k in el) {
    if (k.startsWith('__reactProps$')) {
      const p = (el as unknown as Record<string, Record<string, unknown> | undefined>)[k];
      if (p && 'title' in p) return { known: true, title: typeof p.title === 'string' ? p.title : undefined };
      return { known: false };
    }
  }
  return { known: false };
}
function tipTextOf(el: Element): string {
  const d = el.getAttribute('data-tip');
  if (d) return d;
  return el.getAttribute('title') || el.getAttribute('data-k-tip-hold') || '';
}
function liftTitle(el: Element) {
  const t = el.getAttribute('title');
  if (t) { el.setAttribute('data-k-tip-hold', t); el.removeAttribute('title'); }
}
function restoreTitle(el: Element) {
  const held = el.getAttribute('data-k-tip-hold');
  if (held === null) return;
  el.removeAttribute('data-k-tip-hold');
  if (el.hasAttribute('title')) return;
  const r = reactTitle(el);
  const t = r.known ? r.title : held;
  if (t) el.setAttribute('title', t);
}
function tipWords(el: Element, text: string): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  const own: string[] = [];
  if (el.matches(FADE_SELECTOR)) own.push((el.textContent || '').trim());
  const inner = el.querySelectorAll(FADE_SELECTOR);
  for (let i = 0; i < inner.length && i < 8; i++) own.push((inner[i].textContent || '').trim());
  const t = text.trim();
  for (const name of own) {
    if (!name) continue;
    if (t === name) return '';
    if (t.startsWith(name + '. ')) return t.slice(name.length + 2).trim();
  }
  return text;
}
function isTextSlide(target: EventTarget | null): boolean {
  return target instanceof Element && target.hasAttribute('data-kfade');
}
function hostShown(el: Element, r: DOMRect, at?: DOMRect): boolean {
  if (r.bottom <= 0 || r.right <= 0 || r.top >= window.innerHeight || r.left >= window.innerWidth) return false;
  if (at && (Math.abs(r.left - at.left) > 2 || Math.abs(r.top - at.top) > 2)) return false;
  const seen = (el as Element & { checkVisibility?: (o?: { visibilityProperty?: boolean }) => boolean }).checkVisibility;
  return !seen || seen.call(el, { visibilityProperty: true });
}
function sideOf(el: Element): TipSide {
  const s = el.closest('[data-tip-side]')?.getAttribute('data-tip-side');
  return s === 'bottom' || s === 'left' || s === 'right' ? s : 'top';
}

export const GlobalTips: React.FC = () => {
  const [tip, setTip] = useState<HoverTip | null>(null);
  const [gone, setGone] = useState<HoverTip[]>([]);
  const cur = useRef<HoverTip | null>(null);
  const muted = useRef<Element | null>(null);
  const seq = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let watch: MutationObserver | null = null;
    let held: Element | null = null;
    const letGo = () => {
      if (!held) return;
      watch?.disconnect(); watch = null;
      restoreTitle(held);
      held = null;
    };
    let goneNow: HoverTip[] = [];
    const goneEnds = new Map<number, number>();
    const drop = (t: HoverTip) => {
      goneNow = [...goneNow, t]; setGone(goneNow);
      goneEnds.set(t.id, window.setTimeout(() => {
        goneEnds.delete(t.id);
        goneNow = goneNow.filter(x => x.id !== t.id); setGone(goneNow);
      }, TIP_OUT_MS));
    };
    let shownAt = 0;
    let waitFor: Element | null = null;
    let waitTimer = 0;
    const clearWait = () => { if (waitTimer) { window.clearTimeout(waitTimer); waitTimer = 0; } waitFor = null; };
    let pending = 0;
    const cancelPending = () => { if (pending) { window.clearTimeout(pending); pending = 0; } };
    let raf = 0;
    const watchHost = () => {
      raf = 0;
      const t = cur.current;
      if (!t) return;
      if (!t.el.isConnected) { hide(true); return; }
      if (t.el.closest('[inert]') || !hostShown(t.el, t.el.getBoundingClientRect(), t.rect)) { muted.current = t.el; hide(); return; }
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(watchHost);
    };
    const hide = (left = false) => {
      cancelPending();
      clearWait();
      const t = cur.current;
      if (left) letGo();
      if (!t) return;
      cur.current = null;
      setTip(null);
      drop(t);
      if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; }
    };
    const leave = () => {
      clearWait();
      if (!cur.current) { letGo(); return; }
      if (pending) return;
      const wait = TIP_IN_MS - (performance.now() - shownAt);
      if (wait <= 0) hide(true);
      else pending = window.setTimeout(() => { pending = 0; hide(true); }, wait);
    };
    const show = (el: Element, now = false) => {
      if (cur.current?.el === el) { cancelPending(); return; }
      if (waitFor === el) return;
      hide();
      if (held && held !== el) letGo();
      const text = tipWords(el, tipTextOf(el));
      if (held !== el) {
        liftTitle(el);
        held = el;
        watch = new MutationObserver(() => {
          if (held !== el) return;
          if (el.getAttribute('title') !== null) liftTitle(el);
          if (!cur.current || cur.current.el !== el) return;
          const nt = tipTextOf(el);
          if (nt === cur.current.text) return;
          const words = tipWords(el, nt);
          if (!words) { hide(); return; }
          const t = { ...cur.current, text: words };
          cur.current = t; setTip(t);
        });
        watch.observe(el, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['title', 'data-tip'] });
      }
      if (!text) return;
      if (!now) {
        waitFor = el;
        waitTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
          waitTimer = 0; waitFor = null;
          if (held !== el || !el.isConnected) return;
          const words = tipWords(el, tipTextOf(el));
          if (words) draw(el, words);
        }, TIP_DELAY_MS);
        return;
      }
      draw(el, text);
    };
    const draw = (el: Element, text: string) => {
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!hostShown(el, rect)) return;
      const back = goneNow.find(g => g.el === el);
      if (back) {
        window.clearTimeout(goneEnds.get(back.id)); goneEnds.delete(back.id);
        goneNow = goneNow.filter(g => g !== back); setGone(goneNow);
      }
      const t: HoverTip = { id: back ? back.id : ++seq.current, el, text, rect, zoom: getVisualScale(el) || 1, side: sideOf(el) };
      cur.current = t;
      shownAt = performance.now();
      setTip(t);
      if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(watchHost);
    };
    const offLeave = onLeaveStart(box => {
      const t = cur.current;
      if (t && box.contains(t.el)) { muted.current = t.el; hide(); }
    });
    const anchorOf = (target: EventTarget | null): Element | null => {
      if (!(target instanceof Element)) return null;
      if (target.closest('[data-k-own-tip]')) return null;
      const a = target.closest(TIP_SELECTOR);
      if (!a || a.closest('[data-tip-native]')) return null;
      return a;
    };
    const onOver = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (e.pointerType === 'touch') return;
      if (cur.current && !cur.current.el.isConnected) hide(true);
      if (held && !held.isConnected) letGo();
      const a = anchorOf(e.target);
      if (a === muted.current) return;
      muted.current = null;
      if (a) show(a); else leave();
    };
    const onOut = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const to = e.relatedTarget as Node | null;
      if (muted.current && !(to && muted.current.contains(to))) muted.current = null;
      const el = cur.current?.el ?? held;
      if (el && !(to && el.contains(to))) leave();
    };
    const onDown = () => { clearWait(); if (cur.current) { muted.current = cur.current.el; hide(); } };
    const onScroll = (e: Event) => { if (!isTextSlide(e.target)) hide(); };
    const onWheel = () => hide();
    const onWindowBlur = () => hide(true);
    const onZoom = () => hide();
    const onFocus = (e: FocusEvent) => {
      const el = e.target instanceof Element ? e.target : null;
      if (!el || !el.matches(':focus-visible')) return;
      const a = anchorOf(el);
      if (a === el && a !== muted.current) show(a, true);
    };
    const onBlur = (e: FocusEvent) => { if (cur.current && cur.current.el === e.target) hide(); };
    const opts = { capture: true, passive: true } as const;
    document.addEventListener('pointerover', onOver, opts);
    document.addEventListener('pointerout', onOut, opts);
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onDown, opts);
    document.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, opts);
    document.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, opts);
    document.addEventListener('focusin', onFocus, true);
    document.addEventListener('focusout', onBlur, true);
    window.addEventListener('blur', onWindowBlur);
    const offZoom = onZoomChange(onZoom);
    return () => {
      hide(true);
      offLeave();
      goneEnds.forEach(id => window.clearTimeout(id));
      document.removeEventListener('pointerover', onOver, opts);
      document.removeEventListener('pointerout', onOut, opts);
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onDown, opts);
      document.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll, opts);
      document.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel, opts);
      document.removeEventListener('focusin', onFocus, true);
      document.removeEventListener('focusout', onBlur, true);
      window.removeEventListener('blur', onWindowBlur);
      offZoom();
    };
  }, []);

  const all = tip ? [...gone, tip] : gone;
  return (
    <>
      {all.map(t => <TooltipPopup key={t.id} text={t.text} rect={t.rect} zoom={t.zoom} position={t.side} leaving={t !== tip} />)}
    </>
  );
};

export const HelpTooltip: React.FC<{
  text: React.ReactNode;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
}> = ({ text, icon }) => {
  const hover = useTipHover();
  const show = hover.show;
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const [rect, setRect] = useState<DOMRect | null>(null);
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);

  const place = useCallback(() => {
    if (!ref.current) return false;
    setRect(ref.current.getBoundingClientRect());
    setZoom(getVisualScale(ref.current) || 1);
    return true;
  }, []);
  const { enter, leave, closeNow } = hover;
  const setShow = useCallback((v: boolean) => { if (v) enter(); else closeNow(); }, [enter, closeNow]);
  const onEnter = useCallback(() => { if (place()) enter(); }, [place, enter]);
  const onFocusIn = useCallback(() => { if (place()) enter(true); }, [place, enter]);
  const onLeave = leave;
  const onTap = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setPinned(p => { const n = !p; if (n) place(); return n; });
  }, [place]);
  const unpin = useCallback(() => { setPinned(false); setShow(false); }, []);
  useEscapeOwner(unpin, pinned);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pinned) return;
    const away = (e: PointerEvent) => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setPinned(false); };
    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', away, true);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', away, true);
  }, [pinned]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pinned) return;
    return toolStore.subscribe(() => { setPinned(false); setShow(false); });
  }, [pinned]);

  const open = show || pinned;
  const tipStage = useMenuStage<'tip'>(open ? 'tip' : null);
  useTipHost(ref, open, () => { setPinned(false); closeNow(); });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    return onZoomChange(() => { setShow(false); setPinned(false); });
  }, [open, setShow]);

  return (
    <span ref={ref} data-k-own-tip className="k-ico inline-flex items-center align-middle pointer-events-auto" onMouseEnter={onEnter} onMouseLeave={onLeave}
      onClick={onTap} onFocus={onFocusIn} onBlur={onLeave} tabIndex={0} role="button" aria-label="Help" aria-expanded={open}>
      <span className="k-ico-art w-[14px] h-[14px] flex items-center justify-center cursor-help shrink-0 select-none text-[var(--k-help-ink)] hover:text-[var(--text-secondary)] transition-colors">{icon ?? <HelpBubble size={14} />}</span>
      {tipStage.shown && rect && <TooltipPopup text={text} rect={rect} zoom={zoom} position="below" leaving={tipStage.leaving} />}
    </span>
  );
};

export const ButtonTooltip: React.FC<{ text: string; children: React.ReactNode; fit?: boolean }> = ({ text, children, fit }) => {
  const { show, enter, leave, closeNow } = useTipHover();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const [rect, setRect] = useState<DOMRect | null>(null);
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);

  const onEnter = useCallback(() => {
    if (ref.current) {
      setRect(ref.current.getBoundingClientRect());
      setZoom(getVisualScale(ref.current) || 1);
      enter();
    }
  }, [enter]);
  const onLeave = leave;
  const tipStage = useMenuStage<'tip'>(show ? 'tip' : null);
  useTipHost(ref, show, closeNow);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!show) return;
    return onZoomChange(closeNow);
  }, [show, closeNow]);

  return (
    <span ref={ref} data-k-own-tip className={fit ? "inline-flex" : "inline-flex w-full"} onMouseEnter={onEnter} onMouseLeave={onLeave}>
      {children}
      {tipStage.shown && rect && <TooltipPopup text={text} rect={rect} zoom={zoom} position="above" leaving={tipStage.leaving} />}
    </span>
  );
};
import React, { useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { NumberBox } from '../kit/NumberBox';

export const NUMBER_INPUT_BASE = 'k-text-in border border-[var(--border-default)] rounded-lg px-3 h-8 text-sm tabular-nums text-left bg-[var(--surface-input)] text-[var(--text-primary)] shadow-[var(--shadow-input)]';

interface NumberInputProps {
  value: number | string;
  onChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  step?: number;
  placeholder?: string;
  className?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  id?: string;
  arrows?: boolean;
}

export const NumberInput: React.FC<NumberInputProps> = ({
  value, onChange, min, max, step, placeholder, className, disabled, id, arrows,
}) => {
  const [localText, setLocalText] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleFocus = useCallback(() => {
    setLocalText(String(value));
  }, [value]);

  const handleChange = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setLocalText(e.target.value);
    const v = parseFloat(e.target.value);
    if (isFinite(v)) onChange(e);
  }, [onChange]);

  const handleBlur = useCallback(() => {
    setLocalText(null);
  }, []);

  const handleKeyDown = useCallback((e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
    }
  }, []);

  return (
    <NumberBox
      ref={inputRef}
      id={id}
      arrows={arrows}
      value={localText !== null ? localText : value}
      onChange={handleChange}
      onFocus={handleFocus}
      onBlur={handleBlur}
      onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
      min={min}
      max={max}
      step={step}
      placeholder={placeholder}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={className ?? NUMBER_INPUT_BASE}
    />
  );
};
import type React from 'react';

export function sliderFillStyle(val: number, min: number, max: number): React.CSSProperties {
  const pct = max > min ? ((val - min) / (max - min)) * 100 : 0;
  return { '--slider-pct': `${pct}%` } as React.CSSProperties;
}

export type SliderStep = number | 'any';

const DOMAIN_PAD = 0.15;

export function sliderDomain(min: number, max: number, val: number, step: SliderStep): { lo: number; hi: number } {
  if (typeof val !== 'number' || !isFinite(val) || (val >= min && val <= max)) return { lo: min, hi: max };
  if (step === 'any') {
    const pad = Math.abs(max - min) * DOMAIN_PAD || Math.abs(val) * DOMAIN_PAD || 1;
    return { lo: val < min ? val - pad : min, hi: val > max ? val + pad : max };
  }
  const s = Math.abs(step) || 1;
  return {
    lo: val < min ? min - Math.ceil((min - val) / s + 1) * s : min,
    hi: val > max ? max + Math.ceil((val - max) / s + 1) * s : max,
  };
}
import React, { useRef, useCallback } from 'react';

export function useBackdropClose(onClose: () => void) {
  const downOnBackdropRef = useRef(false);

  const onMouseDown = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    downOnBackdropRef.current = e.target === e.currentTarget;
  }, []);

  const onMouseUp = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (downOnBackdropRef.current && e.target === e.currentTarget) {
      onClose();
    }
    downOnBackdropRef.current = false;
  }, [onClose]);

  return { onMouseDown, onMouseUp };
}

const STYLE_EMPTY: React.CSSProperties = {};

export const DROP_SLIDE_MS = 125;

const DROP_ENTER_MS = DROP_SLIDE_MS + DROP_FADE_MS + 40;
const reducedMotion = motionOff;

export const BLUR_LAYERS = '.modal-scrim, .k-glass, .k-backdrop, .k-mapgen-glass, .k-msc-glass, .k-mm-card, .k-play-window, .toolbar-rail, .k-frame-glass, .k-bar.k-chrome';
function blurOnScreen(): boolean {
  const els = document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(BLUR_LAYERS);
  for (let i = 0; i < els.length; i++) {
    const el = els[i];
    if (el.getClientRects().length === 0) continue;
    const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
    const f = cs.backdropFilter || cs.getPropertyValue('-webkit-backdrop-filter');
    if (f && f !== 'none') return true;
  }
  return false;
}
function colourUnder(el: HTMLElement | null): string {
  for (let p = el; p; p = p.parentElement) {
    const c = getComputedStyle(p).backgroundColor;
    const m = c.match(/rgba?\(([^)]+)\)/);
    if (!m) continue;
    const parts = m[1].split(/[\s,/]+/).filter(Boolean);
    const a = parts.length > 3 ? parseFloat(parts[3]) : 1;
    if (a >= 0.99) return c;
  }
  return '';
}

function computeBestFitPosition(
  triggerRect: AnchorRect,
  height: number,
  gap: number,
  edgeMargin: number,
  estimatedWidth: number,
  zoom: number,
  align: 'start' | 'end' = 'start',
): PopupPosition {
  const viewH = window.innerHeight / zoom;
  const viewW = window.innerWidth / zoom;

  const spaceBelow = viewH - edgeMargin - (triggerRect.bottom + gap);
  const spaceAbove = triggerRect.top - gap - edgeMargin;

  let flipUp: boolean;
  if (height <= spaceBelow) {
    flipUp = false;
  } else if (height <= spaceAbove) {
    flipUp = true;
  } else {
    flipUp = spaceAbove > spaceBelow;
  }

  const fitsLeft = triggerRect.left + estimatedWidth <= viewW - edgeMargin;
  const fitsEnd = triggerRect.right - estimatedWidth >= edgeMargin;
  const anchored = align === 'end'
    ? (fitsEnd ? triggerRect.right - estimatedWidth : triggerRect.left)
    : (fitsLeft ? triggerRect.left : triggerRect.right - estimatedWidth);
  const left = Math.max(edgeMargin, Math.min(anchored, viewW - estimatedWidth - edgeMargin));

  let top: number | null = null;
  let bottom: number | null = null;

  if (flipUp) {
    const bottomPos = viewH - triggerRect.top + gap;
    const topEdge = viewH - bottomPos - height;
    if (topEdge < edgeMargin) {
      top = edgeMargin;
    } else {
      bottom = bottomPos;
    }
  } else {
    let topPos = triggerRect.bottom + gap;
    if (topPos + height > viewH - edgeMargin) {
      topPos = viewH - edgeMargin - height;
    }
    if (topPos < edgeMargin) topPos = edgeMargin;
    top = topPos;
  }

  return { top, bottom, left, flipped: flipUp };
}

export function useFloatingPopup(options: UseFloatingPopupOptions) {
  const claimsEscape = options.claimsEscape;
  const {
    gap = 4,
    edgeMargin = 8,
    estimatedWidth,
    estimatedHeight = 200,
    align = 'start',
  } = options;

  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const popupRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [popupPos, setPopupPos] = useState<PopupPosition | null>(null);
  const [popupZoom, setPopupZoom] = useState(1);
  const triggerRectRef = useRef<AnchorRect | null>(null);
  const popupZoomRef = useRef(1);
  const [entered, setEntered] = useState(false);
  const [leaving, setLeaving] = useState(false);
  const leaveTimer = useRef(0);
  const enterRaf = useRef(0);
  const openRef = useRef(false);
  const leavingRef = useRef(false);
  const movingUntil = useRef(0);
  const [settling, setSettling] = useState(false);
  const settleTimer = useRef(0);
  const [flatUnder, setFlatUnder] = useState('');

  const open = useCallback((clickRect?: DOMRect, instant = false) => {
    const rect = (clickRect && typeof clickRect.top === 'number' ? clickRect : null) ?? triggerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect() ?? null;
    setFlatUnder(blurOnScreen() ? (colourUnder(triggerRef.current) || 'var(--k-popover)') : '');
    const pz = getVisualScale(triggerRef.current) || 1;
    popupZoomRef.current = pz;
    setPopupZoom(pz);
    triggerRectRef.current = rect
      ? { top: rect.top / pz, bottom: rect.bottom / pz, left: rect.left / pz, right: rect.right / pz }
      : null;

    if (triggerRectRef.current) {
      const t0 = triggerRectRef.current;
      setPopupPos(computeBestFitPosition(t0, estimatedHeight, gap, edgeMargin, estimatedWidth ?? (t0.right - t0.left), pz, align));
    }
    window.clearTimeout(leaveTimer.current);
    window.clearTimeout(settleTimer.current);
    cancelAnimationFrame(enterRaf.current);
    leavingRef.current = false; setLeaving(false);
    setEntered(instant || reducedMotion());
    if (!instant) enterRaf.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => { enterRaf.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => setEntered(true)); });
    openRef.current = true;
    movingUntil.current = instant || reducedMotion() ? 0 : performance.now() + DROP_ENTER_MS;
    if (movingUntil.current > 0) {
      noteMotion(DROP_ENTER_MS);
      setSettling(true);
      settleTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setSettling(false), DROP_ENTER_MS);
    } else setSettling(false);
    setIsOpen(true);
  }, [estimatedHeight, gap, edgeMargin, estimatedWidth, align]);

  const closeNow = useCallback(() => {
    blurFocusedField(popupRef.current);
    window.clearTimeout(leaveTimer.current);
    window.clearTimeout(settleTimer.current);
    setSettling(false);
    cancelAnimationFrame(enterRaf.current);
    openRef.current = false;
    leavingRef.current = false;
    setLeaving(false);
    setIsOpen(false);
    setPopupPos(null);
    triggerRectRef.current = null;
  }, []);

  const close = useCallback(() => {
    if (!openRef.current || leavingRef.current) return;
    if (performance.now() < movingUntil.current) return;
    if (reducedMotion()) { closeNow(); return; }
    noteMotion(DROP_EXIT_MS);
    leaveStarts(popupRef.current);
    leavingRef.current = true;
    movingUntil.current = performance.now() + DROP_EXIT_MS;
    setLeaving(true);
    leaveTimer.current = window.setTimeout(closeNow, DROP_EXIT_MS);
  }, [closeNow]);


  const toggle = useCallback((clickRect?: DOMRect) => {
    if (performance.now() < movingUntil.current) return;
    if (openRef.current && !leavingRef.current) close(); else open(clickRect);
  }, [open, close]);

  useEffect(() => () => { window.clearTimeout(leaveTimer.current); window.clearTimeout(settleTimer.current); cancelAnimationFrame(enterRaf.current); }, []);
  const flippedRef = useRef(false);
  flippedRef.current = !!popupPos?.flipped;
  useLayoutEffect(() => () => {
    if (!openRef.current) return;
    const el = popupRef.current;
    const inner = el?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.k-drop-in');
    const left = inner ? parseFloat(getComputedStyle(inner).opacity) || 0 : 0;
    finishLeaving(el, [
      { sel: '.k-drop-in', to: { opacity: 0 }, ms: Math.max(1, Math.round(DROP_FADE_MS * left)) },
      { to: { clipPath: flippedRef.current ? 'inset(100% -24px -24px -24px)' : 'inset(-24px -24px 100% -24px)' }, ms: DROP_SLIDE_MS, delay: Math.round(DROP_FADE_MS * left) },
    ]);
  }, []);
  useBlurOnUnmount(popupRef);

  const popupStyle: React.CSSProperties = useMemo(() => {
    if (!isOpen || !popupPos) return STYLE_EMPTY;
    const style: React.CSSProperties = { position: 'fixed' as const };
    if (popupPos.top != null) style.top = popupPos.top;
    if (popupPos.bottom != null) style.bottom = popupPos.bottom;
    style.left = popupPos.left;
    const side = align === 'end' ? 'right' : 'left';
    style.transformOrigin = popupPos.flipped ? `bottom ${side}` : `top ${side}`;
    if (popupZoom !== 1) style.zoom = popupZoom;
    if (flatUnder) (style as Record<string, string | number>)['--k-drop-under'] = flatUnder;
    return style;
  }, [isOpen, popupPos, popupZoom, align, flatUnder]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const popup = popupRef.current;
    if (!popup) return;
    const tRect = triggerRectRef.current;
    if (!tRect) return;
    const actualHeight = Math.min(popup.offsetHeight, estimatedHeight * 2);
    const actualWidth = popup.offsetWidth || estimatedWidth || (tRect.right - tRect.left);
    const pos = computeBestFitPosition(tRect, actualHeight, gap, edgeMargin, actualWidth, popupZoomRef.current, align);
    setPopupPos(prev => {
      if (prev && prev.top === pos.top && prev.bottom === pos.bottom
          && prev.left === pos.left && prev.flipped === pos.flipped) {
        return prev;
      }
      return pos;
    });
  }, [isOpen, gap, edgeMargin, estimatedWidth, estimatedHeight, popupZoom, align]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    return onZoomChange(closeNow);
  }, [isOpen, closeNow]);

  useEscapeOwner(close, isOpen && claimsEscape && !leaving);

  const dropClass = `k-drop${popupPos?.flipped ? ' k-drop-up' : ''}${!entered ? ' k-drop-start' : ''}${leaving ? ' k-drop-leave' : ''}${flatUnder ? ' k-drop-flat' : ''}${settling || leaving ? ' k-drop-busy' : ''}`;

  const moving = useCallback(() => performance.now() < movingUntil.current, []);
  return { triggerRef, popupRef, isOpen, open, close, closeNow, toggle, popupStyle, popupZoom, leaving, dropClass, moving };
}

const TEXT_BOX = 'input:not([type]), input[type="text"], input[type="search"], input[type="number"]';
export const FADE_SELECTOR = `.k-fade, .truncate, .k-split-title, .k-pick-title, .k-pick-meta, .k-lib-tag-sm > span, .k-pb-name, .k-death-label, .k-hub-name, .k-hub-foot-text, .k-ev-sentence, .k-ev-mon-line, .k-ev-detail-title, .k-ev-msg-where, ${TEXT_BOX}`;
const FADE_EM = 1.6;
const READ_PX_S = 58;
const BACK_PX_S = READ_PX_S * 2;
const HOVER_WAIT_MS = 280;
const RAMP_S = 0.07;

function rampPos(t: number, D: number, v: number): number {
  const a = v / RAMP_S;
  if (D < v * RAMP_S) {
    const tp = Math.sqrt(D / a);
    if (t <= tp) return 0.5 * a * t * t;
    const r = Math.max(0, 2 * tp - t);
    return D - 0.5 * a * r * r;
  }
  const T = D / v + RAMP_S;
  if (t <= RAMP_S) return 0.5 * a * t * t;
  if (t >= T) return D;
  if (t >= T - RAMP_S) { const r = T - t; return D - 0.5 * a * r * r; }
  return v * RAMP_S / 2 + v * (t - RAMP_S);
}
function rampTime(D: number, v: number): number {
  const a = v / RAMP_S;
  return D < v * RAMP_S ? 2 * Math.sqrt(D / a) : D / v + RAMP_S;
}

interface Glide { raf: number; from: number; to: number; t0: number; dur: number; wait: number }
const glides = new Map<HTMLElement, Glide>();
const pending = new Set<HTMLElement>();
let frame = 0;
let ro: ResizeObserver | null = null;
let mo: MutationObserver | null = null;
let layerMo: MutationObserver | null = null;
let reduce = false;
let _playing = false;
const menuRoots = new Set<HTMLElement>();
const WATCH_ALL: MutationObserverInit = { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['value'] };

function isLayer(n: Node): n is HTMLElement {
  return n instanceof HTMLElement && n.id !== 'root' && n.tagName !== 'SCRIPT' && n.tagName !== 'STYLE';
}

function armPlaying(): void {
  if (!mo || !layerMo) return;
  const left = mo.takeRecords();
  if (left.length) onRecords(left);
  mo.disconnect();
  layerMo.observe(document.body, { childList: true });
  const kids = document.body.children;
  for (let i = 0; i < kids.length; i++) if (isLayer(kids[i])) mo.observe(kids[i], WATCH_ALL);
  menuRoots.forEach(r => mo!.observe(r, WATCH_ALL));
}

export function setTextFadePlaying(on: boolean): void {
  if (on === _playing) return;
  _playing = on;
  if (!mo || !ro || !layerMo) return;
  if (on) {
    mo.takeRecords();
    ro.disconnect();
    pending.clear();
    if (frame) { cancelAnimationFrame(frame); frame = 0; }
    glides.forEach((_g, el) => {
      let inMenu = false;
      menuRoots.forEach(r => { if (r.contains(el)) inMenu = true; });
      if (inMenu) return;
      stop(el);
      setPos(el, 0);
      if (el.scrollLeft !== 0) el.scrollLeft = 0;
      paint(el, overOf(el));
    });
    armPlaying();
  } else {
    layerMo.disconnect();
    const left = mo.takeRecords();
    if (left.length) onRecords(left);
    mo.disconnect();
    mo.observe(document.body, WATCH_ALL);
    track(document.body);
  }
}

export function registerTextFadeRoot(el: HTMLElement): () => void {
  menuRoots.add(el);
  if (_playing && mo) { mo.observe(el, WATCH_ALL); track(el); }
  return () => {
    menuRoots.delete(el);
    if (_playing) { untrack(el); armPlaying(); }
  };
}

function onRecords(records: MutationRecord[]): void {
  for (const r of records) {
    if (r.type === 'attributes') { if (isFade(r.target as Element)) schedule(r.target as HTMLElement); continue; }
    if (r.type === 'characterData') {
      const host = r.target.parentElement?.closest(FADE_SELECTOR) as HTMLElement | null;
      if (host) schedule(host);
      continue;
    }
    r.addedNodes.forEach(n => {
      if (n.nodeType === 1) track(n as Element);
      else if (n.nodeType === 3) { const host = n.parentElement?.closest(FADE_SELECTOR) as HTMLElement | null; if (host) schedule(host); }
    });
    r.removedNodes.forEach(n => { if (n.nodeType === 1) untrack(n as Element); });
  }
}

function onLayers(records: MutationRecord[]): void {
  let gone = false;
  for (const r of records) {
    r.addedNodes.forEach(n => { if (isLayer(n) && mo) { mo.observe(n, WATCH_ALL); track(n); } });
    r.removedNodes.forEach(n => { if (isLayer(n)) { untrack(n); gone = true; } });
  }
  if (gone) armPlaying();
}

function isFade(el: Element): el is HTMLElement { return el instanceof HTMLElement && el.matches(FADE_SELECTOR); }

const ROW_HOST = '[data-kfade-row]';
function fadeUnder(t: Element | null): HTMLElement | null {
  const el = t?.closest?.(FADE_SELECTOR) as HTMLElement | null;
  if (el) return el;
  const row = t?.closest?.(ROW_HOST);
  return row ? row.querySelector<HTMLElement>(FADE_SELECTOR) : null;
}

function fadeLen(el: HTMLElement): number { return (parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).fontSize) || 12) * FADE_EM; }

const indents = new WeakMap<HTMLElement, number>();
function setIndent(el: HTMLElement, i: number): void {
  indents.set(el, i);
  el.style.textIndent = i > 0.01 ? `${(-i).toFixed(2)}px` : '';
}
function posOf(el: HTMLElement): number { return (indents.get(el) ?? 0) + el.scrollLeft; }
function setPos(el: HTMLElement, x: number): void { if (isTextBox(el)) setIndent(el, x); else el.scrollLeft = x; }
function overOf(el: HTMLElement): number {
  const i = indents.get(el) ?? 0;
  if (i <= 0.01) return el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth;
  el.style.textIndent = '';
  const over = el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth;
  el.style.textIndent = `${(-i).toFixed(2)}px`;
  return over;
}
function foldScroll(el: HTMLElement): void {
  if (!isTextBox(el)) return;
  const s = el.scrollLeft;
  if (s > 0.5) { el.scrollLeft = 0; setIndent(el, (indents.get(el) ?? 0) + s); }
}
function unfoldIndent(el: HTMLElement): void {
  const i = indents.get(el) ?? 0;
  if (i <= 0.01) return;
  setIndent(el, 0);
  el.scrollLeft = i;
}

function paint(el: HTMLElement, over: number): void {
  if (over <= 1) {
    if (el.hasAttribute('data-kfade')) { el.removeAttribute('data-kfade'); el.style.removeProperty('--kf-l'); el.style.removeProperty('--kf-r'); }
    if (indents.get(el)) setIndent(el, 0);
    if (el.scrollLeft !== 0) el.scrollLeft = 0;
    return;
  }
  if (!el.hasAttribute('data-kfade')) el.setAttribute('data-kfade', '');
  if (!glides.has(el) && (indents.get(el) ?? 0) > over + 0.5) setIndent(el, over);
  setEnds(el, fadeLen(el), over, posOf(el));
}
function setEnds(el: HTMLElement, f: number, over: number, x: number): void {
  x = Math.max(0, Math.min(over, x));
  el.style.setProperty('--kf-l', `${Math.min(f, x).toFixed(1)}px`);
  el.style.setProperty('--kf-r', `${Math.min(f, over - x).toFixed(1)}px`);
}

function measureNow(): void {
  frame = 0;
  const list: HTMLElement[] = [];
  const overs: number[] = [];
  pending.forEach(el => { if (el.isConnected) { list.push(el); overs.push(overOf(el)); } });
  pending.clear();
  for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) if (!glides.has(list[i])) paint(list[i], overs[i]);
}
function schedule(el: HTMLElement): void {
  pending.add(el);
  if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(measureNow);
}
function track(root: Element): void {
  if (isFade(root)) { ro?.observe(root); schedule(root); }
  const inner = root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FADE_SELECTOR);
  for (let i = 0; i < inner.length; i++) { ro?.observe(inner[i]); schedule(inner[i]); }
}
function untrack(root: Element): void {
  if (isFade(root)) { ro?.unobserve(root); stop(root); }
  const inner = root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FADE_SELECTOR);
  for (let i = 0; i < inner.length; i++) { ro?.unobserve(inner[i]); stop(inner[i]); }
}

function stop(el: HTMLElement): void {
  const g = glides.get(el);
  if (!g) return;
  cancelAnimationFrame(g.raf);
  window.clearTimeout(g.wait);
  glides.delete(el);
}

function glide(el: HTMLElement, to: number, speed: number, delay: number): void {
  stop(el);
  foldScroll(el);
  const over = overOf(el);
  if (over <= 1) return;
  const from = posOf(el);
  const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(over, to));
  if (Math.abs(target - from) < 0.5) { paint(el, over); return; }
  if (reduce) { setPos(el, target); paint(el, over); return; }
  const f = fadeLen(el);
  const D = Math.abs(target - from), dir = target > from ? 1 : -1;
  const g: Glide = { raf: 0, from, to: target, t0: 0, dur: rampTime(D, speed) * 1000, wait: 0 };
  glides.set(el, g);
  const step = (now: number) => {
    if (!g.t0) g.t0 = now;
    const t = Math.min(1, (now - g.t0) / g.dur);
    const x = t >= 1 ? g.to : g.from + dir * rampPos((now - g.t0) / 1000, D, speed);
    setPos(el, x);
    if (t < 1 && glides.get(el) === g) { setEnds(el, f, over, x); g.raf = requestAnimationFrame(step); return; }
    paint(el, overOf(el));
    if (glides.get(el) === g) glides.delete(el);
  };
  const begin = () => { g.raf = requestAnimationFrame(step); };
  if (delay > 0) g.wait = window.setTimeout(begin, delay); else begin();
}

function typingIn(el: Element | null): el is HTMLInputElement { return isTextBox(el) && el === document.activeElement; }
function isTextBox(el: Element | null): el is HTMLInputElement { return el instanceof HTMLInputElement && el.matches(TEXT_BOX); }
const lastX = new WeakMap<HTMLInputElement, number>();
const lastKeyAt = new WeakMap<HTMLInputElement, number>();
const typingHome = new WeakMap<HTMLInputElement, number>();
function wholeSelected(el: HTMLInputElement): boolean {
  try { return el.value.length > 0 && el.selectionStart === 0 && el.selectionEnd === el.value.length; } catch { return false; }
}
let downOn: EventTarget | null = null;
let downAt = 0;
function standsAtStart(el: HTMLInputElement): boolean {
  if (wholeSelected(el)) return true;
  if (downOn === el && performance.now() - downAt < 1000) return false;
  try { const n = el.value.length; return n > 0 && el.selectionStart === n && el.selectionEnd === n; } catch { return false; }
}
export function textBoxToStart(el: HTMLInputElement): void {
  if (!isTextBox(el)) return;
  typingHome.delete(el);
  try { const n = el.value.length; el.setSelectionRange(n, n); } catch { }
  if (el.scrollLeft !== 0) el.scrollLeft = 0;
  setIndent(el, 0); paint(el, overOf(el));
}
const TYPING_REST_MS = 700;
let measureCtx: CanvasRenderingContext2D | null = null;
function backTarget(el: HTMLInputElement): number {
  let end: number | null = null;
  try { end = el.selectionEnd; } catch { end = null; }
  if (end == null) return 0;
  if (!measureCtx) measureCtx = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
  if (!measureCtx) return 0;
  const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
  measureCtx.font = cs.font;
  const caret = measureCtx.measureText(el.value.slice(0, end)).width;
  const view = el.clientWidth - (parseFloat(cs.paddingLeft) || 0) - (parseFloat(cs.paddingRight) || 0);
  return Math.max(0, caret - view + 2);
}

export function installTextFade(): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return () => {};
  reduce = !!window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  ro = new ResizeObserver(entries => { for (const e of entries) schedule(e.target as HTMLElement); });
  mo = new MutationObserver(onRecords);
  layerMo = new MutationObserver(onLayers);
  if (_playing) armPlaying();
  else { mo.observe(document.body, WATCH_ALL); track(document.body); }
  const over = (e: PointerEvent) => {
    if (_playing && (e.target as Element | null)?.tagName === 'CANVAS') return;
    const el = fadeUnder(e.target as Element | null);
    if (!el || !el.hasAttribute('data-kfade')) return;
    if (typingIn(el)) return;
    const g = glides.get(el);
    if (g && g.to > 0) return;
    glide(el, overOf(el), READ_PX_S, posOf(el) > 0 ? 0 : HOVER_WAIT_MS);
  };
  const out = (e: PointerEvent) => {
    const el = fadeUnder(e.target as Element | null);
    if (!el) return;
    const to = e.relatedTarget as Node | null;
    if (to && (el.closest(ROW_HOST) ?? el).contains(to)) return;
    if (typingIn(el)) { typingHome.delete(el); return; }
    if (posOf(el) > 0 || glides.has(el)) glide(el, 0, BACK_PX_S, 0);
  };
  const focusIn = (e: FocusEvent) => {
    const el = e.target as Element | null;
    if (!isTextBox(el)) return;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (document.activeElement !== el || !standsAtStart(el)) return;
      const g = glides.get(el);
      if (g && g.to <= 0.5) return;
      stop(el);
      if (el.scrollLeft !== 0) el.scrollLeft = 0;
      setIndent(el, 0); paint(el, overOf(el));
    });
    if (!el.hasAttribute('data-kfade')) return;
    stop(el);
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (document.activeElement !== el || standsAtStart(el)) return;
      unfoldIndent(el); paint(el, overOf(el));
    }, 0);
  };
  const focusOut = (e: FocusEvent) => {
    const el = e.target as Element | null;
    if (!isTextBox(el)) return;
    stop(el);
    const seen = Math.max(posOf(el), lastX.get(el) ?? 0);
    if (seen <= 0.5) return;
    if (el.scrollLeft !== 0) el.scrollLeft = 0;
    setIndent(el, seen);
    glide(el, 0, BACK_PX_S, 0);
  };
  const pointerDown = (e: PointerEvent) => { downOn = e.target; downAt = performance.now(); };
  const keyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    const el = e.target as Element | null;
    if (!isTextBox(el)) return;
    lastKeyAt.set(el, performance.now());
    stop(el);
    typingHome.delete(el);
    unfoldIndent(el);
  };
  const typed = (e: Event) => { const el = e.target as Element | null; if (isTextBox(el)) schedule(el); };
  const scrolled = (e: Event) => {
    const el = e.target as Element | null;
    if (!isTextBox(el)) return;
    lastX.set(el, posOf(el));
    if (!glides.has(el) && el.hasAttribute('data-kfade')) paint(el, overOf(el));
  };
  document.addEventListener('pointerover', over, true);
  document.addEventListener('pointerout', out, true);
  document.addEventListener('focusin', focusIn, true);
  document.addEventListener('focusout', focusOut, true);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', keyDown, true);
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', pointerDown, true);
  document.addEventListener('input', typed, true);
  document.addEventListener('scroll', scrolled, true);
  return () => {
    document.removeEventListener('pointerover', over, true);
    document.removeEventListener('pointerout', out, true);
    document.removeEventListener('focusin', focusIn, true);
    document.removeEventListener('focusout', focusOut, true);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', keyDown, true);
    document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', pointerDown, true);
    document.removeEventListener('input', typed, true);
    document.removeEventListener('scroll', scrolled, true);
    mo?.disconnect(); ro?.disconnect(); layerMo?.disconnect(); mo = null; ro = null; layerMo = null;
    glides.forEach((_g, el) => stop(el));
    if (frame) cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    frame = 0; pending.clear();
  };
}
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import type { Tool } from './engineTools';

let current: Tool = 'tank';
const subs = new Set<() => void>();

export const toolStore = {
  get(): Tool { return current; },
  set(t: Tool): void { if (t === current) return; current = t; subs.forEach(f => f()); },
  subscribe(f: () => void): () => void { subs.add(f); return () => { subs.delete(f); }; },
};

export function useActiveTool(): Tool {
  return useSyncExternalStore(toolStore.subscribe, toolStore.get, toolStore.get);
}

export function useIsActiveTool(t: Tool): boolean {
  const get = () => current === t;
  return useSyncExternalStore(toolStore.subscribe, get, get);
}
export const Tok = { Plain: 0, Comment: 1, Keyword: 2, String: 3, Number: 4, Func: 5, Type: 6, Prop: 7, Punct: 8, Tag: 9, Attr: 10, Head: 11 } as const;
export type Tok = number;

export interface Tokens { starts: Uint32Array; kinds: Uint8Array; count: number }

class Out {
  starts = new Uint32Array(4096);
  kinds = new Uint8Array(4096);
  count = 0;
  last = -1;
  mark(at: number, k: Tok): void {
    if (k === this.last) return;
    if (this.count > 0 && this.starts[this.count - 1] === at) {
      this.kinds[this.count - 1] = k;
      this.last = k;
      if (this.count > 1 && this.kinds[this.count - 2] === k) { this.count--; }
      return;
    }
    if (this.count === this.starts.length) {
      const s = new Uint32Array(this.count * 2); s.set(this.starts); this.starts = s;
      const d = new Uint8Array(this.count * 2); d.set(this.kinds); this.kinds = d;
    }
    this.starts[this.count] = at;
    this.kinds[this.count] = k;
    this.count++;
    this.last = k;
  }
  done(): Tokens { return { starts: this.starts, kinds: this.kinds, count: this.count }; }
}

const JS_KEYWORDS = new Set((
  'abstract as async await break case catch class const continue debugger declare default delete do else enum export ' +
  'extends false finally for from function get if implements import in infer instanceof interface is keyof let module ' +
  'namespace new null of package private protected public readonly return satisfies set static super switch this throw ' +
  'true try type typeof undefined unique var void while with yield'
).split(' '));
const JS_TYPES = new Set('any bigint boolean never number object string symbol unknown'.split(' '));
const EXPR_WORDS = new Set('return typeof case do else in of new delete void throw yield await instanceof'.split(' '));

const isIdStart = (c: number) => (c >= 65 && c <= 90) || (c >= 97 && c <= 122) || c === 95 || c === 36 || c > 127;
const isIdPart = (c: number) => isIdStart(c) || (c >= 48 && c <= 57);
const isDigit = (c: number) => c >= 48 && c <= 57;
const isSpace = (c: number) => c === 32 || c === 9 || c === 10 || c === 13 || c === 12 || c === 11;

function lexJs(src: string, from: number, to: number, out: Out, jsx: boolean): void {
  const kind: number[] = [0];
  const depth: number[] = [0];
  let i = from;
  let after = 0;
  let prevDot = false;
  while (i < to) {
    const top = kind.length - 1;
    const mode = kind[top];
    const c = src.charCodeAt(i);
    if (mode === 1) {
      out.mark(i, Tok.String);
      while (i < to) {
        const d = src.charCodeAt(i);
        if (d === 92) { i += 2; continue; }
        if (d === 96) { i++; kind.pop(); depth.pop(); after = 1; break; }
        if (d === 36 && src.charCodeAt(i + 1) === 123) {
          out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i += 2; kind.push(0); depth.push(1); after = 0; break;
        }
        i++;
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (mode === 3) {
      if (c === 123) { out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++; kind.push(0); depth.push(1); after = 0; continue; }
      if (c === 60) {
        const closing = src.charCodeAt(i + 1) === 47;
        out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i += closing ? 2 : 1;
        if (closing) depth[top]--; else depth[top]++;
        kind.push(2); depth.push(closing ? -1 : 0);
        const s = i;
        while (i < to && (isIdPart(src.charCodeAt(i)) || src.charCodeAt(i) === 46 || src.charCodeAt(i) === 45 || src.charCodeAt(i) === 58)) i++;
        if (i > s) out.mark(s, Tok.Tag);
        continue;
      }
      out.mark(i, Tok.Plain);
      while (i < to) { const d = src.charCodeAt(i); if (d === 60 || d === 123) break; i++; }
      continue;
    }
    if (mode === 2) {
      if (isSpace(c)) { out.mark(i, Tok.Plain); i++; continue; }
      if (c === 47 && src.charCodeAt(i + 1) === 42) {
        out.mark(i, Tok.Comment);
        const end = src.indexOf('*/', i + 2);
        i = end < 0 || end >= to ? to : end + 2;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === 47 && src.charCodeAt(i + 1) === 47) { out.mark(i, Tok.Comment); while (i < to && src.charCodeAt(i) !== 10) i++; continue; }
      if (c === 62 || (c === 47 && src.charCodeAt(i + 1) === 62)) {
        const selfClose = c === 47;
        out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i += selfClose ? 2 : 1;
        const closingTag = depth[top] === -1;
        kind.pop(); depth.pop();
        const pt = kind.length - 1;
        if (kind[pt] === 3) {
          if (selfClose) depth[pt]--;
          if (depth[pt] <= 0) { kind.pop(); depth.pop(); after = 1; }
        } else if (!selfClose && !closingTag) {
          kind.push(3); depth.push(1);
        } else after = 1;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === 123) { out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++; kind.push(0); depth.push(1); after = 0; continue; }
      if (c === 34 || c === 39) {
        out.mark(i, Tok.String); i++;
        while (i < to && src.charCodeAt(i) !== c) i++;
        i++; continue;
      }
      if (isIdStart(c)) {
        out.mark(i, Tok.Attr);
        while (i < to && (isIdPart(src.charCodeAt(i)) || src.charCodeAt(i) === 45 || src.charCodeAt(i) === 58)) i++;
        continue;
      }
      out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++; continue;
    }

    if (isSpace(c)) { out.mark(i, Tok.Plain); i++; continue; }
    if (c === 47 && src.charCodeAt(i + 1) === 47) {
      out.mark(i, Tok.Comment);
      while (i < to && src.charCodeAt(i) !== 10) i++;
      continue;
    }
    if (c === 47 && src.charCodeAt(i + 1) === 42) {
      out.mark(i, Tok.Comment);
      const end = src.indexOf('*/', i + 2);
      i = end < 0 || end >= to ? to : end + 2;
      continue;
    }
    if (c === 34 || c === 39) {
      out.mark(i, Tok.String); i++;
      while (i < to) {
        const d = src.charCodeAt(i);
        if (d === 92) { i += 2; continue; }
        if (d === c) { i++; break; }
        if (d === 10) break;
        i++;
      }
      after = 1; prevDot = false; continue;
    }
    if (c === 96) { out.mark(i, Tok.String); i++; kind.push(1); depth.push(0); continue; }
    if (isDigit(c) || (c === 46 && isDigit(src.charCodeAt(i + 1)))) {
      out.mark(i, Tok.Number); i++;
      while (i < to) {
        const d = src.charCodeAt(i);
        if (isIdPart(d) || d === 46) { i++; continue; }
        if ((d === 43 || d === 45) && (src.charCodeAt(i - 1) | 32) === 101 && !/^0[xX]/.test(src.slice(i - 3, i))) { i++; continue; }
        break;
      }
      after = 1; prevDot = false; continue;
    }
    if (isIdStart(c)) {
      const s = i;
      while (i < to && isIdPart(src.charCodeAt(i))) i++;
      const word = src.slice(s, i);
      let k: Tok = Tok.Plain;
      if (prevDot) {
        let j = i; while (j < to && (src.charCodeAt(j) === 32 || src.charCodeAt(j) === 9)) j++;
        k = src.charCodeAt(j) === 40 ? Tok.Func : Tok.Prop;
      } else if (JS_KEYWORDS.has(word)) k = word === 'true' || word === 'false' || word === 'null' || word === 'undefined' ? Tok.Number : Tok.Keyword;
      else if (JS_TYPES.has(word)) k = Tok.Type;
      else {
        let j = i; while (j < to && (src.charCodeAt(j) === 32 || src.charCodeAt(j) === 9)) j++;
        const n = src.charCodeAt(j);
        if (n === 40) k = Tok.Func;
        else if (word.charCodeAt(0) >= 65 && word.charCodeAt(0) <= 90) k = Tok.Type;
      }
      out.mark(s, k);
      after = EXPR_WORDS.has(word) ? 0 : 1;
      prevDot = false;
      continue;
    }
    if (c === 47) {
      if (after === 0) {
        let j = i + 1, inClass = false, ok = false;
        while (j < to) {
          const d = src.charCodeAt(j);
          if (d === 10) break;
          if (d === 92) { j += 2; continue; }
          if (d === 91) inClass = true;
          else if (d === 93) inClass = false;
          else if (d === 47 && !inClass) { ok = true; break; }
          j++;
        }
        if (ok) {
          out.mark(i, Tok.String); i = j + 1;
          while (i < to && isIdPart(src.charCodeAt(i))) i++;
          after = 1; continue;
        }
      }
      out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++; after = 0; prevDot = false; continue;
    }
    if (jsx && c === 60 && after === 0) {
      const n = src.charCodeAt(i + 1);
      if (isIdStart(n) || n === 62) {
        let j = i + 1;
        while (j < to && (isIdPart(src.charCodeAt(j)) || src.charCodeAt(j) === 46 || src.charCodeAt(j) === 45)) j++;
        let q = j; while (q < to && isSpace(src.charCodeAt(q))) q++;
        const nq = src.charCodeAt(q);
        const generic = nq === 44 || src.startsWith('extends ', q);
        if (!generic) {
          out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++;
          if (j > i) out.mark(i, Tok.Tag);
          i = j;
          kind.push(2); depth.push(0);
          continue;
        }
      }
    }
    if (c === 123) { depth[top]++; out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++; after = 0; prevDot = false; continue; }
    if (c === 125) {
      depth[top]--;
      out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++;
      if (depth[top] <= 0 && kind.length > 1) { kind.pop(); depth.pop(); }
      after = 1; prevDot = false; continue;
    }
    if (c === 41 || c === 93) { out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++; after = 1; prevDot = false; continue; }
    if (c === 46 && src.charCodeAt(i + 1) !== 46) { out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++; prevDot = true; after = 0; continue; }
    if (c === 63 && src.charCodeAt(i + 1) === 46 && !isDigit(src.charCodeAt(i + 2))) { out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i += 2; prevDot = true; after = 0; continue; }
    out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++; after = 0; prevDot = false;
  }
}

function lexJson(src: string, from: number, to: number, out: Out): void {
  let i = from;
  while (i < to) {
    const c = src.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c === 34) {
      const s = i; i++;
      while (i < to) { const d = src.charCodeAt(i); if (d === 92) { i += 2; continue; } i++; if (d === 34) break; }
      let j = i; while (j < to && isSpace(src.charCodeAt(j))) j++;
      out.mark(s, src.charCodeAt(j) === 58 ? Tok.Prop : Tok.String);
      continue;
    }
    if (isDigit(c) || c === 45) {
      out.mark(i, Tok.Number); i++;
      while (i < to) { const d = src.charCodeAt(i); if (isDigit(d) || d === 101 || d === 69 || d === 43 || d === 45 || d === 46) i++; else break; }
      continue;
    }
    if (c === 116 || c === 102 || c === 110) { out.mark(i, Tok.Number); while (i < to && isIdPart(src.charCodeAt(i))) i++; continue; }
    if (isSpace(c)) { out.mark(i, Tok.Plain); i++; continue; }
    out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++;
  }
}

function lexCss(src: string, from: number, to: number, out: Out): void {
  let i = from;
  let inDecl = false;
  while (i < to) {
    const c = src.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c === 47 && src.charCodeAt(i + 1) === 42) {
      out.mark(i, Tok.Comment);
      const end = src.indexOf('*/', i + 2);
      i = end < 0 || end >= to ? to : end + 2;
      continue;
    }
    if (isSpace(c)) { out.mark(i, Tok.Plain); i++; continue; }
    if (c === 34 || c === 39) {
      out.mark(i, Tok.String); i++;
      while (i < to) { const d = src.charCodeAt(i); if (d === 92) { i += 2; continue; } i++; if (d === c || d === 10) break; }
      continue;
    }
    if (c === 123 || c === 59) { out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++; inDecl = false; continue; }
    if (c === 125) { out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++; inDecl = false; continue; }
    if (inDecl) {
      if (isDigit(c) || (c === 46 && isDigit(src.charCodeAt(i + 1))) || (c === 45 && isDigit(src.charCodeAt(i + 1)))) {
        out.mark(i, Tok.Number); i++;
        while (i < to && (isIdPart(src.charCodeAt(i)) || src.charCodeAt(i) === 46 || src.charCodeAt(i) === 37)) i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === 35) { out.mark(i, Tok.Number); i++; while (i < to && isIdPart(src.charCodeAt(i))) i++; continue; }
      if (isIdStart(c) || c === 45) {
        const s = i;
        while (i < to && (isIdPart(src.charCodeAt(i)) || src.charCodeAt(i) === 45)) i++;
        out.mark(s, src.charCodeAt(i) === 40 ? Tok.Func : src.startsWith('--', s) ? Tok.Prop : Tok.Plain);
        continue;
      }
      if (c === 33) { out.mark(i, Tok.Keyword); i++; while (i < to && isIdPart(src.charCodeAt(i))) i++; continue; }
      out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++; continue;
    }
    if (c === 64) { out.mark(i, Tok.Keyword); i++; while (i < to && (isIdPart(src.charCodeAt(i)) || src.charCodeAt(i) === 45)) i++; continue; }
    let j = i, sel = false;
    while (j < to) {
      const d = src.charCodeAt(j);
      if (d === 123) { sel = true; break; }
      if (d === 59 || d === 125) break;
      if (d === 47 && src.charCodeAt(j + 1) === 42) { const e = src.indexOf('*/', j + 2); j = e < 0 ? to : e + 2; continue; }
      j++;
    }
    if (sel) {
      out.mark(i, Tok.Type);
      while (i < j && !(src.charCodeAt(i) === 47 && src.charCodeAt(i + 1) === 42)) i++;
      continue;
    }
    const s = i;
    while (i < to && src.charCodeAt(i) !== 58 && src.charCodeAt(i) !== 59 && src.charCodeAt(i) !== 125 && src.charCodeAt(i) !== 10) i++;
    out.mark(s, Tok.Prop);
    if (src.charCodeAt(i) === 58) { out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++; inDecl = true; }
  }
}

function lexHtml(src: string, from: number, to: number, out: Out): void {
  let i = from;
  while (i < to) {
    const c = src.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c === 60 && src.startsWith('<!--', i)) {
      out.mark(i, Tok.Comment);
      const end = src.indexOf('-->', i + 4);
      i = end < 0 || end >= to ? to : end + 3;
      continue;
    }
    if (c === 60 && (isIdStart(src.charCodeAt(i + 1)) || src.charCodeAt(i + 1) === 47 || src.charCodeAt(i + 1) === 33)) {
      out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++;
      if (src.charCodeAt(i) === 47 || src.charCodeAt(i) === 33) i++;
      const s = i;
      while (i < to && (isIdPart(src.charCodeAt(i)) || src.charCodeAt(i) === 45)) i++;
      const name = src.slice(s, i).toLowerCase();
      const closing = src.charCodeAt(s - 1) === 47;
      out.mark(s, Tok.Tag);
      while (i < to && src.charCodeAt(i) !== 62) {
        const d = src.charCodeAt(i);
        if (isSpace(d)) { out.mark(i, Tok.Plain); i++; continue; }
        if (d === 34 || d === 39) {
          out.mark(i, Tok.String); i++;
          while (i < to && src.charCodeAt(i) !== d) i++;
          i++; continue;
        }
        if (isIdStart(d)) { out.mark(i, Tok.Attr); while (i < to && (isIdPart(src.charCodeAt(i)) || src.charCodeAt(i) === 45 || src.charCodeAt(i) === 58)) i++; continue; }
        out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++;
      }
      if (i < to) { out.mark(i, Tok.Punct); i++; }
      if (!closing && (name === 'style' || name === 'script')) {
        const end = src.toLowerCase().indexOf('</' + name, i);
        const stop = end < 0 || end > to ? to : end;
        if (name === 'style') lexCss(src, i, stop, out); else lexJs(src, i, stop, out, false);
        i = stop;
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (c === 38) {
      const semi = src.indexOf(';', i);
      if (semi > i && semi - i < 10) { out.mark(i, Tok.Number); i = semi + 1; continue; }
    }
    out.mark(i, Tok.Plain); i++;
  }
}

function lexMarkdown(src: string, out: Out): void {
  let i = 0;
  const n = src.length;
  let fenced = false;
  while (i < n) {
    let e = src.indexOf('\n', i);
    if (e < 0) e = n;
    const line = src.slice(i, e);
    if (/^\s*(```|~~~)/.test(line)) { out.mark(i, Tok.String); fenced = !fenced; i = e + 1; continue; }
    if (fenced) { out.mark(i, Tok.String); i = e + 1; continue; }
    if (/^#{1,6}\s/.test(line)) { out.mark(i, Tok.Head); i = e + 1; continue; }
    const list = /^(\s*)([-*+]|\d+\.)\s/.exec(line);
    let j = i;
    if (list) { out.mark(i, Tok.Plain); out.mark(i + list[1].length, Tok.Punct); j = i + list[0].length; }
    else if (line.startsWith('>')) { out.mark(i, Tok.Comment); i = e + 1; continue; }
    out.mark(j, Tok.Plain);
    while (j < e) {
      const c = src.charCodeAt(j);
      if (c === 96) { const k = src.indexOf('`', j + 1); if (k > j && k < e) { out.mark(j, Tok.String); j = k + 1; out.mark(j, Tok.Plain); continue; } }
      if (c === 42 && src.charCodeAt(j + 1) === 42) { const k = src.indexOf('**', j + 2); if (k > j && k < e) { out.mark(j, Tok.Type); j = k + 2; out.mark(j, Tok.Plain); continue; } }
      if (c === 91) { const k = src.indexOf('](', j); const m = k > 0 ? src.indexOf(')', k) : -1; if (k > j && m > k && m < e) { out.mark(j, Tok.Func); j = m + 1; out.mark(j, Tok.Plain); continue; } }
      j++;
    }
    i = e + 1;
  }
}

export function lexCode(src: string, lang: string): Tokens {
  const out = new Out();
  out.mark(0, Tok.Plain);
  try {
    if (lang === 'ts' || lang === 'js') lexJs(src, 0, src.length, out, false);
    else if (lang === 'tsx') lexJs(src, 0, src.length, out, true);
    else if (lang === 'json') lexJson(src, 0, src.length, out);
    else if (lang === 'css') lexCss(src, 0, src.length, out);
    else if (lang === 'html') lexHtml(src, 0, src.length, out);
    else if (lang === 'md') lexMarkdown(src, out);
  } catch {
    const plain = new Out();
    plain.mark(0, Tok.Plain);
    return plain.done();
  }
  return out.done();
}
import React, { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
