export const ROW_H = 20;
const PAD = 12;
const OVERSCAN = 40;
const MAX_DRAWN = 4000;
const GUTTER_PAD = 36;
const SYNC_LEX = 150_000;
const MAX_HITS = 20_000;

const TOK_CLASS = ['', 'k-sc-c', 'k-sc-k', 'k-sc-s', 'k-sc-n', 'k-sc-f', 'k-sc-y', 'k-sc-p', 'k-sc-u', 'k-sc-g', 'k-sc-a', 'k-sc-h'];

interface Lines { starts: Uint32Array; count: number; widest: number }

function linesOf(text: string): Lines {
  const n = text.length;
  let breaks = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (text.charCodeAt(i) === 10) breaks++;
  const endsWithBreak = n > 0 && text.charCodeAt(n - 1) === 10;
  const count = Math.max(1, endsWithBreak ? breaks : breaks + 1);
  const starts = new Uint32Array(count + 1);
  let k = 1, from = 0, tabs = 0, widest = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const c = text.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c === 9) tabs++;
    else if (c === 10) {
      const w = i - from + tabs * 3;
      if (w > widest) widest = w;
      if (k <= count) starts[k++] = i + 1;
      from = i + 1; tabs = 0;
    }
  }
  if (from < n) { const w = n - from + tabs * 3; if (w > widest) widest = w; }
  starts[count] = endsWithBreak ? n : n + 1;
  return { starts, count, widest };
}

function lineAt(lines: Lines, pos: number): number {
  let lo = 0, hi = lines.count - 1;
  while (lo < hi) { const mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1; if (lines.starts[mid] <= pos) lo = mid; else hi = mid - 1; }
  return lo;
}
function tokenAt(tk: Tokens, pos: number): number {
  let lo = 0, hi = tk.count - 1;
  while (lo < hi) { const mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1; if (tk.starts[mid] <= pos) lo = mid; else hi = mid - 1; }
  return lo;
}

export interface Hits { line: Int32Array; start: Int32Array; end: Int32Array; count: number }
const NO_HITS: Hits = { line: new Int32Array(0), start: new Int32Array(0), end: new Int32Array(0), count: 0 };

function findHits(lower: string, q: string, lines: Lines): Hits {
  if (!q) return NO_HITS;
  const line = new Int32Array(MAX_HITS), start = new Int32Array(MAX_HITS), end = new Int32Array(MAX_HITS);
  let count = 0, from = 0, ln = 0;
  while (count < MAX_HITS) {
    const at = lower.indexOf(q, from);
    if (at < 0) break;
    while (ln + 1 < lines.count && lines.starts[ln + 1] <= at) ln++;
    line[count] = ln; start[count] = at - lines.starts[ln]; end[count] = start[count] + q.length;
    count++;
    from = at + q.length;
  }
  return { line, start, end, count };
}
function firstHitOf(h: Hits, line: number): number {
  let lo = 0, hi = h.count;
  while (lo < hi) { const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (h.line[mid] < line) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid; }
  return lo;
}

let worker: Worker | null = null;
let workerFailed = false;
let lexSeq = 0;
const waiting = new Map<number, (t: Tokens) => void>();
function lexOffThread(text: string, lang: string): Promise<Tokens> {
  if (!worker && !workerFailed) {
    try {
      worker = new Worker(new URL('./lexWorker.ts', import.meta.url), { type: 'module' });
      worker.onmessage = (e: MessageEvent<{ id: number } & Tokens>) => {
        const done = waiting.get(e.data.id);
        waiting.delete(e.data.id);
        done?.({ starts: e.data.starts, kinds: e.data.kinds, count: e.data.count });
      };
      worker.onerror = () => { workerFailed = true; worker = null; for (const [, done] of waiting) done({ starts: new Uint32Array([0]), kinds: new Uint8Array([0]), count: 1 }); waiting.clear(); };
    } catch { workerFailed = true; }
  }
  if (!worker) return Promise.resolve(lexCode(text, lang));
  const id = ++lexSeq;
  return new Promise(resolve => { waiting.set(id, resolve); worker!.postMessage({ id, text, lang }); });
}

const Row = React.memo(function Row({ i, text, s, e, tk, hits, active }: {
  i: number; text: string; s: number; e: number; tk: Tokens | null; hits: Hits; active: number;
}) {
  const parts: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  const cut = Math.min(e, s + MAX_DRAWN);
  let t = tk ? tokenAt(tk, s) : -1;
  let h = hits.count ? firstHitOf(hits, i) : 0;
  let p = s, key = 0;
  while (p < cut) {
    let end = cut, kind = 0, mark = 0;
    if (tk) {
      kind = tk.kinds[t];
      if (t + 1 < tk.count && tk.starts[t + 1] < end) end = tk.starts[t + 1];
    }
    if (h < hits.count && hits.line[h] === i) {
      const hs = s + hits.start[h], he = s + hits.end[h];
      if (p < hs) { if (hs < end) end = hs; }
      else { mark = h === active ? 2 : 1; if (he < end) end = he; }
    }
    if (end <= p) end = p + 1;
    const piece = text.slice(p, end);
    const cls = mark ? (mark === 2 ? 'k-sc-hit k-sc-hit-on ' : 'k-sc-hit ') + TOK_CLASS[kind] : TOK_CLASS[kind];
    parts.push(cls ? <span key={key++} className={cls}>{piece}</span> : piece);
    p = end;
    if (tk) while (t + 1 < tk.count && tk.starts[t + 1] <= p) t++;
    if (h < hits.count && hits.line[h] === i && p >= s + hits.end[h]) h++;
  }
  return (
    <div className="k-sc-row" data-i={i} style={{ top: PAD + i * ROW_H }}>
      <span className="k-sc-text">{parts}</span>
      {e > cut && <span className="k-sc-more">{`  +${fmtCount(e - cut)} more characters`}</span>}
    </div>
  );
});

function textPos(lines: Lines, text: string, layer: HTMLElement, node: Node, offset: number): number | null {
  let el: Node | null = node;
  if (node === layer) {
    const rowsEls = layer.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(':scope > .k-sc-row');
    const after = rowsEls[offset] as HTMLElement | undefined;
    if (after) return lines.starts[Number(after.dataset.i)];
    const last = rowsEls[rowsEls.length - 1] as HTMLElement | undefined;
    if (!last) return null;
    const li = Number(last.dataset.i);
    return Math.min(text.length, lines.starts[li + 1] - 1);
  }
  while (el && !(el instanceof HTMLElement && el.classList.contains('k-sc-row'))) el = el.parentNode;
  if (!el || el.parentNode !== layer) return null;
  const row = el as HTMLElement;
  const i = Number(row.dataset.i);
  const words = row.querySelector('.k-sc-text');
  const s = lines.starts[i];
  let e = Math.min(text.length, lines.starts[i + 1] - 1);
  if (e > s && text.charCodeAt(e - 1) === 13) e--;
  if (!words) return s;
  if (!words.contains(node)) {
    if (node === row && offset === 0) return s;
    return e;
  }
  const r = document.createRange();
  r.setStart(words, 0);
  r.setEnd(node, offset);
  return Math.min(e, s + r.toString().length);
}

export interface CodeViewProps {
  text: string;
  lang: string;
  find: string;
  step: { seq: number; delta: number };
  onFind: (active: number, count: number) => void;
  goLine: { line: number; seq: number } | null;
}

export const CodeView: React.FC<CodeViewProps> = React.memo(({ text, lang, find, step, onFind, goLine }) => {
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const lines = useMemo(() => linesOf(text), [text]);
  const [tk, setTk] = useState<Tokens | null>(() => (text.length <= SYNC_LEX ? lexCode(text, lang) : null));
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tk) return;
    let alive = true;
    lexOffThread(text, lang).then(t => { if (alive) setTk(t); });
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [text, lang, tk]);

  const q = find.toLowerCase();
  const wantLower = !!q;
  const lower = useMemo(() => (wantLower ? text.toLowerCase() : ''), [text, wantLower]);
  const hits = useMemo(() => (q ? findHits(lower, q, lines) : NO_HITS), [lower, q, lines]);
  const [activeRaw, setActive] = useState(-1);
  const active = hits.count ? Math.min(Math.max(0, activeRaw), hits.count - 1) : -1;
  const markLine = useRef<number | null>(goLine ? goLine.line - 1 : null);

  const [view, setView] = useState({ top: 0, h: 600 });
  const raf = useRef(0);
  const measure = () => {
    raf.current = 0;
    const el = box.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const top = el.scrollTop, h = el.clientHeight || 600;
    setView(v => (Math.abs(v.top - top) < ROW_H * 8 && v.h === h ? v : { top, h }));
  };
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = box.current;
    if (!el) return;
    measure();
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => { if (!raf.current) raf.current = requestAnimationFrame(measure); });
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => { ro.disconnect(); if (raf.current) cancelAnimationFrame(raf.current); };
  }, []);
  const lastLeft = useRef(0);
  const onScroll = () => {
    const el = box.current;
    if (el && el.scrollLeft !== lastLeft.current) { lastLeft.current = el.scrollLeft; el.style.setProperty('--k-sc-sl', `${el.scrollLeft}px`); }
    if (!raf.current) raf.current = requestAnimationFrame(measure);
  };

  const [askedLine, setAskedLine] = useState<number | null>(goLine ? goLine.line - 1 : null);
  const onLine = active >= 0 ? hits.line[active] : askedLine;

  const placed = useRef(false);
  const bring = (line: number, col?: number) => {
    const el = box.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const to = Math.max(0, PAD + line * ROW_H - el.clientHeight / 2 + ROW_H / 2);
    if (!placed.current) { el.scrollTop = to; placed.current = true; measure(); }
    else scrollGlide(el, to);
    if (col !== undefined) {
      const ch = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).fontSize) * 0.6;
      const gutter = String(lines.count).length * ch + GUTTER_PAD;
      const x = gutter + col * ch;
      if (x < el.scrollLeft + gutter + 8 || x > el.scrollLeft + el.clientWidth - 40) el.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, x - gutter - el.clientWidth / 3);
      else if (x < el.clientWidth * 0.6) el.scrollLeft = 0;
    }
  };
  const goSeq = goLine?.seq;
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!goLine) { placed.current = true; return; }
    setAskedLine(goLine.line - 1);
    markLine.current = goLine.line - 1;
    bring(goLine.line - 1);
  }, [goSeq]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!hits.count) { setActive(-1); return; }
    const el = box.current;
    const from = markLine.current ?? (el ? Math.max(0, Math.floor((el.scrollTop - PAD) / ROW_H)) : 0);
    const k = firstHitOf(hits, from);
    setActive(k < hits.count ? k : 0);
  }, [hits]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!step.seq || !hits.count) return;
    setActive(a => ((a < 0 ? 0 : a + step.delta) % hits.count + hits.count) % hits.count);
  }, [step.seq]);
  useEffect(() => { onFind(active, hits.count); }, [active, hits.count, onFind]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (active < 0) return;
    markLine.current = hits.line[active];
    bring(hits.line[active], hits.start[active]);
  }, [active, hits]);

  const a = Math.max(0, Math.floor((view.top - PAD) / ROW_H) - OVERSCAN);
  const b = Math.min(lines.count, Math.ceil((view.top + view.h) / ROW_H) + OVERSCAN);
  const rows: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  const nums: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let i = a; i < b; i++) {
    const s = lines.starts[i];
    let e = lines.starts[i + 1] - 1;
    if (e > text.length) e = text.length;
    if (e > s && text.charCodeAt(e - 1) === 13) e--;
    const lineActive = active >= 0 && hits.line[active] === i ? active : -1;
    rows.push(<Row key={i} i={i} text={text} s={s} e={e} tk={tk} hits={hits} active={lineActive} />);
    nums.push(<span key={i} className={onLine === i ? 'k-sc-num k-sc-num-on' : 'k-sc-num'} style={{ top: PAD + i * ROW_H }}>{i + 1}</span>);
  }

  const layer = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const all = useRef<{ a: Node | null; ao: number; f: Node | null; fo: number } | null>(null);
  const onKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && !e.altKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'a') {
      const sel = window.getSelection();
      const el = layer.current;
      if (!sel || !el || !el.firstElementChild) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const r = document.createRange();
      r.selectNodeContents(el);
      sel.removeAllRanges();
      sel.addRange(r);
      all.current = { a: sel.anchorNode, ao: sel.anchorOffset, f: sel.focusNode, fo: sel.focusOffset };
    }
  };
  const onCopy = (e: React.ClipboardEvent) => {
    const sel = window.getSelection();
    const el = layer.current;
    if (!sel || !el || sel.rangeCount === 0 || sel.isCollapsed) return;
    const w = all.current;
    if (w && w.a === sel.anchorNode && w.ao === sel.anchorOffset && w.f === sel.focusNode && w.fo === sel.focusOffset) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.clipboardData.setData('text/plain', text);
      return;
    }
    all.current = null;
    const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);
    const from = textPos(lines, text, el, r.startContainer, r.startOffset);
    const to = textPos(lines, text, el, r.endContainer, r.endOffset);
    if (from === null || to === null || to <= from) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.clipboardData.setData('text/plain', text.slice(from, to));
  };
  const digits = String(lines.count).length;
  const cols = Math.min(lines.widest, MAX_DRAWN + 24);

  const ticks = useMemo(() => {
    if (!hits.count) return [] as number[];
    const out: number[] = [];
    let last = -1;
    const step = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(lines.count / 400));
    for (let k = 0; k < hits.count; k++) {
      const bucket = Math.floor(hits.line[k] / step);
      if (bucket !== last) { out.push(hits.line[k]); last = bucket; }
    }
    return out;
  }, [hits, lines.count]);

  return (
    <div className="k-sc-view">
      <div ref={box} className="k-sc-scroll custom-scrollbar" onScroll={onScroll} onKeyDown={onKeyDown} onCopy={onCopy} tabIndex={0}
        role="region" aria-label="Code" style={{ ['--k-sc-digits' as string]: digits } as React.CSSProperties}>
        <div className="k-sc-rows" style={{ height: PAD * 2 + lines.count * ROW_H, width: `calc(${digits + cols}ch + ${GUTTER_PAD + 60}px)` }}>
          <Fade when={onLine !== null && onLine < lines.count}>{() => <div className="k-sc-band" style={{ top: PAD + (onLine as number) * ROW_H }} aria-hidden />}</Fade>
          <div className="k-sc-gutter" aria-hidden>{nums}</div>
          <div ref={layer} className="k-sc-lines">
            <div className="k-sc-skel" style={{ top: PAD, height: a * ROW_H }} aria-hidden />
            {rows}
            <div className="k-sc-skel" style={{ top: PAD + b * ROW_H, height: Math.max(0, lines.count - b) * ROW_H }} aria-hidden />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {ticks.length > 0 && (
        <div className="k-sc-ticks" aria-hidden>
          {ticks.map(l => <span key={l} className={active >= 0 && hits.line[active] === l ? 'k-sc-tick k-sc-tick-on' : 'k-sc-tick'} style={{ top: `${(l / Math.max(1, lines.count)) * 100}%` }} />)}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

self.onmessage = (e: MessageEvent<{ id: number; text: string; lang: string }>) => {
  const { id, text, lang } = e.data;
  const t = lexCode(text, lang);
  const starts = t.starts.slice(0, t.count);
  const kinds = t.kinds.slice(0, t.count);
  (self as unknown as Worker).postMessage({ id, starts, kinds, count: t.count }, [starts.buffer, kinds.buffer]);
};

interface ZipState { busy: boolean; done: number; total: number }
let zipState: ZipState = { busy: false, done: 0, total: 0 };
const zipSubs = new Set<() => void>();
const setZip = (z: ZipState) => { zipState = z; zipSubs.forEach(f => f()); };
const zipSubscribe = (f: () => void) => { zipSubs.add(f); return () => { zipSubs.delete(f); }; };
const zipGet = () => zipState;

function saveBlob(blob: Blob, name: string): void {
  const href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = href;
  a.download = name;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(href), 60_000);
}

function startZip(project: SourceProject): void {
  if (zipState.busy) return;
  let w: Worker;
  try { w = new Worker(new URL('./zipWorker.ts', import.meta.url), { type: 'module' }); }
  catch { toast('error', 'This browser cannot make the zip'); return; }
  const files = project.files.map(f => ({ path: f.path, kind: f.kind, src: f.src, pack: f.pack, offset: f.offset, length: f.length }));
  setZip({ busy: true, done: 0, total: files.length });
  const end = () => { w.terminate(); setZip({ busy: false, done: 0, total: 0 }); };
  w.onmessage = (e: MessageEvent<{ type: string; done?: number; total?: number; blob?: Blob }>) => {
    const m = e.data;
    if (m.type === 'progress') setZip({ busy: true, done: m.done ?? 0, total: m.total ?? files.length });
    else if (m.type === 'done' && m.blob) { end(); saveBlob(m.blob, `${project.name}.zip`); toast('success', `${project.name}.zip is ready`); }
    else { end(); toast('error', 'The zip could not be made. Try again.'); }
  };
  w.onerror = () => { end(); toast('error', 'The zip could not be made. Try again.'); };
  w.postMessage({ base: baseHref(), name: project.name, packs: project.packs, files });
}

function iconOf(f: SourceFile, size = 14): React.ReactNode {
  if (f.kind === 'i') return <Image size={size} />;
  if (f.kind === 'b') return <FilePlain size={size} />;
  if (f.lang === 'json') return <FileJson size={size} />;
  if (f.lang === 'text' || f.lang === 'md') return <FilePlain size={size} />;
  return <FileScript size={size} />;
}

function Marked({ text, col, len }: { text: string; col: number; len: number }) {
  if (col < 0 || col >= text.length) return <>{text}</>;
  return <>{text.slice(0, col)}<mark className="k-sc-found">{text.slice(col, col + len)}</mark>{text.slice(col + len)}</>;
}

function ZipRing({ part }: { part: number }) {
  const r = 7, len = 2 * Math.PI * r;
  return (
    <svg width={18} height={18} viewBox="0 0 18 18" aria-hidden>
      <circle cx={9} cy={9} r={r} fill="none" strokeWidth={2} className="k-sc-ring-track" />
      <circle cx={9} cy={9} r={r} fill="none" strokeWidth={2} strokeLinecap="round" className="k-sc-ring-fill"
        strokeDasharray={len} strokeDashoffset={len * (1 - Math.min(1, Math.max(0.03, part)))} transform="rotate(-90 9 9)" />
    </svg>
  );
}

      <IconButton label={zip.busy ? `Packing the zip, ${pct}%` : 'Download every file in one zip'} disabled={!project}
        aria-busy={zip.busy || undefined} onClick={() => project && startZip(project)}>
        <SwapInPlace swapKey={zip.busy} hold={false} className="grid place-items-center">{zipIcon}</SwapInPlace>
      </IconButton>
    </div>
  );

  const stateKey = failed ? 'failed' : project ? 'ready' : 'wait';
  let stateBody: React.ReactNode = <WaitShape narrow={narrow} />;
  if (failed) stateBody = <div className="flex-1 grid place-items-center"><EmptyState icon={emptyArt(SourceCode)} title="The source code is not in this build" hint="It is made when the site is built." words /></div>;
  else if (project) stateBody = <SourceBody project={project} touch={touch} narrow={narrow} />;

  return (
    <Modal title="Source Code" icon={<SourceCode size={18} />} width={1260} onClose={onClose} fit phoneFull
      bodyClassName="k-modal-body-flush" waitHeight={phone ? Math.max(200, maxH - 58) : bodyH} surface="content" headerRight={tools}>
      <div className="flex min-h-0" style={{ height: phone ? '100%' : bodyH }}>
        <SwapInPlace swapKey={stateKey} hold={false} className="flex flex-1 min-w-0 min-h-0">{stateBody}</SwapInPlace>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

function WaitShape({ narrow }: { narrow: boolean }) {
  const side = narrow ? null : (
    <div className="k-rd-side k-sc-side">
      <div className="k-rd-search"><div className="skeleton-shimmer h-9 rounded-lg" /></div>
      <div className="px-3 flex flex-col gap-2 pt-1">
        {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => <div key={i} className="skeleton-shimmer h-5 rounded" style={{ width: `${55 + ((i * 37) % 40)}%` }} />)}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
  return (
    <div className="k-skel-delay flex flex-1 min-h-0" aria-hidden>
      {side}
      <div className={`flex-1 flex flex-col gap-4 ${narrow ? 'p-4' : 'p-7'}`}>
        <div className="skeleton-shimmer h-6 w-56 rounded" />
        <div className={`grid gap-3 ${narrow ? 'grid-cols-2' : 'grid-cols-4'}`}>{Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => <div key={i} className="skeleton-shimmer h-24 rounded-xl" />)}</div>
        <div className="skeleton-shimmer h-64 rounded-xl" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SourceBody({ project, touch, narrow }: { project: SourceProject; touch: boolean; narrow: boolean }) {
  const treeRow = touch ? TREE_ROW_TOUCH : TREE_ROW;
  const fileRow = touch ? RESULT_FILE_ROW_TOUCH : RESULT_FILE_ROW;
  const lineRow = touch ? RESULT_LINE_ROW_TOUCH : RESULT_LINE_ROW;
  const [filesOpen, setFilesOpen] = useState(false);
  const drawerOn = narrow && filesOpen;
  useEscapeOwner(() => setFilesOpen(false), drawerOn);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set(kept.open));
  const [page, setPage] = useState<Page>(() => (kept.page.kind === 'file' && !project.byPath.has(kept.page.path) ? { kind: 'overview' } : kept.page));
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(kept.query);
  useEffect(() => { kept.open = open; }, [open]);
  useEffect(() => { kept.page = page.kind === 'file' ? { ...page, line: null } : page; }, [page]);
  useEffect(() => { kept.query = query; }, [query]);

  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const treeBox = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const listHost = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [listH, setListH] = useState(480);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = listHost.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const read = () => { const h = el.clientHeight; if (h > 0) setListH(prev => (Math.abs(prev - h) > 1 ? h : prev)); };
    read();
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(read);
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && !e.shiftKey && !e.altKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
        searchRef.current?.focus(); searchRef.current?.select();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
  }, []);
  useEscapeOwner(() => setQuery(''), query !== '');

  const rows = useMemo(() => visibleRows(project.root, open), [project, open]);
  const toggle = useCallback((path: string) => {
    setOpen(prev => { const next = new Set(prev); if (next.has(path)) next.delete(path); else next.add(path); return next; });
  }, []);
  const [revealAsk, setRevealAsk] = useState<{ path: string; seq: number } | null>(null);
  const openFile = useCallback((path: string, find = '', line: number | null = null, reveal = false) => {
    setPage({ kind: 'file', path, find, line, seq: ++pageSeq });
    setFilesOpen(false);
    if (reveal) {
      setOpen(prev => { const next = new Set(prev); for (const d of foldersOf(path)) next.add(d); return next; });
      setRevealAsk({ path, seq: pageSeq });
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!revealAsk || query) return;
    const at = rows.findIndex(r => r.file?.path === revealAsk.path);
    if (at >= 0) window.requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollVirtualRowIntoView(treeBox.current, at * treeRow, treeRow));
  }, [revealAsk, rows, query, treeRow]);

  const navRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const scrimRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const swipe = useRef<{ id: number; x0: number; y0: number; on: boolean; dx: number; w: number; z: number; lastX: number; lastT: number; v: number } | null>(null);
  const swiped = useRef(false);
  const onSwipeDown = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (!drawerOn || e.pointerType === 'mouse' || swipe.current) return;
    swipe.current = { id: e.pointerId, x0: e.clientX, y0: e.clientY, on: false, dx: 0, w: 0, z: 1, lastX: e.clientX, lastT: e.timeStamp, v: 0 };
    swiped.current = false;
  };
  const onSwipeMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    const s = swipe.current, nav = navRef.current;
    if (!s || e.pointerId !== s.id || !nav) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - s.x0, dy = e.clientY - s.y0;
    if (!s.on) {
      if (Math.abs(dy) > 10 && Math.abs(dy) >= Math.abs(dx)) { swipe.current = null; return; }
      if (dx > -10 || Math.abs(dx) < Math.abs(dy)) return;
      s.on = true; swiped.current = true;
      s.w = nav.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      s.z = nav.offsetWidth > 0 ? s.w / nav.offsetWidth : 1;
      try { nav.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch { }
      nav.style.transition = 'none';
      if (scrimRef.current) scrimRef.current.style.transition = 'none';
    }
    s.dx = Math.min(0, dx);
    const dt = e.timeStamp - s.lastT;
    if (dt > 0) { s.v = (e.clientX - s.lastX) / dt; s.lastX = e.clientX; s.lastT = e.timeStamp; }
    nav.style.transform = `translateX(${s.dx / s.z}px)`;
    if (scrimRef.current) scrimRef.current.style.opacity = String(Math.max(0, 1 + s.dx / Math.max(1, s.w)));
  };
  const onSwipeUp = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    const s = swipe.current, nav = navRef.current;
    if (!s || e.pointerId !== s.id) return;
    swipe.current = null;
    if (!s.on || !nav) return;
    nav.style.transition = ''; nav.style.transform = '';
    if (scrimRef.current) { scrimRef.current.style.transition = ''; scrimRef.current.style.opacity = ''; }
    if (s.dx < -s.w * SWIPE_SHARE || (s.dx < -24 && s.v < -SWIPE_SPEED)) setFilesOpen(false);
  };
  const onSwipeClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (!swiped.current) return;
    swiped.current = false;
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    if (drawerOn) return;
    swipe.current = null;
    const nav = navRef.current;
    if (nav && nav.style.transform) { nav.style.transition = ''; nav.style.transform = ''; }
  }, [drawerOn]);
  const filesBar = narrow ? (
    <div className="k-sc-bar">
      <Button variant="primary" size="lg" className="k-sc-files-btn" icon={<PanelLeft size={20} />} aria-expanded={filesOpen} aria-controls="k-sc-files"
        onClick={() => setFilesOpen(true)}>Browse Files</Button>
      <span className="k-badge k-sc-bar-count">{fmtCount(project.root.fileCount)} files</span>
    </div>
  ) : null;

  const shownPath = page.kind === 'file' ? page.path : null;
  const renderTreeRow = (i: number) => {
    const r = rows[i];
    const guides = r.depth > 0 ? <span className="k-sc-guides" style={{ width: r.depth * 14 }} aria-hidden /> : null;
    if (r.folder) {
      const f: SourceFolder = r.folder;
      const isOpen = open.has(f.path);
      return (
        <div className="k-sc-node-wrap">
          {guides}
          <button type="button" className="k-rd-item k-rd-item-sm k-sc-node" style={{ paddingLeft: 6 + r.depth * 14 }}
            onClick={() => toggle(f.path)} aria-expanded={isOpen}>
            <ChevronDown size={12} className={`k-chevron shrink-0 ${isOpen ? 'k-chevron-open' : ''}`} />
            <SwapInPlace swapKey={isOpen} hold={false} className="k-rd-item-icon">{isOpen ? FOLDER_OPEN : FOLDER}</SwapInPlace>
            <span className="k-rd-item-text truncate">{f.name}</span>
            <span className="k-rd-item-meta">{fmtCount(f.fileCount)}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      );
    }
    const file = r.file as SourceFile;
    return (
      <div className="k-sc-node-wrap">
        {guides}
        <button type="button" className={`k-rd-item k-rd-item-sm k-sc-node${file.path === shownPath ? ' k-rd-item-on' : ''}`}
          style={{ paddingLeft: 26 + r.depth * 14 }} onClick={() => openFile(file.path)} title={file.path}>
          <span className="k-rd-item-icon k-sc-file-icon">{iconOf(file)}</span>
          <span className="k-rd-item-text truncate">{file.name}</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const searching = query.trim() !== '';
  const deferred = useDeferredValue(query);
  const [text, setText] = useState<SearchText | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!searching || text) return;
    let alive = true;
    loadSearchText(project).then(t => { if (alive) setText(t); }).catch(() => {});
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [searching, text, project]);
  const result = useMemo(() => (deferred.trim() ? searchProject(project, text ? text.lower : null, deferred) : null), [project, text, deferred]);
  type Item = { key: string; h: number; hit: SearchHit; line?: number };
  const items = useMemo(() => {
    const out: Item[] = [];
    if (!result) return out;
    for (const hit of result.hits) {
      out.push({ key: 'r:' + hit.file.path, h: fileRow, hit });
      for (let k = 0; k < hit.lines.length; k++) out.push({ key: `l:${hit.file.path}:${hit.lines[k].n}:${k}`, h: lineRow, hit, line: k });
    }
    return out;
  }, [result, fileRow, lineRow]);
  const q = deferred.trim();
  const renderItem = (i: number) => {
    const it = items[i];
    const f = it.hit.file;
    if (it.line === undefined) {
      return (
        <button type="button" className={`k-rd-item k-sc-result${f.path === shownPath ? ' k-rd-item-on' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => openFile(f.path, it.hit.count ? q : '', it.hit.lines[0]?.n ?? null, true)}>
          <span className="k-rd-item-icon k-sc-file-icon">{iconOf(f)}</span>
          <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 flex flex-col">
            <span className="truncate text-[var(--text-primary)]">{f.name}</span>
            <span className="truncate k-sc-result-path">{f.dir || project.name}</span>
          </span>
          <Fade when={it.hit.count > 0}>{() => <span className="k-badge k-sc-count">{it.hit.count >= 999 ? '999+' : fmtCount(it.hit.count)}</span>}</Fade>
        </button>
      );
    }
    const line = it.hit.lines[it.line];
    const shown = text ? lineTextOf(text.text[f.pack], line) : { text: '', col: -1 };
    return (
      <button type="button" className="k-sc-result-line" onClick={() => openFile(f.path, q, line.n, true)}>
        <span className="k-sc-result-ln">{line.n}</span>
        <span className="k-sc-result-text truncate"><Marked text={shown.text} col={shown.col} len={q.length} /></span>
      </button>
    );
  };

  const note = !result ? '' : !text
    ? 'Searching every file...'
    : result.files === 0 ? 'Nothing matched. Try a shorter word.'
    : `${fmtCount(result.matches)} match${result.matches === 1 ? '' : 'es'} in ${fmtCount(result.files)} file${result.files === 1 ? '' : 's'}${result.capped ? ', the first 200 shown' : ''}`;

  const treeList = (
    <VirtualList count={rows.length} rowHeight={treeRow} maxHeight={listH} overscan={400} boxRef={treeBox}
      rowKey={i => rows[i].key} renderRow={renderTreeRow} className="k-sc-vl" />
  );
  const resultsList = (
    <div className="h-full flex flex-col">
      <div className="k-rd-note k-sc-note"><SwapText>{note}</SwapText></div>
      <VirtualList count={items.length} rowHeight={i => items[i].h} maxHeight={Math.max(120, listH - 34)} overscan={300}
        rowKey={i => items[i].key} renderRow={renderItem} className="k-sc-vl" />
    </div>
  );
  const shownFile = page.kind === 'file' ? project.byPath.get(page.path) : undefined;
  let pageEl = (
    <div key="overview" className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
      <OverviewPage project={project} onOpen={path => openFile(path, '', null, true)} />
    </div>
  );
  if (page.kind === 'file' && shownFile) {
    pageEl = (
      <div key={'f:' + page.path} className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col">
        <FilePage project={project} file={shownFile} find={page.find} line={page.line} seq={page.seq} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const scrim = narrow
    ? <div ref={scrimRef} className={`k-sc-scrim${drawerOn ? ' k-sc-scrim-on' : ''}`} onClick={() => setFilesOpen(false)} aria-hidden />
    : null;
  const drawerHead = narrow ? (
    <div className="k-sc-drawer-head">
      <span className="k-group-title">Files</span>
      <IconButton label="Close the file list" onClick={() => setFilesOpen(false)}><X size={18} /></IconButton>
    </div>
  ) : null;

  return (
    <div className={`relative flex flex-1 min-w-0 min-h-0${touch ? ' k-sc-touch' : ''}${narrow ? ' k-sc-narrow' : ''}`}>
      {scrim}
      <nav ref={navRef} id="k-sc-files" className={`k-rd-side k-sc-side${narrow ? ' k-sc-drawer' : ''}${drawerOn ? ' k-sc-drawer-on' : ''}`} aria-label="Files"
        inert={narrow && !drawerOn ? true : undefined}
        onPointerDown={narrow ? onSwipeDown : undefined} onPointerMove={narrow ? onSwipeMove : undefined}
        onPointerUp={narrow ? onSwipeUp : undefined} onPointerCancel={narrow ? onSwipeUp : undefined} onClickCapture={narrow ? onSwipeClick : undefined}>
        {drawerHead}
        <div className="k-rd-search">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search size={15} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--k-search-icon)] pointer-events-none" />
            <input ref={searchRef} type="text" value={query} onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)} spellCheck={false}
              placeholder="Search files and code"
              className="k-text-in k-search-bar w-full h-9 pl-9 pr-16 rounded-lg text-[13px] bg-[var(--k-search-bg)] border border-[var(--alpha-card-border)] shadow-[var(--shadow-input)] text-[var(--text-primary)] placeholder:text-[var(--k-placeholder)] outline-none" />
            <SearchEnd query={query} onClear={() => { setQuery(''); searchRef.current?.focus(); }} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="k-sc-pin">
          <button type="button" className={`k-rd-item k-rd-item-sm${page.kind === 'overview' ? ' k-rd-item-on' : ''}`} onClick={() => { setPage({ kind: 'overview' }); setFilesOpen(false); }}>
            <span className="k-rd-item-icon"><Overview size={14} /></span>
            <span className="k-rd-item-text truncate">Overview</span>
          </button>
        </div>
        <div ref={listHost} className="k-sc-list">
          <SwapInPlace swapKey={searching} hold={false} className="h-full">
            {searching ? resultsList : treeList}
          </SwapInPlace>
        </div>
        <div className="k-rd-foot k-sc-foot">
          <span className="k-badge">{fmtCount(project.root.fileCount)} files</span>
          <span className="k-badge">{fmtShort(project.root.lines)} lines</span>
          <span className="k-badge">{fmtBytes(project.root.bytes)}</span>
        </div>
      </nav>
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 flex flex-col relative" inert={drawerOn ? true : undefined}>
        {filesBar}
        <PageSwap>
          {pageEl}
        </PageSwap>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

interface Group { name: string; files: number; lines: number; chars: number; bytes: number }

const OverviewPage: React.FC<{ project: SourceProject; onOpen: (path: string) => void }> = ({ project, onOpen }) => {
  const r = project.root;
  const facts = useMemo(() => {
    const groups = new Map<string, Group>();
    let codeFiles = 0, codeLines = 0, codeChars = 0, dataFiles = 0, pictures = 0;
    for (const f of project.files) {
      const g = groupOf(f);
      let x = groups.get(g);
      if (!x) groups.set(g, (x = { name: g, files: 0, lines: 0, chars: 0, bytes: 0 }));
      x.files++; x.lines += f.lines; x.chars += f.chars; x.bytes += f.bytes;
      if (f.kind === 'c') { codeFiles++; codeLines += f.lines; codeChars += f.chars; }
      else if (f.kind === 'd') dataFiles++;
      else if (f.kind === 'i') pictures++;
    }
    const byKind = [...groups.values()].sort((a, b) => b.bytes - a.bytes);
    const tops: Group[] = r.folders.map(f => ({ name: f.name, files: f.fileCount, lines: f.lines, chars: f.chars, bytes: f.bytes }));
    if (r.files.length) {
      const t: Group = { name: 'Top files', files: 0, lines: 0, chars: 0, bytes: 0 };
      for (const f of r.files) { t.files++; t.lines += f.lines; t.chars += f.chars; t.bytes += f.bytes; }
      tops.push(t);
    }
    tops.sort((a, b) => b.bytes - a.bytes);
    const largest = project.files.filter(f => f.kind === 'c').sort((a, b) => b.lines - a.lines).slice(0, 8);
    return { byKind, tops, largest, codeFiles, codeLines, codeChars, dataFiles, pictures };
  }, [project, r]);

  const stat = (label: string, value: string, sub: string) => (
    <div className="k-info-card k-sc-stat">
      <span className="k-sc-stat-label">{label}</span>
      <span className="k-sc-stat-value truncate">{value}</span>
      <span className="k-sc-stat-sub truncate">{sub}</span>
    </div>
  );
  const table = (title: string, list: Group[], total: number) => (
    <section className="k-info-card k-sc-table">
      <div className="k-sc-table-head">
        <span className="k-sc-table-title">{title}</span>
        <span className="k-sc-cols"><span>Files</span><span>Lines</span><span>Size</span></span>
      </div>
      {list.map(g => (
        <div key={g.name} className="k-sc-table-row">
          <span className="k-sc-table-name">
            <span className="truncate">{g.name}</span>
            <span className="k-sc-share" aria-hidden><span style={{ transform: `scaleX(${total ? g.bytes / total : 0})` }} /></span>
          </span>
          <span className="k-sc-cols"><span>{fmtCount(g.files)}</span><span>{fmtCount(g.lines)}</span><span>{fmtBytes(g.bytes)}</span></span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </section>
  );

  return (
    <div className="k-sc-page">
        <div className="k-sc-overhead">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="k-rd-path">Source code</div>
            <h1 className="k-rd-title">{project.name}</h1>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="k-sc-stats">
          {stat('Files', fmtCount(r.fileCount), `${fmtCount(facts.codeFiles)} code, ${fmtCount(facts.dataFiles)} data, ${fmtCount(facts.pictures)} pictures`)}
          {stat('Lines', fmtCount(r.lines), `${fmtCount(facts.codeLines)} of them code`)}
          {stat('Characters', fmtCount(r.chars), `${fmtCount(facts.codeChars)} of them code`)}
          {stat('Size', fmtBytes(r.bytes), `${fmtCount(r.bytes)} bytes in ${fmtCount(project.folderCount)} folders`)}
        </div>
        {table('By kind', facts.byKind, r.bytes)}
        {table('By folder', facts.tops, r.bytes)}
        <section className="k-info-card k-sc-table">
          <div className="k-sc-table-head">
            <span className="k-sc-table-title">Longest code files</span>
            <span className="k-sc-cols"><span>Lines</span><span>Characters</span><span>Size</span></span>
          </div>
          {facts.largest.map(f => (
            <button key={f.path} type="button" className="k-sc-table-row k-sc-table-link" onClick={() => onOpen(f.path)}>
              <span className="k-sc-table-name">
                <span className="k-sc-file-icon">{iconOf(f)}</span>
                <span className="truncate">{f.name}</span>
                <span className="truncate k-sc-result-path">{f.dir}</span>
              </span>
              <span className="k-sc-cols"><span>{fmtCount(f.lines)}</span><span>{fmtCount(f.chars)}</span><span>{fmtBytes(f.bytes)}</span></span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </section>
    </div>
  );
}

const FilePage: React.FC<{ project: SourceProject; file: SourceFile; find: string; line: number | null; seq: number }> = ({ project, file, find: findAsked, line, seq }) => {
  const isText = file.kind === 'c' || file.kind === 'd';
  const [text, setText] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isText) return;
    let alive = true;
    loadFileText(project, file).then(t => { if (alive) setText(t); }).catch(() => { if (alive) setFailed(true); });
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [project, file, isText]);

  const [findOpen, setFindOpen] = useState(!!findAsked);
  const [find, setFind] = useState(findAsked);
  const [step, setStep] = useState({ seq: 0, delta: 1 });
  const [found, setFound] = useState({ active: -1, count: 0 });
  const onFind = useCallback((active: number, count: number) => setFound(f => (f.active === active && f.count === count ? f : { active, count })), []);
  const findBox = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [goLine, setGoLine] = useState<{ line: number; seq: number } | null>(line ? { line, seq } : null);
  const lastSeq = useRef(seq);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (seq === lastSeq.current) return;
    lastSeq.current = seq;
    if (findAsked) { setFind(findAsked); setFindOpen(true); }
    if (line) setGoLine({ line, seq });
  }, [seq, findAsked, line]);

  const focusFind = () => window.setTimeout(() => { const el = findBox.current?.querySelector('input'); el?.focus(); el?.select(); }, 0);
  const openFind = useCallback(() => {
    const sel = window.getSelection();
    const picked = sel && !sel.isCollapsed ? sel.toString() : '';
    const inCode = !!sel?.anchorNode?.parentElement?.closest('.k-sc-lines');
    if (inCode && picked && !/[\r\n]/.test(picked) && picked.length <= 200) setFind(picked);
    setFindOpen(true);
    focusFind();
  }, []);
  const closeFind = useCallback(() => { setFindOpen(false); setFind(''); }, []);
  const next = (delta: number) => setStep(s => ({ seq: s.seq + 1, delta }));
  useEscapeOwner(closeFind, findOpen);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isText) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && !e.altKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'f') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); openFind(); }
      else if (e.key === 'F3') { e.preventDefault(); next(e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1); }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
  }, [isText, openFind]);

  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => { if (!copied) return; const t = window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500); return () => window.clearTimeout(t); }, [copied]);
  const copy = () => {
    if (text === null) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => setCopied(true), () => toast('error', 'The text could not be copied'));
  };
  const download = () => {
    if (isText) { if (text !== null) saveBlob(new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain' }), file.name); return; }
    fetch(urlOf(file.src)).then(r => r.blob()).then(b => saveBlob(b, file.name), () => toast('error', 'The file could not be downloaded'));
  };
  const [dims, setDims] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const bodyKind = file.kind === 'i' ? 'picture' : file.kind === 'b' ? 'binary' : failed ? 'failed' : text === null ? 'wait' : 'code';
  let body: React.ReactNode;
  switch (bodyKind) {
    case 'picture':
      body = (
        <div className="k-sc-picture">
          <img src={urlOf(file.src)} alt={file.name} draggable={false}
            onLoad={e => setDims(`${e.currentTarget.naturalWidth} x ${e.currentTarget.naturalHeight}`)} />
        </div>
      );
      break;
    case 'binary':
      body = <div className="h-full grid place-items-center"><EmptyState icon={emptyArt(FilePlain)} title="This file is not text" hint={`${fmtBytes(file.bytes)}. Download it to open it.`} words /></div>;
      break;
    case 'failed':
      body = <div className="h-full grid place-items-center"><EmptyState icon={emptyArt(FilePlain)} title="This file could not be loaded" hint="Close the window and open it again." words /></div>;
      break;
    case 'wait':
      body = (
        <div className="k-skel-delay absolute inset-0 px-6 py-4 flex flex-col gap-2.5" aria-hidden>
          {Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, i) => <div key={i} className="skeleton-shimmer h-3 rounded" style={{ width: `${20 + ((i * 53) % 60)}%`, marginLeft: `${(i % 4) * 16}px` }} />)}
        </div>
      );
      break;
    default:
      body = <CodeView text={text as string} lang={file.lang} find={findOpen ? find : ''} step={step} onFind={onFind} goLine={goLine} />;
  }
  const copyIcon = copied ? ICON_COPIED : ICON_COPY;

  const parts = file.path.split('/');
  return (
    <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col">
      <div className="k-sc-filehead">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="k-rd-path k-sc-crumbs">
            {parts.length > 1 ? parts.slice(0, -1).map((p, i) => (
              <React.Fragment key={i}>{i > 0 && <span className="k-rd-path-sep">/</span>}<span className="truncate">{p}</span></React.Fragment>
            )) : <span>{project.name}</span>}
          </div>
          <div className="k-sc-filename">
            <span className="k-sc-file-icon">{iconOf(file, 16)}</span>
            <h2 className="truncate">{file.name}</h2>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="k-sc-tags">
          <span className="k-badge">{kindName(file)}</span>
          {isText && <span className="k-badge">{fmtCount(file.lines)} lines</span>}
          {isText && <span className="k-badge">{fmtCount(file.chars)} characters</span>}
          <Fade when={dims}>{() => <span className="k-badge">{dims}</span>}</Fade>
          <span className="k-badge">{fmtBytes(file.bytes)}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          {isText && <IconButton label="Find in this file (Ctrl F)" active={findOpen} onClick={() => (findOpen ? focusFind() : openFind())}><Search size={16} /></IconButton>}
          {isText && (
            <IconButton label={copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy the whole file'} onClick={copy} disabled={text === null}>
              <SwapInPlace swapKey={copied} hold={false} className="grid place-items-center">{copyIcon}</SwapInPlace>
            </IconButton>
          )}
          <IconButton label="Download this file" onClick={download} disabled={isText && text === null}><Download size={16} /></IconButton>
        </div>
      </div>
      {isText && (
        <Reveal when={findOpen}>
          <div ref={findBox} className="k-sc-findbar"
            onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); next(e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1); } }}>
            <div className="relative k-sc-findfield">
              <Search size={14} className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--k-search-icon)] pointer-events-none" />
              <input type="text" value={find} onChange={e => setFind(e.target.value)} placeholder="Find in this file" spellCheck={false} autoFocus
                className="k-text-in k-search-bar w-full h-8 pl-8 pr-3 rounded-lg text-[12.5px] bg-[var(--k-search-bg)] border border-[var(--alpha-card-border)] text-[var(--text-primary)] placeholder:text-[var(--k-placeholder)] outline-none" />
            </div>
            <span className="k-sc-findcount">
              {find ? (found.count ? `${fmtCount(found.active + 1)} of ${fmtCount(found.count)}${found.count >= 20000 ? '+' : ''}` : 'No matches') : ''}
            </span>
            <IconButton label="Previous match (Shift Enter)" onClick={() => next(-1)} disabled={!found.count}><ArrowUp size={15} /></IconButton>
            <IconButton label="Next match (Enter)" onClick={() => next(1)} disabled={!found.count}><ArrowDown size={15} /></IconButton>
            <IconButton label="Close Find" onClick={closeFind}><X size={15} /></IconButton>
          </div>
        </Reveal>
      )}
      <SwapInPlace swapKey={bodyKind} hold={false} className="flex-1 min-h-0 relative">{body}</SwapInPlace>
    </div>
  );
}
export type SourceKind = 'c' | 'd' | 'i' | 'b';

export interface SourceFile {
  path: string;
  name: string;
  dir: string;
  kind: SourceKind;
  lang: string;
  bytes: number;
  lines: number;
  chars: number;
  pack: number;
  offset: number;
  length: number;
  src: string;
}

export interface SourceFolder {
  path: string;
  name: string;
  folders: SourceFolder[];
  files: SourceFile[];
  fileCount: number;
  bytes: number;
  lines: number;
  chars: number;
}

export interface SourceProject {
  name: string;
  packs: string[];
  files: SourceFile[];
  root: SourceFolder;
  byPath: Map<string, SourceFile>;
  folders: Map<string, SourceFolder>;
  folderCount: number;
}

const BASE: string = (() => { try { return import.meta.env.BASE_URL || '/'; } catch { return '/'; } })();
export function urlOf(src: string): string { return BASE + src.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/'); }

const byName = (a: string, b: string) => a.localeCompare(b, 'en', { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });

function buildProject(index: { name?: string; packs?: string[]; files?: unknown[] }): SourceProject {
  const root: SourceFolder = { path: '', name: index.name || 'iStrongEngine', folders: [], files: [], fileCount: 0, bytes: 0, lines: 0, chars: 0 };
  const folders = new Map<string, SourceFolder>([['', root]]);
  const files: SourceFile[] = [];
  const byPath = new Map<string, SourceFile>();
  const folderOf = (dir: string): SourceFolder => {
    let f = folders.get(dir);
    if (f) return f;
    const cut = dir.lastIndexOf('/');
    const parent = folderOf(cut < 0 ? '' : dir.slice(0, cut));
    f = { path: dir, name: dir.slice(cut + 1), folders: [], files: [], fileCount: 0, bytes: 0, lines: 0, chars: 0 };
    parent.folders.push(f);
    folders.set(dir, f);
    return f;
  };
  for (const raw of index.files ?? []) {
    const r = raw as (string | number)[];
    const path = String(r[0]);
    const kind = r[1] as SourceKind;
    const cut = path.lastIndexOf('/');
    const dir = cut < 0 ? '' : path.slice(0, cut);
    const file: SourceFile = {
      path, name: path.slice(cut + 1), dir, kind, lang: String(r[2]),
      bytes: Number(r[3]) || 0, lines: Number(r[4]) || 0, chars: Number(r[5]) || 0,
      pack: kind === 'c' ? Number(r[6]) : -1, offset: kind === 'c' ? Number(r[7]) : 0, length: kind === 'c' ? Number(r[8]) : 0,
      src: kind === 'd' ? 'data/' + path.slice('Data/'.length) : kind === 'c' ? '' : String(r[6]),
    };
    files.push(file);
    byPath.set(path, file);
    folderOf(dir).files.push(file);
  }
  const total = (f: SourceFolder) => {
    f.folders.sort((a, b) => byName(a.name, b.name));
    f.files.sort((a, b) => byName(a.name, b.name));
    let n = f.files.length, bytes = 0, lines = 0, chars = 0;
    for (const x of f.files) { bytes += x.bytes; lines += x.lines; chars += x.chars; }
    for (const s of f.folders) { total(s); n += s.fileCount; bytes += s.bytes; lines += s.lines; chars += s.chars; }
    f.fileCount = n; f.bytes = bytes; f.lines = lines; f.chars = chars;
  };
  total(root);
  return { name: root.name, packs: index.packs ?? [], files, root, byPath, folders, folderCount: folders.size - 1 };
}

let projectLoad: Promise<SourceProject> | null = null;
export function loadSourceProject(): Promise<SourceProject> {
  if (!projectLoad) {
    projectLoad = fetch(BASE + 'source-code/index.json', { cache: 'no-store' })
      .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('no source index'); return r.json(); })
      .then(buildProject);
    projectLoad.catch(() => { projectLoad = null; });
  }
  return projectLoad;
}

const packs = new Map<number, Promise<string>>();
function loadPack(project: SourceProject, i: number): Promise<string> {
  let p = packs.get(i);
  if (!p) {
    p = fetch(BASE + project.packs[i]).then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('pack'); return r.text(); });
    p.catch(() => packs.delete(i));
    packs.set(i, p);
  }
  return p;
}

const dataTexts = new Map<string, Promise<string>>();
export function loadFileText(project: SourceProject, file: SourceFile): Promise<string> {
  if (file.kind === 'c') return loadPack(project, file.pack).then(t => t.slice(file.offset, file.offset + file.length));
  let p = dataTexts.get(file.path);
  if (!p) {
    p = fetch(urlOf(file.src)).then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('file'); return r.text(); });
    p.catch(() => dataTexts.delete(file.path));
    dataTexts.set(file.path, p);
  }
  return p;
}

export interface SearchText { text: string[]; lower: string[] }
let searchText: Promise<SearchText> | null = null;
export function loadSearchText(project: SourceProject): Promise<SearchText> {
  if (!searchText) {
    searchText = Promise.all(project.packs.map((_, i) => loadPack(project, i))).then(text => ({ text, lower: text.map(t => t.toLowerCase()) }));
    searchText.catch(() => { searchText = null; });
  }
  return searchText;
}
export function baseHref(): string { return new URL(BASE, location.href).href; }

export interface TreeRow { key: string; depth: number; folder?: SourceFolder; file?: SourceFile }

export function visibleRows(root: SourceFolder, open: ReadonlySet<string>): TreeRow[] {
  const rows: TreeRow[] = [];
  const walk = (f: SourceFolder, depth: number) => {
    for (const s of f.folders) {
      rows.push({ key: 'd:' + s.path, depth, folder: s });
      if (open.has(s.path)) walk(s, depth + 1);
    }
    for (const x of f.files) rows.push({ key: 'f:' + x.path, depth, file: x });
  };
  walk(root, 0);
  return rows;
}

export function foldersOf(path: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  let at = path.indexOf('/');
  while (at > 0) { out.push(path.slice(0, at)); at = path.indexOf('/', at + 1); }
  return out;
}

export interface SearchLine { n: number; col: number; s: number; e: number }
export interface SearchHit { file: SourceFile; named: boolean; count: number; lines: SearchLine[] }
export interface SearchResult { hits: SearchHit[]; files: number; matches: number; capped: boolean }

const MAX_FILES = 200;
const MAX_LINES = 3;
const MAX_COUNT = 999;

const packFiles = new WeakMap<SourceProject, SourceFile[][]>();
function filesByPack(project: SourceProject): SourceFile[][] {
  let list = packFiles.get(project);
  if (!list) {
    list = project.packs.map(() => [] as SourceFile[]);
    for (const f of project.files) if (f.kind === 'c' && list[f.pack]) list[f.pack].push(f);
    for (const l of list) l.sort((a, b) => a.offset - b.offset);
    packFiles.set(project, list);
  }
  return list;
}

export function searchProject(project: SourceProject, lower: string[] | null, query: string): SearchResult {
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const hits: SearchHit[] = [];
  let matches = 0;
  if (!q) return { hits, files: 0, matches: 0, capped: false };
  const found = new Map<SourceFile, { count: number; lines: SearchLine[] }>();
  if (lower) {
    const byPack = filesByPack(project);
    for (let p = 0; p < lower.length; p++) {
      const hay = lower[p];
      const files = byPack[p] ?? [];
      let fi = 0, from = 0;
      let lineFile: SourceFile | null = null, line = 1, scanned = 0;
      for (;;) {
        const at = hay.indexOf(q, from);
        if (at < 0) break;
        from = at + q.length;
        while (fi < files.length && files[fi].offset + files[fi].length <= at) fi++;
        if (fi >= files.length) break;
        const f = files[fi];
        const end = f.offset + f.length;
        if (at < f.offset || at + q.length > end) continue;
        let e = found.get(f);
        if (!e) found.set(f, (e = { count: 0, lines: [] }));
        if (e.count >= MAX_COUNT) continue;
        e.count++;
        if (e.lines.length >= MAX_LINES) continue;
        if (lineFile !== f) { lineFile = f; line = 1; scanned = f.offset; }
        for (let i = scanned; i < at; i++) if (hay.charCodeAt(i) === 10) line++;
        scanned = at;
        const s = Math.max(hay.lastIndexOf('\n', at - 1) + 1, f.offset);
        let le = hay.indexOf('\n', at);
        if (le < 0 || le > end) le = end;
        e.lines.push({ n: line, col: at - s, s, e: le });
      }
    }
  }
  for (const file of project.files) {
    const named = file.path.toLowerCase().includes(q);
    const e = found.get(file);
    if (!named && !e) continue;
    const count = e ? e.count : 0;
    matches += count;
    hits.push({ file, named, count, lines: e ? e.lines : [] });
  }
  hits.sort((a, b) => (a.named === b.named ? b.count - a.count || byName(a.file.path, b.file.path) : a.named ? -1 : 1));
  const capped = hits.length > MAX_FILES;
  return { hits: capped ? hits.slice(0, MAX_FILES) : hits, files: hits.length, matches, capped };
}

export function lineTextOf(packText: string, line: SearchLine): { text: string; col: number } {
  const raw = packText.slice(line.s, line.e).replace(/\r$/, '');
  const lead = raw.length - raw.trimStart().length;
  let text = raw.trim();
  let col = Math.max(0, line.col - lead);
  if (col > 40) { text = '...' + text.slice(col - 30); col = 33; }
  return { text: text.slice(0, 200), col };
}

const LANG_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
  ts: 'TypeScript', tsx: 'TypeScript JSX', js: 'JavaScript', json: 'JSON', css: 'CSS', html: 'HTML', md: 'Markdown', text: 'Text',
};
export function kindName(f: SourceFile): string {
  if (f.kind === 'i') return f.lang.toUpperCase() + ' picture';
  if (f.kind === 'b') return f.lang ? f.lang.toUpperCase() + ' file' : 'File';
  const ext = f.name.slice(f.name.lastIndexOf('.') + 1).toLowerCase();
  if (ext === 'svg') return 'SVG';
  return LANG_NAMES[f.lang] ?? 'Text';
}

export function groupOf(f: SourceFile): string {
  if (f.kind === 'd') return 'Game data';
  if (f.kind === 'i') return 'Pictures';
  if (f.kind === 'b') return 'Other files';
  return LANG_NAMES[f.lang] ?? 'Text';
}

const NUM = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US');
export function fmtCount(n: number): string { return NUM.format(n); }
export function fmtBytes(n: number): string {
  if (n < 1024) return `${n} B`;
  if (n < 1024 * 1024) return `${(n / 1024).toFixed(n < 10 * 1024 ? 1 : 0)} KB`;
  if (n < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return `${(n / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
  return `${(n / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} GB`;
}
export function fmtShort(n: number): string {
  if (n < 10_000) return NUM.format(n);
  if (n < 1_000_000) return `${Math.round(n / 1000)}K`;
  if (n < 1_000_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(n < 10_000_000 ? 2 : 1)}M`;
  return `${(n / 1_000_000_000).toFixed(2)}B`;
}
interface ZipFile { path: string; kind: 'c' | 'd' | 'i' | 'b'; src: string; pack: number; offset: number; length: number }
interface Job { base: string; name: string; packs: string[]; files: ZipFile[] }

const CRC = (() => {
  const t = new Uint32Array(256);
  for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
    let c = n;
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? 0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1) : c >>> 1;
    t[n] = c >>> 0;
  }
  return t;
})();
function crc32(b: Uint8Array): number {
  let c = 0xffffffff;
  for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) c = CRC[(c ^ b[i]) & 0xff] ^ (c >>> 8);
  return (c ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0;
}

const canDeflate = typeof CompressionStream !== 'undefined';
async function deflate(b: Uint8Array): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const stream = new Blob([b]).stream().pipeThrough(new CompressionStream('deflate-raw'));
  return new Uint8Array(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer());
}

const url = (base: string, src: string) => base + src.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/');
async function fetchBytes(u: string): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const r = await fetch(u);
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`${r.status} ${u}`);
  return new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer());
}

function dosTime(d: Date): { time: number; date: number } {
  return {
    time: (d.getHours() << 11) | (d.getMinutes() << 5) | (d.getSeconds() >> 1),
    date: ((d.getFullYear() - 1980) << 9) | ((d.getMonth() + 1) << 5) | d.getDate(),
  };
}

self.onmessage = async (e: MessageEvent<Job>) => {
  const job = e.data;
  const post = (m: unknown) => (self as unknown as Worker).postMessage(m);
  try {
    const enc = new TextEncoder();
    const packs: (string | null)[] = job.packs.map(() => null);
    const packOf = async (i: number) => {
      if (packs[i] === null) { const r = await fetch(job.base + job.packs[i]); if (!r.ok) throw new Error('pack'); packs[i] = await r.text(); }
      return packs[i] as string;
    };
    const bytesOf = async (f: ZipFile): Promise<Uint8Array> => {
      if (f.kind === 'c') { const t = await packOf(f.pack); return enc.encode(t.slice(f.offset, f.offset + f.length)); }
      return fetchBytes(url(job.base, f.src));
    };

    const { time, date } = dosTime(new Date());
    const parts: Uint8Array[] = [];
    const central: Uint8Array[] = [];
    let offset = 0;
    const total = job.files.length;
    const ahead: Promise<Uint8Array>[] = [];
    const AHEAD = 12;
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(AHEAD, total); i++) ahead.push(bytesOf(job.files[i]));
    let lastTold = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
      const f = job.files[i];
      const data = await ahead[i];
      if (i + AHEAD < total) ahead.push(bytesOf(job.files[i + AHEAD]));
      (ahead as (Promise<Uint8Array> | undefined)[])[i] = undefined;
      const crc = crc32(data);
      const store = !canDeflate || f.kind === 'i' || data.length < 64;
      const body = store ? data : await deflate(data);
      const method = store ? 0 : 8;
      const name = enc.encode(job.name + '/' + f.path);

      const local = new Uint8Array(30 + name.length);
      const lv = new DataView(local.buffer);
      lv.setUint32(0, 0x04034b50, true); lv.setUint16(4, 20, true); lv.setUint16(6, 0x0800, true); lv.setUint16(8, method, true);
      lv.setUint16(10, time, true); lv.setUint16(12, date, true); lv.setUint32(14, crc, true);
      lv.setUint32(18, body.length, true); lv.setUint32(22, data.length, true); lv.setUint16(26, name.length, true); lv.setUint16(28, 0, true);
      local.set(name, 30);

      const cen = new Uint8Array(46 + name.length);
      const cv = new DataView(cen.buffer);
      cv.setUint32(0, 0x02014b50, true); cv.setUint16(4, 20, true); cv.setUint16(6, 20, true); cv.setUint16(8, 0x0800, true);
      cv.setUint16(10, method, true); cv.setUint16(12, time, true); cv.setUint16(14, date, true); cv.setUint32(16, crc, true);
      cv.setUint32(20, body.length, true); cv.setUint32(24, data.length, true); cv.setUint16(28, name.length, true);
      cv.setUint32(42, offset, true);
      cen.set(name, 46);

      parts.push(local, body);
      central.push(cen);
      offset += local.length + body.length;
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastTold > 100 || i === total - 1) { post({ type: 'progress', done: i + 1, total }); lastTold = now; }
    }
    let cenSize = 0;
    for (const c of central) cenSize += c.length;
    const end = new Uint8Array(22);
    const ev = new DataView(end.buffer);
    ev.setUint32(0, 0x06054b50, true); ev.setUint16(8, total, true); ev.setUint16(10, total, true);
    ev.setUint32(12, cenSize, true); ev.setUint32(16, offset, true);
    const blob = new Blob([...parts, ...central, end] as BlobPart[], { type: 'application/zip' });
    post({ type: 'done', blob });
  } catch (err) {
    post({ type: 'error', message: String((err as Error)?.message ?? err) });
  }
};

export interface IconProps extends Omit<React.SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  size?: number | string;
  strokeWidth?: number;
  absoluteStrokeWidth?: boolean;
}
export type AppIcon = React.ForwardRefExoticComponent<IconProps & React.RefAttributes<SVGSVGElement>>;
export type LucideIcon = AppIcon;

const STROKE = 1.5;
const MIN_REAL_STROKE = 1.25;

function make(icon: IconSvgElement, cls: string): AppIcon {
  const C = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
    { size = 24, strokeWidth, absoluteStrokeWidth = false, className, style, ...rest }, ref,
  ) {
    const px = typeof size === 'number' ? size : parseFloat(size) || 24;
    const sw = strokeWidth ?? (absoluteStrokeWidth ? STROKE : Math.max(STROKE, (MIN_REAL_STROKE * 24) / px));
    return (
      <HugeiconsIcon
        ref={ref}
        icon={icon}
        size={size}
        strokeWidth={sw}
        absoluteStrokeWidth={absoluteStrokeWidth}
        className={className ? `k-svg ${cls} ${className}` : `k-svg ${cls}`}
        style={{ ['--k-ico' as string]: px, ...style } as React.CSSProperties}
        {...rest}
      />
    );
  });
  C.displayName = cls;
  return C;
}

import React, { createContext, useContext } from 'react';

const ScrollAreaCtx = createContext(false);

interface ScrollAreaProps {
  className?: string;
  contentClassName?: string;
  overlay?: React.ReactNode;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export const ScrollArea: React.FC<ScrollAreaProps> = ({
  className = '',
  contentClassName = '',
  overlay,
  children,
}) => {
  const nested = useContext(ScrollAreaCtx);

  if (nested) {
    return <div className={`min-h-0 ${contentClassName} ${className}`}>{children}</div>;
  }

  return (
    <ScrollAreaCtx.Provider value={true}>
      <div className={`relative flex flex-col min-h-0 h-full ${className}`}>
        {overlay}
        <div className={`flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto tool-scrollbar ${contentClassName}`}>
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>
    </ScrollAreaCtx.Provider>
  );
};
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useLayoutEffect, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { ToastDone, XCircle, Info, Lightbulb, X } from './icons';
import { useChromeScale, useZoomCompensation, UI_SCALE } from '../../utils/useMenuScale';
import { getCumulativeZoom } from '../../utils/zoomCompensation';
import { MotionList } from '../kit/Collapse';

type ToastVariant = 'success' | 'error' | 'info';
type ToastKind = ToastVariant | 'tip';

export interface ToastAction { label: string; run: () => void }

interface ToastItem {
  id: number;
  kind: ToastKind;
  message: string;
  action?: ToastAction;
  onHide?: () => void;
}

interface ToastContextValue {
  showToast: (variant: ToastVariant, message: string, action?: ToastAction) => void;
}

const ToastContext = createContext<ToastContextValue | null>(null);

let _showToast: ToastContextValue['showToast'] | null = null;
export function toast(variant: ToastVariant, message: string, action?: ToastAction): void { _showToast?.(variant, message, action); }
const ACTION_MS = 6000;
const MESSAGE_MS = 3000;

let _tipApi: { show: (text: string, life: number, onHide: () => void) => void; clear: () => void } | null = null;
export function showTipToast(text: string, life: number, onHide: () => void): void { _tipApi?.show(text, life, onHide); }
export function clearTipToasts(): void { _tipApi?.clear(); }

export interface ToastArea { left: number; right: number; gap: number }
let _area: ToastArea | null = null;
const _areaSubs = new Set<() => void>();
export function setToastArea(a: ToastArea | null): void {
  if (a === _area || (a && _area && a.left === _area.left && a.right === _area.right && a.gap === _area.gap)) return;
  _area = a;
  _areaSubs.forEach(f => f());
}
const areaSub = (f: () => void) => { _areaSubs.add(f); return () => { _areaSubs.delete(f); }; };
const areaNow = () => _area;
const COVER_SEL = '[role="dialog"], [aria-modal="true"], .k-backdrop, .modal-scrim';
function coveredNow(): boolean {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return false;
  const list = document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(COVER_SEL);
  for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) if (list[i].isConnected && list[i].getClientRects().length > 0) return true;
  return false;
}
const WINDOW_GAP = Math.round(24 / UI_SCALE);

export function useToast(): ToastContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useToast must be used inside ToastProvider');
  return ctx;
}

export const ToastProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<ToastItem[]>([]);
  const [covered, setCovered] = useState(false);
  const idCounter = useRef(0);
  const zoomComp = useZoomCompensation();
  const chromeScale = useChromeScale();
  const toastScale = zoomComp * chromeScale;
  const area = useSyncExternalStore(areaSub, areaNow, areaNow);

  const add = useCallback((item: Omit<ToastItem, 'id'>, life: number, replaceKind?: ToastKind) => {
    const id = ++idCounter.current;
    setCovered(coveredNow());
    setToasts(prev => [...(replaceKind ? prev.filter(t => t.kind !== replaceKind) : prev), { id, ...item }]);
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      setToasts(prev => prev.filter(t => t.id !== id));
    }, life);
  }, []);
  const showToast = useCallback((variant: ToastVariant, message: string, action?: ToastAction) => {
    add({ kind: variant, message, action }, action ? ACTION_MS : MESSAGE_MS);
  }, [add]);
  _showToast = showToast;
  _tipApi = {
    show: (text, life, onHide) => add({ kind: 'tip', message: text, onHide }, life, 'tip'),
    clear: () => setToasts(prev => prev.filter(t => t.kind !== 'tip')),
  };
  const pressed = useCallback((t: ToastItem) => {
    setToasts(prev => prev.filter(x => x.id !== t.id));
    t.action?.run();
  }, []);
  const hidden = useCallback((t: ToastItem) => {
    t.onHide?.();
    setToasts(prev => prev.filter(x => x.id !== t.id));
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo(() => ({ showToast }), [showToast]);

  const ui = zoomComp * chromeScale;
  const onCanvas = !!area && !covered;
  const left = onCanvas ? area.left * ui : 0, right = onCanvas ? area.right * ui : 0;
  const gap = onCanvas ? area.gap : WINDOW_GAP;

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
      {createPortal(
        <div className="fixed bottom-0 z-[99999] flex justify-center pointer-events-none" style={{ left, right }} role="status" aria-live="polite">
          <div style={{ marginBottom: gap, ...(toastScale !== 1 ? { zoom: toastScale } : null) }}>
          <MotionList gap={8}>
          {toasts.map(t => (
            <div key={t.id} className="flex justify-center">
              <ToastCard t={t} roomW={() => window.innerWidth - left - right} onPress={pressed} onHide={hidden} />
            </div>
          ))}
          </MotionList>
          </div>
        </div>,
        document.body
      )}
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
};

const ToastCard: React.FC<{ t: ToastItem; roomW: () => number; onPress: (t: ToastItem) => void; onHide: (t: ToastItem) => void }> = ({ t, roomW, onPress, onHide }) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [fit, setFit] = useState(1);
  const roomRef = useRef(roomW);
  roomRef.current = roomW;
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const compute = () => {
      const el = ref.current;
      if (!el) return;
      const w = el.offsetWidth * (getCumulativeZoom(el) || 1);
      const avail = roomRef.current() * 0.94;
      const s = w > avail ? avail / w : 1;
      setFit(prev => (Math.abs(prev - s) < 0.01 ? prev : s));
    };
    compute();
    window.addEventListener('resize', compute);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', compute);
  }, [t.message]);
  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className={`k-toast${t.kind === 'tip' ? ' k-toast-tip' : ''} flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap pointer-events-auto select-none`}
      style={fit !== 1 ? { transform: `scale(${fit})`, transformOrigin: 'center bottom' } : undefined}
    >
      {t.kind === 'success' ? <ToastDone size={16} absoluteStrokeWidth className="shrink-0" />
        : t.kind === 'info' ? <Info size={16} absoluteStrokeWidth className="shrink-0" />
        : t.kind === 'tip' ? <Lightbulb size={16} absoluteStrokeWidth className="shrink-0" aria-hidden />
        : <XCircle size={16} absoluteStrokeWidth className="shrink-0" />}
      <span className="k-toast-text">{t.message}</span>
      {t.action && (
        <button type="button" className="k-btn k-btn-ghost k-btn-sm k-toast-action" onClick={() => onPress(t)}>{t.action.label}</button>
      )}
      {t.kind === 'tip' && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onHide(t)}
          title="Hide this tip"
          aria-label="Hide tip"
          className="k-ico grid h-6 w-6 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-md opacity-60 transition-[opacity,background-color] hover:opacity-100 hover:bg-[var(--k-icon-hover)] active:scale-[0.94]"
        >
          <X size={13} />
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export type UpgradeStat = string;
export const AC_RAINBOW_STOPS: readonly number[] = Object.freeze([0xFF1000, 0xFF9000, 0xFFD300, 0x00E00B, 0x226EF6, 0xA913CF]);
export const AC_TRANS_BLUE = 0x55CDFC;
export const AC_TRANS_PINK = 0xF7A8B8;
export const AC_WHITE = 0xFFFFFF;

export const AC_CODE = Object.freeze({
  FLASH_BLUE_RED: 20, FLASH_BLUE_GREY: 21, FLASH_GREY_BLUE: 22, FLASH_RED_GREY: 23, FLASH_GREY_RED: 24,
  RAINBOW: 36, TRANS: 37,
} as const);

export const AC_FLASH_SLOTS: readonly (readonly [number, number])[] = Object.freeze([
  Object.freeze([10, 12] as const), Object.freeze([10, 16] as const), Object.freeze([16, 10] as const),
  Object.freeze([12, 16] as const), Object.freeze([16, 12] as const),
]);
export const AC_FLASH_PERIOD_S = 0.3;
export const AC_FLASH_FIRST_S = 0.15;
export const AC_RAINBOW_TURNS_PER_S = 0.5;

export function acLerpK(a: number, b: number, k: number): number {
  const j = 256 - k;
  return (((((b >> 16) & 255) * k + ((a >> 16) & 255) * j) >> 8) << 16)
    | (((((b >> 8) & 255) * k + ((a >> 8) & 255) * j) >> 8) << 8)
    | (((b & 255) * k + (a & 255) * j) >> 8);
}

export function acLerpW(a: number, b: number, w: number): number {
  if (w >= 1) return b;
  if (!(w > 0)) return a;
  return acLerpK(a, b, Math.trunc(w * 256));
}

const _STEPS = 257;
const _HEX2: string[] = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) _HEX2.push((i < 16 ? '0' : '') + i.toString(16));
const _hexOf = (c: number): string => '#' + _HEX2[(c >> 16) & 255] + _HEX2[(c >> 8) & 255] + _HEX2[c & 255];

const _RAINBOW_RGB = new Int32Array(6 * _STEPS);
const _RAINBOW_HEX: string[] = [];
for (let seg = 0; seg < 6; seg++) {
  const A = AC_RAINBOW_STOPS[seg], B = AC_RAINBOW_STOPS[(seg + 1) % 6];
  for (let k = 0; k < _STEPS; k++) {
    const c = k === 256 ? B : acLerpK(A, B, k);
    _RAINBOW_RGB[seg * _STEPS + k] = c;
    _RAINBOW_HEX.push(_hexOf(c));
  }
}
const _TRANS_RGB = new Int32Array(2 * _STEPS);
const _TRANS_HEX: string[] = [];
for (let half = 0; half < 2; half++) {
  const col = half === 0 ? AC_TRANS_BLUE : AC_TRANS_PINK;
  for (let k = 0; k < _STEPS; k++) {
    const c = k === 256 ? col : acLerpK(AC_WHITE, col, k);
    _TRANS_RGB[half * _STEPS + k] = c;
    _TRANS_HEX.push(_hexOf(c));
  }
}

function _rainbowIndex(p: number): number {
  const x = p * 6;
  const m = x % 6;
  const seg = m >= 0 ? Math.trunc(m) : 0;
  const frac = x - Math.trunc(x);
  const k = frac >= 1 ? 256 : frac > 0 ? Math.trunc(frac * 256) : 0;
  return seg * _STEPS + k;
}

function _transIndex(t: number): number {
  const h = t * 0.5;
  const f = Math.sin((h - Math.trunc(h)) * Math.PI) * 5 + -2;
  const half = (t + Math.trunc(t / 4) * -4) < 2 ? 0 : 1;
  const k = f >= 1 ? 256 : f > 0 ? Math.trunc(f * 256) : 0;
  return half * _STEPS + k;
}

export function acRainbow(p: number): number { return _RAINBOW_RGB[_rainbowIndex(p)]; }

export function acTrans(t: number): number { return _TRANS_RGB[_transIndex(t)]; }

export function acFlashFirst(t: number): boolean { return (t % AC_FLASH_PERIOD_S) < AC_FLASH_FIRST_S; }

export function acCodeRgb(code: number, t: number, palette: readonly number[]): number | undefined {
  if (code === AC_CODE.RAINBOW) return acRainbow(t * AC_RAINBOW_TURNS_PER_S);
  if (code === AC_CODE.TRANS) return acTrans(t);
  if (code >= 20 && code <= 24) { const pair = AC_FLASH_SLOTS[code - 20]; return palette[acFlashFirst(t) ? pair[0] : pair[1]]; }
  return undefined;
}

export function acMix(a: number, b: number, w255: number): number { return acLerpW(a, b, w255 / 255); }

const _CLOCK_WRAP_MS = 60000;
export const AC_UI = 0;
export const AC_WORLD = 1;
const _rainbowAt = [0, 0];
const _transAt = [0, 0];
const _flashFirst = [true, true];

export function acClockSeconds(nowMs: number): number { return (nowMs % _CLOCK_WRAP_MS) / 1000; }

export function acTick(nowMs: number, clock: number = AC_UI): void {
  const t = acClockSeconds(nowMs);
  _rainbowAt[clock] = _rainbowIndex(t * AC_RAINBOW_TURNS_PER_S);
  _transAt[clock] = _transIndex(t);
  _flashFirst[clock] = acFlashFirst(t);
}

export function acRainbowHex(clock: number = AC_UI): string { return _RAINBOW_HEX[_rainbowAt[clock]]; }
export function acTransHex(clock: number = AC_UI): string { return _TRANS_HEX[_transAt[clock]]; }
export function acFlashIsFirst(clock: number = AC_UI): boolean { return _flashFirst[clock]; }

export const CM_RGB_BASE = 0x1000000;
export function cmRgbLive(hex: unknown): number {
  return typeof hex === 'string' && /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(hex) ? CM_RGB_BASE + parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16) : -1;
}

export function cmMapOf(v: unknown): number | undefined {
  return typeof v === 'number' && (v === CM_FREE || (v >= 0 && v < CM_COUNT && Math.floor(v) === v)) ? v : undefined;
}

const _HEX6 = /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/;

export function cmTurretColorSafe(t: any): void {
  if (t.colorMap === undefined) return;
  const m = cmMapOf(t.colorMap);
  if (m === undefined || (m < 0 && !(typeof t.color === 'string' && _HEX6.test(t.color)))) {
    delete t.color; delete t.colorMap; delete t.colorFree;
    return;
  }
  if (m >= 0 && t.color !== CM_ARRAS_LIGHT[m]) t.color = CM_ARRAS_LIGHT[m];
  if (t.colorFree !== undefined && !(m >= 0 && typeof t.colorFree === 'string' && _HEX6.test(t.colorFree))) delete t.colorFree;
}

export type CmRgb = readonly [number, number, number];

function rgbOf(hex: string): CmRgb {
  const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
  return Object.freeze<[number, number, number]>([(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255]);
}

function hisDark(use: number): readonly string[] {
  const d = CM_ARRAS_DARK.slice();
  d[CM.BORDERS] = CM_BORDER_DARK;
  if (use !== CM_USE.GENERAL) d[CM.EGGS] = CM_ARRAS_LIGHT[CM.EGGS];
  return Object.freeze(d);
}

  Object.freeze([CM_ARRAS_LIGHT, hisDark(CM_USE.GENERAL)]),
  Object.freeze([CM_ARRAS_LIGHT, hisDark(CM_USE.SHAPE)]),
  Object.freeze([CM_ARRAS_LIGHT, hisDark(CM_USE.TANK)]),
]);

  Object.freeze(_HEX.map(modes => Object.freeze(modes.map(t => Object.freeze(t.map(rgbOf))))));

const _BORDER_RGB_DARK = rgbOf(CM_BORDER_DARK);

export const PHONE_SHORT_SIDE_MAX = 600;

let _coarse: MediaQueryList | null | undefined;
function coarsePointer(): boolean {
  if (_coarse === undefined) {
    try { _coarse = window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)'); } catch { _coarse = null; }
  }
  return !!_coarse && _coarse.matches;
}

export function isTouchScreen(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || MOBILE_UI === 0) return false;
  if (coarsePointer()) return true;
  return isPhoneDevice();
}

export function isPhoneUi(): boolean {
  return MOBILE_UI !== 0 && isPhoneDevice();
}

export function isPhoneDevice(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  let touch = coarsePointer();
  if (!touch && typeof navigator !== 'undefined') touch = (navigator.maxTouchPoints || 0) > 0;
  const s = window.screen;
  const shortSide = s ? Math.min(s.width, s.height) : Infinity;
  return touch && shortSide < PHONE_SHORT_SIDE_MAX;
}
