const KEY = 'istrong-game-theme';

const _tg = globalThis as { __ISTRONG_OLD_THEME_SYNC?: unknown; process?: { env?: Record<string, string | undefined> } };
export const THEME_SYNC_LOCKED: boolean = !(_tg.__ISTRONG_OLD_THEME_SYNC === 1 || _tg.process?.env?.ISTRONG_OLD_THEME_SYNC === '1');

let _pick: GameThemeId = 'light';
let _sync = true;
let _blend: number | null = null;
let _idNow: GameThemeId = 'light';
let _darkNow = false;
let _blendNow = CM_BORDER_BLEND_LIGHT;
let _version = 0;
const _subs = new Set<() => void>();

function uiDark(): boolean {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return false;
  const cl = document.documentElement?.classList;
  return !!cl && typeof cl.contains === 'function' && cl.contains('dark');
}
function idNow(): GameThemeId {
  return _sync ? (uiDark() ? 'dark' : 'light') : _pick;
}
export function themeOwnBlend(id: GameThemeId): number {
  return id === 'dark' ? CM_BORDER_BLEND_DARK : CM_BORDER_BLEND_LIGHT;
}

function save(): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify({ pick: _pick, sync: _sync, blend: _blend, blendOf: _idNow }));
  } catch { }
}

(function load(): void {
  let blendOf: unknown = null;
  try {
    const raw = typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem(KEY) : null;
    if (raw) {
      const o = JSON.parse(raw) as { pick?: unknown; sync?: unknown; blend?: unknown; blendOf?: unknown };
      if (o.pick === 'light' || o.pick === 'dark') _pick = o.pick;
      if (typeof o.sync === 'boolean' && !THEME_SYNC_LOCKED) _sync = o.sync;
      if (typeof o.blend === 'number' && o.blend >= 0 && o.blend <= 1) _blend = o.blend;
      blendOf = o.blendOf;
    }
  } catch { }
  _idNow = idNow();
  if (blendOf !== _idNow) _blend = null;
  _darkNow = _idNow === 'dark';
  _blendNow = _blend !== null ? _blend : themeOwnBlend(_idNow);
  writeHudTokens(_darkNow);
})();

function writeHudTokens(dark: boolean): void {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  const st = document.documentElement?.style;
  if (!st || typeof st.setProperty !== 'function') return;
  const G = CM_USE.GENERAL;
  const ink = cmRgb(CM.BORDERS, dark, G);
  st.setProperty('--ig-stroke', cmHex(CM.BORDERS, dark, G));
  st.setProperty('--ig-text', cmHex(CM.TEXT, dark, G));
  st.setProperty('--ig-empty', cmHex(CM.BARRELS, dark, G));
  st.setProperty('--ig-pill-bg', `rgba(${ink[0]}, ${ink[1]}, ${ink[2]}, 0.5)`);
  st.setProperty('--ig-kills', cmHex(CM.BLUE, dark, G));
}

function changed(): void {
  const id = idNow();
  if (id !== _idNow) { _idNow = id; _blend = null; }
  const dark = id === 'dark';
  const blend = _blend !== null ? _blend : themeOwnBlend(id);
  save();
  setGameDarkMode(dark);
  if (dark === _darkNow && blend === _blendNow) return;
  if (dark !== _darkNow) writeHudTokens(dark);
  _darkNow = dark; _blendNow = blend;
  _version++;
  _subs.forEach(fn => fn());
}

  _sync = on;
  changed();
}

  _subs.forEach(fn => fn());
}

export function hudEase(a: number, t: number): number {
  if (a <= 1) { const q = Math.pow(a, 0.2) - t; return q > 0 ? Math.pow(q, 5) : 0; }
  const l = Math.log(a);
  const e = l + (t * -5);
  if (e >= 0) return Math.exp(e);
  const q = ((l / 5) + 1) - t;
  return q > 0 ? Math.pow(q, 5) : 0;
}

function signum(x: number): number {
  return x !== x ? NaN : (x > 0 || Object.is(x, 0)) ? 1 : -1;
}

export function roundHalfAway(x: number): number {
  const r = Math.trunc(x);
  return Math.abs(x - r) >= 0.5 ? r + Math.sign(x) : r;
}

export interface HudEaseRecord { stampUs: number; x: number; T: number; }

export function hudEaseStep(rec: HudEaseRecord, S: number, clockUs: number): number {
  const m = clockUs > 1 ? clockUs : 1;
  const t = (m > rec.stampUs ? m - rec.stampUs : 0) / 1000000 / 0.7;
  const d = rec.x - rec.T;
  const x2 = rec.T + (signum(d) * hudEase(Math.abs(d), t));
  rec.stampUs = m;
  rec.x = x2;
  rec.T = S;
  const d2 = x2 - S;
  return (signum(d2) * hudEase(Math.abs(d2), 0)) + S;
}

export function hudXpAdvance(rec: HudEaseRecord, S: number, clockUs: number, easeDrops = false): number {
  if ((!(S >= rec.T) && !(easeDrops && S === S)) || rec.x !== rec.x) { rec.x = S; rec.T = S; }
  return hudEaseStep(rec, S, clockUs);
}

export function hudLevelFloor(s: number, coeff: number): number {
  return Math.floor(Math.cbrt(s / coeff));
}

export function hudXpFill(s: number, F: number, coeff: number): number {
  const a = ((F + 1) * ((F + 1) * (F + 1))) * coeff;
  const b = (F * (F * F)) * coeff;
  return (s - b) / (a - b);
}

export interface HudXpView { level: number; pct: number; }

export function hudXpView(v: number, coeff: number, offset: number, cap: number, out: HudXpView): void {
  const s = roundHalfAway(v);
  const F = hudLevelFloor(s, coeff);
  const level = F + 1 - offset;
  out.level = level;
  out.pct = level >= cap ? 100 : hudXpFill(s, F, coeff) * 100;
}

export function hudScoreOfXp(xp: number, base: number): number {
  return Math.floor(xp) + base;
}

export const LB_BLEND_US = 250000;

export function lbBlendValue(old: number, now: number, stampUs: number, clockUs: number): number {
  if (stampUs === 0) return now;
  const m = clockUs > 1 ? clockUs : 1;
  const dd = m > stampUs ? m - stampUs : 0;
  if (dd < LB_BLEND_US) { const t = (dd / 1000000) * 4; return ((1 - t) * old) + (t * now); }
  return now;
}

export function lbMaxFold(acc: number, value: number): number {
  const a1 = acc !== acc ? value : acc;
  const v1 = value !== value ? a1 : value;
  return a1 > v1 ? a1 : v1;
}

export function lbScoreOf(t: { currentXp: number }, start = 0): number {
  return t.currentXp + start;
}

export function lbU32(v: number): number {
  return !(v >= 0) ? 0 : !(v <= 4294967295) ? 4294967295 : Math.trunc(v);
}

export function lbAbbrev(n: number): string {
  if (n < 1000) return String(n);
  if (n >= 1e9) {
    const x = Math.floor(n / 1e6);
    const h = Math.floor((x % 1000) / 10);
    return `${Math.floor(x / 1000)}.${h < 10 ? '0' : ''}${h}b`;
  }
  const s = n >= 1e6 ? Math.floor(n / 1000) : n;
  const unit = n >= 1e6 ? 'm' : 'k';
  const f = s % 1000;
  if (s <= 99999) {
    const h = Math.floor(f / 10);
    return `${Math.floor(s / 1000)}.${h < 10 ? '0' : ''}${h}${unit}`;
  }
  return `${Math.floor(s / 1000)}.${Math.floor(f / 100)}${unit}`;
}

export const ENTITY_EASE_SEC = 1 / 30;

export function entityEase(drawn: number, to: number, left: number, dt: number): number {
  return dt >= left ? to : drawn + (to - drawn) * (dt / left);
}

export function barGlide(drawn: number, to: number, max: number, dt: number): number {
  if (!(max > 0) || !(to > drawn)) return to;
  const a = (to - drawn) / max * 255;
  return to - hudEase(a, dt / 0.7) * max / 255;
}

const KILLS_BAR_LERP = 0.1;
export const KILLS_BAR_LERP_HZ = 60;
const KILLS_BAR_MAX_STEP = 0.1;

export function killsBarLerpStep(elapsedSec: number): number {
  const e = Math.min(Math.max(elapsedSec, 0), KILLS_BAR_MAX_STEP);
  return 1 - Math.pow(1 - KILLS_BAR_LERP, e * KILLS_BAR_LERP_HZ);
}

export const LB_EXIT_DELETE_US = 4000000;

export interface LbRow {
  old: number;
  now: number;
  stampUs: number;
  rank: number;
  rankTo: number;
  off: number;
  offTo: number;
  leaving: boolean;
  leftUs: number;
  seen: number;
  shown: number;
}

export interface LbBoard<R extends LbRow> {
  rows: Map<string, R>;
  held: R[];
  gen: number;
}

export function lbNewBoard<R extends LbRow>(): LbBoard<R> {
  return { rows: new Map(), held: [], gen: 0 };
}

export function lbClearBoard<R extends LbRow>(board: LbBoard<R>): void {
  board.rows.clear();
  board.held.length = 0;
}

export function lbApplyUpdate<R extends LbRow, E extends { id: string; score: number }>(
  board: LbBoard<R>, list: readonly E[], clockUs: number, make: (e: E) => R,
): void {
  const gen = ++board.gen;
  const rows = board.rows;
  const stamp = clockUs > 0 ? clockUs : 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
    const e = list[i];
    let r = rows.get(e.id);
    if (r === undefined) {
      r = make(e);
      r.old = 0; r.now = e.score; r.stampUs = stamp;
      r.rank = i; r.rankTo = i;
      r.off = 1; r.offTo = 0;
      r.leaving = false; r.leftUs = 0;
      r.shown = 0;
      rows.set(e.id, r);
    } else {
      if (!Object.is(e.score, r.now)) {
        r.old = lbBlendValue(r.old, r.now, r.stampUs, clockUs);
        r.now = e.score;
        r.stampUs = stamp;
      }
      r.rankTo = i;
      r.offTo = 0;
      r.leaving = false;
    }
    r.seen = gen;
  }
  const held = board.held;
  held.length = 0;
  for (const [id, r] of rows) {
    if (r.seen !== gen) {
      if (!r.leaving) {
        r.leaving = true;
        r.leftUs = clockUs;
        r.offTo = 1;
      } else if (clockUs - r.leftUs >= LB_EXIT_DELETE_US) {
        rows.delete(id);
        continue;
      }
    }
    held.push(r);
  }
}

export function lbStep<R extends LbRow>(board: LbBoard<R>, dtSec: number, rankPx: number, offPx: number): boolean {
  const k = lbCurveLeft(dtSec);
  const held = board.held;
  let moving = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < held.length; i++) {
    const r = held[i];
    if (r.rank !== r.rankTo) {
      const g = (r.rank - r.rankTo) * k;
      r.rank = Math.abs(g) * rankPx < LB_SNAP_PX ? r.rankTo : r.rankTo + g;
      if (r.rank !== r.rankTo) moving = true;
    }
    if (r.off !== r.offTo) {
      const g = (r.off - r.offTo) * k;
      r.off = Math.abs(g) * offPx < LB_SNAP_PX ? r.offTo : r.offTo + g;
      if (r.off !== r.offTo) moving = true;
    }
  }
  return moving;
}

export function lbMoving<R extends LbRow>(board: LbBoard<R>): boolean {
  const held = board.held;
  for (let i = 0; i < held.length; i++) {
    const r = held[i];
    if (r.rank !== r.rankTo || r.off !== r.offTo) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function lbFoldValues<R extends LbRow>(board: LbBoard<R>, clockUs: number): number {
  const held = board.held;
  let max = 1.0;
  for (let i = 0; i < held.length; i++) {
    const r = held[i];
    r.shown = lbBlendValue(r.old, r.now, r.stampUs, clockUs);
    max = lbMaxFold(max, r.shown);
  }
  return max;
}

export function lbBlending<R extends LbRow>(board: LbBoard<R>, clockUs: number): boolean {
  const held = board.held;
  for (let i = 0; i < held.length; i++) {
    const r = held[i];
    if (r.stampUs !== 0 && clockUs - r.stampUs < LB_BLEND_US) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function lbTitleOff<R extends LbRow>(board: LbBoard<R>): number {
  const held = board.held;
  let m = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < held.length; i++) if (held[i].off < m) m = held[i].off;
  return m;
}

export function lbFillFrac(shown: number, max: number): number {
  const f = shown / max;
  return f > 0 ? (f < 1 ? f : 1) : 0;
}

export function lbRowPrefix(name: string, tank: string): string {
  return (name ? name + ' - ' + tank : tank) + ': ';
}

export const LB_LABEL_MAX = LB_BAR_LEN + 4;
export const LB_ELLIPSIS = '...';

export const LB_NUM_MASKS: readonly string[] = ['8', '88', '888', '8.88k', '88.88k', '888.8k', '8.88m', '88.88m', '888.8m', '8.88b'];

export function lbNumShape(n: number): number {
  if (n < 1000) return n < 10 ? 0 : n < 100 ? 1 : 2;
  if (n >= 1e9) return 9;
  const m = n >= 1e6;
  const s = m ? Math.floor(n / 1000) : n;
  return (m ? 6 : 3) + (s < 10000 ? 0 : s <= 99999 ? 1 : 2);
}

interface LbSegmenter { segment(s: string): Iterable<{ index: number; segment: string }>; }
let _lbSegmenter: LbSegmenter | null | undefined;
const _LB_JOINS_PREVIOUS = /^[\p{M}\u200d\ufe00-\ufe0f]$/u;

export function lbCharEnds(s: string): number[] {
  const out: number[] = [];
  if (_lbSegmenter === undefined) {
    const I = (globalThis as { Intl?: { Segmenter?: new (l?: string, o?: { granularity: string }) => LbSegmenter } }).Intl;
    _lbSegmenter = I && typeof I.Segmenter === 'function' ? new I.Segmenter(undefined, { granularity: 'grapheme' }) : null;
  }
  if (_lbSegmenter) {
    for (const g of _lbSegmenter.segment(s)) out.push(g.index + g.segment.length);
    return out;
  }
  let i = 0;
  while (i < s.length) {
    let cp = s.codePointAt(i) as number;
    i += cp > 0xffff ? 2 : 1;
    while (i < s.length) {
      const next = s.codePointAt(i) as number;
      const ch = String.fromCodePoint(next);
      if (!_LB_JOINS_PREVIOUS.test(ch) && cp !== 0x200d) break;
      cp = next;
      i += next > 0xffff ? 2 : 1;
    }
    out.push(i);
  }
  return out;
}

function _lbTrimEnd(s: string): string {
  let e = s.length;
  while (e > 0 && s.charCodeAt(e - 1) === 32) e--;
  return e === s.length ? s : s.slice(0, e);
}

export function lbFitName(name: string, room: number, measure: (s: string) => number): string {
  if (name === '') return name;
  const whole = measure(name);
  if (whole <= room) return name;
  const ends = lbCharEnds(name);
  if (ends.length < 2) return name;
  let lo = 1, hi = ends.length - 1, best = 1;
  while (lo <= hi) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
    if (measure(_lbTrimEnd(name.slice(0, ends[mid - 1])) + LB_ELLIPSIS) <= room) { best = mid; lo = mid + 1; }
    else hi = mid - 1;
  }
  const cut = _lbTrimEnd(name.slice(0, ends[best - 1])) + LB_ELLIPSIS;
  return measure(cut) < whole ? cut : name;
}

export function lbFitPrefix(name: string, tank: string, numW: number, room: number, measure: (s: string) => number): string {
  if (!name) return lbRowPrefix(name, tank);
  const rest = ' - ' + tank + ': ';
  return lbFitName(name, room - numW - measure(rest), measure) + rest;
}

export const safeInsets = { l: 0, t: 0, r: 0, b: 0 };

const _subs = new Set<() => void>();

function _px(v: string): number { const n = parseFloat(v); return n > 0 ? n : 0; }

export function readSafeInsets(): typeof safeInsets {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined' || !document.body) return safeInsets;
  if (!_probe) {
    _probe = document.createElement('div');
    _probe.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    _probe.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:0;height:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;'
      + 'padding:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) env(safe-area-inset-right,0px) env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)';
    document.body.appendChild(_probe);
  }
  const cs = getComputedStyle(_probe);
  const z = getBrowserZoomFactor() || 1;
  const l = _px(cs.paddingLeft) * z, t = _px(cs.paddingTop) * z, r = _px(cs.paddingRight) * z, b = _px(cs.paddingBottom) * z;
  if (l !== safeInsets.l || t !== safeInsets.t || r !== safeInsets.r || b !== safeInsets.b) {
    safeInsets.l = l; safeInsets.t = t; safeInsets.r = r; safeInsets.b = b;
    for (const f of _subs) f();
  }
  return safeInsets;
}

export function subscribeSafeArea(f: () => void): () => void { _subs.add(f); return () => { _subs.delete(f); }; }

function _install(): void {
  if (_installed || typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  _installed = true;
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => { readSafeInsets(); }, { capture: true, passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', () => { readSafeInsets(); }, { passive: true });
}

export function setPageCover(on: boolean): void {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  _install();
  if (on === _cover) return;
  _cover = on;
  const meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="viewport"]');
  if (meta) {
    const c = (meta.getAttribute('content') || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => s && !/^viewport-fit\s*=/.test(s));
    if (on) c.push('viewport-fit=cover');
    meta.setAttribute('content', c.join(', '));
  }
  readSafeInsets();
  if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') requestAnimationFrame(() => { readSafeInsets(); });
}

import { gameThemeUiChanged } from './gameTheme';

const THEME_KEY = 'istrong-theme';
const SYSTEM_DARK = '(prefers-color-scheme: dark)';

function storedPick(): 'light' | 'dark' | null {
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY);
    if (stored === 'dark' || stored === 'light') return stored;
  } catch { }
  return null;
}

function systemTheme(): 'light' | 'dark' {
  try {
    return window.matchMedia(SYSTEM_DARK).matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
  } catch { }
  return 'light';
}

export function getStoredTheme(): 'light' | 'dark' {
  return storedPick() ?? systemTheme();
}

export function applyTheme(theme: 'light' | 'dark', remember = true): void {
  const html = document.documentElement;

  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = '*, *::before, *::after { transition: none !important; }';
  document.head.appendChild(style);

  if (theme === 'dark') {
    html.classList.add('dark');
  } else {
    html.classList.remove('dark');
  }

  gameThemeUiChanged();

  html.offsetHeight;
  document.head.removeChild(style);

  if (!remember) return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, theme);
  } catch { }
}

export function startTheme(): void {
  applyTheme(getStoredTheme(), false);
  if (storedPick() !== null) return;
  try {
    window.matchMedia(SYSTEM_DARK).addEventListener('change', (e) => {
      if (storedPick() === null) applyTheme(e.matches ? 'dark' : 'light', false);
    });
  } catch { }
}

export function toggleTheme(): 'light' | 'dark' {
  const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
  const newTheme: 'light' | 'dark' = isDark ? 'light' : 'dark';
  applyTheme(newTheme);
  return newTheme;
}

const TEXT_TYPES = new Set(['text', 'search', 'number', 'tel', 'url', 'email', '']);
function isTypingBox(t: EventTarget | null): t is HTMLInputElement {
  if (!(t instanceof HTMLInputElement)) return false;
  return TEXT_TYPES.has(t.type) && !t.readOnly && !t.disabled && !t.closest('[data-no-type-sheet]');
}

const clean = (s: string | null | undefined): string => (s ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
function textOf(n: Element | null | undefined): string {
  if (!n) return '';
  const own = n.querySelector('.k-row-label-text');
  if (own) return clean(own.textContent);
  let s = '';
  const walk = (e: Node): void => {
    for (const c of Array.from(e.childNodes)) {
      if (c.nodeType === 3) s += c.textContent ?? '';
      else if (c instanceof Element && !c.matches('button, svg, [role="button"], [aria-hidden="true"], .k-row-lead')) walk(c);
    }
  };
  walk(n);
  return clean(s);
}
export function labelOfBox(el: Element | null): string {
  if (!el) return '';
  const aria = clean(el.getAttribute('aria-label'));
  if (aria && aria !== 'Edit Value') return aria;
  const lb = el instanceof HTMLInputElement && el.labels && el.labels.length > 0 ? textOf(el.labels[0]) : '';
  if (lb) return lb;
  const row = el.closest('.k-slider-row, .k-row, .k-row-stack, .k-num');
  const rl = textOf(row?.querySelector('.k-row-label-text, .k-num-label'));
  if (rl) return rl;
  return clean(el.getAttribute('placeholder')) || clean(el.getAttribute('title'));
}

function typeInto(el: HTMLInputElement, v: string): void {
  Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value')?.set?.call(el, v);
  el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
}
function replay(f: () => void): void { _replay = true; try { f(); } finally { _replay = false; } }
function keyTo(el: HTMLElement, type: 'keydown' | 'keyup', key: string): void {
  el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key, code: key, keyCode: key === 'Enter' ? 13 : 0, which: key === 'Enter' ? 13 : 0, bubbles: true, cancelable: true } as KeyboardEventInit));
}

function takeKeyboard(job: SheetJob): void {
  const f = _field;
  if (!f) return;
  f.value = job.start;
  f.setAttribute('inputmode', job.inputMode);
  f.setAttribute('enterkeyhint', 'done');
  if (job.box && job.box.maxLength > 0) f.maxLength = job.box.maxLength; else f.removeAttribute('maxlength');
  f.placeholder = job.placeholder;
  f.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  const n = f.value.length;
  try { f.setSelectionRange(n, n); } catch { }
}

function openForBox(box: HTMLInputElement): void {
  if (_job) endTypeSheet('away');
  const im = box.getAttribute('inputmode') || (box.type === 'number' ? 'decimal' : box.type === 'search' ? 'search' : box.type === 'email' ? 'email' : box.type === 'tel' ? 'tel' : box.type === 'url' ? 'url' : 'text');
  _job = { box, label: labelOfBox(box), start: box.value, placeholder: box.placeholder || '', inputMode: im, numeric: im === 'decimal' || im === 'numeric' || im === 'tel' };
  _keep = box;
  holdSize();
  takeKeyboard(_job);
  _notify();
}

export function openTypeSheet(job: { label: string; start: string; inputMode?: string; done: (text: string) => void }): boolean {
  if (!typeSheetOn()) return false;
  if (_job) endTypeSheet('away');
  const im = job.inputMode ?? 'decimal';
  _job = { box: null, label: job.label, start: job.start, placeholder: '', inputMode: im, numeric: im === 'decimal' || im === 'numeric', done: job.done };
  holdSize();
  takeKeyboard(_job);
  _notify();
  return true;
}

export function sheetTyped(text: string): void {
  const job = _job;
  const b = job?.box;
  if (!job || !b) return;
  if (!b.isConnected) { endTypeSheet('away'); return; }
  replay(() => typeInto(b, text));
  queueMicrotask(() => { const f = _field; if (_job === job && f && b.value !== f.value) f.value = b.value; });
}

export function sheetEnter(): void {
  const job = _job;
  if (!job) return;
  const b = job.box;
  if (b && b.dataset.sheetEnter === 'away') { endTypeSheet('away'); return; }
  if (b && b.isConnected) {
    const f = _field;
    if (f && f.value !== b.value) replay(() => typeInto(b, f.value));
    replay(() => { keyTo(b, 'keydown', 'Enter'); keyTo(b, 'keyup', 'Enter'); });
  }
  endTypeSheet('done');
}

export function endTypeSheet(how: 'done' | 'away' | 'cancel'): void {
  const job = _job;
  if (!job) return;
  const f = _field;
  const text = f ? f.value : job.start;
  _job = null;
  if (job.done) { if (how !== 'cancel') job.done(text); }
  else if (job.box && job.box.isConnected) {
    const b = job.box;
    replay(() => {
      const want = how === 'cancel' ? job.start : text;
      if (b.value !== want) typeInto(b, want);
      b.dispatchEvent(new FocusEvent('blur', { relatedTarget: null }));
      b.dispatchEvent(new FocusEvent('focusout', { bubbles: true, relatedTarget: null }));
    });
  }
  _keep = null;
  _notify();
  if (f && document.activeElement === f) {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => { if (_job === null && document.activeElement === f) f.blur(); }));
  }
  releaseSizeSoon();
}

export function sheetFieldLost(to: EventTarget | null, intoWindow: boolean): void {
  if (intoWindow || !_job || (to !== null && to === _job.box)) return;
  endTypeSheet('away');
}

export function keyboardRoom(now: number, land: boolean, numeric: boolean): number {

  if (now >= SHEET_KB_MIN) { if (now > (_kbSeen.get(k) ?? 0)) _kbSeen.set(k, now); return now; }
  return _kbSeen.get(k) ?? (numeric ? _kbSeen.get((land ? 'l' : 'p') + 't') ?? 0 : 0);
}
export function sheetTop(innerH: number, shownTop: number, kb: number, h: number): number {
  if (kb <= 0) return shownTop + SHEET_EDGE;

}

const HOLD_AFTER_MS = 1200;
let _held: { w: number; h: number; rootPx: number; root: HTMLElement | null; wrote: boolean; was: string } | null = null;
let _closing = false;
let _releaseTimer = 0;
function holdSize(): void {
  _closing = false;
  if (_releaseTimer) { clearTimeout(_releaseTimer); _releaseTimer = 0; }
  if (_held || _overlay) return;
  const root = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-app-root]');
  const comp = getZoomCompensation() || 1;
  _held = { w: window.innerWidth, h: window.innerHeight, rootPx: root ? root.getBoundingClientRect().height / comp : 0, root, wrote: false, was: '' };
}
function releaseSize(tell: boolean): void {
  const h = _held;
  if (!h) return;
  _held = null; _closing = false;
  if (_releaseTimer) { clearTimeout(_releaseTimer); _releaseTimer = 0; }
  if (h.wrote && h.root) h.root.style.height = h.was;
  if (tell && (window.innerWidth !== h.w || window.innerHeight !== h.h)) window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
}
function releaseSizeSoon(): void {
  if (!_held || _job !== null) return;
  if (window.innerWidth !== _held.w || window.innerHeight >= _held.h - 2) { releaseSize(true); return; }
  _closing = true;
  _releaseTimer = window.setTimeout(() => releaseSize(true), HOLD_AFTER_MS);
}
function onHeldResize(e: Event): void {
  const h = _held;
  if (!h) return;
  if (window.innerWidth !== h.w) { releaseSize(false); return; }
  if (_closing && window.innerHeight >= h.h - 2) { releaseSize(false); return; }
  e.stopImmediatePropagation();
  if (!h.wrote && h.root && h.rootPx > 0) { h.was = h.root.style.height; h.root.style.height = `${h.rootPx}px`; h.wrote = true; }
}

export function installTypeSheet(): void {
  if (_installed || typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  _installed = true;
  const k = vkApi();
  if (k && isTouchScreen()) { try { k.overlaysContent = true; _overlay = k.overlaysContent === true; } catch { _overlay = false; } }
  window.addEventListener('resize', onHeldResize, true);
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e: PointerEvent) => { _lastTouch = e.pointerType !== 'mouse'; }, { capture: true, passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('focusin', (e: FocusEvent) => {
    const t = e.target;
    if (_replay || t === _field || !isTypingBox(t)) return;
    if (_job && _job.box === t) { e.stopImmediatePropagation(); takeKeyboardBack(); return; }
    if (!typeSheetOn()) return;
    openForBox(t);
  }, true);
  const keepOut = (e: FocusEvent): void => { if (!_replay && _keep !== null && e.target === _keep) e.stopImmediatePropagation(); };
  window.addEventListener('blur', keepOut, true);
  window.addEventListener('focusout', keepOut, true);
}
function takeKeyboardBack(): void {
  const f = _field;
  if (f && document.activeElement !== f) f.focus({ preventScroll: true });
}

export const UI_SIZE_DEFAULT_TOUCH = UI_SIZE_MIN;
export function uiSizeDefault(): number {
  try { return isTouchScreen() ? UI_SIZE_DEFAULT_TOUCH : UI_SIZE_DEFAULT; } catch { return UI_SIZE_DEFAULT; }
}

function clampUiSize(v: number): number {
  return Number.isFinite(v) ? Math.max(UI_SIZE_MIN, Math.min(UI_SIZE_MAX, v)) : uiSizeDefault();
}

let _uiSizeSetting = UI_SIZE_DEFAULT;
try {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem(UI_SIZE_KEY);
  _uiSizeSetting = saved == null ? uiSizeDefault() : clampUiSize(parseFloat(saved));
} catch { }

const _uiSizeListeners = new Set<() => void>();

export function getUiSizeSetting(): number {
  return _uiSizeSetting;
}

export function setUiSizeSetting(v: number): void {
  const next = clampUiSize(v);
  if (next === _uiSizeSetting) return;
  _uiSizeSetting = next;
  try { localStorage.setItem(UI_SIZE_KEY, String(next)); } catch { }
  _uiSizeListeners.forEach(fn => fn());
}

export const PHONE_UI_BASE = 1;
export const PHONE_EDGE = 16;
export const PHONE_NEED_H = 340;
export const PHONE_NEED_W = 240;

export function getMenuScale(): number {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 1;
  if (isPhoneUi()) {
    const s = PHONE_UI_BASE * _uiSizeSetting;
    const room = Math.min((getEffectiveViewportHeight() - 2 * PHONE_EDGE) / PHONE_NEED_H, (getEffectiveViewportWidth() - 2 * PHONE_EDGE) / PHONE_NEED_W);
    return Math.min(s, Math.max(Math.min(1, s), room));
  }
  const w = getEffectiveViewportWidth();
  const h = getEffectiveViewportHeight();
  const raw = Math.min(w / REF_WIDTH, h / REF_HEIGHT);
  return UI_SCALE * Math.max(MIN_SCALE, Math.min(1, raw)) * _uiSizeSetting;
}

export function useMenuScale(): number {
  const [scale, setScale] = useState<number>(() =>
    typeof window === 'undefined' ? 1 : getMenuScale()
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    let rafId = 0;
    const onResize = () => {
      if (rafId) return;
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        rafId = 0;
        const next = getMenuScale();
        setScale(prev => (prev === next ? prev : next));
      });
    };
    const onUiSize = () => {
      const next = getMenuScale();
      setScale(prev => (prev === next ? prev : next));
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
    _uiSizeListeners.add(onUiSize);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize);
      _uiSizeListeners.delete(onUiSize);
      if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    };
  }, []);
  return scale;
}

export function getChromeScale(): number {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 1;
  const w = getEffectiveViewportWidth();
  const h = getEffectiveViewportHeight();
  const raw = Math.min(w / REF_WIDTH, h / REF_HEIGHT);
  return UI_SCALE * Math.max(MIN_CHROME_SCALE, Math.min(1, raw)) * _uiSizeSetting;
}

export function useChromeScale(): number {
  const [scale, setScale] = useState<number>(() =>
    typeof window === 'undefined' ? 1 : getChromeScale()
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    let rafId = 0;
    const onResize = () => {
      if (rafId) return;
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        rafId = 0;
        const next = getChromeScale();
        setScale(prev => (prev === next ? prev : next));
      });
    };
    const onUiSize = () => {
      const next = getChromeScale();
      setScale(prev => (prev === next ? prev : next));
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
    _uiSizeListeners.add(onUiSize);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize);
      _uiSizeListeners.delete(onUiSize);
      if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    };
  }, []);
  return scale;
}

export function useZoomCompensation(): number {
  const [comp, setComp] = useState<number>(() =>
    typeof window === 'undefined' ? 1 : getZoomCompensation()
  );
  useEffect(() => onZoomChange(setComp), []);
  return comp;
}

export function usePortalMenuScale(): number {
  return useMenuScale() * useZoomCompensation();
}

export function useFitScale(
  cardRef: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>,
  baseScale: number,
  active: boolean,
  margin = 24,
): number {
  const [fit, setFit] = useState(baseScale);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return;
    const el = cardRef.current;
    if (!el) { setFit(baseScale); return; }
    const compute = () => {
      const availW = getEffectiveViewportWidth() - margin * 2;
      const availH = getEffectiveViewportHeight() - margin * 2;
      const w = el.offsetWidth;
      const h = el.offsetHeight;
      let s = baseScale;
      if (w > 0 && h > 0) s = Math.min(baseScale, availW / w, availH / h);
      setFit(prev => (Math.abs(prev - s) < 0.001 ? prev : s));
    };
    compute();
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(compute);
    ro.observe(el);
    window.addEventListener('resize', compute);
    return () => {
      ro.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener('resize', compute);
    };
  }, [cardRef, baseScale, active, margin]);
  return active ? fit : baseScale;
}

const MODAL_VIEWPORT_MARGIN = 28;
const MODAL_MIN_HEIGHT = 200;

export function getModalMaxHeightPx(margin?: number): number {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 640;
  const m = margin ?? (isPhoneUi() ? PHONE_EDGE : MODAL_VIEWPORT_MARGIN);
  const avail = getEffectiveViewportHeight() - safeInsets.t - safeInsets.b - m * 2;
  const scale = getMenuScale();
  return Math.max(MODAL_MIN_HEIGHT, scale > 0 ? avail / scale : avail);
}

export function getModalMaxWidthPx(margin?: number): number {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 1200;
  const m = margin ?? (isPhoneUi() ? PHONE_EDGE : 16);
  const avail = getEffectiveViewportWidth() - safeInsets.l - safeInsets.r - m * 2;
  const scale = getMenuScale();
  return Math.max(240, scale > 0 ? avail / scale : avail);
}

export function useModalMaxWidth(margin?: number): number {
  const [maxW, setMaxW] = useState<number>(() => (typeof window === 'undefined' ? 1200 : getModalMaxWidthPx(margin)));
  useEffect(() => {
    let rafId = 0;
    const recompute = () => { const next = getModalMaxWidthPx(margin); setMaxW(prev => (Math.abs(prev - next) < 0.5 ? prev : next)); };
    const onResize = () => { if (rafId) return; rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => { rafId = 0; recompute(); }); };
    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
    _uiSizeListeners.add(recompute);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize); _uiSizeListeners.delete(recompute); if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId); };
  }, [margin]);
  return maxW;
}

export function useModalMaxHeight(margin?: number): number {
  const [maxH, setMaxH] = useState<number>(() =>
    typeof window === 'undefined' ? 640 : getModalMaxHeightPx(margin)
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    let rafId = 0;
    const recompute = () => {
      const next = getModalMaxHeightPx(margin);
      setMaxH(prev => (Math.abs(prev - next) < 0.5 ? prev : next));
    };
    const onResize = () => {
      if (rafId) return;
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => { rafId = 0; recompute(); });
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
    _uiSizeListeners.add(recompute);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize);
      _uiSizeListeners.delete(recompute);
      if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    };
  }, [margin]);
  return maxH;
}
export const INITIAL_DPR: number = (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.devicePixelRatio : 1) || 1;

export function getZoomCompensation(): number {
  return INITIAL_DPR / (window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
}

export function getEffectiveDPR(): number {
  return INITIAL_DPR;
}

export function getBrowserZoomFactor(): number {
  return (window.devicePixelRatio || 1) / INITIAL_DPR;
}

export function getEffectiveViewportWidth(): number {
  return window.innerWidth * getBrowserZoomFactor();
}
export function getEffectiveViewportHeight(): number {
  return window.innerHeight * getBrowserZoomFactor();
}

export function getCumulativeZoom(el: Element | null): number {
  if (!el) return 1;
  const native = (el as HTMLElement & { currentCSSZoom?: number }).currentCSSZoom;
  if (typeof native === 'number' && native > 0) return native;
  let z = 1;
  let node: Element | null = el;
  while (node && node !== document.documentElement) {
    const f = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(node).getPropertyValue('zoom'));
    if (f > 0 && f !== 1) z *= f;
    node = node.parentElement;
  }
  return z || 1;
}

const SCALE_OF = /scale\(\s*([\d.]+)/;
export function getVisualScale(el: Element | null): number {
  let s = getCumulativeZoom(el);
  for (let n = el as HTMLElement | null; n; n = n.parentElement) {
    const t = n.style?.transform;
    if (!t || !t.includes('scale(')) continue;
    const f = parseFloat((SCALE_OF.exec(t) ?? [])[1] ?? '');
    if (f > 0) s *= f;
  }
  return s || 1;
}

export function blockBrowserZoomInputs(): () => void {
  const onWheel = (e: WheelEvent) => {
    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) e.preventDefault();
  };
  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (!(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) || e.altKey) return;
    if (e.key === '+' || e.key === '-' || e.key === '=' || e.key === '_' ||
        e.code === 'NumpadAdd' || e.code === 'NumpadSubtract') {
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  };
  window.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false, capture: true });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown, true);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel, true);
    window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown, true);
  };
}

export function onZoomChange(callback: (compensation: number) => void): () => void {
  let disposed = false;
  let lastDpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const notifyIfChanged = () => {
    if (disposed) return;
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    if (dpr !== lastDpr) {
      lastDpr = dpr;
      callback(getZoomCompensation());
    }
  };
  let mq: MediaQueryList | null = null;
  const onQueryChange = () => {
    if (disposed) return;
    notifyIfChanged();
    listen();
  };
  function listen() {
    mq = matchMedia(`(resolution: ${window.devicePixelRatio}dppx)`);
    mq.addEventListener('change', onQueryChange, { once: true });
  }
  listen();
  window.addEventListener('resize', notifyIfChanged);
  return () => {
    disposed = true;
    if (mq) { mq.removeEventListener('change', onQueryChange); mq = null; }
    window.removeEventListener('resize', notifyIfChanged);
  };
}

import { convertEnvelopeToArras, emitArrasJS, buildOsaPack, osaPackFiles, type GameMenus, type PackFile, type PackGroupedFile } from 'nexum-library';

export type FileKind = 'Tank' | 'TurretPreset' | 'CustomProjectile' | 'FoodShape' | 'Other' | 'Legacy' | 'Unknown';
export const KIND_WORD: Record<FileKind, string> = {
  Tank: 'Tank', TurretPreset: 'Turret', CustomProjectile: 'Projectile', FoodShape: 'Food Shape', Other: 'Other', Legacy: 'Old style turret', Unknown: 'Not an iStrong file',
};
export function kindOf(env: any): FileKind {
  const t = env?.type;
  if (t === 'Tank' || t === 'TurretPreset' || t === 'CustomProjectile' || t === 'FoodShape' || t === 'Other') return t;
  if (t === 'CustomTurret') return 'Legacy';
  return 'Unknown';
}
export const hasClassCode = (k: FileKind) => k === 'Tank' || k === 'TurretPreset' || k === 'CustomProjectile';
export const inAddon = (k: FileKind) => k !== 'Legacy' && k !== 'Unknown';

export interface LoadedFile { name: string; key: string; envelope: any; kind: FileKind; group?: string }
export interface SourceFile { id: string; name: string; key: string; kind: FileKind; group?: string; envelope?: any; path?: string }

export function classCodeOf(f: LoadedFile): { text: string; className: string; warnings: { severity: string; field: string; message: string }[] } {
  const r = convertEnvelopeToArras(f.envelope);
  const text = [...r.dependencies, r.primary].map((c) => emitArrasJS(c)).join('\n');
  return { text, className: r.primary.className, warnings: r.warnings as any };
}

const safeKey = (s: string) => s.replace(/\.json$/i, '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+/g, '_') || 'file';

export function addonFilesOf(files: LoadedFile[], menus: GameMenus | null): { files: { name: string; content: string }[]; problems: string[]; notConverted: string[] } {
  const tanks: PackFile[] = [], shapes: PackGroupedFile[] = [], others: PackGroupedFile[] = [], presets: PackGroupedFile[] = [], projectiles: PackGroupedFile[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const keyOf = (f: LoadedFile) => { let k = safeKey(f.key), n = 2; while (seen.has(k)) k = `${safeKey(f.key)}_${n++}`; seen.add(k); return k; };
  for (const f of files) {
    const key = keyOf(f);
    const group = f.group || f.envelope?.category || 'Picked';
    if (f.kind === 'Tank') tanks.push({ key, envelope: f.envelope });
    else if (f.kind === 'TurretPreset') presets.push({ group, key, envelope: f.envelope });
    else if (f.kind === 'CustomProjectile') projectiles.push({ group, key, envelope: f.envelope });
    else if (f.kind === 'FoodShape') shapes.push({ group, key, envelope: f.envelope });
    else if (f.kind === 'Other') others.push({ group, key, envelope: f.envelope });
  }
  const pack = buildOsaPack({ tanks, shapes, others, presets, projectiles, menus });
  const out = osaPackFiles(pack);
  return { files: Object.entries(out).map(([n, content]) => ({ name: `istrong/${n}`, content })), problems: pack.problems, notConverted: pack.notConverted };
}

let dropSeq = 0;
export async function readIstrongFiles(picked: (File | { file: File; path: string })[]): Promise<{ files: SourceFile[]; errors: string[] }> {
  const list = picked.map((p) => (p instanceof File ? { file: p, path: (p as any).webkitRelativePath || p.name } : p));
  const files: SourceFile[] = [], errors: string[] = [];
  const add = (name: string, text: string) => {
    try {
      const envelope = JSON.parse(text);
      const kind = kindOf(envelope);
      if (kind === 'Unknown') { errors.push(`${name}: not an iStrong file`); return; }
      const base = name.split('/').pop() || name;
      const parts = name.split('/');
      files.push({ id: `drop-${++dropSeq}`, name: envelope?.name || base, key: base.replace(/\.json$/i, ''), envelope, kind, group: parts.length > 2 ? parts[parts.length - 2] : undefined });
    } catch (e) { errors.push(`${name}: ${(e as Error).message}`); }
  };
  for (const { file, path } of list) {
    const lower = file.name.toLowerCase();
    if (lower.endsWith('.zip')) {
      try {
        const JSZip = (await import('jszip')).default;
        const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(await file.arrayBuffer());
        for (const [p, entry] of Object.entries(zip.files)) {
          const e = entry as any;
          if (e.dir || !p.toLowerCase().endsWith('.json')) continue;
          add(p, await e.async('string'));
        }
      } catch (e) { errors.push(`${file.name}: ${(e as Error).message}`); }
    } else if (lower.endsWith('.json')) add(path, await file.text());
  }
  return { files, errors };
}

export async function filesOfDrop(dt: DataTransfer): Promise<{ file: File; path: string }[]> {
  const out: { file: File; path: string }[] = [];
  const entries: any[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < dt.items.length; i++) {
    const it = dt.items[i];
    if (it.kind !== 'file') continue;
    const en = typeof (it as any).webkitGetAsEntry === 'function' ? (it as any).webkitGetAsEntry() : null;
    if (en) entries.push(en);
    else { const f = it.getAsFile(); if (f) out.push({ file: f, path: f.name }); }
  }
  const walk = async (en: any, base: string): Promise<void> => {
    if (en.isFile) {
      const f: File = await new Promise((res, rej) => en.file(res, rej));
      out.push({ file: f, path: base + f.name });
    } else if (en.isDirectory) {
      const reader = en.createReader();
      for (;;) {
        const batch: any[] = await new Promise((res, rej) => reader.readEntries(res, rej));
        if (!batch.length) break;
        for (const c of batch) await walk(c, base + en.name + '/');
      }
    }
  };
  for (const en of entries) await walk(en, '');
  return out;
}
import type { JobIn, JobOut } from './packWorker';

export function downloadBlob(name: string, blob: Blob): void {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = name;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}
export function downloadText(name: string, text: string, type = 'text/plain'): void { downloadBlob(name, new Blob([text], { type })); }

export async function downloadZip(name: string, files: { name: string; content: string }[]): Promise<void> {
  const JSZip = (await import('jszip')).default;
  const zip = new JSZip();
  for (const f of files) zip.file(f.name, f.content);
  downloadBlob(name, await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob', compression: 'DEFLATE' }));
}

export function copyText(text: string): Promise<void> {
  if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
  return Promise.reject(new Error('The browser does not allow copying here'));
}

export const fileSafe = (s: string) => s.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, '_').trim() || 'file';

type JobRequest = JobIn extends infer J ? (J extends { id: number } ? Omit<J, 'id'> : never) : never;
export type JobProgress = { done: number; total: number; stage: 'read' | 'convert' | 'zip' };
export type JobResult = Extract<JobOut, { kind: 'done' }>;

let seq = 0;
export function runJob(req: JobRequest, onProgress?: (p: JobProgress) => void): Promise<JobResult> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const w = new Worker(new URL('./packWorker.ts', import.meta.url), { type: 'module' });
    const id = ++seq;
    w.onmessage = (ev: MessageEvent<JobOut>) => {
      const m = ev.data;
      if (m.id !== id) return;
      if (m.kind === 'progress') onProgress?.(m);
      else if (m.kind === 'done') { w.terminate(); resolve(m); }
      else { w.terminate(); reject(new Error(m.error)); }
    };
    w.onerror = (e) => { w.terminate(); reject(new Error(e.message || 'The converter stopped')); };
    w.postMessage({ ...req, id } as JobIn);
  });
}

import type { GameMenus } from 'nexum-library';
import { kindOf, type LoadedFile } from '../convert';

export type KindId = 'Tanks' | 'Turrets' | 'Projectiles' | 'Shapes' | 'Others';
export const KINDS: KindId[] = ['Tanks', 'Turrets', 'Projectiles', 'Shapes', 'Others'];
export const KIND_LABEL: Record<KindId, string> = { Tanks: 'Tanks', Turrets: 'Turrets', Projectiles: 'Projectiles', Shapes: 'Food Shapes', Others: 'Others' };
export const KIND_ONE: Record<KindId, string> = { Tanks: 'tank', Turrets: 'turret', Projectiles: 'projectile', Shapes: 'food shape', Others: 'other' };

export interface ManifestEntry { file: string; name: string; type: string; category: string; sub: string; bytes: number; fp: string }
export interface ManifestGroup { id: string; trail: string[]; tree?: string; keys: string[] }
export interface Manifest {
  version: number; fingerprint: string; counts: Record<KindId, number>;
  kinds: Record<KindId, { label: string; count: number; entries: Record<string, ManifestEntry>; groups: ManifestGroup[] }>;
}

export interface LibItem { kind: KindId; key: string; e: ManifestEntry; pic: string }
export const itemId = (it: LibItem) => `${it.kind}:${it.key}`;

let manifestP: Promise<Manifest | null> | null = null;
export function loadManifest(): Promise<Manifest | null> {
  if (!manifestP) manifestP = fetch('/prebuilt/library-manifest.json').then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null)).catch(() => null);
  return manifestP;
}

let menusP: Promise<GameMenus | null> | null = null;
export function loadMenus(): Promise<GameMenus | null> {
  if (!menusP) menusP = fetch('/prebuilt/game/menus.json').then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null)).catch(() => null);
  return menusP;
}

const fileCache = new Map<string, Promise<any>>();
export function loadEnvelope(it: LibItem): Promise<any> {
  let p = fileCache.get(it.e.file);
  if (!p) {
    p = fetch('/prebuilt/library/' + it.e.file.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/')).then((r) => {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`${it.e.name}: could not be loaded`);
      return r.json();
    });
    fileCache.set(it.e.file, p);
    p.catch(() => fileCache.delete(it.e.file));
  }
  return p;
}

export async function loadedFilesOf(items: LibItem[], onProgress?: (done: number) => void): Promise<LoadedFile[]> {
  const out: LoadedFile[] = new Array(items.length);
  let done = 0, next = 0;
  const worker = async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const i = next++;
      const it = items[i];
      const envelope = await loadEnvelope(it);
      const group = it.kind === 'Shapes' || it.kind === 'Others' ? it.e.sub || it.e.category : it.e.category;
      out[i] = { name: it.e.name, key: it.key, envelope, kind: kindOf(envelope), group };
      done++;
      onProgress?.(done);
    }
  };
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(8, items.length) }, worker));
  return out;
}

export function itemsOf(m: Manifest, kind: KindId): LibItem[] {
  const k = m.kinds[kind];
  return Object.entries(k.entries).map(([key, e]) => ({ kind, key, e, pic: e.file.replace(/\.json$/i, '') }));
}

import { KINDS, KIND_LABEL, KIND_ONE, itemsOf, itemId, loadManifest, loadMenus, loadEnvelope, type KindId, type LibItem, type Manifest, type ManifestGroup } from './catalog';
import { loadPicture, pictureNow, drawPicture, tickAnimatedColours, isAnimated, type Pic } from './pictures';
