const MARGIN = 28, CLOSE_MS = 120;
function windowSize(): { w: number; h: number } {
  const s = getMenuScale() || 1;
  const w = (getEffectiveViewportWidth() - MARGIN * 2) / s;
  const h = (getEffectiveViewportHeight() - MARGIN * 2) / s;
  return { w: Math.round(Math.max(900, Math.min(1500, w))), h: Math.round(Math.max(560, Math.min(960, h))) };
}

type CardSize = 's' | 'm' | 'l';
const PAD = 18, GAP = 14, TITLE_H = 40, FOOT_H = 58;
const MIN_W: Record<CardSize, number> = { s: 146, m: 178, l: 230 };
const SIZE_KEY = 'nexum_lib_card_size';
const readSize = (): CardSize => { try { const v = localStorage.getItem(SIZE_KEY); return v === 's' || v === 'l' ? v : 'm'; } catch { return 'm'; } };
const storeSize = (s: CardSize) => { try { localStorage.setItem(SIZE_KEY, s); } catch { } };

interface Section { id: string; title: string; items: LibItem[] }
interface Row { kind: 'title' | 'cards'; top: number; h: number; section: number; start: number; count: number }
interface Layout { cols: number; cardW: number; heroH: number; cardH: number; rows: Row[]; contentH: number }

function gridLayout(sections: Section[], vw: number, size: CardSize): Layout {
  const inner = Math.max(120, vw - PAD * 2);
  const cols = Math.max(1, Math.floor((inner + GAP) / (MIN_W[size] + GAP)));
  const cardW = (inner - GAP * (cols - 1)) / cols;
  const heroH = Math.round(cardW * 0.8);
  const cardH = heroH + FOOT_H;
  const rows: Row[] = [];
  let y = PAD;
  sections.forEach((s, si) => {
    if (!s.items.length) return;
    if (s.title) { rows.push({ kind: 'title', top: y, h: TITLE_H, section: si, start: 0, count: 0 }); y += TITLE_H; }
    for (let i = 0; i < s.items.length; i += cols) {
      rows.push({ kind: 'cards', top: y, h: cardH, section: si, start: i, count: Math.min(cols, s.items.length - i) });
      y += cardH + GAP;
    }
    y += GAP;
  });
  return { cols, cardW, heroH, cardH, rows, contentH: Math.max(0, y - GAP * 2 + PAD) };
}

const animated = new Set<() => void>();
let animRaf = 0;
function animLoop() {
  animRaf = 0;
  if (!animated.size) return;
  tickAnimatedColours();
  for (const draw of animated) draw();
  animRaf = requestAnimationFrame(animLoop);
}
function watchAnimated(draw: () => void): () => void {
  animated.add(draw);
  if (!animRaf) animRaf = requestAnimationFrame(animLoop);
  return () => { animated.delete(draw); };
}

const PictureCanvas: React.FC<{ picKey: string; dark: boolean; w: number; h: number; iconFrac: number; onReady?: (ok: boolean) => void }> = ({ picKey, dark, w, h, iconFrac, onReady }) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const [pics, setPics] = useState<[Pic, Pic] | null | undefined>(() => pictureNow(picKey));
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    if (pics === undefined) loadPicture(picKey).then((p) => { if (live) setPics(p); });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [picKey, pics]);
  useEffect(() => { if (pics !== undefined) onReady?.(!!pics); }, [pics, onReady]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const c = ref.current;
    if (!c || !pics) return;
    const dpr = getEffectiveDPR();
    const W = Math.max(1, Math.round(w * dpr)), H = Math.max(1, Math.round(h * dpr));
    if (c.width !== W) c.width = W;
    if (c.height !== H) c.height = H;
    const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;
    const pic = pics[dark ? 1 : 0];
    const draw = () => {
      ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
      drawPicture(ctx, pic, dark, c.width / 2, c.height / 2, Math.min(c.width, c.height) * iconFrac);
    };
    draw();
    return isAnimated(pic) ? watchAnimated(draw) : undefined;
  }, [pics, dark, w, h, iconFrac]);
  return <canvas ref={ref} aria-hidden className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full" />;
};

const Card: React.FC<{
  it: LibItem; x: number; y: number; w: number; heroH: number; h: number; dark: boolean; floor: string; grid: string;
  selected: boolean; chosen: boolean; badge: string; onSelect: (it: LibItem) => void; onChoose: (it: LibItem) => void;
}> = React.memo(({ it, x, y, w, heroH, h, dark, floor, grid, selected, chosen, badge, onSelect, onChoose }) => {
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const cell = Math.max(14, Math.round(w / 9));
  return (
    <div role="gridcell" aria-selected={selected} aria-label={it.e.name} data-ready={ready ? 1 : 0}
      onClick={() => onSelect(it)} onDoubleClick={() => onChoose(it)}
      className="group absolute select-none cursor-pointer" style={{ left: x, top: y, width: w, height: h }}>
      <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-xl border bg-[var(--k-lib-card-bg)] shadow-[var(--k-card-shadow)] border-[var(--alpha-card-border)]" />
      <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-xl shadow-[var(--shadow-raise)] opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-150 pointer-events-none" />
      <div className="absolute overflow-hidden rounded-t-[11px]" style={{ left: 1, top: 1, right: 1, height: heroH - 1, backgroundColor: floor,
        backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(${grid} 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, ${grid} 1px, transparent 1px)`,
        backgroundSize: `${cell}px ${cell}px`, backgroundPosition: 'center center' }}>
        <div className="absolute inset-0 skeleton-shimmer transition-opacity duration-200 group-data-[ready=1]:opacity-0" style={{ borderRadius: 0 }} />
        <PictureCanvas picKey={it.pic} dark={dark} w={w - 2} h={heroH - 1} iconFrac={0.62} onReady={setReady} />
        <div aria-hidden={!chosen} className={`absolute left-2.5 bottom-2.5 h-6 w-6 rounded-full bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent-ink)] grid place-items-center shadow-[var(--shadow-sm)] transition-opacity duration-150 ${chosen ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'}`}>
          <Check size={14} strokeWidth={3} />
        </div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" onClick={(ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); onChoose(it); }} onDoubleClick={(ev) => ev.stopPropagation()}
        title={chosen ? 'Unpick' : 'Pick'} aria-label={chosen ? `Unpick ${it.e.name}` : `Pick ${it.e.name}`}
        className={`k-ico absolute right-2 top-2 h-7 w-7 grid place-items-center rounded-md transition-opacity duration-150 text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:bg-[var(--alpha-hover)] ${chosen ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100'}`}>
        <AddCircle size={15} />
      </button>
      <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 px-3" style={{ top: heroH + 9 }}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
          <span className="text-[13px] leading-tight truncate text-[var(--text-primary)]">{it.e.name}</span>
        </div>
        {badge && <div className="k-lib-facts k-fade"><span className="k-badge">{badge}</span></div>}
      </div>
      <div className={`absolute inset-0 rounded-xl k-pick-ring pointer-events-none transition-opacity duration-150 ${selected ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'}`} />
    </div>
  );
});
Card.displayName = 'NexumLibraryCard';

function badgeOf(it: LibItem): string {
  if (it.kind === 'Shapes' || it.kind === 'Others') return it.e.sub && it.e.sub !== it.e.category ? it.e.sub : '';
  return it.e.category || '';
}

const Grid: React.FC<{
  sections: Section[]; size: CardSize; dark: boolean; selectedId: string | null; chosen: ReadonlySet<string>;
  onSelect: (it: LibItem) => void; onChoose: (it: LibItem) => void; resetKey: string; empty: React.ReactNode;
}> = ({ sections, size, dark, selectedId, chosen, onSelect, onChoose, resetKey, empty }) => {
  const vpRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [vw, setVw] = useState(0);
  const [vh, setVh] = useState(0);
  const [top, setTop] = useState(0);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = vpRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver((es) => {
      const r = es[0].contentRect;
      setVw((p) => (Math.abs(p - r.width) > 4 ? r.width : p));
      setVh((p) => (Math.abs(p - r.height) > 4 ? r.height : p));
    });
    setVw(el.clientWidth); setVh(el.clientHeight);
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);
  useLayoutEffect(() => { if (vpRef.current) vpRef.current.scrollTop = 0; setTop(0); }, [resetKey]);
  const raf = useRef(0);
  const onScroll = useCallback(() => {
    if (raf.current) return;
    raf.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => { raf.current = 0; if (vpRef.current) setTop(vpRef.current.scrollTop); });
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => () => { if (raf.current) cancelAnimationFrame(raf.current); }, []);
  const L = useMemo(() => gridLayout(sections, vw || 900, size), [sections, vw, size]);
  const floor = cmHex(CM.BACKGROUND, dark, CM_USE.GENERAL);
  const grid = useMemo(() => gameGridLine(dark), [dark]);
  const lo = top - vh * 0.75, hi = top + vh * 1.75;
  const items: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (const row of L.rows) {
    if (row.top + row.h < lo || row.top > hi) continue;
    const s = sections[row.section];
    if (row.kind === 'title') {
      items.push(
        <div key={'t@' + s.id} className="absolute flex items-end gap-2 pb-2.5" style={{ left: PAD, right: PAD, top: row.top, height: row.h }}>
          <span className="k-subhead">{s.title}</span>
          <span className="k-count">{s.items.length}</span>
        </div>,
      );
      continue;
    }
    for (let c = 0; c < row.count; c++) {
      const it = s.items[row.start + c];
      const id = itemId(it);
      items.push(<Card key={id + '@' + s.id} it={it} x={PAD + c * (L.cardW + GAP)} y={row.top} w={L.cardW} heroH={L.heroH} h={L.cardH}
        dark={dark} floor={floor} grid={grid} selected={id === selectedId} chosen={chosen.has(id)} badge={badgeOf(it)} onSelect={onSelect} onChoose={onChoose} />);
    }
  }
  return (
    <div ref={vpRef} onScroll={onScroll} role="grid" className="relative flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto popup-scrollbar">
      {L.rows.length === 0 ? <div className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center">{empty}</div>
        : <div className="relative" style={{ height: L.contentH }}>{items}</div>}
    </div>
  );
};

const TagChip: React.FC<{ label: string; on: boolean; onClick: () => void }> = React.memo(({ label, on, onClick }) => (
  <button type="button" onClick={onClick} title={on ? 'Click again to deselect' : `Show only ${label.toLowerCase()}`} aria-pressed={on}
    className={`k-lib-tag${on ? ' k-lib-tag-on' : ''}`}>
    {on && <Check size={12} strokeWidth={2.5} className="-ml-0.5" />}
    <span>{label}</span>
  </button>
));
TagChip.displayName = 'NexumTagChip';

const groupTitle = (g: ManifestGroup) => g.trail.join(' / ');
const tagLabel = (g: ManifestGroup) => (g.trail.length > 1 ? g.trail.slice(1).join(' / ') : g.trail[0]);

const SidePanel: React.FC<{
  it: LibItem; dark: boolean; chosen: boolean; trail: string; onChoose: () => void; onClose: () => void;
  onConvert: () => void; onDownloadFile: () => void; onDownloadCode: () => void;
}> = ({ it, dark, chosen, trail, onChoose, onClose, onConvert, onDownloadFile, onDownloadCode }) => {
  const floor = cmHex(CM.BACKGROUND, dark, CM_USE.GENERAL);
  const grid = gameGridLine(dark);
  const code = it.kind === 'Tanks' || it.kind === 'Turrets' || it.kind === 'Projectiles';
  return (
    <div className="k-lib-panel-box w-[332px] shrink-0 border-l border-[var(--alpha-divider)] bg-[var(--layer-1)] flex flex-col min-h-0">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 h-[52px] shrink-0">
        <span className="k-subhead truncate">{KIND_LABEL[it.kind]}</span>
        <IconButton label="Close the panel" onClick={onClose}><PanelRightClose size={16} /></IconButton>
      </div>
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto popup-scrollbar px-4 pb-4">
        <div className="relative w-full aspect-[5/4] rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-[var(--alpha-card-border)]"
          style={{ backgroundColor: floor, backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(${grid} 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, ${grid} 1px, transparent 1px)`, backgroundSize: '30px 30px', backgroundPosition: 'center center' }}>
          <PictureCanvas key={it.pic} picKey={it.pic} dark={dark} w={300} h={240} iconFrac={0.66} />
        </div>
        <div className="mt-4">
          <h3 className="text-[17px] font-medium leading-snug text-[var(--text-primary)] break-words">{it.e.name}</h3>
          <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            {trail && <span className="k-badge">{trail}</span>}
            {badgeOf(it) && <span className="k-badge">{badgeOf(it)}</span>}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-2">
          <button type="button" onClick={onConvert} className="k-btn k-btn-lg w-full k-btn-primary">
            <span className="k-btn-icon"><ArrowLeftRight size={15} /></span><span className="truncate">Open in the converter</span>
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={onChoose} className="k-btn k-btn-lg w-full k-btn-secondary">
            <span className="k-btn-icon"><AddCircle size={15} /></span><SwapText className="truncate">{chosen ? 'Unpick' : 'Pick'}</SwapText>
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={onDownloadFile} className="k-btn k-btn-lg w-full k-btn-secondary">
            <span className="k-btn-icon"><FileJson size={15} /></span><span className="truncate">Download the iStrong file</span>
          </button>
          {code && (
            <button type="button" onClick={onDownloadCode} className="k-btn k-btn-lg w-full k-btn-secondary">
              <span className="k-btn-icon"><FileScript size={15} /></span><span className="truncate">Download as OSA class code</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="mt-5 text-[11px] text-[var(--text-quaternary)] break-all">File: {it.e.file}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const LibraryWindow: React.FC<{ isDark: boolean; onClose: () => void; onConvert: (files: SourceFile[]) => void }> = ({ isDark, onClose, onConvert }) => {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const portalScale = usePortalMenuScale();
  const scrimRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const cardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [closing, setClosing] = useState(false);
  const closingRef = useRef(false);
  const close = useCallback((after?: unknown) => {
    if (closingRef.current) return;
    closingRef.current = true;
    const a = document.activeElement;
    if (a instanceof HTMLElement && cardRef.current && cardRef.current.contains(a)) a.blur();
    setClosing(true);
    window.setTimeout(typeof after === 'function' ? (after as () => void) : onClose, CLOSE_MS);
  }, [onClose]);
  useWindowFrame({ scrim: scrimRef, card: cardRef, closing });
  useEscapeOwner(close);
  const backdrop = useBackdropClose(close);
  const [size, setSize] = useState(windowSize);
  useEffect(() => {
    let raf = 0;
    const on = () => { if (raf) return; raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => { raf = 0; setSize((p) => { const n = windowSize(); return n.w === p.w && n.h === p.h ? p : n; }); }); };
    window.addEventListener('resize', on);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('resize', on); if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf); };
  }, []);
  const fit = useFitScale(cardRef, portalScale, true);

  const [manifest, setManifest] = useState<Manifest | null | undefined>(undefined);
  useEffect(() => { let live = true; loadManifest().then((m) => { if (live) setManifest(m); }); return () => { live = false; }; }, []);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<KindId>('Tanks');
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [cardSize, setCardSize] = useState<CardSize>(readSize);
  const [tags, setTags] = useState<Record<KindId, Set<string>>>(() => ({ Tanks: new Set(), Turrets: new Set(), Projectiles: new Set(), Shapes: new Set(), Others: new Set() }));
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<LibItem | null>(null);
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<Map<string, LibItem>>(() => new Map());
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const all = useMemo(() => {
    const out = {} as Record<KindId, LibItem[]>;
    if (manifest) for (const k of KINDS) out[k] = itemsOf(manifest, k);
    return out;
  }, [manifest]);
  const byKey = useMemo(() => {
    const out = {} as Record<KindId, Map<string, LibItem>>;
    for (const k of KINDS) out[k] = new Map((all[k] ?? []).map((it) => [it.key, it]));
    return out;
  }, [all]);
  const groups = manifest ? manifest.kinds[kind].groups : [];
  const picked = tags[kind];
  const dq = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const sections = useMemo<Section[]>(() => {
    if (!manifest) return [];
    const map = byKey[kind];
    const shown = picked.size ? groups.filter((g) => picked.has(g.id)) : groups;
    const out: Section[] = [];
    for (const g of shown) {
      const items: LibItem[] = [];
      for (const k of g.keys) {
        const it = map.get(k);
        if (it && (!dq || it.e.name.toLowerCase().includes(dq) || it.key.toLowerCase().includes(dq))) items.push(it);
      }
      if (items.length) out.push({ id: g.id, title: groupTitle(g), items });
    }
    return out;
  }, [manifest, byKey, kind, groups, picked, dq]);
  const resultN = useMemo(() => { const s = new Set<string>(); for (const sec of sections) for (const it of sec.items) s.add(it.key); return s.size; }, [sections]);
  const trailOf = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const g of groups) for (const k of g.keys) if (!m.has(k)) m.set(k, groupTitle(g));
    return m;
  }, [groups]);
  const chosenIds = useMemo(() => new Set(chosen.keys()), [chosen]);

  const toggleTag = useCallback((id: string) => setTags((p) => { const n = new Set(p[kind]); if (n.has(id)) n.delete(id); else n.add(id); return { ...p, [kind]: n }; }), [kind]);
  const clearTags = useCallback(() => setTags((p) => ({ ...p, [kind]: new Set() })), [kind]);
  const onSelect = useCallback((it: LibItem) => setSelected(it), []);
  const onChoose = useCallback((it: LibItem) => setChosen((p) => { const n = new Map(p); const id = itemId(it); if (n.has(id)) n.delete(id); else n.set(id, it); return n; }), []);
  const pickShown = useCallback(() => setChosen((p) => { const n = new Map(p); for (const s of sections) for (const it of s.items) n.set(itemId(it), it); return n; }), [sections]);
  const clearPicked = useCallback(() => {
    const before = chosen;
    setChosen(new Map());
    showToast('info', `Unpicked ${before.size} ${before.size === 1 ? 'file' : 'files'}`, { label: 'Undo', run: () => setChosen(before) });
  }, [chosen, showToast]);

  const sourcesOf = (items: LibItem[]): SourceFile[] => items.map((it) => ({
    id: 'lib:' + itemId(it), name: it.e.name, key: it.key, path: it.e.file,
    kind: it.kind === 'Tanks' ? 'Tank' : it.kind === 'Turrets' ? (it.e.type === 'CustomTurret' ? 'Legacy' : 'TurretPreset') : it.kind === 'Projectiles' ? 'CustomProjectile' : it.kind === 'Shapes' ? 'FoodShape' : 'Other',
    group: it.kind === 'Shapes' || it.kind === 'Others' ? it.e.sub || it.e.category : it.e.category,
  }));
  const progressWord = (p: JobProgress) => (p.stage === 'read' ? `Reading ${p.done} of ${p.total}` : p.stage === 'convert' ? 'Converting' : 'Packing');
  const runDownload = useCallback(async (job: 'addon' | 'files', items: LibItem[]) => {
    if (busy || !items.length) return;
    setBusy('Starting');
    try {
      const menus = job === 'addon' ? await loadMenus() : null;
      const r = await runJob(job === 'addon'
        ? { job, files: sourcesOf(items), menus, zipName: 'istrong-osa-addon.zip' }
        : { job, files: sourcesOf(items), zipName: 'istrong-files.zip' }, (p) => setBusy(progressWord(p)));
      downloadBlob(r.name, r.blob);
      const left = r.notConverted.length + r.problems.length;
      showToast(left ? 'info' : 'success', left ? `Downloaded ${r.name}: ${left} ${left === 1 ? 'file' : 'files'} could not be converted (listed in not-converted.txt)` : `Downloaded ${r.name}`);
    } catch (e) {
      showToast('error', (e as Error).message);
    } finally { setBusy(null); }
  }, [busy, showToast]);

  const downloadOne = useCallback(async (it: LibItem, code: boolean) => {
    try {
      const env = await loadEnvelope(it);
      if (!code) { downloadText(`${fileSafe(it.key)}.json`, JSON.stringify(env, null, 2), 'application/json'); return; }
      const k = kindOf(env);
      if (!hasClassCode(k)) { showToast('info', 'This kind of file goes out only in an OSA addon'); return; }
      const c = classCodeOf({ name: it.e.name, key: it.key, envelope: env, kind: k });
      downloadText(`${fileSafe(it.e.name)}.js`, c.text, 'application/javascript');
    } catch (e) { showToast('error', (e as Error).message); }
  }, [showToast]);

  const handOver = useCallback((items: LibItem[]) => { const files = sourcesOf(items); close(() => onConvert(files)); }, [close, onConvert]);

  const onKeyDown = useCallback((ev: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if ((ev.ctrlKey || ev.metaKey) && ev.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') { ev.preventDefault(); searchRef.current?.focus(); searchRef.current?.select(); }
  }, []);

  const activeChips = groups.filter((g) => picked.has(g.id));
  const sideSections = useMemo(() => {
    const out: { head: string; groups: ManifestGroup[] }[] = [];
    for (const g of groups) {
      const head = g.trail.length > 1 ? g.trail[0] : '';
      const last = out[out.length - 1];
      if (last && last.head === head) last.groups.push(g); else out.push({ head, groups: [g] });
    }
    return out;
  }, [groups]);
  const n = chosen.size;
  const one = KIND_ONE[kind];

  const sizeToggle = (
    <div className="k-lib-tabs k-lib-tabs-sm" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Card size">
      {(['s', 'm', 'l'] as CardSize[]).map((sz) => (
        <button key={sz} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={cardSize === sz} onClick={() => { setCardSize(sz); storeSize(sz); }}
          title={sz === 's' ? 'Small cards' : sz === 'm' ? 'Medium cards' : 'Large cards'} aria-label={sz === 's' ? 'Small cards' : sz === 'm' ? 'Medium cards' : 'Large cards'}
          className={`k-ico k-lib-tab k-lib-tab-icon${cardSize === sz ? ' k-lib-tab-on' : ''}`}>
          <span className="k-ico-art grid gap-[2px]" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${sz === 's' ? 3 : sz === 'm' ? 2 : 1}, 1fr)` }}>
            {Array.from({ length: sz === 's' ? 9 : sz === 'm' ? 4 : 1 }, (_, i) => <span key={i} className="block rounded-[1.5px] bg-current" style={{ width: sz === 's' ? 3 : sz === 'm' ? 5 : 11, height: sz === 's' ? 3 : sz === 'm' ? 5 : 11 }} />)}
          </span>
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );

  const card = (
    <div ref={scrimRef} className={`modal-scrim z-[70] animate-fadeIn ${closing ? 'pointer-events-none' : ''}`} {...backdrop}>
      <div style={{ zoom: fit }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div ref={cardRef} tabIndex={-1} onKeyDown={onKeyDown} role="dialog" aria-label="Tank Library"
          className="modal-card k-lib-window flex flex-col outline-none relative animate-scaleUp" style={{ width: size.w, height: size.h }}>
          <div className="k-win-head shrink-0 flex items-center gap-4 pl-5 pr-3 h-[60px]">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0 w-[280px] shrink-0">
              <ContentLibraryIcon size={20} absoluteStrokeWidth className="text-[var(--text-primary)] shrink-0" />
              <h2 className="k-modal-title min-w-0 truncate">Tank Library</h2>
            </div>
            <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-[560px] mx-auto">
              <Search size={15} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--k-search-icon)] pointer-events-none" />
              <input ref={searchRef} type="text" value={query} autoFocus onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape' && query) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); setQuery(''); } }}
                placeholder={`Search ${KIND_LABEL[kind].toLowerCase()}`}
                className="k-text-in k-search-bar w-full h-9 pl-9 pr-16 rounded-lg text-[13px] bg-[var(--k-search-bg)] border border-[var(--alpha-card-border)] shadow-[var(--shadow-input)] text-[var(--text-primary)] placeholder:text-[var(--k-placeholder)] outline-none" />
              <SearchEnd query={query} onClear={() => { setQuery(''); searchRef.current?.focus(); }} />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
              {sizeToggle}
              <ThemeSwitch />
              <IconButton label="Close" onClick={() => close()}><X size={18} /></IconButton>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="k-win-head shrink-0 flex items-center px-5 pb-3 border-b border-[var(--alpha-divider)]">
            <div className="k-lib-tabs" role="tablist">
              {KINDS.map((k) => (
                <button key={k} type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={k === kind} onClick={() => { setKind(k); setSelected(null); }}
                  className={`k-lib-tab${k === kind ? ' k-lib-tab-on' : ''}`}>
                  {KIND_LABEL[k]}
                  <span className="k-lib-count">{manifest ? manifest.kinds[k].count : ''}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="relative flex-1 min-h-0 flex">
            <div className="k-lib-side w-[264px] shrink-0 border-r border-[var(--alpha-divider)] overflow-y-auto popup-scrollbar">
              <div className="space-y-5 p-4">
                {sideSections.map((sec, si) => (
                  <div key={sec.head + si}>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between h-5">
                      <span className="k-subhead">{sec.head || (si === 0 ? 'Groups' : 'More')}</span>
                      <Fade when={sec.groups.some((g) => picked.has(g.id))}>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => setTags((p) => { const nn = new Set(p[kind]); for (const g of sec.groups) nn.delete(g.id); return { ...p, [kind]: nn }; })}
                          className="k-btn k-btn-ghost k-lib-btn-xs -mr-2 -my-0.5">Clear</button>
                      </Fade>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-2">
                      {sec.groups.map((g) => <TagChip key={g.id} label={tagLabel(g)} on={picked.has(g.id)} onClick={() => toggleTag(g.id)} />)}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="k-lib-content flex-1 min-w-0 flex flex-col">
              <div className="k-lib-results shrink-0 flex items-center gap-2 px-[18px] min-h-[52px] py-2 border-b border-[var(--alpha-divider)]">
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-y-1.5">
                  <span className="text-[12px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] tabular-nums mr-2.5">
                    <SwapText>{manifest ? `${resultN} ${resultN === 1 ? one : KIND_LABEL[kind].toLowerCase()}` : ''}</SwapText>
                  </span>
                  <InlineMotion items={[
                    ...activeChips.map((g) => ({ key: g.id, node: (
                      <span className="k-lib-chip">
                        <span>{tagLabel(g)}</span>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => toggleTag(g.id)} className="k-chip-x" aria-label={`Remove ${tagLabel(g)}`}><X size={11} /></button>
                      </span>
                    ) })),
                    ...((activeChips.length > 0 || query) ? [{ key: 'clear-all', node: <button type="button" onClick={() => { clearTags(); setQuery(''); }} className="k-btn k-btn-ghost k-lib-btn-xs">Clear all</button> }] : []),
                  ]} />
                </div>
                <button type="button" onClick={pickShown} disabled={!resultN} className="k-btn k-btn-secondary k-btn-md shrink-0">
                  <span className="k-btn-icon"><AddCircle size={13} /></span><span className="truncate">Pick all shown</span>
                </button>
              </div>
              {manifest === null ? (
                <div className="flex-1 grid place-items-center text-center px-6">
                  <div className="text-[13px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">The library could not be loaded. Check the connection and open it again.</div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <Grid sections={sections} size={cardSize} dark={isDark} selectedId={selected ? itemId(selected) : null} chosen={chosenIds}
                  onSelect={onSelect} onChoose={onChoose} resetKey={kind + '|' + dq + '|' + [...picked].join(',')}
                  empty={manifest ? <div className="text-center"><span className="flex justify-center text-[var(--text-primary)]">{emptyArt(SearchX)}</span>
                    <div className="sr-only">Nothing matches.</div>
                    {(activeChips.length > 0 || query) && <button type="button" onClick={() => { clearTags(); setQuery(''); }} className="k-btn k-btn-secondary k-btn-md mt-4">Clear all</button>}</div> : null} />
              )}
            </div>

            {selected && (
              <div className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 right-0 z-[4] overflow-hidden pointer-events-none flex justify-end" style={{ width: 356 }}>
                <div className="k-lib-panel pointer-events-auto flex k-lib-panel-in">
                  <SidePanel key={itemId(selected)} it={selected} dark={isDark} chosen={chosenIds.has(itemId(selected))} trail={trailOf.get(selected.key) ?? ''}
                    onChoose={() => onChoose(selected)} onClose={() => setSelected(null)} onConvert={() => handOver([selected])}
                    onDownloadFile={() => downloadOne(selected, false)} onDownloadCode={() => downloadOne(selected, true)} />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="k-pop-foot shrink-0 border-t border-[var(--alpha-divider)] bg-[var(--k-content)]">
            <div className="k-bar bg-[var(--k-foot-bg)] flex items-center gap-2 px-4 h-[56px]">
              <span className="text-[12px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] tabular-nums"><SwapText>{busy ?? (n ? `${n} picked` : 'Pick files to convert or download them')}</SwapText></span>
              <Fade when={n > 0 && !busy}><button type="button" onClick={clearPicked} className="k-btn k-btn-ghost k-btn-md">Unpick all</button></Fade>
              <div className="flex-1" />
              <button type="button" disabled={!n || !!busy} onClick={() => runDownload('files', [...chosen.values()])} className="k-btn k-btn-secondary k-btn-md">
                <span className="k-btn-icon"><Download size={14} /></span><span className="truncate">Download files</span>
              </button>
              <button type="button" disabled={!n || !!busy} onClick={() => runDownload('addon', [...chosen.values()])} className="k-btn k-btn-secondary k-btn-md">
                <span className="k-btn-icon"><Download size={14} /></span><span className="truncate">Download OSA addon</span>
              </button>
              <button type="button" disabled={!n || !!busy} onClick={() => handOver([...chosen.values()])} className="k-btn k-btn-primary k-btn-md">
                <span className="k-btn-icon"><ArrowLeftRight size={14} /></span><span className="truncate">Open in the converter</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
  return createPortal(card, document.body);
};
import { acTick, AC_UI, acRainbowHex, acTransHex, acFlashIsFirst } from '../../istrong/utils/animColorArras';
import { cmBorderRgb } from '../../istrong/utils/colorMap';
import { borderBlendFor } from '../../istrong/utils/gameTheme';

export type Part = [number, number, number, number, number, number, string, number];
export interface Pic { p: Part[]; a?: string; o?: number }
type MeshDef = { kind: 'outline'; points: [number, number][] } | { kind: 'line' } | { kind: 'star' | 'curvedStar'; sides: number; inner: number };
interface PicIndex {
  version: number; chunk: number; meshStart: number; meshes: MeshDef[];
  flash: Record<string, [string[], string[]]>; flashTypes: Record<string, number>; index: Record<string, number>;
}

const BASE = '/prebuilt/pictures/';
let indexP: Promise<PicIndex | null> | null = null;
let index: PicIndex | null = null;
const chunks = new Map<number, Promise<Record<string, [Pic, Pic]>>>();
const ready = new Map<string, [Pic, Pic] | null>();

function loadIndex(): Promise<PicIndex | null> {
  if (!indexP) {
    indexP = fetch(BASE + 'index.json').then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null)).then((ix: PicIndex | null) => { index = ix; return ix; }).catch(() => null);
  }
  return indexP;
}

export async function loadPicture(key: string): Promise<[Pic, Pic] | null> {
  const known = ready.get(key);
  if (known !== undefined) return known;
  const ix = await loadIndex();
  const n = ix?.index[key];
  if (ix == null || n == null) { ready.set(key, null); return null; }
  let c = chunks.get(n);
  if (!c) {
    c = fetch(`${BASE}${n}.json`).then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : {})).catch(() => ({}));
    chunks.set(n, c);
  }
  const all = await c;
  const two = all[key] ?? null;
  ready.set(key, two);
  return two;
}
export function pictureNow(key: string): [Pic, Pic] | null | undefined { return ready.get(key); }

const MESH_BARREL = 0, MESH_CIRCLE = 1, MESH_POLY0 = 2, MESH_CROSS = 16;
const CROSS_X = [0.3, 1, 1, 0.3, 0.3, -0.3, -0.3, -1, -1, -0.3, -0.3, 0.3];
const CROSS_Y = [-0.3, -0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1, 1, 0.3, 0.3, -0.3, -0.3, -1, -1];
const STROKE_HALF = 3, ICON_UNITS = 80;

function tracePart(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, mesh: number, aspect: number, made: MeshDef | undefined): void {
  if (mesh === MESH_BARREL) {
    ctx.moveTo(0, -0.5); ctx.lineTo(1, -0.5 * aspect); ctx.lineTo(1, 0.5 * aspect); ctx.lineTo(0, 0.5); ctx.closePath();
  } else if (mesh === MESH_CIRCLE) {
    ctx.moveTo(1, 0); ctx.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  } else if (mesh === MESH_CROSS) {
    ctx.moveTo(CROSS_X[0], CROSS_Y[0]);
    for (let i = 1; i < 12; i++) ctx.lineTo(CROSS_X[i], CROSS_Y[i]);
    ctx.closePath();
  } else if (mesh >= MESH_POLY0 && mesh < MESH_CROSS) {
    const n = mesh - MESH_POLY0 + 3;
    ctx.moveTo(1, 0);
    for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) { const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / n; ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a), Math.sin(a)); }
    ctx.closePath();
  } else if (made) {
    if (made.kind === 'outline') {
      const pts = made.points;
      if (!pts.length) return;
      ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]);
      for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
      ctx.closePath();
    } else if (made.kind === 'line') {
      ctx.moveTo(-1, 0); ctx.lineTo(1, 0);
    } else if (made.kind === 'star') {
      const n = made.sides * 2;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / n, r = i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : made.inner;
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(r * Math.cos(a), r * Math.sin(a)); else ctx.lineTo(r * Math.cos(a), r * Math.sin(a));
      }
      ctx.closePath();
    } else {
      const n = made.sides;
      ctx.moveTo(1, 0);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const h = (Math.PI * 2 * (i + 0.5)) / n, nx = (Math.PI * 2 * (i + 1)) / n;
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(made.inner * Math.cos(h), made.inner * Math.sin(h), Math.cos(nx), Math.sin(nx));
      }
      ctx.closePath();
    }
  }
}

const strokeOf = new Map<string, string>();
function outlineColour(fill: string, dark: boolean): string {
  const k = (dark ? 'd' : 'l') + fill;
  let s = strokeOf.get(k);
  if (!s) {
    const n = parseInt(fill.charCodeAt(0) === 35 ? fill.slice(1) : fill, 16) || 0;
    const ink = cmBorderRgb(dark), b = borderBlendFor(dark);
    const mix = (c: number, i: number) => Math.round(c * (1 - b) + i * b);
    s = `rgb(${mix((n >> 16) & 255, ink[0])},${mix((n >> 8) & 255, ink[1])},${mix(n & 255, ink[2])})`;
    strokeOf.set(k, s);
  }
  return s;
}

function animColour(a: string, dark: boolean): string {
  if (a === 'rainbow') return acRainbowHex(AC_UI);
  const f = index?.flashTypes[a];
  if (f === undefined) return acTransHex(AC_UI);
  const pair = index!.flash[String(f)]?.[dark ? 1 : 0];
  return pair ? (acFlashIsFirst(AC_UI) ? pair[0] : pair[1]) : acTransHex(AC_UI);
}

export function tickAnimatedColours(): void { acTick(Date.now(), AC_UI); }

let scratch: HTMLCanvasElement | null = null;

export function drawPicture(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, pic: Pic, dark: boolean, cx: number, cy: number, size: number): void {
  if (pic.o !== undefined && pic.o < 1) {
    const w = ctx.canvas.width, h = ctx.canvas.height;
    if (!scratch) scratch = document.createElement('canvas');
    if (scratch.width !== w || scratch.height !== h) { scratch.width = w; scratch.height = h; }
    const s = scratch.getContext('2d')!;
    s.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
    s.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    drawParts(s, pic, dark, cx, cy, size);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = pic.o;
    ctx.drawImage(scratch, 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }
  drawParts(ctx, pic, dark, cx, cy, size);
}

function drawParts(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, pic: Pic, dark: boolean, cx: number, cy: number, size: number): void {
  const unit = size / ICON_UNITS;
  const anim = pic.a ? animColour(pic.a, dark) : '';
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  for (const part of pic.p) {
    const [mesh, x, y, rot, sx, sy, hex, aspect] = part;
    const made = mesh >= (index?.meshStart ?? 17) ? index?.meshes[mesh - (index?.meshStart ?? 17)] : undefined;
    const fill = anim || '#' + hex;
    const c = Math.cos(rot), s = Math.sin(rot);
    ctx.setTransform(c * sx * size, s * sx * size, -s * sy * size, c * sy * size, cx + x * size, cy + y * size);
    ctx.beginPath();
    tracePart(ctx, mesh, aspect, made);
    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
    const line = made?.kind === 'line';
    ctx.strokeStyle = outlineColour(fill, dark);
    ctx.lineWidth = STROKE_HALF * 2 * unit * (mesh === MESH_CROSS ? 0.7 : 1);
    ctx.lineCap = line ? 'round' : 'butt';
    ctx.stroke();
    if (!line) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); }
  }
}

export const isAnimated = (pic: Pic) => !!pic.a;

type Block = { t: 'title' | 'h' | 'p' | 'li' | 'quote'; text: string };
function blocksOf(source: string): Block[] {
  const out: Block[] = [];
  let para: string[] = [];
  const flush = () => { if (para.length) { out.push({ t: 'p', text: para.join(' ') }); para = []; } };
  for (const raw of source.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split('\n')) {
    const line = raw.trim();
    if (!line) { flush(); continue; }
    if (line.startsWith('## ')) { flush(); out.push({ t: 'h', text: line.slice(3) }); continue; }
    if (line.startsWith('# ')) { flush(); out.push({ t: 'title', text: line.slice(2) }); continue; }
    if (line.startsWith('- ')) { flush(); out.push({ t: 'li', text: line.slice(2) }); continue; }
    if (line.startsWith('> ')) { flush(); out.push({ t: 'quote', text: line.slice(2) }); continue; }
    para.push(line);
  }
  flush();
  return out;
}
type Span = { k: 'text' | 'bold' | 'code'; text: string } | { k: 'link'; text: string; href: string };
function spansOf(text: string): Span[] {
  const out: Span[] = [];
  const re = /\*\*\*(.+?)\*\*\*|\*\*(.+?)\*\*|`(.+?)`|\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\)|<(https?:\/\/[^>\s]+)>|(https?:\/\/[^\s)>]+)/g;
  let at = 0;
  for (let m = re.exec(text); m; m = re.exec(text)) {
    if (m.index > at) out.push({ k: 'text', text: text.slice(at, m.index) });
    if (m[1] !== undefined) out.push({ k: 'bold', text: m[1] });
    else if (m[2] !== undefined) out.push({ k: 'bold', text: m[2] });
    else if (m[3] !== undefined) out.push({ k: 'code', text: m[3] });
    else if (m[4] !== undefined) out.push(/^https?:\/\//.test(m[5]) ? { k: 'link', text: m[4], href: m[5] } : { k: 'text', text: m[4] });
    else if (m[6] !== undefined) out.push({ k: 'link', text: m[6], href: m[6] });
    else {
      const href = m[7].replace(/[.,;:]+$/, '');
      out.push({ k: 'link', text: href, href });
      if (href.length < m[7].length) out.push({ k: 'text', text: m[7].slice(href.length) });
    }
    at = re.lastIndex;
  }
  if (at < text.length) out.push({ k: 'text', text: text.slice(at) });
  return out;
}

function Spans({ text }: { text: string }) {
  return <>{spansOf(text).map((s, i) => {
    if (s.k === 'bold') return <strong key={i} className="k-legal-strong">{s.text}</strong>;
    if (s.k === 'code') return <code key={i} className="k-legal-code">{s.text}</code>;
    if (s.k === 'link') return <a key={i} href={s.href} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="k-legal-link">{s.text}</a>;
    return <React.Fragment key={i}>{s.text}</React.Fragment>;
  })}</>;
}
function Blocks({ blocks, inCard }: { blocks: Block[]; inCard?: boolean }) {
  return <>{blocks.map((b, i) => {
    switch (b.t) {
      case 'title': return <h3 key={i} className={inCard ? 'k-legal-card-title' : 'k-legal-title'}>{b.text}</h3>;
      case 'h': return <h4 key={i} className={inCard ? 'k-legal-card-h' : 'k-docs-h'}>{b.text}</h4>;
      case 'li': return <p key={i} className="k-docs-p k-legal-li"><span className="k-legal-dot" aria-hidden /><Spans text={b.text} /></p>;
      case 'quote': return <p key={i} className="k-docs-p k-legal-quote"><Spans text={b.text} /></p>;
      default:
        if (/^(Version |Required Notice:)/.test(b.text)) return <p key={i} className="k-legal-meta"><Spans text={b.text} /></p>;
        return <p key={i} className="k-docs-p"><Spans text={b.text} /></p>;
    }
  })}</>;
}

interface NoticePart { name: string; license: string; link: string; blocks: Block[] }
function noticeParts(src: string): { intro: Block[]; parts: NoticePart[] } {
  const chunks = src.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split(/^={20,}$/m);
  const parts: NoticePart[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i + 1 < chunks.length; i += 2) {
    const head = chunks[i].trim().split('\n');
    const m = /^(.*) \(([^()]+)\)$/.exec((head[0] ?? '').trim());
    parts.push({ name: m ? m[1] : (head[0] ?? ''), license: m ? m[2] : '', link: (head[1] ?? '').trim(), blocks: blocksOf(chunks[i + 1]) });
  }
  return { intro: blocksOf(chunks[0] ?? ''), parts };
}
const LICENSE = blocksOf(licenseSource);
const NOTICES = noticeParts(noticesSource);

                  ))}

              )}

          </div>
        </PageSwap>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );

import { getEffectiveViewportHeight, getEffectiveViewportWidth } from '../istrong/utils/zoomCompensation';

const CARD_W = 400, CARD_MIN_W = 300, SIDE = 16, END = 24;

function useCardZoom(card: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>): { zoom: number; width: number } {
  const scale = useMenuScale();
  const [vp, setVp] = useState(() => ({ w: getEffectiveViewportWidth(), h: getEffectiveViewportHeight() }));
  const [natH, setNatH] = useState(0);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    let raf = 0;
    const on = () => { if (raf) return; raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => { raf = 0; setVp({ w: getEffectiveViewportWidth(), h: getEffectiveViewportHeight() }); }); };
    window.addEventListener('resize', on);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('resize', on); if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf); };
  }, []);
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = card.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const read = () => setNatH(el.offsetHeight);
    read();
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(read);
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [card]);
  const width = Math.max(CARD_MIN_W, Math.min(CARD_W, (vp.w - 2 * SIDE) / scale));
  let zoom = Math.min(scale, (vp.w - 2 * SIDE) / width);
  if (natH > 0) zoom = Math.min(zoom, (vp.h - 2 * END) / natH);
  return { zoom: Math.max(0.1, zoom), width };
}

import JSZip from 'jszip';
import type { GameMenus } from 'nexum-library';
import { addonFilesOf, classCodeOf, kindOf, hasClassCode, type LoadedFile, type SourceFile } from './convert';

export type JobIn =
  | { id: number; job: 'addon'; files: SourceFile[]; menus: GameMenus | null; zipName: string }
  | { id: number; job: 'code'; files: SourceFile[]; zipName: string }
  | { id: number; job: 'files'; files: SourceFile[]; zipName: string };
export type JobOut =
  | { id: number; kind: 'progress'; done: number; total: number; stage: 'read' | 'convert' | 'zip' }
  | { id: number; kind: 'done'; blob: Blob; name: string; problems: string[]; notConverted: string[]; count: number }
  | { id: number; kind: 'failed'; error: string };

const post = (m: JobOut) => (self as unknown as Worker).postMessage(m);

async function read(id: number, files: SourceFile[]): Promise<LoadedFile[]> {
  const out: LoadedFile[] = new Array(files.length);
  let done = 0, next = 0;
  const one = async () => {
    while (next < files.length) {
      const i = next++;
      const f = files[i];
      let envelope = f.envelope;
      if (envelope === undefined && f.path) {
        const r = await fetch('/prebuilt/library/' + f.path.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/'));
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`${f.name}: could not be loaded`);
        envelope = await r.json();
      }
      out[i] = { name: f.name, key: f.key, envelope, kind: kindOf(envelope), group: f.group };
      if (++done % 20 === 0 || done === files.length) post({ id, kind: 'progress', done, total: files.length, stage: 'read' });
    }
  };
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(8, files.length) }, one));
  return out;
}

const safe = (s: string) => s.replace(/\.json$/i, '').replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, '_').trim() || 'file';

self.onmessage = async (ev: MessageEvent<JobIn>) => {
  const m = ev.data;
  try {
    const files = await read(m.id, m.files);
    const zip = new JSZip();
    let problems: string[] = [], notConverted: string[] = [];
    if (m.job === 'addon') {
      post({ id: m.id, kind: 'progress', done: 0, total: files.length, stage: 'convert' });
      const r = addonFilesOf(files, m.menus);
      for (const f of r.files) zip.file(f.name, f.content);
      problems = r.problems; notConverted = r.notConverted;
    } else if (m.job === 'code') {
      const used = new Set<string>();
      files.forEach((f, i) => {
        if (!hasClassCode(f.kind)) { notConverted.push(`${f.name}: a ${f.kind === 'FoodShape' ? 'food shape' : 'file of this kind'} goes out only in an OSA addon`); return; }
        try {
          const c = classCodeOf(f);
          let n = safe(f.name), k = 2;
          while (used.has(n.toLowerCase())) n = `${safe(f.name)} ${k++}`;
          used.add(n.toLowerCase());
          zip.file(`${n}.js`, c.text);
          for (const w of c.warnings) if (w.severity === 'error') problems.push(`${f.name}: ${w.message}`);
        } catch (e) { problems.push(`${f.name}: ${(e as Error).message}`); }
        if ((i + 1) % 20 === 0) post({ id: m.id, kind: 'progress', done: i + 1, total: files.length, stage: 'convert' });
      });
    } else {
      const used = new Set<string>();
      for (const f of files) {
        const folder = f.kind === 'Tank' ? 'Tanks' : f.kind === 'TurretPreset' || f.kind === 'Legacy' ? 'Turrets' : f.kind === 'CustomProjectile' ? 'Projectiles' : f.kind === 'FoodShape' ? 'Shapes' : 'Others';
        let n = `${folder}/${safe(f.key)}.json`, k = 2;
        while (used.has(n.toLowerCase())) n = `${folder}/${safe(f.key)} ${k++}.json`;
        used.add(n.toLowerCase());
        zip.file(n, JSON.stringify(f.envelope, null, 2));
      }
    }
    post({ id: m.id, kind: 'progress', done: files.length, total: files.length, stage: 'zip' });
    const blob = await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob', compression: 'DEFLATE' });
    post({ id: m.id, kind: 'done', blob, name: m.zipName, problems, notConverted, count: files.length });
  } catch (e) {
    post({ id: m.id, kind: 'failed', error: (e as Error).message });
  }
};

interface Found { name: string; label: string; kind: string; envelope: any | null; json: string; notes: string[] }
const KIND: Record<string, string> = { tank: 'Tank', boss: 'Boss', projectile: 'Projectile', turret: 'Turret', other: 'Other' };
const NO_STEP = { seq: 0, delta: 0 };
const noFind = () => {};

let baseP: Promise<{ registry: Registry; gunvals: any; helpers: any }> | null = null;
function loadBase() {
  if (!baseP) {
    baseP = Promise.all(['osa-registry', 'osa-gunvals', 'osa-helpers'].map((n) => fetch(`/prebuilt/${n}.json`).then((r) => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('The OSA definitions could not be loaded'); return r.json(); })))
      .then(([reg, gunvals, helpers]) => ({ registry: buildRegistryFromJson(reg), gunvals, helpers }));
    baseP.catch(() => { baseP = null; });
  }
  return baseP;
}

function topClasses(names: string[], registry: Registry): string[] {
  const set = new Set(names);
  const objs = new Map<any, string>();
  for (const n of names) objs.set(registry.get(n), n);
  const used = new Set<string>();
  const seen = new Set<any>();
  const walk = (v: any, self: string, depth: number) => {
    if (v == null || depth > 12) return;
    if (typeof v === 'string') { if (v !== self && set.has(v)) used.add(v); return; }
    if (typeof v !== 'object') return;
    const o = objs.get(v);
    if (o && o !== self && depth > 0) { used.add(o); return; }
    if (seen.has(v)) return;
    seen.add(v);
    if (Array.isArray(v)) { for (const x of v) walk(x, self, depth + 1); return; }
    for (const k of Object.keys(v)) if (k !== 'PARENT' && k !== '_className') walk(v[k], self, depth + 1);
  };
  for (const n of names) { seen.clear(); walk(registry.get(n), n, 0); }
  return names.filter((n) => !used.has(n));
}

export const FromOsaPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const [found, setFound] = useState<Found[]>([]);
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(0);
  const [pickedName, setPickedName] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => { loadBase().catch(() => {}); }, []);

  const convert = useCallback(async (text: string, packClasses?: Record<string, any>) => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const base = await loadBase();
      let registry: Registry, names: string[];
      if (packClasses) {
        registry = new Map(base.registry);
        names = [];
        for (const [n, d] of Object.entries(packClasses)) { registry.set(n, { ...(d as any), _className: n }); names.push(n); }
      } else {
        const r = parseArrasUserCode(text, base.registry, base.gunvals, base.helpers);
        if (r.errors.length) { showToast('error', r.errors[0]); return; }
        registry = r.registry; names = r.newClassNames;
      }
      if (!names.length) { showToast('info', 'No new Class definitions were found. The code must set Class.name = { ... }'); return; }
      const tops = topClasses(names, registry);
      const out: Found[] = [];
      for (const n of tops) {
        const warn = new WarningCollector();
        const def: any = registry.get(n);
        try {
          const envelope = convertArrasClassToExport(n, registry, warn);
          out.push({ name: n, label: (def?.LABEL as string) || n, kind: KIND[classifyEntity(n, registry)] ?? 'Tank', envelope, json: JSON.stringify(envelope, null, 2), notes: warn.list().filter((w: any) => w.severity !== 'info').map((w: any) => w.message) });
        } catch (e) {
          out.push({ name: n, label: (def?.LABEL as string) || n, kind: 'Not converted', envelope: null, json: '', notes: [(e as Error).message] });
        }
      }
      setFound(out); setHidden(names.length - tops.length); setPickedName(out[0]?.name ?? null);
      showToast('success', `Found ${out.length} ${out.length === 1 ? 'class' : 'classes'}`);
    } catch (e) { showToast('error', (e as Error).message); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }, [showToast]);

  const readFiles = useCallback(async (list: (File | { file: File; path: string })[]) => {
    const texts: string[] = [];
    let pack: Record<string, any> | null = null;
    for (const it of list) {
      const file = it instanceof File ? it : it.file;
      const lower = file.name.toLowerCase();
      if (lower.endsWith('.zip')) {
        const JSZip = (await import('jszip')).default;
        const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(await file.arrayBuffer());
        for (const [p, e] of Object.entries(zip.files)) {
          const en = e as any;
          if (en.dir) continue;
          if (p.toLowerCase().endsWith('.js') && !p.toLowerCase().endsWith('istrong/istrong.js')) texts.push(await en.async('string'));
          else if (p.toLowerCase().endsWith('istrong.json')) { try { pack = { ...(pack ?? {}), ...JSON.parse(await en.async('string')).classes }; } catch { } }
        }
      } else if (lower.endsWith('.js')) texts.push(await file.text());
      else if (lower.endsWith('.json')) { try { const j = JSON.parse(await file.text()); if (j && j.classes) pack = { ...(pack ?? {}), ...j.classes }; } catch { } }
    }
    if (pack) { convert('', pack); return; }
    if (!texts.length) { showToast('info', 'No OSA code was found in those files (.js, a .zip of them, or an iStrong OSA addon)'); return; }
    const joined = texts.join('\n\n');
    setCode(joined);
    convert(joined);
  }, [convert, showToast]);
  const onDrop = useCallback((dt: DataTransfer) => { filesOfDrop(dt).then(readFiles); }, [readFiles]);

  const picked = useMemo(() => found.find((f) => f.name === pickedName) ?? null, [found, pickedName]);
  const good = found.filter((f) => f.envelope);
  const downloadAll = useCallback(() => {
    if (good.length === 1) { downloadText(`${fileSafe(good[0].label)}.json`, good[0].json, 'application/json'); return; }
    const used = new Set<string>();
    downloadZip('istrong-files.zip', good.map((f) => {
      let n = fileSafe(f.label), k = 2;
      while (used.has(n.toLowerCase())) n = `${fileSafe(f.label)} ${k++}`;
      used.add(n.toLowerCase());
      return { name: `${n}.json`, content: f.json };
    })).catch((e) => showToast('error', (e as Error).message));
  }, [good, showToast]);

  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex min-h-0">
      <input ref={fileRef} type="file" accept=".js,.json,.zip" multiple className="hidden" onChange={(e) => { const l = Array.from(e.target.files ?? []); e.target.value = ''; readFiles(l); }} />
      <DropZone enabled={!busy} onDrop={onDrop} className="w-[420px] shrink-0 border-r border-[var(--alpha-divider)] flex flex-col min-h-0 p-4 gap-3"
        label="Release files here" sub="OSA code (.js), a .zip of it, or an iStrong OSA addon">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="k-subhead flex-1">OSA code</span>
          <Button size="sm" icon={<Upload size={13} />} onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}>Open files</Button>
        </div>
        <textarea value={code} onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)} spellCheck={false}
          placeholder={'Paste Class code of Open Source Arras here, for example:\n\nClass.myTank = {\n    PARENT: "genericTank",\n    LABEL: "My Tank",\n    GUNS: [{\n        POSITION: [18, 8, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0],\n        PROPERTIES: { SHOOT_SETTINGS: combineStats([g.basic]), TYPE: "bullet" },\n    }],\n};'}
          className="k-field flex-1 min-h-0 resize-none font-mono text-[12px] leading-[1.5] p-3" />
        <Button variant="primary" block disabled={!code.trim() || busy} onClick={() => convert(code)}>{busy ? 'Converting' : 'Convert'}</Button>
      </DropZone>
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 flex min-h-0">
        <div className="w-[300px] shrink-0 border-r border-[var(--alpha-divider)] flex flex-col min-h-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 h-12 shrink-0 border-b border-[var(--alpha-divider)]">
            <span className="k-subhead flex-1">Classes <span className="k-count">{found.length}</span></span>
            <IconButton label="Download every converted file" onClick={downloadAll} disabled={!good.length}><Download size={16} /></IconButton>
            <IconButton label="Clear the list" onClick={() => { setFound([]); setPickedName(null); }} disabled={!found.length}><X size={16} /></IconButton>
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto popup-scrollbar p-3">
            {found.length === 0 ? <div className="h-full grid place-items-center"><EmptyState icon={emptyArt(HdFileManagement)} title="Nothing converted yet" /></div> : (
              <LongList count={found.length} rowKey={(i) => found[i].name} gap={6} estimate={52}
                renderRow={(i) => { const f = found[i]; return <PickRow title={f.label} selected={f.name === pickedName} onPick={() => setPickedName(f.name)} facts={[{ key: 'k', text: f.kind }]} />; }} />
            )}
            {hidden > 0 && <p className="k-row-desc mt-3">{hidden} more {hidden === 1 ? 'class is' : 'classes are'} part of the ones above (bullets, layers, auto turrets).</p>}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 overflow-y-auto popup-scrollbar p-4 space-y-3">
          <Group title={picked ? picked.label : 'iStrong file'} icon={headerIcon(FileJson)}
            right={picked?.envelope ? <Button size="sm" icon={<Download size={13} />} onClick={() => downloadText(`${fileSafe(picked.label)}.json`, picked.json, 'application/json')}>Download</Button> : undefined}>
            {!picked ? <p className="k-row-desc">Convert some code, then pick a class to see its iStrong file.</p> : (
              <>
                {picked.notes.length > 0 && <div className="mb-3 space-y-1">{picked.notes.slice(0, 12).map((n, i) => <p key={i} className="k-row-desc">{n}</p>)}</div>}
                {picked.json && <div className="h-[520px] rounded-lg border border-[var(--alpha-card-border)] overflow-hidden relative"><CodeView text={picked.json} lang="json" find="" step={NO_STEP} onFind={noFind} goLine={null} /></div>}
              </>
            )}
          </Group>
          <p className="k-row-desc flex items-center gap-1.5"><FileScript size={13} /> Open the file in iStrong with Import in the Content Library.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

async function envelopeOf(f: SourceFile): Promise<any> {
  if (f.envelope !== undefined) return f.envelope;
  const r = await fetch('/prebuilt/library/' + f.path!.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/'));
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`${f.name}: could not be loaded`);
  return r.json();
}

export const ToOsaPage: React.FC<{ handed: { files: SourceFile[]; at: number } | null; onLibrary: () => void }> = ({ handed, onLibrary }) => {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<SourceFile[]>([]);
  const [pickedId, setPickedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [output, setOutput] = useState<Output>('addon');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<{ id: string; text: string; notes: string[] } | null>(null);
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const folderRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const add = useCallback((more: SourceFile[], from: string) => {
    if (!more.length) return;
    setFiles((p) => { const have = new Set(p.map((f) => f.id)); return [...p, ...more.filter((f) => !have.has(f.id))]; });
    setPickedId((id) => id ?? more[0].id);
    showToast('success', `Added ${more.length} ${more.length === 1 ? 'file' : 'files'} ${from}`);
  }, [showToast]);
  const lastHanded = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => { if (handed && handed.at !== lastHanded.current) { lastHanded.current = handed.at; add(handed.files, 'from the library'); } }, [handed, add]);

  const read = useCallback(async (list: (File | { file: File; path: string })[]) => {
    const r = await readIstrongFiles(list);
    add(r.files, '');
    if (r.errors.length) showToast('info', r.errors.length === 1 ? r.errors[0] : `${r.errors.length} files were not iStrong files and were left out`);
  }, [add, showToast]);
  const onDrop = useCallback((dt: DataTransfer) => { filesOfDrop(dt).then(read); }, [read]);

  const remove = useCallback((f: SourceFile) => {
    const before = files;
    setFiles(files.filter((x) => x.id !== f.id));
    if (pickedId === f.id) setPickedId(null);
    showToast('info', `Removed ${f.name}`, { label: 'Undo', run: () => setFiles(before) });
  }, [files, pickedId, showToast]);
  const removeAll = useCallback(() => {
    const before = files;
    setFiles([]); setPickedId(null);
    showToast('info', `Removed ${before.length} files`, { label: 'Undo', run: () => setFiles(before) });
  }, [files, showToast]);

  const picked = useMemo(() => files.find((f) => f.id === pickedId) ?? null, [files, pickedId]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!picked) { setPreview(null); return; }
    let live = true;
    envelopeOf(picked).then((env) => {
      if (!live) return;
      const kind = kindOf(env);
      if (!hasClassCode(kind)) {
        setPreview({ id: picked.id, text: '', notes: [`A ${KIND_WORD[kind].toLowerCase()} goes out only in an OSA addon (its look is built there).`] });
        return;
      }
      const c = classCodeOf({ name: picked.name, key: picked.key, envelope: env, kind });
      setPreview({ id: picked.id, text: c.text, notes: c.warnings.filter((w) => w.severity !== 'info').map((w) => w.message) });
    }).catch((e) => { if (live) setPreview({ id: picked.id, text: '', notes: [(e as Error).message] }); });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [picked]);

  const download = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!files.length || busy) return;
    if (output === 'code' && files.length === 1 && preview?.id === files[0].id && preview.text) {
      downloadText(`${fileSafe(files[0].name)}.js`, preview.text, 'application/javascript');
      return;
    }
    setBusy('Starting');
    try {
      const menus = output === 'addon' ? await loadMenus() : null;
      const r = await runJob(output === 'addon'
        ? { job: 'addon', files, menus, zipName: 'istrong-osa-addon.zip' }
        : { job: 'code', files, zipName: 'istrong-class-code.zip' },
      (p) => setBusy(p.stage === 'read' ? `Reading ${p.done} of ${p.total}` : p.stage === 'convert' ? 'Converting' : 'Packing'));
      downloadBlob(r.name, r.blob);
      const left = r.notConverted.length + r.problems.length;
      showToast(left ? 'info' : 'success', left ? `Downloaded ${r.name}: ${left} ${left === 1 ? 'file' : 'files'} could not be converted` : `Downloaded ${r.name}`);
    } catch (e) { showToast('error', (e as Error).message); } finally { setBusy(null); }
  }, [files, busy, output, preview, showToast]);

  const inputs = (
    <>
      <input ref={fileRef} type="file" accept=".json,.zip" multiple className="hidden" onChange={(e) => { const l = Array.from(e.target.files ?? []); e.target.value = ''; read(l); }} />
      <input ref={folderRef} type="file" multiple className="hidden" {...({ webkitdirectory: '', directory: '' } as any)}
        onChange={(e) => { const l = Array.from(e.target.files ?? []); e.target.value = ''; read(l); }} />
    </>
  );

  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex min-h-0">
      {inputs}
      <DropZone enabled={!busy} onDrop={onDrop} className="w-[380px] shrink-0 border-r border-[var(--alpha-divider)] flex flex-col min-h-0"
        label="Release files here" sub="iStrong files (.json), a folder or a .zip">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 h-12 shrink-0 border-b border-[var(--alpha-divider)]">
          <span className="k-subhead flex-1">Files <span className="k-count">{files.length}</span></span>
          <IconButton label="Add files" onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}><Upload size={16} /></IconButton>
          <IconButton label="Add a folder" onClick={() => folderRef.current?.click()}><FolderOpen size={16} /></IconButton>
          <IconButton label="Pick from the Tank Library" onClick={onLibrary}><ContentLibraryIcon size={16} /></IconButton>
          <IconButton label="Remove every file" onClick={removeAll} disabled={!files.length}><Trash2 size={16} /></IconButton>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto popup-scrollbar p-3">
          {files.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="h-full grid place-items-center text-center">
              <div>
                <EmptyState icon={emptyArt(HdFileManagement)} title="No files yet" hint="Drop iStrong files here, add them, or pick them from the Tank Library." words />
                <div className="mt-4 flex justify-center gap-2">
                  <Button variant="primary" icon={<Upload size={14} />} onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}>Add files</Button>
                  <Button icon={<ContentLibraryIcon size={14} />} onClick={onLibrary}>Tank Library</Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <LongList count={files.length} rowKey={(i) => files[i].id} gap={6} estimate={52}
              renderRow={(i) => {
                const f = files[i];
                return <PickRow title={f.name} selected={f.id === pickedId} onPick={() => setPickedId(f.id)} facts={[{ key: 'k', text: KIND_WORD[f.kind] }]}
                  actions={<IconButton label={`Remove ${f.name}`} onClick={() => remove(f)}><X size={14} /></IconButton>} />;
              }} />
          )}
        </div>
      </DropZone>
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 flex flex-col min-h-0 overflow-y-auto popup-scrollbar p-4 space-y-3">
        <Group title="Output" icon={headerIcon(HdInboxDownload)}>
          <Segmented<Output> block value={output} onChange={setOutput} options={[
            { value: 'addon', label: 'OSA addon', title: 'A folder for server\\lib\\definitions\\entityAddons, with a menu to become every file' },
            { value: 'code', label: 'Class code', title: 'Plain Class definitions, one .js file a tank, turret or projectile' },
          ]} />
          <p className="k-row-desc mt-3">
            {output === 'addon'
              ? 'Unzip it into your Open Source Arras folder at server\\lib\\definitions\\entityAddons. Every tank, turret, projectile, food shape and Other is then in the developer menu, on the iStrong page.'
              : 'Each tank, turret or projectile as Class code you can paste into a definitions file of Open Source Arras. Food shapes and Others need the OSA addon.'}
          </p>
          <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3">
            <Button variant="primary" icon={<Download size={14} />} disabled={!files.length || !!busy} onClick={download}>
              {busy ?? (files.length > 1 || output === 'addon' ? 'Download .zip' : 'Download .js')}
            </Button>
            <span className="text-[12px] text-[var(--text-tertiary)]">{files.length ? `${files.length} ${files.length === 1 ? 'file' : 'files'}` : 'Add files first'}</span>
          </div>
        </Group>
        <Group title={picked ? picked.name : 'Preview'} icon={headerIcon(FileScript)}>
          {!picked ? <p className="k-row-desc">Pick a file to see its class code.</p> : (
            <>
              {preview && preview.id === picked.id && preview.notes.length > 0 && (
                <div className="mb-3 space-y-1">{preview.notes.slice(0, 12).map((n, i) => <p key={i} className="k-row-desc">{n}</p>)}</div>
              )}
              {preview && preview.id === picked.id && preview.text && (
                <div className="h-[460px] rounded-lg border border-[var(--alpha-card-border)] overflow-hidden relative">
                  <CodeView text={preview.text} lang="js" find="" step={NO_STEP} onFind={noFind} goLine={null} />
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </Group>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

    </button>
  );
}

import type { ArrasClassDef, Registry } from '../types/arras.js';
import { combineStats, weaponArray, ensureIsClass, makeConfigProxy } from './helpers.js';

export interface ParseArrasResult {
  registry: Registry;
  newClassNames: string[];
  errors: string[];
}

export function buildRegistryFromJson(registryJson: Record<string, ArrasClassDef>): Registry {
  const map = new Map<string, ArrasClassDef>();
  for (const [name, def] of Object.entries(registryJson)) {
    map.set(name, { ...def, _className: name });
  }
  return map;
}

export type OsaHelperSources = Record<string, string>;

export function parseArrasUserCode(
  userCode: string,
  baseRegistry: Registry,
  gunvals: Record<string, any>,
  helpers?: OsaHelperSources | null,
): ParseArrasResult {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  const ClassObj: Record<string, any> = {};
  for (const [name, def] of baseRegistry) {
    ClassObj[name] = def;
  }

  const before = new Set(Object.keys(ClassObj));
  const g: Record<string, any> = { ...gunvals };
  Object.defineProperty(g, 'g', { value: g, enumerable: false });
  const Config = makeConfigProxy();

  const util = {
    forcePush(obj: any, key: string, value: any) {
      if (!obj[key]) obj[key] = [];
      obj[key].push(value);
    },
    getJackpot: (x: number) => (x > 39450 ? Math.pow(x - 26300, 0.85) + 26300 : x / 1.5),
    getReversedJackpot: (x: number) => (x > 39450 ? Math.pow(x - 26300, 1.15) + 26300 : x * 1.5),
  };

  const modules: Record<string, any> = {};
  const helperFile = (p: string): string | null => {
    const base = p.split(/[\\/]/).pop()!.replace(/\.js$/, '') + '.js';
    return helpers && typeof helpers[base] === 'string' ? base : null;
  };
  const sandboxRequire = (p: string): any => {
    const file = helperFile(p);
    if (file === 'gunvals.js' || (!file && p.includes('gunvals'))) return g;
    if (file) {
      if (!(file in modules)) {
        const mod = { exports: {} as any };
        modules[file] = mod.exports;
        const run = new Function('module', 'exports', 'require', 'Class', 'ensureIsClass', 'Config', 'util', helpers![file]!);
        run(mod, mod.exports, sandboxRequire, ClassObj, (s: any) => ensureIsClass(ClassObj, s), Config, util);
        modules[file] = mod.exports;
      }
      return modules[file];
    }
    if (p.includes('facilitators')) return { combineStats, weaponArray };
    return {};
  };

  const consoleStub = { log: () => {}, warn: () => {}, error: () => {} };

  try {
    const wrapped = `
      var module = { exports: {} };
      var exports = module.exports;
      {
      ${userCode}
      }
      return module.exports;
    `;
    const fn = new Function('Class', 'g', 'combineStats', 'weaponArray', 'ensureIsClass', 'Config', 'require', 'util', 'console', 'Math', 'JSON', 'Array', 'Object', 'String', 'Number', 'Boolean', 'parseInt', 'parseFloat', 'isNaN', 'isFinite', 'Infinity', 'NaN', 'key', wrapped);
    fn(
      ClassObj,
      g,
      combineStats,
      weaponArray,
      (s: any) => ensureIsClass(ClassObj, s),
      Config,
      sandboxRequire,
      util,
      consoleStub,
      Math, JSON, Array, Object, String, Number, Boolean,
      parseInt, parseFloat, isNaN, isFinite,
      Infinity, NaN,
      (name: string) => String.fromCharCode(1) + name + String.fromCharCode(1),
    );
  } catch (e) {
    errors.push(friendlyParseError(e as Error));
  }

  const newClassNames: string[] = [];
  for (const name of Object.keys(ClassObj)) {
    if (!before.has(name) && ClassObj[name] && typeof ClassObj[name] === 'object') {
      ClassObj[name]._className = name;
      newClassNames.push(name);
    }
  }

  const mergedRegistry = new Map<string, ArrasClassDef>();
  for (const [name, def] of Object.entries(ClassObj)) {
    if (def && typeof def === 'object') {
      mergedRegistry.set(name, def as ArrasClassDef);
    }
  }

  return { registry: mergedRegistry, newClassNames, errors };
}

export function detectClassesInPaste(text: string): string[] {
  const matches: string[] = [];
  const re = /Class\.([A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)\s*=/g;
  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(text)) !== null) {
    if (!matches.includes(m[1]!)) matches.push(m[1]!);
  }
  return matches;
}

const MAX_ERROR_TEXT = 140;

export function friendlyParseError(err: Error): string {
  const raw = (err.message || String(err)).trim();
  if (/is not defined/.test(raw)) {
    const m = raw.match(/^(.+?)\s+is not defined/);
    const identifier = m && m[1] ? m[1].trim() : 'identifier';
    const short = identifier.length > 32 ? identifier.slice(0, 32) + '...' : identifier;
    return `Undefined identifier: ${short}. Make sure all referenced classes, gun presets, and helpers exist in the bundled arras source.`;
  }
  if (/Unexpected (token|identifier|end)/.test(raw)) {
    const head = raw.length > MAX_ERROR_TEXT ? raw.slice(0, MAX_ERROR_TEXT) + '...' : raw;
    return `Syntax error: ${head}`;
  }
  if (/is not a function/.test(raw)) {
    const m = raw.match(/^(.+?)\s+is not a function/);
    const fn = m && m[1] ? m[1].trim() : 'value';
    const short = fn.length > 32 ? fn.slice(0, 32) + '...' : fn;
    return `Not a function: ${short}. Likely a missing helper or incorrect call.`;
  }
  if (raw.length > MAX_ERROR_TEXT) return raw.slice(0, MAX_ERROR_TEXT) + '...';
  return raw;
}
import { GUN_STAT_KEYS, DEFAULT_GUN_STATS } from '../constants/gunStats.js';
import type { GunStats } from '../constants/gunStats.js';

export function combineStats(arr: any): GunStats {
  const out: any = { ...DEFAULT_GUN_STATS };
  if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return out;
  for (const k of GUN_STAT_KEYS) {
    let val = 1;
    for (const obj of arr) {
      if (obj && typeof obj === 'object' && typeof obj[k] === 'number') {
        val *= obj[k];
      }
    }
    out[k] = val;
  }
  return out;
}

export function weaponArray(angles: number[] | number, basePosition: number[]): any[] {
  const list: number[] = Array.isArray(angles) ? angles : (typeof angles === 'number' ? [angles] : []);
  const out: any[] = [];
  for (const a of list) {
    const pos = [...basePosition];
    pos[5] = a;
    out.push({ POSITION: pos });
  }
  return out;
}

export function ensureIsClass(Class: Record<string, any>, str: any): any {
  if (typeof str === 'object') return str;
  if (str in Class) return Class[str];
  return { LABEL: str, _className: typeof str === 'string' ? str : undefined };
}

export function makeConfigProxy(): any {
  return new Proxy({}, {
    get: (_target, prop) => {
      if (prop === 'spawn_class') return 'basic';
      if (prop === 'LEVEL_CAP') return 45;
      if (prop === 'SKILL_CAP') return 9;
      if (prop === 'TIER_CAP') return 9;
      if (prop === 'TIER_MULT') return 15;
      if (prop === 'level_cap') return 45;
      if (prop === 'skill_cap') return 9;
      if (prop === 'tier_multiplier') return 15;
      return undefined;
    }
  });
}

}

import type { ArrasClassEmit } from '../types/warnings.js';

const INDENT = '    ';

function quoteKey(key: string): string {
  if (/^[a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*$/.test(key)) return key;
  return JSON.stringify(key);
}

function formatNumber(n: number): string {
  if (!isFinite(n)) return 'null';
  if (Number.isInteger(n)) return String(n);
  const fixed = n.toFixed(6);
  return parseFloat(fixed).toString();
}

function serialize(value: any, depth: number): string {
  const pad = INDENT.repeat(depth);
  const childPad = INDENT.repeat(depth + 1);

  if (value === null || value === undefined) return 'null';
  if (typeof value === 'string') return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (typeof value === 'number') return formatNumber(value);
  if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value ? 'true' : 'false';

  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    if (value.length === 0) return '[]';
    const isNumericArray = value.every(v => typeof v === 'number');
    if (isNumericArray && value.length <= 8) {
      return '[' + value.map(formatNumber).join(', ') + ']';
    }
    const parts = value.map(v => childPad + serialize(v, depth + 1));
    return '[\n' + parts.join(',\n') + '\n' + pad + ']';
  }

  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    const keys = Object.keys(value);
    if (keys.length === 0) return '{}';
    const parts = keys.map(k => `${childPad}${quoteKey(k)}: ${serialize(value[k], depth + 1)}`);
    return '{\n' + parts.join(',\n') + '\n' + pad + '}';
  }

  return JSON.stringify(value);
}

export function emitArrasJS(cls: ArrasClassEmit): string {
  const body: Record<string, any> = {};
  const skipKeys = new Set(['className']);
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(cls)) {
    if (skipKeys.has(key)) continue;
    if (value === undefined) continue;
    body[key] = value;
  }
  const rendered = serialize(body, 0);
  return `Class.${cls.className} = ${rendered};\n`;
}

export function emitArrasJSBundle(classes: ArrasClassEmit[]): string {
  return classes.map(emitArrasJS).join('\n');
}
import type { ArrasClassEmit } from '../types/warnings.js';

export function emitArrasJSON(cls: ArrasClassEmit): string {
  const body: Record<string, any> = {};
  const skipKeys = new Set(['className']);
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(cls)) {
    if (skipKeys.has(key)) continue;
    if (value === undefined) continue;
    body[key] = value;
  }
  return JSON.stringify({ [cls.className]: body }, null, 2);
}

export function emitArrasJSONBundle(classes: ArrasClassEmit[]): string {
  const obj: Record<string, any> = {};
  for (const cls of classes) {
    const body: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(cls)) {
      if (key === 'className' || value === undefined) continue;
      body[key] = value;
    }
    obj[cls.className] = body;
  }
  return JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2);
}
import type { ReverseResult } from '../types/warnings.js';
import { emitArrasJS } from './jsEmitter.js';
import { emitArrasJSON } from './jsonEmitter.js';

export interface BundledFiles {
  js: Record<string, string>;
  json: Record<string, string>;
}

export function bundleReverseResult(result: ReverseResult): BundledFiles {
  const js: Record<string, string> = {};
  const json: Record<string, string> = {};

  const primaryName = result.primary.className;
  js[`${primaryName}.js`] = emitArrasJS(result.primary);
  json[`${primaryName}.json`] = emitArrasJSON(result.primary);

  for (const dep of result.dependencies) {
    js[`${dep.className}.js`] = emitArrasJS(dep);
    json[`${dep.className}.json`] = emitArrasJSON(dep);
  }

  return { js, json };
}
export function alphaIsCapped(alpha: unknown): boolean {
  if (!Array.isArray(alpha)) return false;
  const max = alpha[1];
  return typeof max === 'number' && max > 0 && max < 1;
}

export function alphaIsFixedBelowOne(alpha: unknown): boolean {
  return typeof alpha === 'number' && alpha > 0 && alpha < 1;
}
