function deepClone(value: any): any {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return value;
  if (typeof value !== 'object') return value;
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(deepClone);
  const out: Record<string, any> = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(value)) {
    out[k] = deepClone((value as any)[k]);
  }
  return out;
}

export function collectTankArrasOnly(classDef: ArrasClassDef | undefined): Record<string, any> | undefined {
  if (!classDef || typeof classDef !== 'object') return undefined;
  const out: Record<string, any> = {};
  let hasAny = false;
  for (const key of Object.keys(classDef)) {
    if (key.startsWith('_')) continue;
    if (MAPPED_TANK_KEYS.has(key)) continue;
    out[key] = deepClone((classDef as any)[key]);
    hasAny = true;
  }
  const body = (classDef as any).BODY;
  if (body && typeof body === 'object' && !Array.isArray(body)) {
    const unmappedBody: Record<string, any> = {};
    let hasBody = false;
    for (const bKey of Object.keys(body)) {
      if (bKey.startsWith('_')) continue;
      if (MAPPED_BODY_KEYS.has(bKey)) continue;
      unmappedBody[bKey] = deepClone(body[bKey]);
      hasBody = true;
    }
    if (hasBody) {
      out.BODY = unmappedBody;
      hasAny = true;
    }
  }
  if ((classDef as any).COLOR === -1) {
    out.COLOR = -1;
    hasAny = true;
  }
  return hasAny ? out : undefined;
}

export function collectGunArrasOnly(properties: Record<string, any> | undefined): Record<string, any> | undefined {
  if (!properties || typeof properties !== 'object') return undefined;
  const out: Record<string, any> = {};
  let hasAny = false;
  for (const key of Object.keys(properties)) {
    if (key.startsWith('_')) continue;
    if (MAPPED_GUN_PROPERTIES.has(key)) continue;
    out[key] = deepClone(properties[key]);
    hasAny = true;
  }
  return hasAny ? out : undefined;
}

export function collectProjectileArrasOnly(classDef: ArrasClassDef | undefined): Record<string, any> | undefined {
  if (!classDef || typeof classDef !== 'object') return undefined;
  const out: Record<string, any> = {};
  let hasAny = false;
  for (const key of Object.keys(classDef)) {
    if (key.startsWith('_')) continue;
    if (MAPPED_PROJECTILE_KEYS.has(key)) continue;
    out[key] = deepClone((classDef as any)[key]);
    hasAny = true;
  }
  const body = (classDef as any).BODY;
  if (body && typeof body === 'object' && !Array.isArray(body)) {
    const unmappedBody: Record<string, any> = {};
    let hasBody = false;
    for (const bKey of Object.keys(body)) {
      if (bKey.startsWith('_')) continue;
      if (MAPPED_BODY_KEYS.has(bKey)) continue;
      unmappedBody[bKey] = deepClone(body[bKey]);
      hasBody = true;
    }
    if (hasBody) {
      out.BODY = unmappedBody;
      hasAny = true;
    }
  }
  if ((classDef as any).COLOR === -1) {
    out.COLOR = -1;
    hasAny = true;
  }
  return hasAny ? out : undefined;
}
const CONTROLLER_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  'nearestDifferentMaster': 'autoTargetEnemy',
  'canRepel': 'canRepel',
  'mapTargetToGoal': 'followMouse',
  'hangOutNearMaster': 'hangNearOwner',
  'alwaysFire': 'alwaysFire',
  'targetSelf': 'targetSelf',
  'spin': 'spinContinuous',
  'avoid': 'avoid',
  'minion': 'minionControl',
  'boomerang': 'returnToOwner',
  'formulaTarget': 'formulaTarget',
  'moveInCircles': 'patrolCircle',
  'fleeAtLowHealth': 'fleeWhenDamaged',
  'snake': 'snake',
  'snakeSwing': 'snake',
  'goToMasterTarget': 'goToTarget',
  'mapAltToFire': 'mapAltToFire',
  'scaleWithMaster': 'scaleWithMaster',
  'stackGuns': 'stackGuns',
  'disableOnOverride': 'disableOnOverride',
  'healTeamMasters': 'autoTargetEnemy',
  'reverseSpin': 'spinContinuous',
  'spin2': 'reverseSpinOnAlt',
  'listenToPlayer': 'followMouse',
};

export interface BehaviorConfig {
  type: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  [key: string]: any;
}

export function mapControllers(controllers: any[] | undefined): BehaviorConfig[] {
  if (!controllers || !Array.isArray(controllers)) return [];

  const behaviors: BehaviorConfig[] = [];

  for (const ctrl of controllers) {
    let name: string;
    let options: any = {};

    if (typeof ctrl === 'string') {
      name = ctrl;
    } else if (Array.isArray(ctrl)) {
      name = ctrl[0];
      options = ctrl[1] || {};
    } else {
      continue;
    }

    const iStrongType = CONTROLLER_MAP[name];
    if (!iStrongType) continue;

    if (behaviors.some(b => b.type === iStrongType)) continue;

    const config: BehaviorConfig = {
      type: iStrongType,
      enabled: true,
      acceptsFromTop: true,
      responseLag: 0.1,
      maxTurnRate: 360,
      predictionStrength: 50,
      targetRange: 0,
      orbitRadius: 100,
      orbitSpeed: 1.5,
      returnSpeed: 1.5,
      maxDistance: 400,
      cohesion: 0.5,
      separation: 0.3,
      alignment: 0.4,
      spinSpeed: 3,
      targetPriority: 'nearest',
      snakeAmplitude: 150,
      snakePeriod: 5,
      snakeInvert: false,
      snakeYOffset: 0,
      snakeAngle: 0,
      formulaDivisor: 4,
    };

    if (name === 'spin' || name === 'reverseSpin') {
      const rawSpeed = options.speed ?? options.SPEED;
      if (rawSpeed !== undefined) {
        const signed = name === 'reverseSpin' ? -rawSpeed : rawSpeed;
        config.spinSpeed = signed * 30;
      }
    }

    if (name === 'minion') config.orbitRadius = options.turnwiserange ?? 140;
    if (options.radius !== undefined) config.orbitRadius = options.radius;
    if (options.SPEED !== undefined) config.orbitSpeed = options.SPEED;
    if (options.speed !== undefined && name !== 'spin' && name !== 'reverseSpin') {
      config.orbitSpeed = options.speed;
    }

    if (name === 'snakeSwing') {
      if (options.onAlt === true) config.snakeOnAlt = true;
      if (options.swing !== undefined) config.snakeSwing = options.swing;
      if (options.rate !== undefined) config.snakeRate = options.rate;
      if (options.delay !== undefined) config.snakeDelay = options.delay;
      if (options.invert !== undefined) config.snakeInvert = !!options.invert;
    }

    if (name === 'snake') {
      if (options.amplitude !== undefined) config.snakeAmplitude = options.amplitude;
      if (options.period !== undefined) config.snakePeriod = options.period;
      if (options.invert !== undefined) config.snakeInvert = !!options.invert;
      if (options.yOffset !== undefined) config.snakeYOffset = options.yOffset;
      if (options.angle !== undefined) config.snakeAngle = options.angle;
    }

    if (name === 'formulaTarget' && options.divisor !== undefined) {
      config.formulaDivisor = options.divisor;
    }

    if (options.speed !== undefined && (name === 'mapTargetToGoal' || name === 'goToMasterTarget' || name === 'boomerang')) {
      config.returnSpeed = options.speed;
    }

    behaviors.push(config);
  }

  return behaviors;
}

export function mapStatCalculator(calc: string | number | undefined): string {
  if (calc === undefined || calc === null || calc === 0 || calc === 'default') return 'bullet';
  if (typeof calc === 'string') {
    switch (calc) {
      case 'drone': return 'drone';
      case 'trap': case 'block': return 'trap';
      case 'swarm': return 'swarm';
      case 'thruster': return 'thruster';
      case 'necro': return 'necro';
      case 'sustained': return 'sustained';
      case 'sustained+lowspeed': return 'sustainedLowspeed';
      case 'fixedReload': return 'fixedReload';
      default: return 'bullet';
    }
  }
  return 'bullet';
}

    case 'motor': return 'motor';
    case 'chase': return 'chase';
    case 'swarm': return 'swarm';

  }
}

export function mapFacingType(arras: any): string {
  if (!arras) return 'toTarget';
  const name = typeof arras === 'string' ? arras : (Array.isArray(arras) ? arras[0] : 'toTarget');
  switch (name) {
    case 'toTarget': return 'toTarget';
    case 'smoothToTarget': return 'smoothToTarget';
    case 'smoothWithMotion': return 'smoothWithMotion';
    case 'turnWithSpeed': return 'turnWithSpeed';
    case 'spin': return 'spin';
    case 'fastspin': return 'spin';
    case 'veryfastspin': return 'spin';
    case 'locksFacing': return 'locksFacing';
    case 'looseWithMotion': return 'smoothWithMotion';
    case 'withMotion': return 'smoothWithMotion';
    case 'autospin': return 'spin';
    case 'bound': return 'toTarget';
    default: return 'toTarget';
  }
}
import type { ArrasClassDef, Registry } from '../types/arras.js';

const MERGE_OBJECT_KEYS = new Set(['BODY', 'SHOOT_SETTINGS', 'PROPERTIES', 'STAT_NAMES']);

function resolveParentChain(name: string, registry: Registry, visited: Set<string> = new Set()): ArrasClassDef[] {
  if (visited.has(name)) return [];
  visited.add(name);
  const def = registry.get(name);
  if (!def) return [];
  const chain: ArrasClassDef[] = [def];
  const parent = def.PARENT;
  if (typeof parent === 'string') {
    chain.push(...resolveParentChain(parent, registry, visited));
  } else if (Array.isArray(parent)) {
    for (const p of parent) {
      if (typeof p === 'string') {
        chain.push(...resolveParentChain(p, registry, visited));
      }
    }
  }
  return chain;
}

export function resolveFlat(name: string, registry: Registry): ArrasClassDef {
  const chain = resolveParentChain(name, registry).reverse();
  const merged: any = {};
  for (const def of chain) {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(def)) {
      if (k.startsWith('_')) continue;
      if (MERGE_OBJECT_KEYS.has(k) && v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v)) {
        merged[k] = { ...(merged[k] ?? {}), ...v };
      } else if (v !== undefined) {
        merged[k] = v;
      }
    }
  }
  merged._className = name;
  return merged as ArrasClassDef;
}

export function resolveField<T = any>(name: string, registry: Registry, field: string): T | undefined {
  const chain = resolveParentChain(name, registry);
  for (const def of chain) {
    if ((def as any)[field] !== undefined) return (def as any)[field] as T;
  }
  return undefined;
}

function isInTurretChain(name: string, registry: Registry, visited: Set<string> = new Set()): boolean {
  if (visited.has(name)) return false;
  visited.add(name);
  if (name === 'autoTurret') return true;
  const def = registry.get(name);
  if (!def) return false;
  const p = def.PARENT;
  if (typeof p === 'string') return isInTurretChain(p, registry, visited);
  if (Array.isArray(p)) {
    for (const s of p) {
      if (typeof s === 'string' && isInTurretChain(s, registry, visited)) return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

export function classifyEntity(name: string, registry: Registry): 'tank' | 'boss' | 'projectile' | 'turret' | 'other' {
  const flat = resolveFlat(name, registry);
  const parent = flat.PARENT;
  const parentStr = typeof parent === 'string' ? parent : (Array.isArray(parent) ? (typeof parent[0] === 'string' ? parent[0] : '') : '');

  if (parentStr === 'genericBoss' || parentStr.includes('Boss')) return 'boss';
  if (['bullet', 'drone', 'swarm', 'trap', 'minion', 'hive', 'boomerang'].includes(parentStr)) return 'projectile';
  if (isInTurretChain(name, registry)) return 'turret';
  if (parentStr === 'genericTank' || parentStr.includes('Tank')) return 'tank';

  const ent = registry.get(parentStr);
  if (ent) return classifyEntity(parentStr, registry);

  if (flat.GUNS || flat.TURRETS) return 'tank';
  return 'other';
}

export function detectProjectileVisual(typeName: string, registry: Registry): string {
  const flat = resolveFlat(typeName, registry);
  const directType = (flat as any).TYPE;
  if (typeof directType === 'string') {
    const lower = directType.toLowerCase();
    if (['bullet', 'drone', 'swarm', 'trap', 'minion', 'hive', 'boomerang'].includes(lower)) return lower;
  }
  let cur: string | undefined = typeName;
  const visited = new Set<string>();
  while (cur && !visited.has(cur)) {
    visited.add(cur);
    if (cur === 'bullet' || cur === 'drone' || cur === 'swarm' || cur === 'trap' || cur === 'minion' || cur === 'hive' || cur === 'boomerang') {
      return cur;
    }
    const def = registry.get(cur);
    if (!def) break;
    const p = def.PARENT;
    cur = typeof p === 'string' ? p : (Array.isArray(p) && typeof p[0] === 'string' ? p[0] : undefined);
  }
  return 'bullet';
}
import { ARRAS_COLORS, ARRAS_COLOR_SLOTS } from '../constants/colors.js';

export function resolveColor(color: any): string {
  if (color === undefined || color === null) return '#a7a7af';
  if (color === -1) return 'inherit';
  if (typeof color === 'number') {
    return ARRAS_COLORS[color] ?? '#a7a7af';
  }
  if (typeof color === 'string') {
    if (color.startsWith('#')) return color;
    if (ARRAS_COLORS[color]) return ARRAS_COLORS[color];
    const parts = color.split(' ');
    if (parts.length >= 1) {
      const base = isNaN(Number(parts[0])) ? parts[0] : Number(parts[0]);
      return ARRAS_COLORS[base] ?? '#a7a7af';
    }
    return '#a7a7af';
  }
  if (typeof color === 'object' && color.BASE !== undefined) {
    return resolveColor(color.BASE);
  }
  return '#a7a7af';
}

export function isTeamDefaultColor(color: any): boolean {
  if (color === undefined || color === null || color === -1 || color === 'mirror') return true;
  let base: any, hue: any, sat: any, bright: any, invert: any;
  if (typeof color === 'number') {
    base = color;
  } else if (typeof color === 'string') {
    const parts = color.trim().split(/\s+/);
    base = parts[0]; hue = parts[1]; sat = parts[2]; bright = parts[3]; invert = parts[4];
  } else if (typeof color === 'object') {
    base = color.BASE ?? color.base ?? 16;
    hue = color.HUE_SHIFT ?? color.hueShift;
    sat = color.SATURATION_SHIFT ?? color.saturationShift;
    bright = color.BRIGHTNESS_SHIFT ?? color.brightnessShift;
    invert = color.ALLOW_BRIGHTNESS_INVERT ?? color.allowBrightnessInvert;
  } else {
    return false;
  }
  const baseStr = String(base).trim();
  if (baseStr === '-1' || baseStr === 'mirror') return true;
  if (baseStr !== '16') return false;
  if (hue !== undefined && Number(hue) !== 0) return false;
  if (sat !== undefined && Number(sat) !== 1) return false;
  if (bright !== undefined && Number(bright) !== 0) return false;
  if (invert !== undefined && String(invert) !== 'false') return false;
  return true;
}

export function colorSlotOf(color: any): number | undefined {
  if (color === undefined || color === null) return undefined;
  let base: any, hue: any, sat: any, bright: any, invert: any;
  if (typeof color === 'string') {
    const parts = color.trim().split(/\s+/);
    base = parts[0]; hue = parts[1]; sat = parts[2]; bright = parts[3]; invert = parts[4];
  } else if (typeof color === 'object') {
    base = color.BASE ?? color.base;
    hue = color.HUE_SHIFT ?? color.hueShift;
    sat = color.SATURATION_SHIFT ?? color.saturationShift;
    bright = color.BRIGHTNESS_SHIFT ?? color.brightnessShift;
    invert = color.ALLOW_BRIGHTNESS_INVERT ?? color.allowBrightnessInvert;
  } else {
    return undefined;
  }
  if (typeof base !== 'string') return undefined;
  if (hue !== undefined && Number(hue) !== 0) return undefined;
  if (sat !== undefined && Number(sat) !== 1) return undefined;
  if (bright !== undefined && Number(bright) !== 0) return undefined;
  if (invert !== undefined && String(invert) !== 'false') return undefined;
  return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ARRAS_COLOR_SLOTS, base) ? ARRAS_COLOR_SLOTS[base] : undefined;
}

export const RAMMER_RING_SLOT: number = ARRAS_COLOR_SLOTS.black!;

export function getEntityColor(colorVal: any, defaultColor: string = '#3ca4cb'): string {
  const resolved = resolveColor(colorVal);
  return resolved === 'inherit' ? defaultColor : resolved;
}
export const EXPLODE_MAX_COUNT = 32;
export const EXPLODE_MAX_RINGS = 8;
export const START_DEG_MIN = -180, START_DEG_MAX = 180, ARC_DEG_MIN = 1, ARC_DEG_MAX = 360;
export const EVEN_TOL_DEG = 0.01;

export function explodeAngleDeg(count: number, startDeg: number, arcDeg: number, i: number): number {
  if (count <= 1) return startDeg;
  if (arcDeg >= 360) return startDeg + (360 / count) * i;
  return startDeg - arcDeg / 2 + (arcDeg / (count - 1)) * i;
}

export interface DeathGun {
  angleDeg: number; x: number; y: number;
  template: any;
}
export interface BurstRing { count: number; startDeg: number; arcDeg: number; fragment: any }
export interface DeathBurst { enabled: true; anyDeath: true; rings: BurstRing[] }

const turn = (d: number) => { const a = ((d % 360) + 360) % 360; return a >= 360 - 1e-9 ? 0 : a; };
const signed = (d: number) => { const a = turn(d); return a > 180 ? a - 360 : a; };
const r6 = (v: number) => Math.round(v * 1e6) / 1e6;

function pieceKey(template: any): string {
  const strip = (o: any, top: boolean): any => {
    if (o === null || typeof o !== 'object') return o;
    if (Array.isArray(o)) return o.map((x) => strip(x, false));
    const out: any = {};
    for (const k of Object.keys(o).sort()) {
      if (k === 'id' || k === 'primarySubTurretId' || k === 'primaryTurretId') continue;
      if (top && (k === 'angle' || k === 'xOffset' || k === 'yOffset')) continue;
      out[k] = strip(o[k], false);
    }
    return out;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(strip(template, true));
}

function ringsOfAngles(angles: readonly number[], templateOf: (i: number) => any): BurstRing[] {
  const fragmentOf = (i: number) => ({ ...templateOf(i), angle: 0 });
  const n = angles.length;
  if (n === 1) return [{ count: 1, startDeg: r6(signed(angles[0])), arcDeg: 360, fragment: fragmentOf(0) }];
  const order = angles.map((a, i) => ({ a: turn(a), i })).sort((p, q) => p.a - q.a);
  const gaps = order.map((p, k) => (k + 1 < n ? order[k + 1].a : order[0].a + 360) - p.a);
  const even = 360 / n;
  if (gaps.every((g) => Math.abs(g - even) <= EVEN_TOL_DEG)) {
    return [{ count: n, startDeg: r6(signed(order[0].a)), arcDeg: 360, fragment: fragmentOf(order[0].i) }];
  }
  let widest = 0; for (let k = 1; k < n; k++) if (gaps[k] > gaps[widest]) widest = k;
  const first = (widest + 1) % n;
  const fan: number[] = []; let at = order[first].a; fan.push(at);
  for (let k = 0; k < n - 1; k++) { at += gaps[(first + k) % n]; fan.push(at); }
  const step = (fan[n - 1] - fan[0]) / (n - 1);
  const arc = fan[n - 1] - fan[0];
  const steady = fan.every((v, k) => Math.abs(v - (fan[0] + step * k)) <= EVEN_TOL_DEG);
  if (steady && arc >= ARC_DEG_MIN && arc < ARC_DEG_MAX) {
    return [{ count: n, startDeg: r6(signed(fan[0] + arc / 2)), arcDeg: r6(arc), fragment: fragmentOf(order[first].i) }];
  }
  return order.map((p) => ({ count: 1, startDeg: r6(signed(p.a)), arcDeg: 360, fragment: fragmentOf(p.i) }));
}

export function burstOfDeathGuns(guns: readonly DeathGun[], who: string): DeathBurst {
  if (guns.length === 0) throw new Error(`deathBurst: ${who}: no death gun given`);
  for (const g of guns) {
    if (Math.abs(g.x) > 1e-9 || Math.abs(g.y) > 1e-9) {
      throw new Error(`deathBurst: ${who}: a death gun sits off the round's middle (X ${g.x}, Y ${g.y}); the game's pieces appear at the middle, so this cannot be written. Not guessed.`);
    }
  }
  const groups: { key: string; idx: number[] }[] = [];
  guns.forEach((g, i) => { const key = pieceKey(g.template); const at = groups.find((x) => x.key === key); if (at) at.idx.push(i); else groups.push({ key, idx: [i] }); });
  const rings: BurstRing[] = [];
  for (const grp of groups) rings.push(...ringsOfAngles(grp.idx.map((i) => guns[i].angleDeg), (k) => guns[grp.idx[k]].template));
  if (rings.length > EXPLODE_MAX_RINGS) throw new Error(`deathBurst: ${who}: ${rings.length} rings, the game holds ${EXPLODE_MAX_RINGS}. Not cut.`);
  for (const r of rings) {
    if (r.count < 1 || r.count > EXPLODE_MAX_COUNT) throw new Error(`deathBurst: ${who}: a ring of ${r.count} pieces, the game holds 1 to ${EXPLODE_MAX_COUNT}. Not cut.`);
    if (r.startDeg < START_DEG_MIN || r.startDeg > START_DEG_MAX || r.arcDeg < ARC_DEG_MIN || r.arcDeg > ARC_DEG_MAX) throw new Error(`deathBurst: ${who}: ring ${JSON.stringify({ startDeg: r.startDeg, arcDeg: r.arcDeg })} lies outside what the game's load keeps`);
  }
  const want = guns.map((g) => turn(g.angleDeg)).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const got: number[] = [];
  for (const r of rings) for (let i = 0; i < r.count; i++) got.push(turn(explodeAngleDeg(r.count, r.startDeg, r.arcDeg, i)));
  got.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const off = (a: number, b: number) => { const d = Math.abs(a - b); return d > 180 ? 360 - d : d; };
  if (got.length !== want.length || got.some((a, i) => off(a, want[i]) > EVEN_TOL_DEG)) {
    throw new Error(`deathBurst: ${who}: the rings give ${JSON.stringify(got.map(r6))} where arras points its guns at ${JSON.stringify(want.map(r6))}`);
  }
  return { enabled: true, anyDeath: true, rings };
}

export function applyExhaustRule(tankConfig: any, className: string, launcherFamily: Set<string>, isV2Dreadnought: boolean): number {
  const inLauncher = launcherFamily.has(className);
  if (!inLauncher && !isV2Dreadnought) return 0;
  const want = isV2Dreadnought ? false : true;
  let changed = 0;
  const seen = new Set<any>();
  const walk = (o: any): void => {
    if (!o || typeof o !== 'object' || seen.has(o)) return;
    seen.add(o);
    if (Array.isArray(o)) { for (const x of o) walk(x); return; }
    const riders = o.customProjectileDesign?.turrets;
    if (Array.isArray(riders)) {
      for (const g of riders) {
        if (!g || g.turretType === 'auto' || g.turretType === 'decorative' || !g.projectileType) continue;
        if (g.projectileType.persistsAfterDeath !== want) { g.projectileType.persistsAfterDeath = want; changed++; }
      }
    }
    for (const k of Object.keys(o)) walk(o[k]);
  };
  walk(tankConfig);
  return changed;
}

const SMASHER_STAT_NAMES_OVERRIDES = new Set<string>(['bob', 'nemesis']);
export function detectStatNamesType(statNames: any, className?: string): string {
  if (className && SMASHER_STAT_NAMES_OVERRIDES.has(className)) return 'smasher';
  if (!statNames || typeof statNames !== 'object') return 'generic';
  const reload = statNames.RELOAD;
  const speed = statNames.BULLET_SPEED;
  if (reload === 'Max Drone Count') return 'necro';
  if (reload === 'Respawn Rate') return 'drone';
  if (reload === 'Engine Acceleration') return 'smasher';
  if (speed === 'Placement Speed') return 'trap';
  if (speed === 'Swarm Speed') return 'swarm';
  if (speed === 'Weapon Speed') return 'mixed';
  if (speed === 'Drone Speed') return 'drone';
  return 'generic';
}

function camelToTitle(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/^./, c => c.toUpperCase()).replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

function buildSkillCaps(arrasCap: any): IstrongSkillCaps {
  const out: any = {
    reload: 9,
    bulletPenetration: 9,
    bulletHealth: 9,
    bulletDamage: 9,
    bulletSpeed: 9,
    shieldCapacity: 9,
    bodyDamage: 9,
    maxHealth: 9,
    shieldRegen: 9,
    movementSpeed: 9,
  };
  if (Array.isArray(arrasCap)) {
    for (let i = 0; i < SKCNV_ORDER.length; i++) {
      const v = arrasCap[i];
      if (typeof v === 'number') out[SKCNV_ORDER[i]!] = v;
    }
  }
  return out as IstrongSkillCaps;
}

function buildPreDefinedSkills(arrasSkill: any): Record<string, number> | undefined {
  if (!Array.isArray(arrasSkill)) return undefined;
  const out: Record<string, number> = {};
  let hasAny = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < SKCNV_ORDER.length; i++) {
    const v = arrasSkill[i];
    if (typeof v === 'number') {
      out[SKCNV_ORDER[i]!] = v;
      hasAny = true;
    }
  }
  return hasAny ? out : undefined;
}

export function convertArrasClassToTank(
  className: string,
  registry: Registry,
  warn?: WarningCollector,
): ExportFile<TankData> {
  const w = warn ?? new WarningCollector();
  resetTurretIdCounter();
  resetSharedTurretIds();

  const flat = resolveFlat(className, registry);
  const kind = classifyEntity(className, registry);

  const body = flat.BODY ?? {};
  const healthWithLevel = (flat as any).HEALTH_WITH_LEVEL !== false;
  const tankHP = convertBodyHP(body.HEALTH ?? 20, healthWithLevel);
  const tankShield = convertShieldCapacity(body.SHIELD ?? 0, healthWithLevel);

  const layered = detectLayeredBoss(className, registry);
  const rawClass = registry.get(className);
  const bodySlot = colorSlotOf(flat.COLOR);

  const arrasGuns = Array.isArray(flat.GUNS) ? flat.GUNS : [];
  const arrasTurrets = Array.isArray(flat.TURRETS) ? flat.TURRETS : [];
  const rcFamilies = rightClickFamiliesOf(registry);
  const nexumMade = !!(rawClass as any)?._iStrongMeta;
  const _measuredSIZE = nexumMade ? undefined : measuredBodySize(className);
  const tankArrasSize = _measuredSIZE !== undefined ? _measuredSIZE * 2 : ((flat.SIZE as number | undefined) ?? 12) * (entityLevelsUp(flat as Record<string, unknown>) ? 2 : 1);
  const tankMount: AutoTurretMount = { size: tankArrasSize, dreadBody: isDreadnoughtV2Class(rawClass, registry) };

  let turrets: IstrongTurret[];
  let bodyLayersOut: any[] = [];
  let layeredTankSides: number | undefined;
  let layeredTankColor: string | undefined;
  let layeredBaseSpin: { enabled: boolean; speed: number; direction: 1 | -1 } | undefined;

  const plates = readPlates(flat, rawClass, registry, tankArrasSize, (guns, autos, size, color) => {
    const g = mapGuns(guns, registry, 0, undefined, size) as IstrongTurret[];
    applyRightClickFamilies(className, g, rcFamilies, makeBehavior);
    if (!nexumMade) applyMeasuredFlight(className, g);
    if (!nexumMade) applyMeasuredRounds(className, g);
    return [...g, ...mapAutoTurrets(autos, registry, color, 0, { size, dreadBody: tankMount.dreadBody })];
  });

  if (plates) {
    turrets = plates.turrets as IstrongTurret[];
    bodyLayersOut = plates.bodyLayers;
    const mf = plates.mainBody ? (plates.mainBody as any).FACING_TYPE : undefined;
    if (plates.mainBody) {
      const spin = Array.isArray(mf) && mf[0] === 'spin' && typeof mf[1]?.speed === 'number' ? mf[1].speed : null;
      layeredBaseSpin = spin === null
        ? { enabled: false, speed: 50, direction: 1 }
        : { enabled: true, speed: Math.round(Math.abs(spin) * ARRAS_SPIN_MULTIPLIER), direction: spin >= 0 ? 1 : -1 };
    }
  } else if (layered.isLayered) {
    const mainGuns = mapGuns(arrasGuns, registry, 0, undefined, tankArrasSize);
    applyRightClickFamilies(className, mainGuns, rcFamilies, makeBehavior);
    if (!nexumMade) applyMeasuredFlight(className, mainGuns);
    if (!nexumMade) applyMeasuredRounds(className, mainGuns);
    const outerAuto = mapAutoTurrets(arrasTurrets, registry, flat.COLOR as any, 0, tankMount);
    const outerTurretIds: string[] = [...mainGuns.map((t: any) => t.id), ...outerAuto.map((t: any) => t.id)];

    turrets = [...mainGuns, ...outerAuto] as IstrongTurret[];

    const innermost = layered.innermost!;
    const innermostSize = innermost.arrasSize;
    const outerSizeRatio = innermostSize > 0 ? 20 / innermostSize : 1;

    const outerColor = getEntityColor(flat.COLOR as any, '#3ca4cb');
    const firstInner = layered.layers[0]!;

    const outerBodyLayer: any = {
      id: 'layer-boss-body',
      label: 'Outer Body',
      sides: typeof flat.SHAPE === 'number' ? Math.abs(flat.SHAPE) : 0,
      sizeRatio: outerSizeRatio,
      color: outerColor,
      colorMap: bodySlot,
      useInheritColor: true,
      spinEnabled: true,
      spinDirection: (firstInner.spinDirection === 1 ? -1 : 1) as 1 | -1,
      spinSpeed: firstInner.spinSpeed,
      copies: 1,
      initialAngle: 0,
      starDepth: 0,
      starCurved: false,
      intangible: false,
      showHealerCross: false,
      stationary: false,
      turretIds: outerTurretIds,
      renderOrder: 0,
      maxAliveEnabled: ((flat as any).MAX_CHILDREN ?? 0) > 0,
      maxAlive: (flat as any).MAX_CHILDREN ?? 0,
      _currentAngle: 0,
    };
    applyOuterBodyLayerMeta(outerBodyLayer, rawClass as any);
    bodyLayersOut.push(outerBodyLayer);

    for (let i = 0; i < layered.layers.length - 1; i++) {
      const layer = layered.layers[i]!;
      const flatLayer = resolveFlat(layer.layerName, registry);
      const layerArrasSize = tankArrasSize * layer.arrasSize / 20;
      const layerGuns = mapGuns(Array.isArray(flatLayer.GUNS) ? flatLayer.GUNS : [], registry, 0, undefined, layerArrasSize);
      applyRightClickFamilies(className, layerGuns, rcFamilies, makeBehavior);
      if (!nexumMade) applyMeasuredFlight(className, layerGuns);
      const layerAuto = mapAutoTurrets(Array.isArray(flatLayer.TURRETS) ? flatLayer.TURRETS : [], registry, layer.color, 0, { size: layerArrasSize, dreadBody: tankMount.dreadBody });
      const layerTurretIds = [...layerGuns.map((t: any) => t.id), ...layerAuto.map((t: any) => t.id)];

      for (const lt of layerGuns) turrets.push(lt as IstrongTurret);
      for (const lt of layerAuto) turrets.push(lt as IstrongTurret);

      const layerSlot = colorSlotOf(layer.color);
      const innerBodyLayer: any = {
        id: `layer-${i + 1}`,
        label: `Layer ${String.fromCharCode(65 + i)}`,
        sides: layer.shape,
        sizeRatio: innermostSize > 0 ? layer.arrasSize / innermostSize : 1,
        color: getEntityColor(layer.color, '#3ca4cb'),
        colorMap: layerSlot,
        useInheritColor: layer.colorInherit || (layerSlot !== undefined && layerSlot === bodySlot),
        spinEnabled: true,
        spinDirection: layer.spinDirection,
        spinSpeed: layer.spinSpeed,
        copies: 1,
        initialAngle: 0,
        starDepth: 0,
        starCurved: false,
        intangible: false,
        showHealerCross: layer.hasHealerSymbol,
        stationary: false,
        turretIds: layerTurretIds,
        renderOrder: i + 1,
        maxAliveEnabled: layer.maxChildren > 0,
        maxAlive: layer.maxChildren,
        _currentAngle: 0,
      };
      applyBodyLayerMeta(innerBodyLayer, layer.layerClass as any);
      bodyLayersOut.push(innerBodyLayer);
    }

    const flatInner = resolveFlat(innermost.layerName, registry);
    const innerArrasSize = tankArrasSize * innermost.arrasSize / 20;
    const innerGuns = mapGuns(Array.isArray(flatInner.GUNS) ? flatInner.GUNS : [], registry, 0, undefined, innerArrasSize);
    applyRightClickFamilies(className, innerGuns, rcFamilies, makeBehavior);
    if (!nexumMade) applyMeasuredFlight(className, innerGuns);
    const innerAuto = mapAutoTurrets(Array.isArray(flatInner.TURRETS) ? flatInner.TURRETS : [], registry, innermost.color, 0, { size: innerArrasSize, dreadBody: tankMount.dreadBody });
    for (const lt of innerGuns) turrets.push(lt as IstrongTurret);
    for (const lt of innerAuto) turrets.push(lt as IstrongTurret);

    layeredTankSides = innermost.shape;
    layeredTankColor = outerColor;
    if (innermost.hasExplicitSpin) {
      layeredBaseSpin = {
        enabled: true,
        speed: innermost.spinSpeed,
        direction: innermost.spinDirection,
      };
    }

    if ((flat as any).HAS_NO_RECOIL === true) {
      for (const t of turrets) {
        (t as any).knockback = 0;
        if ((t as any).autoSubTurrets) {
          for (const sub of (t as any).autoSubTurrets) sub.knockback = 0;
        }
      }
    }
  } else {
    turrets = mapGuns(arrasGuns, registry, 0, undefined, tankArrasSize) as IstrongTurret[];
    applyRightClickFamilies(className, turrets, rcFamilies, makeBehavior);
    if (!nexumMade) applyMeasuredFlight(className, turrets);
    if (!nexumMade) applyMeasuredRounds(className, turrets);
    const mainGunCount = turrets.length;

    const autoTurrets = mapAutoTurrets(arrasTurrets, registry, flat.COLOR as any, 0, tankMount);
    for (const at of autoTurrets) turrets.push(at);

    if (mainGunCount > 0 && autoTurrets.length > 0) {
      const hasLayer0Auto = autoTurrets.some((at: any) => at.turretType === 'auto' && (at.renderLayer ?? 0) === 0);
      if (hasLayer0Auto) {
        for (let gi = 0; gi < mainGunCount; gi++) {
          if ((turrets[gi].renderLayer ?? 0) === 0) {
            turrets[gi].renderLayer = 1;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if ((flat as any).HAS_NO_RECOIL === true) {
      for (const t of turrets) {
        (t as any).knockback = 0;
        if ((t as any).autoSubTurrets) {
          for (const sub of (t as any).autoSubTurrets) sub.knockback = 0;
        }
      }
    }

    bodyLayersOut = buildSmasherBodyLayers(arrasTurrets, registry);
  }

  const skillCaps = buildSkillCaps((flat as any).SKILL_CAP);
  const preDefinedSkills = buildPreDefinedSkills(flat.SKILL);
  if (preDefinedSkills && Object.values(preDefinedSkills).some(v => v > 0)) {
    for (const k of Object.keys(skillCaps) as (keyof typeof skillCaps)[]) {
      if ((skillCaps as any)[k] > 9) { (skillCaps as any)[k] = 9; if (typeof preDefinedSkills[k as string] === 'number') preDefinedSkills[k as string] = Math.min(preDefinedSkills[k as string]!, 9); }
    }
  }
  const isBoss = kind === 'boss';
  const canEarnSkillPoints = !preDefinedSkills && !isBoss;

  const bonusSkillPoints = typeof (flat as any).EXTRA_SKILL === 'number'
    ? (flat as any).EXTRA_SKILL
    : (isBoss ? 0 : 42);

  const directFacingType = (rawClass as any)?.FACING_TYPE;
  const rawBaseSpinEnabled = Array.isArray(directFacingType) && directFacingType[0] === 'spin';
  const rawBaseSpinSpeed = rawBaseSpinEnabled && typeof directFacingType[1]?.speed === 'number'
    ? Math.round(Math.abs(directFacingType[1].speed) * ARRAS_SPIN_MULTIPLIER)
    : 50;
  const rawBaseSpinDirection: 1 | -1 = rawBaseSpinEnabled && typeof directFacingType[1]?.speed === 'number'
    ? (directFacingType[1].speed >= 0 ? 1 : -1)
    : 1;
  const baseSpinEnabled = layeredBaseSpin ? layeredBaseSpin.enabled : rawBaseSpinEnabled;
  const baseSpinSpeed = layeredBaseSpin ? layeredBaseSpin.speed : rawBaseSpinSpeed;
  const baseSpinDirection: 1 | -1 = layeredBaseSpin ? layeredBaseSpin.direction : rawBaseSpinDirection;

  const controllers = Array.isArray((flat as any).CONTROLLERS) ? (flat as any).CONTROLLERS : [];
  if (controllers.some((c: any) => (typeof c === 'string' ? c : (Array.isArray(c) ? c[0] : '')) === 'canRepel')) {
    for (const t of turrets) if ((t as any).autoSubTurrets && (t as any).autoSubTurrets.length > 0) (t as any).manualControl = true;
  }
  let cameraZoomEnabled = false;
  let cameraZoomDistance = 225;
  const useCustomAimDirection = true;
  let customAimAngle = 0;
  for (const c of controllers) {
    const name = typeof c === 'string' ? c : (Array.isArray(c) ? c[0] : '');
    const opts = Array.isArray(c) ? (c[1] ?? {}) : {};
    if (name === 'zoom') {
      cameraZoomEnabled = true;
      if (typeof opts.distance === 'number') cameraZoomDistance = opts.distance;
    }
    if (name === 'fixedDirection') {
      if (typeof opts.angle === 'number') customAimAngle = opts.angle;
    }
  }

  const displayName = (flat as any).NAME || flat.LABEL || camelToTitle(className);
  const colorDefault = isBoss ? '#a7a7af' : '#3ca4cb';
  const rawTankColor = (flat.COLOR === undefined || flat.COLOR === null || flat.COLOR === -1)
    ? colorDefault
    : getEntityColor(flat.COLOR, colorDefault);
  const tankColor = layeredTankColor ?? rawTankColor;

  const rawTankSides = typeof flat.SHAPE === 'number' ? Math.abs(flat.SHAPE) : 0;
  const tankSides = layeredTankSides ?? rawTankSides;
  const tankShapeDepth = layered.isLayered
    ? 0
    : ((typeof flat.SHAPE === 'number' && flat.SHAPE < 0)
        ? 6 / (Math.abs(flat.SHAPE) * Math.abs(flat.SHAPE))
        : 0);

  turrets = mergeRestoredLooks(turrets) as IstrongTurret[];
  const data: TankData = {
    _configVersion: 5,
    tankSides,
    tankShapeDepth,
    tankShapeCurved: false,
    tankSize: _measuredSIZE !== undefined ? convertTankSize(_measuredSIZE, true) : convertTankSize(flat.SIZE ?? 12, entityLevelsUp(flat as Record<string, unknown>)),
    tankColor,
    tankColorMap: bodySlot,
    keepOwnColor: isTeamDefaultColor(flat.COLOR) ? undefined : true,
    chargeAI: ['eliteGunner', 'deltaGunner', 'gunnerLegion'].includes(className) ? true : undefined,
    arenaCloserAI: className === 'arenaCloser' ? true : undefined,
    tankHP,
    tankBodyDamage: convertBodyDamage(body.DAMAGE ?? 3),
    tankMovementSpeed: convertDrivenSpeed(body.SPEED ?? 5.25, typeof body.ACCELERATION === 'number' ? body.ACCELERATION : 1.6),
    tankPushShare: convertPushShare(body.SPEED ?? 5.25, typeof body.ACCELERATION === 'number' ? body.ACCELERATION : 1.6),
    tankShieldRegen: convertShieldRegen(body.REGEN ?? 0.01),
    tankShieldCapacity: tankShield,
    fovMultiplier: convertFOV(body.FOV ?? 1.02),
    turrets,
    maxSkillPoints: 42,
    maxPointsPerSkill: 9,
    bonusSkillPoints,
    skillCaps,
    canEarnSkillPoints,
    preDefinedSkills,
    primaryTurretId: turrets.find(t => t.turretType !== 'decorative')?.id ?? null as any,
    useCustomAimDirection,
    customAimAngle,
    cameraZoomEnabled,
    cameraZoomDistance,
    mirrorMode: false,
    autoPlacement: false,
    autoPlacementCount: 2,
    snapPlacement: false,
    snapPlacementCount: 4,
    baseSpinEnabled,
    baseSpinSpeed,
    baseSpinDirection,
    tankPushability: convertPushability(body.PUSHABILITY),
    tankResistBase: typeof body.RESIST === 'number' && body.RESIST !== 1 ? body.RESIST : undefined,
    tankPenetrationBase: typeof body.PENETRATION === 'number' && body.PENETRATION !== 1.05 ? body.PENETRATION : undefined,
    globalMaxAliveEnabled: typeof (flat as any).MAX_CHILDREN === 'number' && (flat as any).MAX_CHILDREN > 0,
    globalMaxAlive: (flat as any).MAX_CHILDREN ?? 0,
    statNamesType: detectStatNamesType((flat as any).STAT_NAMES, className),
    isSmasher: (flat as any).IS_SMASHER ?? undefined,
    isHealer: (flat as any).HEALING_TANK ? true : undefined,

    ignoresWalls: (flat as any).ARENA_CLOSER === true ? true : undefined,
    showHealthBar: (flat as any).DRAW_HEALTH === false ? false : undefined,

    bodyLayers: bodyLayersOut.length > 0 ? bodyLayersOut : undefined,
  };

  const rawInvisible = (flat as any).INVISIBLE;
  if (Array.isArray(rawInvisible)) {
    (data as any).invisible = {
      fadeInRate: (rawInvisible[0] ?? 0.08) / 2,
      fadeOutRate: (rawInvisible[1] ?? 0.03) / 2,
    };
    if (alphaIsCapped((flat as any).ALPHA)) (data as any).invisible.always = true;
  } else if (!rawInvisible && alphaIsFixedBelowOne((flat as any).ALPHA)) {
    (data as any).invisible = { fadeInRate: 0.04, fadeOutRate: 0.015, always: true };
  }

  const arrasOnly = collectTankArrasOnly(rawClass);
  if (arrasOnly) data._arrasOnly = arrasOnly;

  applyExhaustRule(data, className, launcherFamilyOfRegistry(registry), isDreadnoughtV2Class(rawClass, registry));
  applyStartsLoadedRule(data, className, underseerFamilyOfRegistry(registry), makeBehavior);
  applyTankMeta(data as any, rawClass as any);

  return {
    version: '1.0.0',
    type: 'Tank',
    name: displayName,
    timestamp: Date.now(),
    category: kind === 'boss' ? 'Bosses' : 'Tanks',
    source: 'nexum-upload',
    data,
  };
}

export function convertArrasClassToExport(
  className: string,
  registry: Registry,
  warn?: WarningCollector,
): AnyIstrongEnvelope {
  const kind = classifyEntity(className, registry);
  if (kind === 'turret') return convertArrasClassToTurretPreset(className, registry, warn);
  if (kind === 'projectile') return convertArrasClassToCustomProjectile(className, registry, warn);
  return convertArrasClassToTank(className, registry, warn);
}

import type { ExportFile, CustomProjectileData } from '../types/istrong.js';

import { WarningCollector } from '../warnings/collector.js';
import type { DeathBurst } from './deathBurst.js';

function camelToTitle(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/^./, c => c.toUpperCase()).replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

export function convertArrasClassToCustomProjectile(
  className: string,
  registry: Registry,
  warn?: WarningCollector,
): ExportFile<CustomProjectileData> {
  const w = warn ?? new WarningCollector();
  resetSharedTurretIds();

  const flat = resolveFlat(className, registry);
  const visual = detectProjectileVisual(className, registry);

  let shape = typeof flat.SHAPE === 'number' ? Math.abs(flat.SHAPE) : shapeForVisual(visual);
  let trapDepth = 0;
  if (typeof flat.SHAPE === 'number' && flat.SHAPE < 0) {
    const absShape = Math.abs(flat.SHAPE);
    shape = absShape;
    trapDepth = 6 / (absShape * absShape);
  } else if (visual === 'trap') {
    trapDepth = shape === 3 ? 0.67 : (shape === 4 ? 0.38 : 0.15);
  }

  const bodySize = (flat.BODY as any)?.SIZE;
  const size = typeof bodySize === 'number' ? bodySize : 1;

  const useTankColor = flat.COLOR === undefined || flat.COLOR === null || flat.COLOR === -1;
  const color = useTankColor
    ? 'inherit'
    : getEntityColor(flat.COLOR as any, '#3ca4cb');

  const resolvedMotionType = resolveField(flat, 'MOTION_TYPE', registry);
  const resolvedFacingType = resolveField(flat, 'FACING_TYPE', registry);
  const motion = resolvedMotionType
    ? mapMotionType(typeof resolvedMotionType === 'string' ? resolvedMotionType : (Array.isArray(resolvedMotionType) ? resolvedMotionType[0] : 'glide'))
    : motionForVisual(visual);
  const facing = resolvedFacingType
    ? mapFacingType(resolvedFacingType)
    : facingForVisual(visual);

  const controllers = resolveControllers(flat, registry);
  let hasGoToTarget = false;
  if (controllers) {
    for (const c of controllers) {
      const cName = typeof c === 'string' ? c : (Array.isArray(c) ? c[0] : '');
      if (cName === 'goToMasterTarget' || cName === 'goToTarget') {
        hasGoToTarget = true;
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  const displayName = PROJECTILE_NAME_OVERRIDES[className]
    ?? (flat as any).NAME
    ?? flat.LABEL
    ?? camelToTitle(className);

  const burst: { explode?: DeathBurst } = {};
  const cpd = buildCustomProjectileDesign(
    flat,
    registry,
    visual,
    shape,
    motion,
    facing,
    trapDepth,
    hasGoToTarget,
    size,
    0,
    undefined,
    undefined,
    burst,
  );
  if (burst.explode) {
    const pieces = burst.explode.rings.reduce((n, r) => n + r.count, 0);
    w.info('SHOOT_ON_DEATH', `"${className}" bursts into ${pieces} piece(s) when it dies. A projectile file cannot carry a burst: it lives on the barrel that fires the projectile. Convert the tank or the turret that fires it to keep the burst.`, { original: pieces });
  }

  const data: CustomProjectileData = cpd
    ? { ...cpd, name: displayName, category: 'Projectiles' }
    : {
        name: displayName,
        category: 'Projectiles',
        visual,
        shape,
        size,
        color,
        useTankColor,
        useMuzzleSize: true,
        motionType: motion,
        facingType: facing,
        growRate: 1,
      };

  return {
    version: '1.0.0',
    type: 'CustomProjectile',
    name: displayName,
    timestamp: Date.now(),
    category: 'Projectiles',
    source: 'nexum-upload',
    data,
  };
}
import type { Registry } from '../types/arras.js';
import type { ExportFile, TurretPresetData, IstrongTurret } from '../types/istrong.js';

import { resetSharedTurretIds } from './turretMapperHelpers.js';
import { resetTurretIdCounter } from './turretMapperBasic.js';
import { WarningCollector } from '../warnings/collector.js';

function camelToTitle(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/^./, c => c.toUpperCase()).replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

export function convertArrasClassToTurretPreset(
  className: string,
  registry: Registry,
  warn?: WarningCollector,
): ExportFile<TurretPresetData> {
  const w = warn ?? new WarningCollector();
  void w;
  resetTurretIdCounter();
  resetSharedTurretIds();

  const flat = resolveFlat(className, registry);
  const arrasGuns = Array.isArray(flat.GUNS) ? flat.GUNS : [];
  const turrets: IstrongTurret[] = mapGuns(arrasGuns, registry, 0) as IstrongTurret[];

  const arrasTurrets = Array.isArray(flat.TURRETS) ? flat.TURRETS : [];
  const autoTurrets = mapAutoTurrets(arrasTurrets, registry, flat.COLOR as any, 0);
  for (const at of autoTurrets) turrets.push(at as IstrongTurret);

  const displayName = (flat as any).NAME || flat.LABEL || camelToTitle(className);

  const primOverride = PRIMARY_SUB_TURRET_OVERRIDES[className];
  const primaryIndex = primOverride !== undefined && primOverride >= 1 && primOverride <= turrets.length
    ? primOverride - 1
    : undefined;

  return {
    version: '1.0.0',
    type: 'TurretPreset',
    name: displayName,
    timestamp: Date.now(),
    category: 'Turrets',
    source: 'nexum-upload',
    data: {
      name: displayName,
      category: 'Turrets',
      primaryIndex,
      turrets,
    },
  };
}
import {
  ISTRONG_META_KEY,
  ISTRONG_INLINE_PROJECTILE_KEY,
  ISTRONG_OUTER_BODY_KEY,
  META_FIELD_KEYS,
  type IstrongTankMeta,
  type IstrongTurretMeta,
  type IstrongProjectileMeta,
  type IstrongBodyLayerMeta,
} from '../types/istrongMeta.js';

function readMeta(
  source: Record<string, any> | null | undefined,
  key: string = ISTRONG_META_KEY,
): Record<string, any> | undefined {
  if (!source || typeof source !== 'object') return undefined;
  const raw = source[key];
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return undefined;
  return raw;
}

function applyMeta<K extends string>(
  target: Record<string, any>,
  meta: Record<string, any> | undefined,
  keys: ReadonlyArray<K>,
): boolean {
  if (!meta) return false;
  let applied = false;
  for (const k of keys) {
    const v = meta[k];
    if (v === undefined || v === null) continue;
    target[k] = v;
    applied = true;
  }
  return applied;
}

export function readTankMeta(source: Record<string, any> | null | undefined): IstrongTankMeta | undefined {
  const m = readMeta(source);
  return m as IstrongTankMeta | undefined;
}

export function applyTankMeta(target: Record<string, any>, source: Record<string, any> | null | undefined): boolean {
  const m = readMeta(source);
  return applyMeta(target, m, META_FIELD_KEYS.tank);
}

export function applyTurretMeta(target: Record<string, any>, source: Record<string, any> | null | undefined): boolean {

}

export function applyProjectileMeta(target: Record<string, any>, source: Record<string, any> | null | undefined): boolean {

import type { Registry, ArrasClassDef } from '../types/arras.js';
import { resolveFlat } from './classResolver.js';

const ARRAS_OUTER_BODY_SIZE = 20;
const SPIN_MULT = 2500 / 3;

export interface LayeredBossLayer {
  layerName: string;
  layerIndex: number;
  arrasSize: number;
  shape: number;
  color: any;
  colorInherit: boolean;
  spinSpeed: number;
  spinDirection: 1 | -1;
  hasExplicitSpin: boolean;
  maxChildren: number;
  layerClass: ArrasClassDef;
  hasHealerSymbol: boolean;
}

export interface LayeredBossDetection {
  isLayered: boolean;
  mainClassName: string;
  layers: LayeredBossLayer[];
  innermost: LayeredBossLayer | null;
}

function readLayerArrasSize(mainTurrets: any[] | undefined, layerName: string): number {
  if (!Array.isArray(mainTurrets)) return ARRAS_OUTER_BODY_SIZE;
  for (const t of mainTurrets) {
    const tType = typeof t.TYPE === 'string'
      ? t.TYPE
      : (Array.isArray(t.TYPE) ? t.TYPE[0] : null);
    if (tType === layerName && Array.isArray(t.POSITION)) {
      return t.POSITION[0] ?? ARRAS_OUTER_BODY_SIZE;
    }
  }
  return ARRAS_OUTER_BODY_SIZE;
}

function detectHealerSymbol(layerDef: ArrasClassDef): boolean {
  const ts = (layerDef as any).TURRETS;
  if (!Array.isArray(ts)) return false;
  for (const td of ts) {
    const tn = typeof td.TYPE === 'string' ? td.TYPE : (Array.isArray(td.TYPE) ? td.TYPE[0] : '');
    if (tn === 'healerSymbol') return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function detectLayeredBoss(mainClassName: string, registry: Registry): LayeredBossDetection {
  const mainClass = registry.get(mainClassName);
  if (!mainClass) {
    return { isLayered: false, mainClassName, layers: [], innermost: null };
  }
  const flat = resolveFlat(mainClassName, registry);
  const mainTurrets: any[] = Array.isArray(flat.TURRETS) ? flat.TURRETS : [];

  const layers: LayeredBossLayer[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= 10; i++) {
    const layerName = `${mainClassName}Layer${i}`;
    const layerDef = registry.get(layerName);
    if (!layerDef) break;

    const arrasSize = readLayerArrasSize(mainTurrets, layerName);
    const rawColor = (layerDef as any).COLOR;

    let spinSpeed = 50;
    let spinDirection: 1 | -1 = (i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1);
    let hasExplicitSpin = false;
    const ft = (layerDef as any).FACING_TYPE;
    if (Array.isArray(ft) && ft[0] === 'spin') {
      const sp = ft[1]?.speed;
      if (typeof sp === 'number') {
        spinDirection = sp >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
        spinSpeed = Math.min(500, Math.round(Math.abs(sp) * SPIN_MULT));
        hasExplicitSpin = true;
      }
    }

    layers.push({
      layerName,
      layerIndex: i,
      arrasSize,
      shape: typeof (layerDef as any).SHAPE === 'number' ? (layerDef as any).SHAPE : 0,
      color: rawColor,
      colorInherit: rawColor === -1,
      spinSpeed,
      spinDirection,
      hasExplicitSpin,
      maxChildren: typeof (layerDef as any).MAX_CHILDREN === 'number' ? (layerDef as any).MAX_CHILDREN : 0,
      layerClass: layerDef as ArrasClassDef,
      hasHealerSymbol: detectHealerSymbol(layerDef as ArrasClassDef),
    });
  }

  if (layers.length === 0) {
    return { isLayered: false, mainClassName, layers: [], innermost: null };
  }

  return {
    isLayered: true,
    mainClassName,
    layers,
    innermost: layers[layers.length - 1]!,
  };
}
import { convertTankBarrelSpeed } from './physicsCalibrator.js';

export interface MeasuredFlight {
  speed: number;
  lifetime: number;
  reload?: number;
  trail?: readonly (MeasuredTrail | null)[];
}

export interface MeasuredTrail {
  speed: number;
  top: number;
  lifetime: number;
}

export const MEASURED_FLIGHT: Readonly<Record<string, MeasuredFlight>> = Object.freeze({
  sidewinder: Object.freeze({ speed: 177, lifetime: 4, reload: 1.947, trail: Object.freeze([
    Object.freeze({ speed: 48.5, top: 48.5, lifetime: 1.9 }),
    Object.freeze({ speed: 27, top: 110, lifetime: 2.4 }),
  ]) }),
});

export const MEASURE_WINDOW_WIDTH = 2560;
const ENGINE_REF_VIEW = 275 * Math.sqrt((24 + (9 - 1) / 9 * 24) / 2);

export function engineSpeedSliderFor(unitsPerSecond: number): number {
  const movementZoom = MEASURE_WINDOW_WIDTH / ENGINE_REF_VIEW;
  return unitsPerSecond * movementZoom / 60 - 5;
}

export function engineRoundBarrelSliderFor(unitsPerSecond: number): number {
  const movementZoom = MEASURE_WINDOW_WIDTH / ENGINE_REF_VIEW;
  return unitsPerSecond * movementZoom / (60 * 2.25);
}

function ownBarrelsOf(turret: any): any[] | null {
  const cpd = turret?.projectileType?.customProjectileDesign;
  return cpd && Array.isArray(cpd.turrets) && cpd.turrets.length > 0 ? cpd.turrets : null;
}

function setNumber(obj: any, key: string, value: number): boolean {
  if (obj[key] === value) return false;
  obj[key] = value;
  return true;
}

export function applyMeasuredFlight(className: string, turrets: any[]): number {
  const m = MEASURED_FLIGHT[className];
  if (!m) return 0;
  let changed = 0;
  for (const t of turrets) {
    if (!t || t.turretType === 'decorative') continue;
    const own = ownBarrelsOf(t);
    if (!own) continue;
    let touched = false;
    if (setNumber(t, 'speed', engineSpeedSliderFor(m.speed))) touched = true;
    if (setNumber(t.projectileType, 'topSpeedRatio', 1)) touched = true;
    if (setNumber(t, 'bulletLifetime', m.lifetime)) touched = true;
    if (typeof t.projectileType.lifetime === 'number' && t.projectileType.lifetime > 0) {
      if (setNumber(t.projectileType, 'lifetime', m.lifetime)) touched = true;
    }
    if (typeof m.reload === 'number' && m.reload > 0) {
      if (setNumber(t, 'bps', 1 / m.reload)) touched = true;
    }
    let barrel = -1;
    for (const sub of own) {
      if (!sub || sub.turretType === 'decorative') continue;
      barrel++;
      const tr = m.trail ? m.trail[barrel] : null;
      if (tr && sub.projectileType) {
        if (setNumber(sub, 'speed', engineRoundBarrelSliderFor(tr.speed))) touched = true;
        if (setNumber(sub.projectileType, 'topSpeedRatio', tr.top / tr.speed)) touched = true;
        if (setNumber(sub, 'bulletLifetime', tr.lifetime)) touched = true;
        if (typeof sub.projectileType.lifetime === 'number' && sub.projectileType.lifetime > 0) {
          if (setNumber(sub.projectileType, 'lifetime', tr.lifetime)) touched = true;
        }
      }
      if (typeof sub.knockback === 'number' && sub.knockback > 0) { sub.knockback = 0; touched = true; }
    }
    if (touched) changed++;
  }
  return changed;
}

export interface MeasuredBullet { launch: number; cruise: number; }
export const MEASURED_BASIC_BULLET: Readonly<MeasuredBullet> = Object.freeze({ launch: 284.5, cruise: 257.1 });
export const MEASURED_BULLET: Readonly<Record<string, MeasuredBullet>> = Object.freeze({
  sniper: Object.freeze({ launch: 346.8, cruise: 308.1 }),
  assassin: Object.freeze({ launch: 377.4, cruise: 338.7 }),
  ranger: Object.freeze({ launch: 379.0, cruise: 339.1 }),
  stalker: Object.freeze({ launch: 381.3, cruise: 339.2 }),
});
const BASIC_SPEED_STAT = 5, BASIC_TOP_RATIO = 0.75;

export interface MeasuredDrone { sizeOverTank: number; topSpeedFactor: number; }
export const MEASURED_DRONE: Readonly<Record<string, MeasuredDrone>> = Object.freeze({
  director: Object.freeze({ sizeOverTank: 7.4375 / 24.125, topSpeedFactor: 0.9 }),
});
const widthOfSlider = (slider: number) => slider * 20 * 0.96 / 50;

export function applyMeasuredRounds(className: string, turrets: any[]): number {
  const mb = MEASURED_BULLET[className], md = MEASURED_DRONE[className];
  if (!mb && !md) return 0;
  let changed = 0;
  for (const t of turrets) {
    if (!t || t.turretType === 'decorative' || !(t.bps > 0) || !t.projectileType) continue;
    const visual = t.projectileType.visual;
    let touched = false;
    if (mb && visual === 'bullet' && !ownBarrelsOf(t)) {
      const L = mb.launch / MEASURED_BASIC_BULLET.launch, C = mb.cruise / MEASURED_BASIC_BULLET.cruise;
      if (setNumber(t, 'speed', convertTankBarrelSpeed(BASIC_SPEED_STAT * L))) touched = true;
      if (setNumber(t.projectileType, 'topSpeedRatio', BASIC_TOP_RATIO * C / L)) touched = true;
    }
    if (md && visual === 'drone' && !t._measuredDrone) {
      const width = widthOfSlider(t.width);
      if (width > 0) {
        if (setNumber(t.projectileType, 'size', md.sizeOverTank * 20 / width)) touched = true;
        if (setNumber(t.projectileType, 'topSpeedRatio', t.projectileType.topSpeedRatio * md.topSpeedFactor)) touched = true;
        Object.defineProperty(t, '_measuredDrone', { value: true, enumerable: false });
      }
    }
    if (touched) changed++;
  }
  return changed;
}

export const MEASURED_TANK_RADIUS = 24.125;
const SENTRY_RADIUS = 17.625, SENTINEL_RADIUS = 25.6875;
export const MEASURED_BODY_RADIUS: Readonly<Record<string, number>> = Object.freeze({

  sentinel: SENTINEL_RADIUS, sentinelLauncher: SENTINEL_RADIUS, sentinelCrossbow: SENTINEL_RADIUS, sentinelMinigun: SENTINEL_RADIUS,
});
export function measuredBodySize(className: string): number | undefined {
  const r = MEASURED_BODY_RADIUS[className];
  return r === undefined ? undefined : 12 * r / MEASURED_TANK_RADIUS;
}
import { ARRAS_BASE, ARRAS_TICK_RATE, ARRAS_RUN_SPEED, OSA_STAT_PER_TANK_SLIDER, OSA_STAT_PER_ROUND_SLIDER, OSA_DRIVE_PER_FILE_SPEED } from '../constants/physics.js';
import type { GunStats } from '../constants/gunStats.js';

const RECOIL_SCALE = 40 / 1.4;

export function convertRecoil(arrasRecoil: number): number {
  return arrasRecoil * RECOIL_SCALE;
}

export function convertBulletSpeed(arrasSpeed: number): number {
  return Math.min(arrasSpeed, arrasSpeed * 2 - 5);
}

export function convertTankBarrelSpeed(arrasSpeed: number): number {
  return arrasSpeed / OSA_STAT_PER_TANK_SLIDER - 5;
}

export const ROUND_BARREL_SLIDER_PER_STAT = 1 / OSA_STAT_PER_ROUND_SLIDER;
export function convertRoundBarrelSpeed(arrasSpeed: number): number {
  return arrasSpeed * ROUND_BARREL_SLIDER_PER_STAT;
}

export function convertReloadToBPS(arrasReloadTicks: number): number {
  if (arrasReloadTicks <= 0) return 10;
  return ARRAS_TICK_RATE / (arrasReloadTicks * ARRAS_RUN_SPEED);
}

const DAMAGE_SCALE = 2.0;

export function convertDamage(arrasDamage: number): number {
  return arrasDamage * DAMAGE_SCALE;
}

export function convertBulletHealth(arrasHealth: number): number {
  return arrasHealth * DAMAGE_SCALE;
}

export function convertPenetration(arrasPen: number): number {
  return arrasPen;
}

const ENTITY_BASE_RANGE: Record<string, number> = {
  bullet: 90,
  trap: 450,
  swarm: 105,
  drone: 90,
  minion: 90,
  hive: 90,
  boomerang: 120,
};

export function convertLifetime(arrasRange: number, entityType: string = 'bullet'): number {
  const baseRange = ENTITY_BASE_RANGE[entityType] ?? 90;
  const lifetimeSec = (baseRange * arrasRange) / ARRAS_TICK_RATE;
  return Math.max(0.1, Math.min(60, lifetimeSec));
}

export const ARRAS_SPD_NO_POINTS = 1.5;
export const FIXED_RANGE_CALCULATORS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['sustained', 'sustainedLowspeed', 'trap', 'drone', 'necro']);
export const SWARM_CLASS_RANGE = 225;
export const CLASS_RANGE_RULED: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['baseSwarmTurret_swarm']);
export function convertRoundLifetime(arrasRange: number, entityType: string, statCalc: string, ruledClassRange?: number): number {
  if (entityType === 'swarm' && typeof ruledClassRange === 'number' && ruledClassRange > 0 && ruledClassRange !== SWARM_CLASS_RANGE) {
    const ticks = ENTITY_BASE_RANGE.swarm * (ruledClassRange / SWARM_CLASS_RANGE) * arrasRange;
    return Math.max(0.1, Math.min(60, ticks / ARRAS_TICK_RATE));
  }
  if (entityType !== 'bullet') return convertLifetime(arrasRange, entityType);
  let ticks = ENTITY_BASE_RANGE.bullet * arrasRange;
  if (!FIXED_RANGE_CALCULATORS.has(statCalc)) ticks = Math.floor(ticks / Math.sqrt(ARRAS_SPD_NO_POINTS));
  return Math.max(0.1, Math.min(60, ticks / ARRAS_TICK_RATE));
}

export function convertSpread(arrasSpray: number): number {
  return arrasSpray;
}

const BASIC_SLIDER = 9;
export const SIZE_ANCHOR_K = 48.25 / (24 + (9 - 1) / 9 * 24);
const ENGINE_WIDTH_AT_1 = 24 * SIZE_ANCHOR_K;
const ENGINE_WIDTH_AT_10 = 48 * SIZE_ANCHOR_K;
export const BASIC_LEVEL45_GROWTH = 24.125 / 12;
export function engineWidthOfSlider(slider: number): number {
  if (slider <= 10) return ENGINE_WIDTH_AT_1 + (slider - 1) / 9 * (ENGINE_WIDTH_AT_10 - ENGINE_WIDTH_AT_1);
  return ENGINE_WIDTH_AT_10 * (slider / 10);
}
export function engineSliderOfWidth(width: number): number {
  if (width <= ENGINE_WIDTH_AT_10) return 1 + (width - ENGINE_WIDTH_AT_1) * 9 / (ENGINE_WIDTH_AT_10 - ENGINE_WIDTH_AT_1);
  return width * 10 / ENGINE_WIDTH_AT_10;
}

export function convertTankSize(arrasSize: number, levelsUp: boolean = true): number {
  const width = engineWidthOfSlider(BASIC_SLIDER) * (arrasSize / 12) * (levelsUp ? 1 : 1 / BASIC_LEVEL45_GROWTH);
  const slider = Math.round(engineSliderOfWidth(width) * 1000) / 1000;
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(100, slider));
}

export function entityLevelsUp(def: Record<string, unknown> | undefined | null): boolean {
  if (!def) return true;
  if (def.HEALTH_WITH_LEVEL === false) return false;
  return !(def.ACCEPTS_SCORE === false && def.LEVEL == null && def.VALUE == null);
}

export function convertBodyHP(arrasHealth: number, healthWithLevel: boolean = true): number {
  return ((healthWithLevel ? 90 : 0) + arrasHealth) * 2;
}

export function convertBodyDamage(arrasDamage: number): number {
  return arrasDamage;
}

export function convertMovementSpeed(arrasSpeed: number): number {
  return arrasSpeed * (3 / ARRAS_BASE.SPEED);
}

const DRIVE_DECIMALS = 1e6;
export function convertDrivenSpeed(arrasSpeed: number, arrasAccel: number): number {
  if (!(arrasSpeed > 0)) return 0;
  const accel = arrasAccel > 0 ? arrasAccel : 0;
  return Math.round(((arrasSpeed + accel) / OSA_DRIVE_PER_FILE_SPEED) * DRIVE_DECIMALS) / DRIVE_DECIMALS;
}
export function convertPushShare(arrasSpeed: number, arrasAccel: number): number | undefined {
  if (!(arrasSpeed > 0) || !(arrasAccel >= 0)) return undefined;
  if (arrasSpeed === ARRAS_BASE.SPEED && arrasAccel === ARRAS_BASE.ACCEL) return undefined;
  return Math.round(arrasAccel / (arrasSpeed + arrasAccel) * DRIVE_DECIMALS) / DRIVE_DECIMALS;
}

export function convertShieldCapacity(arrasShield: number, healthWithLevel: boolean = true): number {
  return ((healthWithLevel ? 27 : 0) + arrasShield) * 2;
}

export function convertShieldRegen(arrasRegen: number): number {
  return arrasRegen * (3 / ARRAS_BASE.REGEN);
}

export function convertFOV(arrasFOV: number): number {
  return arrasFOV / ARRAS_BASE.FOV;
}

export function convertPushability(arras: number | undefined): number {
  if (arras === undefined || arras === null) return 0.2;
  return Math.max(0.01, Math.min(10, arras));
}

export function convertBarrelLength(arrasLength: number): number {
  const ratio = arrasLength / 20;
  const slider = 1 + (ratio - 0.01) * 99 / 10.49;
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(100, slider));
}

export const GAME_CANVAS_EXTENT = 256;
export function convertBarrelWidth(arrasWidth: number): number {
  const slider = arrasWidth * 50 / (20 * 0.96);
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(GAME_CANVAS_EXTENT, slider));
}

export function convertBarrelX(arrasX: number): number {
  const r = Math.max(-GAME_CANVAS_EXTENT, Math.min(GAME_CANVAS_EXTENT, arrasX / 10));
  return r + 0;
}

export function convertBarrelY(arrasY: number): number {
  const r = Math.max(-GAME_CANVAS_EXTENT, Math.min(GAME_CANVAS_EXTENT, arrasY / 10));
  return r + 0;
}

export function convertTurretX(arrasX: number): number {
  return arrasX / 10 + 0;
}
export function convertTurretY(arrasY: number): number {
  return arrasY / 10 + 0;
}

export function convertBulletSize(arrasSize: number, arrasWidth?: number, arrasAspect: number = 1): number {
  if (!(typeof arrasWidth === 'number' && arrasWidth > 0)) return arrasSize;
  const raw = arrasWidth * 50 / (20 * 0.96);
  const written = convertBarrelWidth(arrasAspect < 0 ? arrasWidth * Math.abs(arrasAspect) : arrasWidth);
  if (!(written > 0)) return arrasSize;
  const k = raw / written;
  return k === 1 ? arrasSize : arrasSize * k;
}

export const BODY_SPEED: Record<string, number> = {
  bullet: 3.75,
  drone: 3.8,
  swarm: 4.5,
  trap: 0,
  minion: 1.8,
  hive: 3.8,
  boomerang: 1.25,
};

export function computeTopSpeedRatio(
  arrasSpeed: number, arrasMaxSpeed: number, entityType: string, ownBodySpeed?: number
): number {
  const bodySpeed = (typeof ownBodySpeed === 'number' && isFinite(ownBodySpeed)) ? ownBodySpeed : (BODY_SPEED[entityType] ?? 3.75);
  if (arrasSpeed <= 0.01) return bodySpeed > 0 ? 1.0 : 0;
  return (arrasMaxSpeed * bodySpeed) / arrasSpeed;
}

export function convertGunStats(stats: GunStats) {
  return {
    bps: convertReloadToBPS(stats.reload),
    speed: convertBulletSpeed(stats.speed),
    knockback: convertRecoil(stats.recoil),
    spread: convertSpread(stats.spray),
    bulletDamage: convertDamage(stats.damage),
    bulletHealthBase: convertBulletHealth(stats.health),
    bulletPenetration: convertPenetration(stats.pen),
    bulletLifetime: convertLifetime(stats.range),
    shudder: stats.shudder,
    _arrasSize: stats.size,
    _arrasMaxSpeed: stats.maxSpeed,
    _arrasDensity: stats.density,
    _arrasResist: stats.resist,
    _arrasShudder: stats.shudder,
  };
}
import type { ArrasClassDef, Registry } from '../types/arras.js';
import { ISTRONG_PLATE_KEY, ISTRONG_MAIN_BODY_KEY } from '../types/istrongMeta.js';
import { resolveFlat } from './classResolver.js';

export interface PlatesRead {
  bodyLayers: any[];
  turrets: any[];
  mainBody: ArrasClassDef | null;
}

const typeName = (t: any): string | null => (typeof t === 'string' ? t : Array.isArray(t) && typeof t[0] === 'string' ? t[0] : null);
const shareOf = (e: any): number => {
  const s = Array.isArray(e?.POSITION) ? e.POSITION[0] : e?.POSITION?.SIZE;
  return (typeof s === 'number' ? s : 10) / 20;
};

export function readPlates(
  flat: ArrasClassDef,
  rawClass: ArrasClassDef | undefined,
  registry: Registry,
  tankArrasSize: number,
  parts: (guns: any[], turrets: any[], arrasSize: number, color: any) => any[],
): PlatesRead | null {
  const entries: any[] = Array.isArray(flat.TURRETS) ? flat.TURRETS : [];
  const marked = entries.map((e) => {
    const n = typeName(e?.TYPE);
    const c: any = n ? registry.get(n) : undefined;
    return { e, n, plate: c?.[ISTRONG_PLATE_KEY] ?? null, main: !!c?.[ISTRONG_MAIN_BODY_KEY] };
  });
  const anchor = (rawClass as any)?.[ISTRONG_PLATE_KEY] ?? null;
  if (!anchor && !marked.some((m) => m.plate || m.main)) return null;

  const main = marked.find((m) => m.main) ?? null;
  const own = marked.filter((m) => !m.plate && !m.main).map((m) => m.e);
  const flatGuns: any[] = Array.isArray(flat.GUNS) ? flat.GUNS : [];
  const layers: { index: number; layer: any }[] = [];
  const turrets: any[] = [];
  const K = main ? 1 / shareOf(main.e) : 1;
  const unpush = (list: any[], gunK: number, autoK: number) => {
    for (const t of list) {
      if (t?.turretType === 'auto' || t?.turretType === 'autoCircle') { for (const s of t.autoSubTurrets ?? []) if (typeof s.knockback === 'number') s.knockback /= autoK; }
      else if (typeof t?.knockback === 'number') t.knockback /= gunK;
    }
    return list;
  };
  const onLayer = (record: any, list: any[]) => {
    const { index, ...layer } = record;
    layers.push({ index: typeof index === 'number' ? index : layers.length, layer: { ...layer, turretIds: list.map((t) => t.id), _currentAngle: 0 } });
  };

  let mainBody: ArrasClassDef | null = null;
  if (main) {
    mainBody = resolveFlat(main.n!, registry);
    const m = unpush(parts(Array.isArray(mainBody.GUNS) ? mainBody.GUNS : [], Array.isArray(mainBody.TURRETS) ? mainBody.TURRETS : [], tankArrasSize * shareOf(main.e), mainBody.COLOR), K, 1 / K);
    turrets.push(...m);
    if (anchor) {
      const a = unpush(parts(flatGuns, own, tankArrasSize, flat.COLOR), 1, K);
      onLayer(anchor, a);
      turrets.push(...a);
    }
  } else {
    turrets.push(...parts(flatGuns, own, tankArrasSize, flat.COLOR));
  }
  for (const m of marked) {
    if (!m.plate) continue;
    const cls = resolveFlat(m.n!, registry);
    const s = shareOf(m.e);
    const list = unpush(parts(Array.isArray(cls.GUNS) ? cls.GUNS : [], Array.isArray(cls.TURRETS) ? cls.TURRETS : [], tankArrasSize * s, cls.COLOR), 1 / s, K * s * s);
    onLayer(m.plate, list);
    turrets.push(...list);
  }
  layers.sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);
  return { bodyLayers: layers.map((l) => l.layer), turrets, mainBody };
}
import type { Registry } from '../types/arras.js';

export type UpgradeTree = Map<string, string[]>;

export const SIDEWINDER_ROOT = 'sidewinder';
export const TWISTER_ROOT = 'twister';

export const SIDEWINDER_SNAKE = Object.freeze({ snakeSwing: 48.4, snakeRate: 44.9, snakeDelay: 0.475 });

export function upgradeTreeOf(registry: Registry): UpgradeTree {
  const tree: UpgradeTree = new Map();
  for (const [name, def] of registry) {
    if (!def) continue;
    let kids: string[] | null = null;
    for (const key of Object.keys(def)) {
      if (!key.startsWith('UPGRADES_TIER_')) continue;
      const list = (def as any)[key];
      if (!Array.isArray(list)) continue;
      for (const child of list) {
        if (typeof child !== 'string') continue;
        if (!kids) kids = [];
        if (!kids.includes(child)) kids.push(child);
      }
    }
    if (kids) tree.set(name, kids);
  }
  return tree;
}

export function familyMembers(root: string, tree: UpgradeTree): Set<string> {
  const out = new Set<string>([root]);
  const queue: string[] = [root];
  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const cur = queue.pop() as string;
    const kids = tree.get(cur);
    if (!kids) continue;
    for (const k of kids) {
      if (out.has(k)) continue;
      out.add(k);
      queue.push(k);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

export interface RightClickFamilies {
  sidewinder: Set<string>;
  twister: Set<string>;
}

export function resolveRightClickFamilies(tree: UpgradeTree): RightClickFamilies {
  return {
    sidewinder: familyMembers(SIDEWINDER_ROOT, tree),
    twister: familyMembers(TWISTER_ROOT, tree),
  };
}

const familiesByRegistry = new WeakMap<Registry, RightClickFamilies>();
export function rightClickFamiliesOf(registry: Registry): RightClickFamilies {
  let f = familiesByRegistry.get(registry);
  if (!f) {
    f = resolveRightClickFamilies(upgradeTreeOf(registry));
    familiesByRegistry.set(registry, f);
  }
  return f;
}

function projectileDrivesItself(turret: any): boolean {
  const cpd = turret?.projectileType?.customProjectileDesign;
  return !!cpd && Array.isArray(cpd.turrets) && cpd.turrets.length > 0;
}

function projectileSpins(turret: any): boolean {
  return turret?.projectileType?.facingType === 'spin';
}

function hasBehavior(turret: any, type: string): any | undefined {
  const list = turret?.projectileBehaviors;
  if (!Array.isArray(list)) return undefined;
  return list.find((b: any) => b && b.type === type);
}

export function applyRightClickFamilies(
  className: string,
  turrets: any[],
  families: RightClickFamilies,
  makeBehavior: (type: string) => any,
): number {
  const inSidewinder = families.sidewinder.has(className);
  const inTwister = families.twister.has(className);
  if (!inSidewinder && !inTwister) return 0;
  let changed = 0;
  for (const t of turrets) {
    if (!t || t.turretType === 'decorative') continue;
    if (!Array.isArray(t.projectileBehaviors)) continue;
    let touched = false;
    if (inSidewinder && projectileDrivesItself(t)) {
      let snake = hasBehavior(t, 'snake');
      if (!snake) {
        snake = makeBehavior('snake');
        t.projectileBehaviors.push(snake);
      }
      if (snake.snakeOnAlt !== true) { snake.snakeOnAlt = true; touched = true; }
      for (const key of Object.keys(SIDEWINDER_SNAKE) as (keyof typeof SIDEWINDER_SNAKE)[]) {
        if (typeof snake[key] !== 'number') { snake[key] = SIDEWINDER_SNAKE[key]; touched = true; }
      }
    }
    if (inTwister && projectileSpins(t)) {
      if (!hasBehavior(t, 'reverseSpinOnAlt')) {
        t.projectileBehaviors.push(makeBehavior('reverseSpinOnAlt'));
        touched = true;
      }
    }
    if (touched) changed++;
  }
  return changed;
}
import type { Registry } from '../types/arras.js';
import { upgradeTreeOf, familyMembers, type UpgradeTree } from './rightClickFamilies.js';

export const UNDERSEER_FAMILY_ROOT = 'underseer';

export function underseerFamilyOf(tree: UpgradeTree): Set<string> {
  return familyMembers(UNDERSEER_FAMILY_ROOT, tree);
}

const familyByRegistry = new WeakMap<Registry, Set<string>>();
export function underseerFamilyOfRegistry(registry: Registry): Set<string> {
  let f = familyByRegistry.get(registry);
  if (!f) { f = underseerFamilyOf(upgradeTreeOf(registry)); familyByRegistry.set(registry, f); }
  return f;
}

const has = (t: any, type: string): boolean =>
  Array.isArray(t?.projectileBehaviors) && t.projectileBehaviors.some((b: any) => b && b.type === type && b.enabled);

export function applyStartsLoadedRule(
  tankConfig: any,
  className: string,
  underseerFamily: Set<string>,
  make: (type: string, enabled: boolean) => any,
): number {
  if (!underseerFamily.has(className)) return 0;
  let changed = 0;
  for (const t of tankConfig?.turrets || []) {
    if (!t || t.turretType === 'auto' || t.turretType === 'decorative') continue;
    if (!has(t, 'waitToCycle') || has(t, 'startsLoaded')) continue;
    if (t.projectileType?.statCalculatorType !== 'necro') continue;
    const at = t.projectileBehaviors.findIndex((b: any) => b && b.type === 'waitToCycle');
    t.projectileBehaviors.splice(at + 1, 0, make('startsLoaded', true));
    changed++;
  }
  return changed;
}
