  '    };',
  '}',
  'for (let shape of pack.shapes) {',
  '    let base = build(shape.recipe, shape.name + "_look");',
  '    if (!base) continue;',
  '    Class[shape.name] = { PARENT: base, LABEL: shape.label, VALUE: shape.value, HEALTH_WITH_LEVEL: false, BODY: shape.body };',
  '    if (shape.size) Class[shape.name].SIZE = shape.size;',
  '    Class[shape.name + "Generator"] = generator(shape.name);',
  '}',
  '',
  'for (let name in pack.menus) {',
  '    Class[name] = makeMenu(pack.menus[name].label, { rerootTree: name, boxColor: pack.menus[name].color });',
  '    Class[name].PASS_UPGRADE_COLOR = true;',
  '}',
  'for (let name in pack.menus) Class[name].UPGRADES_TIER_0 = pack.menus[name].items.filter(item => Class[item]);',
  'Class.menu_special.UPGRADES_TIER_0.push("istrong_menu_developer");',
  ''].join('\n');

export function osaPackFiles(pack: OsaPack): Record<string, string> {
  return {
    'istrong.json': JSON.stringify({ classes: pack.classes, shapes: pack.shapes, menus: pack.menus }),
    'addon.json': JSON.stringify({ name: OSA_PACK_NAME, authors: ['Arjuna'], 'addon-version': 'v0.1.0', 'osa-version': { minimum: 'v2.1.2', target: 'v2.1.2' } }, null, '\t') + '\n',
    'istrong.js': LOADER,
    'not-converted.txt': pack.notConverted.join('\n') + '\n',
  };
}
export function emitTankArrasOnly(
  classDef: Record<string, any>,
  arrasOnly: Record<string, any> | undefined,
): void {
  if (!arrasOnly || typeof arrasOnly !== 'object') return;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(arrasOnly)) {
    if (key === 'BODY') {
      if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') continue;
      if (!classDef.BODY) classDef.BODY = {};
      for (const [bk, bv] of Object.entries(value)) {
        if (classDef.BODY[bk] === undefined) {
          classDef.BODY[bk] = bv;
        }
      }
      continue;
    }
    classDef[key] = value;
  }
}

export function emitGunArrasOnly(
  properties: Record<string, any>,
  arrasOnly: Record<string, any> | undefined,
): void {
  if (!arrasOnly || typeof arrasOnly !== 'object') return;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(arrasOnly)) {
    properties[key] = value;
  }
}

export function emitProjectileArrasOnly(
  classDef: Record<string, any>,
  arrasOnly: Record<string, any> | undefined,
): void {
  emitTankArrasOnly(classDef, arrasOnly);
}
import type { IstrongTurret } from '../types/istrong.js';
import type { ArrasClassEmit, ArrasGunEmit } from '../types/warnings.js';
import type { WarningCollector } from '../warnings/collector.js';
import { invertAutoTurretSize, invertSpinSpeed, invertBarrelX, invertBarrelY } from './physicsInverter.js';
import { arrasColorOf } from './colorInverter.js';
import { emitTurretMeta } from './istrongMetaEmitter.js';
import { ISTRONG_AUTO_KEY, AUTO_FIELDS } from '../types/istrongMeta.js';

export interface InvertedAutoTurret {
  arrasTurret: { POSITION: number[]; TYPE: string; [key: string]: any };
  childClass?: ArrasClassEmit;
}

const CROSS_TURRET = { POSITION: [13, 0, 0, 0, 360, 1], TYPE: 'healerHat' };

function autoBaseShape(sides: number, depthIn: unknown): number[][] {
  const n = Math.floor(sides);
  const depth = typeof depthIn === 'number' && depthIn > 0 ? Math.min(1, depthIn) : 0;
  const turn = n >= 4 && n % 2 === 0 ? -Math.PI / n : 0;
  const pts: number[][] = [];
  const m = depth > 0 ? 2 * n : n;
  for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) {
    const a = turn + (2 * Math.PI * i) / m, r = depth > 0 && i % 2 ? 1 - depth : 1;
    pts.push([+(r * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(4), +(r * Math.sin(a)).toFixed(4)]);
  }
  return pts;
}

export function buildAutoTurretEntry(
  turret: IstrongTurret,
  parentTankName: string,
  turretIndex: number,
  warn: WarningCollector,
  mount: number | null,
  inner: (turrets: IstrongTurret[], parentName: string, warn: WarningCollector) => { GUNS: ArrasGunEmit[]; TURRETS: any[] },
  above: boolean = (turret as any).aboveTankBody === true,
  k: number = 1,
  onRound: boolean = false,
): InvertedAutoTurret {
  const sizeRatio = invertAutoTurretSize(turret.autoCircleSize ?? 25);
  const angle = turret.angle ?? 0;
  const bx = invertBarrelX(turret.xOffset ?? 0);
  const by = invertBarrelY(turret.yOffset ?? 0);
  const cosA = Math.cos(angle);
  const sinA = Math.sin(angle);
  const arrasX = bx * cosA + by * sinA;
  const arrasY = -bx * sinA + by * cosA;
  const arrasAngleDeg = angle * 180 / Math.PI;
  const fov = turret.fov ?? 200;

  const sight = typeof mount === 'number' && mount > 0 && typeof turret.fovSize === 'number' && turret.fovSize > 0
    ? turret.fovSize * 60 / (275 * Math.sqrt(mount * sizeRatio / 20)) : undefined;

  const subTurrets = Array.isArray(turret.autoSubTurrets) ? turret.autoSubTurrets : [];
  const typeName = `${parentTankName}AutoTurret${turretIndex}`;
  const innerResult = inner(subTurrets as IstrongTurret[], typeName, warn);

  const childClass: ArrasClassEmit = {
    className: typeName,
    PARENT: 'autoTurret',
    LABEL: typeName,
    GUNS: innerResult.GUNS,
  };
  const turrets: any[] = [...innerResult.TURRETS];
  if (sight !== undefined) childClass.BODY = { FOV: sight };
  if ((turret as any).fireWithTank === true) childClass.FIRE_WITH_MASTER = true;

  if ((turret as any).autoCircleColorMatch) childClass.COLOR = 'mirror';
  else if (typeof (turret as any).colorMap === 'number') childClass.COLOR = arrasColorOf((turret as any).color, (turret as any).colorMap, warn);
  const sides = (turret as any).autoCircleBaseSides;
  if (typeof sides === 'number' && sides >= 3) childClass.SHAPE = autoBaseShape(sides, (turret as any).autoCircleBaseDepth);
  if ((turret as any).autoCircleHidden) {
    childClass.BORDERLESS = true;
    childClass.DRAW_FILL = false;
  } else if ((turret as any).autoCircleHealer) turrets.push({ ...CROSS_TURRET });
  if (turrets.length > 0) childClass.TURRETS = turrets;

  const spin = (turret as any).autoCircleSpin;
  const spinSpeed = (turret as any).autoCircleSpinSpeed;
  const spinDir = (turret as any).autoCircleSpinDirection;
  const spinMode = (turret as any).autoCircleSpinMode;
  const fixedOn = (turret as any).autoCircleFixed === true;
  const spinning = !!spin && typeof spinSpeed === 'number';
  if (spinning && spinMode !== 'withBody') {
    childClass.FACING_TYPE = ['spin', { speed: invertSpinSpeed(spinSpeed) * (spinDir === -1 ? -1 : 1) }];
  }
  const welded = (spinning && spinMode === 'withBody') || fixedOn;
  if (welded) {
    childClass.CONTROLLERS = [];
    childClass.MIRROR_MASTER_ANGLE = true;
  }
  for (const g of childClass.GUNS ?? []) {
    if (!g.PROPERTIES || !g.PROPERTIES.TYPE) continue;
    if (spinning || fixedOn) g.PROPERTIES.AUTOFIRE = true;
    else delete g.PROPERTIES.AUTOFIRE;
  }

  if ((turret as any).aura === true) {
    if (onRound) warn.info('aura', 'A ring on a round is sized by its tank in OSA: not converted.', { original: 'aura on a round' });
    else {
      const t = turret as any;
      const heal = t.auraType === 'heal';
      const size = typeof t.auraSize === 'number' && t.auraSize > 0 ? t.auraSize : 3;
      const strength = typeof t.auraStrength === 'number' && t.auraStrength >= 0 ? t.auraStrength : 1;
      const opacity = typeof t.auraOpacity === 'number' && t.auraOpacity >= 0 ? Math.min(1, t.auraOpacity) : 0.3;
      (childClass.GUNS ??= []).push({
        POSITION: [0, 20, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
        PROPERTIES: {
          SHOOT_SETTINGS: { reload: 0.001, recoil: 0.001, shudder: 0.001, size: 6, health: 1, damage: heal ? -strength : strength, pen: 1, speed: 0.001, maxSpeed: 0.001, range: 1, density: 1, spray: 0.001, resist: 1 },
          TYPE: [heal ? 'healAura' : 'aura', { COLOR: heal ? 'red' : 'blue', ALPHA: opacity, CONTROLLERS: [['scaleWithMaster', { ratio: +(size / k).toFixed(6) }]] }],
          MAX_CHILDREN: 1,
          AUTOFIRE: true,
          SYNCS_SKILLS: true,
          ALPHA: 0,
          BORDERLESS: true,
          DRAW_FILL: false,
        },
      } as ArrasGunEmit);
    }
  }

  if ((turret as any).manualControl === true) {
    if (!childClass.CONTROLLERS) childClass.CONTROLLERS = ['canRepel', 'mapAltToFire', 'onlyAcceptInArc', 'nearestDifferentMaster'];
  } else childClass.INDEPENDENT = true;

  const own: Record<string, any> = {};
  for (const f of AUTO_FIELDS) if ((turret as any)[f] !== undefined) own[f] = (turret as any)[f];
  (childClass as any)[ISTRONG_AUTO_KEY] = own;

  const arrasTurret: { POSITION: number[]; TYPE: any; [key: string]: any } = {
    POSITION: [sizeRatio, arrasX, arrasY, arrasAngleDeg, fov, above ? 1 : 0],
    TYPE: typeName,
  };
  emitTurretMeta(arrasTurret, turret);

  return {
    arrasTurret,
    childClass,
  };
}
import type { WarningCollector } from '../warnings/collector.js';

const BEHAVIOR_TO_CONTROLLER: Record<string, string> = {
  autoTargetEnemy: 'nearestDifferentMaster',
  canRepel: 'canRepel',
  followMouse: 'mapTargetToGoal',
  hangNearOwner: 'hangOutNearMaster',
  alwaysFire: 'alwaysFire',
  targetSelf: 'targetSelf',
  spinContinuous: 'spin',
  avoid: 'avoid',
  minionControl: 'minion',
  returnToOwner: 'boomerang',
  formulaTarget: 'formulaTarget',
  patrolCircle: 'moveInCircles',
  fleeWhenDamaged: 'fleeAtLowHealth',
  snake: 'snake',
  goToTarget: 'goToMasterTarget',
  mapAltToFire: 'mapAltToFire',
  scaleWithMaster: 'scaleWithMaster',
  stackGuns: 'stackGuns',
  disableOnOverride: 'disableOnOverride',
};

const REVERSE_SPIN_ARRAS_SPEED = 0.2;

const SKIP_BEHAVIORS = new Set([
  'motionGlide',
  'motionMotor',
  'motionChase',
  'motionSwarm',
  'motionGrow',
  'motionWithMaster',
  'swarmAI',
  'waitToCycle',
  'startsLoaded',
  'destroyOldest',
  'independentProjectile',
  'invisible',
  'alwaysInvisible',
]);

export interface InvertedBehavior {
  controllers: any[];
  propertyFlags: Record<string, boolean>;
}

export function invertBehaviors(behaviors: any[] | undefined, warn?: WarningCollector): InvertedBehavior {
  const controllers: any[] = [];
  const propertyFlags: Record<string, boolean> = {};
  if (!Array.isArray(behaviors)) return { controllers, propertyFlags };

  for (const b of behaviors) {
    if (!b || !b.enabled) continue;
    const type = b.type as string;
    if (SKIP_BEHAVIORS.has(type)) {
      if (type === 'waitToCycle') propertyFlags.WAIT_TO_CYCLE = true;
      if (type === 'startsLoaded') propertyFlags.DELAY_SPAWN = false;
      if (type === 'destroyOldest') propertyFlags.DESTROY_OLDEST_CHILD = true;
      if (type === 'independentProjectile') propertyFlags.INDEPENDENT = true;
      if (type === 'alwaysInvisible') propertyFlags.ALWAYS_INVISIBLE = true;
      continue;
    }
    if (type === 'reverseSpinOnAlt') {
      controllers.push(['spin2', { speed: REVERSE_SPIN_ARRAS_SPEED }]);
      continue;
    }
    const name = BEHAVIOR_TO_CONTROLLER[type];
    if (!name) {
      if (warn) warn.info('behavior', `Behavior "${type}" has no arras controller mapping; skipped`);
      continue;
    }

    if (name === 'snake') {
      const options: Record<string, any> = {};
      if (b.snakeOnAlt === true) options.onAlt = true;
      if (typeof b.snakeSwing === 'number' && b.snakeSwing !== 48.4) options.swing = b.snakeSwing;
      if (typeof b.snakeRate === 'number' && b.snakeRate !== 44.9) options.rate = b.snakeRate;
      if (typeof b.snakeDelay === 'number' && b.snakeDelay !== 0.475) options.delay = b.snakeDelay;
      if (b.snakeInvert === true) options.invert = true;
      controllers.push(Object.keys(options).length > 0 ? ['snakeSwing', options] : 'snakeSwing');
      continue;
    }

    if (name === 'spin') {
      const speed = typeof b.spinSpeed === 'number' ? b.spinSpeed / 30 : undefined;
      if (typeof speed === 'number') {
        controllers.push(['spin', { speed }]);
      } else {
        controllers.push('spin');
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (name === 'formulaTarget' && typeof b.formulaDivisor === 'number' && b.formulaDivisor !== 4) {
      controllers.push([name, { divisor: b.formulaDivisor }]);
      continue;
    }

    controllers.push(name);
  }

  return { controllers, propertyFlags };
}

import type { TankData } from '../types/istrong.js';
import type { WarningCollector } from '../warnings/collector.js';
import {
  invertBodyHP,
  invertBodyDamage,
  invertDrive,
  invertShieldCapacity,
  invertShieldRegen,
  invertFOV,
  invertPushability,
  invertTankSize,
} from './physicsInverter.js';
import { touchShareOf } from './turretInverter.js';

export interface InvertedBody {
  BODY: Record<string, number>;
  SIZE?: number;
  SHAPE?: number;
  COLOR?: any;
  LEVEL?: number;
  HEALTH_WITH_LEVEL?: boolean;
}

export function invertBody(tank: TankData, isBoss: boolean, warn: WarningCollector): InvertedBody {
  const touch = touchShareOf(tank.tankTouchScale);
  const hpResult = invertBodyHP(tank.tankHP, isBoss, warn);
  const shieldResult = invertShieldCapacity(tank.tankShieldCapacity, isBoss, warn);

  const drive = invertDrive(tank.tankMovementSpeed, tank.tankPushShare);
  const body: Record<string, number> = {
    DAMAGE: invertBodyDamage(tank.tankBodyDamage),
    SPEED: drive.speed,
    HEALTH: hpResult.health,
    SHIELD: shieldResult.shield,
    REGEN: invertShieldRegen(tank.tankShieldRegen),
    FOV: invertFOV(tank.fovMultiplier) / Math.pow(touch, 0.65),
  };

  if (drive.acceleration !== undefined) {
    body.ACCELERATION = drive.acceleration;
  }
  if (typeof tank.tankResistBase === 'number' && tank.tankResistBase !== 1) {
    body.RESIST = tank.tankResistBase;
  }
  if (typeof tank.tankPenetrationBase === 'number' && tank.tankPenetrationBase !== 1.05) {
    body.PENETRATION = tank.tankPenetrationBase;
  }

  const push = invertPushability(tank.tankPushability);
  if (push !== undefined && push !== 0.2) {
    body.PUSHABILITY = push;
  }

  const result: InvertedBody = {
    BODY: body,
    SIZE: Math.round(invertTankSize(tank.tankSize) * touch * 100) / 100,
    SHAPE: tank.tankSides,
  };

  if (hpResult.healthWithLevel) {
    result.HEALTH_WITH_LEVEL = true;
  }
  if (hpResult.level !== undefined) {
    result.LEVEL = hpResult.level;
  }

  return result;
}
import type { ArrasTurretEmit, ArrasClassEmit } from '../types/warnings.js';
import type { WarningCollector } from '../warnings/collector.js';
import { invertSpinSpeed } from './physicsInverter.js';
import { emitBodyLayerMeta } from './istrongMetaEmitter.js';
import { arrasColorOf } from './colorInverter.js';

const LABEL_TO_BODY_TYPE: Record<string, string> = {
  smasher: 'smasherBody',
  spike: 'spikeBody',
  landmine: 'landmineBody',
  domination: 'dominationBody',
  auto: 'autoSmasherBody',
  mega: 'megaSmasherBody',
  saw: 'sawBody',
};

function labelToBodyType(label: string | undefined): string {
  if (!label) return 'smasherBody';
  const lower = label.toLowerCase();
  for (const key of Object.keys(LABEL_TO_BODY_TYPE)) {
    if (lower.includes(key)) return LABEL_TO_BODY_TYPE[key]!;
  }
  return `${lower.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')}Body`;
}

function layerShape(layer: any, sides: number, warn: WarningCollector): number | number[][] {
  if (Array.isArray(layer.outline) && layer.outline.length >= 3) return layer.outline.map((p: number[]) => [p[0], p[1]]);
  const depth = typeof layer.starDepth === 'number' ? layer.starDepth : 0;
  if (depth > 0 && sides >= 3) {
    if (layer.starCurved) warn.warn('bodyLayers', `layer "${layer.label ?? ''}": a curved star goes to OSA with straight sides`);
    const pts: number[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < sides * 2; i++) {
      const a = Math.PI * i / sides, r = i % 2 ? 1 - depth : 1;
      pts.push([+(r * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(4), +(r * Math.sin(a)).toFixed(4)]);
    }
    return pts;
  }
  return sides;
}

export interface InvertedBodyLayers {
  turrets: ArrasTurretEmit[];
  layeredBossDependencies: ArrasClassEmit[];
  isSmasherDetected: boolean;
}

export function invertBodyLayers(
  bodyLayers: any[] | null | undefined,
  parentClassName: string,
  warn: WarningCollector,
): InvertedBodyLayers {
  const result: InvertedBodyLayers = { turrets: [], layeredBossDependencies: [], isSmasherDetected: false };
  if (!Array.isArray(bodyLayers) || bodyLayers.length === 0) return result;

  const renderOrders = new Set(bodyLayers.map(l => l.renderOrder ?? 0));
  const isLayeredBoss = renderOrders.size > 1 && bodyLayers.some(l => Array.isArray(l.turretIds) && l.turretIds.length > 0);

  if (isLayeredBoss) {
    warn.warn('bodyLayers', `LayeredBoss with ${bodyLayers.length} stacked layers detected. The reverse export collapses layers into TURRETS overlays, and a round trip cannot rebuild LayerN child classes.`, {
      original: { layerCount: bodyLayers.length, renderOrders: [...renderOrders] },
    });
  }

  bodyLayers.forEach((layer, li) => {
    const sizeRatio = typeof layer.sizeRatio === 'number' ? layer.sizeRatio : 1;
    const arrasSize = sizeRatio * 20;
    const sides = typeof layer.sides === 'number' ? layer.sides : 6;
    const initialAngle = typeof layer.initialAngle === 'number' ? layer.initialAngle : 0;
    const angleDeg = initialAngle * 180 / Math.PI;
    const copies = Math.max(1, typeof layer.copies === 'number' ? layer.copies : 1);
    const spinEnabled = !!layer.spinEnabled;
    const spinSpeed = typeof layer.spinSpeed === 'number' ? layer.spinSpeed : 0;
    const spinDir = layer.spinDirection === -1 ? -1 : 1;
    const stationary = !!layer.stationary;

    if (labelToBodyType(layer.label) !== 'sawBody') result.isSmasherDetected = true;

    const shape = layerShape(layer, sides, warn);
    const color = layer.useInheritColor ? 'mirror' : arrasColorOf(layer.color ?? '#484848', layer.colorMap, warn);
    const hat = (name: string, facing: any) => {
      result.layeredBossDependencies.push({
        className: name, LABEL: '', SHAPE: shape, COLOR: color, FACING_TYPE: facing,
        INDEPENDENT: true, MIRROR_MASTER_ANGLE: false,
      } as any);
    };
    const base = `${parentClassName}_layer${li}`;
    if (!stationary) {
      hat(`${base}Body`, spinEnabled && spinSpeed ? ['spin', { speed: invertSpinSpeed(spinSpeed) * spinDir }] : ['toTarget']);
    }
    const angleStep = 360 / copies;
    for (let i = 0; i < copies; i++) {
      const ang = angleDeg + i * angleStep;
      let type = `${base}Body`;
      if (stationary) {
        type = copies > 1 ? `${base}c${i}Body` : `${base}Body`;
        hat(type, ['noFacing', { angle: ang * Math.PI / 180 }]);
      }
      const entry: ArrasTurretEmit = { POSITION: [arrasSize, 0, 0, ang, 360, 0], TYPE: type };
      if (i === 0) emitBodyLayerMeta(entry as any, layer);
      result.turrets.push(entry);
    }
  });

  return result;
}

const ARRAS_RESERVED_BUILTINS = new Set<string>([
  'basic', 'twin', 'sniper', 'machineGun', 'flankGuard', 'tank', 'triplet', 'tripleTwin',
  'quadTank', 'tripleShot', 'pentaShot', 'spreadShot', 'gunner', 'overseer', 'manager',
  'overlord', 'necromancer', 'predator', 'destroyer', 'annihilator', 'hybrid', 'autoTurret',
  'autoGunner', 'auto3', 'auto4', 'auto5', 'sentinel', 'tri-trapper', 'trapper', 'gunnerTrapper',
  'overtrapper', 'mothership', 'sanctuary', 'kronos', 'genericTank', 'genericBoss', 'bullet',
  'drone', 'swarm', 'trap', 'minion', 'hive', 'boomerang',
]);

function classNameFromDisplayName(name: string): string {
  const cleaned = name
    .replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9 _-]/g, '')
    .replace(/[-_\s]+/g, ' ')
    .trim()
    .replace(/\s+(.)/g, (_m, c: string) => c.toUpperCase())
    .replace(/^./, c => c.toLowerCase())
    .replace(/^[0-9]/, m => `_${m}`);
  return cleaned || 'unnamed';
}

function uniqueClassName(base: string, takenNames: Set<string>): string {
  if (!takenNames.has(base) && !ARRAS_RESERVED_BUILTINS.has(base)) {
    takenNames.add(base);
    return base;
  }
  let suffix = 2;
  while (takenNames.has(`${base}${suffix}`) || ARRAS_RESERVED_BUILTINS.has(`${base}${suffix}`)) {
    suffix++;
  }
  const final = `${base}${suffix}`;
  takenNames.add(final);
  return final;
}

function detectIsBoss(envelope: ExportFile<TankData>): boolean {
  const category = (envelope.category || '').toLowerCase();
  if (category.includes('dread')) return false;
  if (category.includes('boss') || category.includes('mystical') || category.includes('celestial') || category.includes('eternal') || category.includes('elite') || category.includes('map entit')) return true;
  if (envelope.data.canEarnSkillPoints === false) return true;
  return false;
}

const LEVEL_45_POINTS = 42;

export interface EmitOptions {
  className?: string;
}

const STAT_NAMES_TEMPLATES: Record<string, Record<string, string>> = {
  drone: {
    RELOAD: 'Respawn Rate',
    BULLET_DAMAGE: 'Drone Damage',
    BULLET_PENETRATION: 'Drone Health',
    BULLET_HEALTH: 'Drone Health',
    BULLET_SPEED: 'Drone Speed',
  },
  swarm: {
    BULLET_SPEED: 'Swarm Speed',
    BULLET_DAMAGE: 'Swarm Damage',
    BULLET_HEALTH: 'Swarm Health',
    BULLET_PENETRATION: 'Swarm Penetration',
  },
  trap: {
    BULLET_SPEED: 'Placement Speed',
    BULLET_DAMAGE: 'Trap Damage',
    BULLET_HEALTH: 'Trap Health',
    BULLET_PENETRATION: 'Trap Penetration',
  },
  necro: {
    RELOAD: 'Max Drone Count',
  },
  mixed: {
    BULLET_SPEED: 'Weapon Speed',
  },
  smasher: {
    RELOAD: 'Engine Acceleration',
  },
};

function buildStatNames(statNamesType: string | undefined): any {
  if (!statNamesType || statNamesType === 'generic') return undefined;
  return STAT_NAMES_TEMPLATES[statNamesType];
}

function buildControllers(tank: TankData): any[] | undefined {
  const controllers: any[] = [];
  if (tank.cameraZoomEnabled) {
    controllers.push(['zoom', { distance: tank.cameraZoomDistance ?? 225 }]);
  }
  if (tank.useCustomAimDirection && typeof tank.customAimAngle === 'number' && tank.customAimAngle !== 0) {
    controllers.push(['fixedDirection', { angle: tank.customAimAngle }]);
  }
  return controllers.length > 0 ? controllers : undefined;
}

function buildFacingType(tank: TankData): any | undefined {
  if (tank.baseSpinEnabled && typeof tank.baseSpinSpeed === 'number') {
    const arrasSpeed = invertSpinSpeed(tank.baseSpinSpeed * (tank.baseSpinDirection ?? 1));
    return ['spin', { speed: arrasSpeed }];
  }
  return undefined;
}

function buildInvisible(tank: TankData): [number, number] | undefined {
  const inv = (tank as any).invisible;
  if (!inv || typeof inv !== 'object') return undefined;
  const fadeIn = typeof inv.fadeInRate === 'number' ? inv.fadeInRate * 2 : undefined;
  const fadeOut = typeof inv.fadeOutRate === 'number' ? inv.fadeOutRate * 2 : undefined;
  if (fadeIn === undefined && fadeOut === undefined) return undefined;
  return [fadeIn ?? 0.08, fadeOut ?? 0.03];
}

function buildAlphaCap(tank: TankData): [number, number] | undefined {
  const inv = (tank as any).invisible;
  return inv && typeof inv === 'object' && inv.always === true ? [0, ALWAYS_INVISIBLE_ARRAS_CAP] : undefined;
}

export function emitTankClass(envelope: ExportFile<TankData>, warn: WarningCollector, opts: EmitOptions = {}): { primary: ArrasClassEmit; dependencies: ArrasClassEmit[] } {
  return withCarrierTouch(touchShareOf(envelope.data?.tankTouchScale), () => emitTankClassOn(envelope, warn, opts));
}

function emitTankClassOn(envelope: ExportFile<TankData>, warn: WarningCollector, opts: EmitOptions): { primary: ArrasClassEmit; dependencies: ArrasClassEmit[] } {
  const tank = envelope.data;
  const isBoss = detectIsBoss(envelope);
  let className: string;
  if (opts.className) {
    className = opts.className;
  } else {
    const baseName = classNameFromDisplayName(envelope.name);
    className = uniqueClassName(baseName, new Set<string>());
    if (className !== baseName) {
      warn.warn('className', `Tank name "${envelope.name}" sanitized to "${baseName}" matches a built in arras name; emitted as "${className}".`);
    }
  }

  const body = invertBody(tank, isBoss, warn);
  const skills = invertSkills(tank.skillCaps, tank.preDefinedSkills, tank.canEarnSkillPoints, tank.bonusSkillPoints, warn, isBoss ? 0 : LEVEL_45_POINTS);
  const mountSize = typeof body.SIZE === 'number' ? body.SIZE * (body.HEALTH_WITH_LEVEL ? 1 + 97 / 96 : 1) : null;
  const K = widestSolidPlate(tank).K;
  const plates = withTankK(K, () => invertPlates(tank, className, warn, mountSize));
  const mainParts = (tank.turrets ?? []).filter((t) => !(t && t.id && plates.onPlates.has(t.id)));
  const turretsResult = plates.anchor
    ? { GUNS: plates.anchorGuns, TURRETS: plates.anchorTurrets, dependencies: [] as ArrasClassEmit[] }
    : withTankK(K, () => withMount(mountSize, () => invertTurretsWithDependencies(mainParts, className, warn)));
  const color = arrasColorOf(tank.tankColor, tank.tankColorMap, warn);
  const controllers = buildControllers(tank);
  const facingType = buildFacingType(tank);
  const invisible = buildInvisible(tank);

  const allTurrets = [...plates.before, ...turretsResult.TURRETS, ...plates.after];

  const classDef: ArrasClassEmit = {
    className,
    PARENT: isBoss ? 'genericBoss' : 'genericTank',
    LABEL: envelope.name,
    BODY: body.BODY as any,
  };

  if (body.SIZE !== undefined) classDef.SIZE = K === 1 ? body.SIZE : Math.round(body.SIZE * K * 100) / 100;
  if (K !== 1 && typeof (classDef.BODY as any).FOV === 'number') (classDef.BODY as any).FOV = (classDef.BODY as any).FOV / Math.pow(K, 0.65);

  if (plates.anchor) {
    const a = plates.anchor;
    classDef.SHAPE = turnedShape(plateShape(a, typeof a.sides === 'number' ? a.sides : 6, warn), a.initialAngle ?? 0) as any;
  } else if (typeof body.SHAPE === 'number' && body.SHAPE !== 0) {
    classDef.SHAPE = osaPolygonShape(body.SHAPE, (tank.tankShapeDepth ?? 0) > 0, true);
  }

  if (plates.anchor && !followsBody(plates.anchor, tank)) classDef.COLOR = arrasColorOf(plates.anchor.color ?? '#a7a7af', plates.anchor.colorMap, warn);
  else if (tank.keepOwnColor === true && color !== 'inherit' && color !== -1) classDef.COLOR = color;
  if (body.HEALTH_WITH_LEVEL !== undefined) classDef.HEALTH_WITH_LEVEL = body.HEALTH_WITH_LEVEL;
  if (body.LEVEL !== undefined) classDef.LEVEL = body.LEVEL;

  if (turretsResult.GUNS.length > 0) classDef.GUNS = turretsResult.GUNS;
  if (allTurrets.length > 0) classDef.TURRETS = allTurrets;

  if (skills.SKILL_CAP) classDef.SKILL_CAP = skills.SKILL_CAP;
  if (skills.SKILL) classDef.SKILL = skills.SKILL;
  if (skills.EXTRA_SKILL) classDef.EXTRA_SKILL = skills.EXTRA_SKILL;

  if (controllers) classDef.CONTROLLERS = controllers;

  const effectiveFacing = plates.anchor ? plateFacing(plates.anchor) : facingType;
  if (effectiveFacing) classDef.FACING_TYPE = effectiveFacing;
  else if (isBoss) classDef.FACING_TYPE = 'toTarget';

  if (tank.isHealer) classDef.HEALING_TANK = true;
  if (tank.ignoresWalls === true) classDef.ARENA_CLOSER = true;
  if (tank.showHealthBar === false) classDef.DRAW_HEALTH = false;

  if (invisible) (classDef as any).INVISIBLE = invisible;
  const alphaCap = invisible ? buildAlphaCap(tank) : undefined;
  if (alphaCap) (classDef as any).ALPHA = alphaCap;

  const statNames = buildStatNames(tank.statNamesType);
  if (statNames) classDef.STAT_NAMES = statNames;

  if (tank.statNamesType === 'smasher') (classDef as any).IS_SMASHER = true;

  if (typeof tank.globalMaxAlive === 'number' && tank.globalMaxAliveEnabled) {
    classDef.MAX_CHILDREN = tank.globalMaxAlive;
  }

  if (tank._tapRootId !== undefined || (tank as any).fearHeat !== undefined) {
    warn.info('istrong-only', 'iStrong-only fields (_tapRootId, fearHeat, enemy behavior fields) dropped on reverse export');
  }

  emitTankArrasOnly(classDef as any, (tank as any)._arrasOnly);
  emitTankMeta(classDef as any, tank);
  if (plates.anchor) {
    emitOuterBodyLayerMeta(classDef as any, plates.anchor);
    (classDef as any)[ISTRONG_PLATE_KEY] = plateRecord(plates.anchor, plates.anchorIndex);
  }

  const allDependencies = [...turretsResult.dependencies, ...plates.dependencies];

  return { primary: classDef, dependencies: allDependencies };
}

export function buildReverseResult(envelope: ExportFile<TankData>, opts: EmitOptions = {}): ReverseResult {
  const warn = new WarningCollector();
  const result = emitTankClass(envelope, warn, opts);

  const pairedFilenames = result.dependencies.map(d => `${d.className}.js`);

  return {
    primary: result.primary,
    dependencies: result.dependencies,
    warnings: warn.list(),
    suggestedFilenames: {
      js: `${result.primary.className}.js`,
      json: `${result.primary.className}.json`,
      paired: pairedFilenames.length > 0 ? pairedFilenames : undefined,
    },
  };
}
import { ARRAS_COLORS, SLOT_ARRAS_NAME } from '../constants/colors.js';
import type { WarningCollector } from '../warnings/collector.js';

const EXCLUDED_FOR_INVERSE = new Set(['rainbow', 'trans']);

const NAMED_COLOR_PRIORITY = [
  'blue', 'green', 'red', 'magenta', 'yellow', 'grey', 'dgrey', 'vlgrey', 'lgrey',
  'gold', 'orange', 'purple', 'aqua', 'pink', 'lavender', 'teal', 'lgreen',
  'black', 'white', 'mustard', 'tangerine', 'brown', 'cyan',
];

function hexToRgb(hex: string): { r: number; g: number; b: number } | null {
  const clean = hex.replace('#', '');
  if (clean.length !== 6) return null;
  const r = parseInt(clean.slice(0, 2), 16);
  const g = parseInt(clean.slice(2, 4), 16);
  const b = parseInt(clean.slice(4, 6), 16);
  if (isNaN(r) || isNaN(g) || isNaN(b)) return null;
  return { r, g, b };
}

function colorDistance(a: { r: number; g: number; b: number }, b: { r: number; g: number; b: number }): number {
  const dr = a.r - b.r;
  const dg = a.g - b.g;
  const db = a.b - b.b;
  return dr * dr + dg * dg + db * db;
}

export function arrasColorOf(istrongHex: string | undefined, colorMap: unknown, _warn?: WarningCollector): string | number {
  if (typeof colorMap === 'number' && Number.isInteger(colorMap) && colorMap >= 0 && colorMap < SLOT_ARRAS_NAME.length) {
    return SLOT_ARRAS_NAME[colorMap]!;
  }
  if (!istrongHex || typeof istrongHex !== 'string') return 'grey';
  if (istrongHex === 'inherit') return -1;
  return hexToRgb(istrongHex) ? istrongHex.toLowerCase() : 'grey';
}

export function invertColor(istrongHex: string, _warn?: WarningCollector): string | number {
  if (!istrongHex || typeof istrongHex !== 'string') return 'grey';
  if (istrongHex === 'inherit') return -1;

  for (const name of NAMED_COLOR_PRIORITY) {
    if (ARRAS_COLORS[name]?.toLowerCase() === istrongHex.toLowerCase()) {
      return name;
    }
  }

  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(ARRAS_COLORS)) {
    if (typeof key === 'string' && EXCLUDED_FOR_INVERSE.has(key)) continue;
    if (value.toLowerCase() === istrongHex.toLowerCase()) {
      const asNumber = Number(key);
      return isNaN(asNumber) ? key : asNumber;
    }
  }

  if (!hexToRgb(istrongHex)) return 'grey';
  return istrongHex.toLowerCase();
}
import type { IstrongTurret } from '../types/istrong.js';
import type { ArrasClassEmit, ArrasGunEmit } from '../types/warnings.js';
import type { WarningCollector } from '../warnings/collector.js';
import { invertColor } from './colorInverter.js';
import { invertMotionType, invertFacingType, invertStatCalculator } from './behaviorInverter.js';
import { emitProjectileMeta } from './istrongMetaEmitter.js';

const VISUAL_TO_PARENT: Record<string, string> = {
  bullet: 'bullet',
  drone: 'drone',
  swarm: 'swarm',
  trap: 'trap',
  minion: 'minion',
  hive: 'hive',
  boomerang: 'boomerang',
  bomb: 'bullet',
  rocket: 'bullet',
  missile: 'bullet',
};

export interface InvertedCPD {
  classDef: ArrasClassEmit;
  innerGunInverter: (turrets: IstrongTurret[], parentName: string, warn: WarningCollector) => { GUNS: ArrasGunEmit[]; TURRETS: any[] };
}

export function buildCpdClass(
  cpd: any,
  parentTankName: string,
  gunIndex: number,
  warn: WarningCollector,
  innerInverter: (turrets: IstrongTurret[], parentName: string, warn: WarningCollector) => { GUNS: ArrasGunEmit[]; TURRETS: any[] },
): ArrasClassEmit {
  const className = `${parentTankName}Projectile${gunIndex}`;
  const visual = (cpd.visual || 'bullet').toLowerCase();
  const parent = VISUAL_TO_PARENT[visual] ?? 'bullet';

  const classDef: ArrasClassEmit = {
    className,
    PARENT: parent,
    LABEL: cpd.name || className,
  };

  const motion = invertMotionType(cpd.motionType);
  if (motion && motion !== 'glide') classDef.MOTION_TYPE = motion;

  const facing = invertFacingType(cpd.facingType);
  if (facing && facing !== 'toTarget') classDef.FACING_TYPE = facing;

  if (typeof cpd.shape === 'number' && cpd.shape !== 0) {
    if (cpd.trapDepth && cpd.trapDepth > 0) {
      classDef.SHAPE = -cpd.shape;
    } else {
      classDef.SHAPE = cpd.shape;
    }
  }

  if (cpd.color && cpd.color !== 'inherit' && !cpd.useTankColor) {
    classDef.COLOR = invertColor(cpd.color, warn);
  }

  if (typeof cpd.density === 'number' && cpd.density !== 1) {
    if (!classDef.BODY) classDef.BODY = {} as any;
    (classDef.BODY as any).DENSITY = cpd.density;
  }

  if (cpd.hitsOwnType && cpd.hitsOwnType !== 'none') {
    const hitsMap: Record<string, string> = {
      push: 'push',
      drone: 'droneCollision',
      hardWithBuffer: 'hardWithBuffer',
      assembler: 'assembler',
    };
    classDef.HITS_OWN_TYPE = hitsMap[cpd.hitsOwnType] ?? cpd.hitsOwnType;
  }

  if (cpd.persistsAfterDeath) classDef.PERSISTS_AFTER_DEATH = true;

  if (Array.isArray(cpd.turrets) && cpd.turrets.length > 0) {
    const inner = innerInverter(cpd.turrets as IstrongTurret[], className, warn);
    if (inner.GUNS.length > 0) classDef.GUNS = inner.GUNS;
    if (inner.TURRETS.length > 0) classDef.TURRETS = inner.TURRETS;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(cpd.bodyLayers) && cpd.bodyLayers.length > 0) {
    warn.info('cpd.bodyLayers', `Custom projectile "${className}" has body layer overlays. They are emitted as extra TURRETS but the parent class layers may not perfectly match.`);
  }

  emitProjectileMeta(classDef as any, cpd);

  return classDef;
}
import type { ArrasClassEmit } from '../types/warnings.js';
import { arrasColorOf } from './colorInverter.js';

export interface DesignItem { part: any; lx: number; ly: number; rot: number }

export function designItems(body: any): DesignItem[] {
  const items: DesignItem[] = [];
  const walk = (p: any, px: number, py: number, f: number): void => {
    const kids: any[] = Array.isArray(p.parts) ? p.parts : [];
    const c = Math.cos(f), s = Math.sin(f);
    const child = (k: any) => walk(k, px + (k.x ?? 0) * c - (k.y ?? 0) * s, py + (k.x ?? 0) * s + (k.y ?? 0) * c, f + (k.angle ?? 0));
    for (const k of kids) if (!k.above) child(k);
    items.push({ part: p, lx: px, ly: py, rot: f + (p.turn ?? 0) });
    for (const k of kids) if (k.above) child(k);
  };
  walk(body, 0, 0, 0);
  return items;
}

const round4 = (v: number) => +v.toFixed(4);

export function partShape(p: any, rot: number): number | number[][] | null {
  const c = Math.cos(rot), s = Math.sin(rot);
  const turned = (q: number[][]) => q.map(([x, y]) => [round4(x! * c - y! * s), round4(x! * s + y! * c)]);
  if (p.kind === 'circle') return 0;
  if (p.kind === 'line') return turned([[1, 0], [-1, 0]]);
  if (p.kind === 'outline' && Array.isArray(p.points)) return turned(p.points);
  const n = p.sides;
  if (!(typeof n === 'number' && n >= 3)) return null;
  const pts: number[][] = [];
  if (p.kind === 'polygon') for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) pts.push([Math.cos((2 * Math.PI * i) / n), Math.sin((2 * Math.PI * i) / n)]);
  else if (p.kind === 'star') for (let i = 0; i < 2 * n; i++) { const r = i % 2 ? p.inner ?? 0.5 : 1; pts.push([r * Math.cos((Math.PI * i) / n), r * Math.sin((Math.PI * i) / n)]); }
  else return null;
  return turned(pts);
}

export function partColor(p: any): string | number {
  if (p.team === true) return 'mirror';
  return arrasColorOf(p.color, p.colorMap);
}

export interface DesignClasses {
  root: ArrasClassEmit;
  parts: ArrasClassEmit[];
  skipped: string[];
}

export function designClasses(body: any, className: string): DesignClasses {
  const items = designItems(body);
  const at = items.findIndex((it) => it.part === body);
  const R = body.radius ?? 1;
  const skipped: string[] = [];
  const shape = partShape(body, body.turn ?? 0);
  const root: ArrasClassEmit = {
    className, LABEL: '', SHAPE: shape ?? 0, COLOR: partColor(body), INDEPENDENT: true, MIRROR_MASTER_ANGLE: true,
  } as any;
  if (body.kind === 'line') (root as any).DRAW_FILL = false;
  const parts: ArrasClassEmit[] = [];
  const turrets: any[] = [];
  items.forEach((it, i) => {
    if (i === at) return;
    const p = it.part;
    const own = partShape(p, 0);
    if (own === null) { skipped.push(`${className}: a ${p.kind} part`); return; }
    const name = `${className}_part${parts.length}`;
    const cls: any = { className: name, LABEL: '', SHAPE: own, COLOR: partColor(p), INDEPENDENT: true, MIRROR_MASTER_ANGLE: true };
    if (p.kind === 'line') cls.DRAW_FILL = false;
    parts.push(cls);
    const a = it.rot, ca = Math.cos(-a), sa = Math.sin(-a);
    const x = (10 * it.lx) / R, y = (10 * it.ly) / R;
    turrets.push({ POSITION: [round4((20 * (p.radius ?? 1)) / R), round4(x * ca - y * sa), round4(x * sa + y * ca), round4((a * 180) / Math.PI), 360, i < at ? 0 : 1], TYPE: name });
  });
  if (turrets.length) (root as any).TURRETS = turrets;
  return { root, parts, skipped };
}
import type { ExportFile, TankData, TurretPresetData, CustomProjectileData } from '../types/istrong.js';
import type { ReverseResult } from '../types/warnings.js';
import { buildReverseResult, emitTankClass } from './classEmitter.js';
import { WarningCollector } from '../warnings/collector.js';
import { VIEWER_BODY, viewerGunFiring } from './viewerTank.js';
import type { EmitOptions } from './classEmitter.js';

export { buildReverseResult, emitTankClass };

export function convertTankToArras(envelope: ExportFile<TankData>): ReverseResult {
  return buildReverseResult(envelope);
}

export function convertPresetToArras(envelope: ExportFile<TurretPresetData>, opts: EmitOptions = {}): ReverseResult {
  const tank: ExportFile<TankData> = {
    version: envelope.version ?? '1.0.0', type: 'Tank', name: envelope.name || envelope.data?.name || 'preset', timestamp: 0,
    category: 'Tanks', data: { ...VIEWER_BODY, turrets: (envelope.data?.turrets ?? []) as any } as TankData,
  };
  const r = buildReverseResult(tank, opts);
  return { ...r, warnings: [...r.warnings, { severity: 'info', field: 'preset', message: 'A turret preset holds no tank: it is written on the body of the Basic, its turrets as they are. Move them onto your own tank class.' }] };
}

export function convertProjectileToArras(envelope: ExportFile<CustomProjectileData>, opts: EmitOptions = {}): ReverseResult {
  const design: any = { ...envelope.data };
  if (!Array.isArray(design.turrets) && Array.isArray(design.subTurrets)) design.turrets = design.subTurrets;
  const tank: ExportFile<TankData> = {
    version: envelope.version ?? '1.0.0', type: 'Tank', name: envelope.name || design.name || 'projectile', timestamp: 0,
    category: 'Tanks', data: { ...VIEWER_BODY, turrets: [viewerGunFiring(design)] } as TankData,
  };
  const r = buildReverseResult(tank, opts);
  return { ...r, warnings: [...r.warnings, { severity: 'info', field: 'projectile', message: 'A projectile file holds no barrel: its round is fired by the barrel of the Basic (its speed, damage and reload). Put the round class on your own gun.' }] };
}

export function detectEnvelopeType(envelope: any): 'Tank' | 'TurretPreset' | 'CustomProjectile' | 'Unknown' {
  if (!envelope || typeof envelope !== 'object') return 'Unknown';
  const t = envelope.type;
  if (t === 'Tank' || t === 'TurretPreset' || t === 'CustomProjectile') return t;
  return 'Unknown';
}

export function convertEnvelopeToArras(envelope: any): ReverseResult {
  const type = detectEnvelopeType(envelope);
  if (type === 'Tank') return convertTankToArras(envelope);
  if (type === 'TurretPreset') return convertPresetToArras(envelope);
  if (type === 'CustomProjectile') return convertProjectileToArras(envelope);
  const warn = new WarningCollector();
  warn.error('envelope', `Unknown envelope type: ${envelope?.type ?? 'undefined'}`);
  return {
    primary: { className: 'unknown' },
    dependencies: [],
    warnings: warn.list(),
    suggestedFilenames: { js: 'unknown.js', json: 'unknown.json' },
  };
}
import {
  ISTRONG_META_KEY,
  ISTRONG_INLINE_PROJECTILE_KEY,
  ISTRONG_OUTER_BODY_KEY,
  ISTRONG_META_VERSION,
  META_FIELD_KEYS,
  type IstrongTankMeta,
  type IstrongTurretMeta,
  type IstrongProjectileMeta,
  type IstrongBodyLayerMeta,
} from '../types/istrongMeta.js';

function pickDefined<K extends string>(
  source: Record<string, any> | null | undefined,
  keys: ReadonlyArray<K>,
): Record<K, any> | undefined {
  if (!source || typeof source !== 'object') return undefined;
  let hasAny = false;
  const out = {} as Record<K, any>;
  for (const k of keys) {
    const v = source[k];
    if (v === undefined || v === null) continue;
    out[k] = v;
    hasAny = true;
  }
  return hasAny ? out : undefined;
}

function attachMeta(
  target: Record<string, any>,
  meta: Record<string, any> | undefined,
  key: string = ISTRONG_META_KEY,
): void {
  if (!meta) return;
  target[key] = { v: ISTRONG_META_VERSION, ...meta };
}

export function emitTankMeta(target: Record<string, any>, tank: any): void {
  const meta = pickDefined<keyof IstrongTankMeta>(tank, META_FIELD_KEYS.tank);
  if (meta && !(typeof tank?.tankShieldCapacity === 'number' && tank.tankShieldCapacity < 54)) delete meta.tankShieldCapacity;
  if (meta && tank?.keepOwnColor === true) {
    delete meta.tankColor;
    if (Object.keys(meta).length === 0) return;
  }
  attachMeta(target, meta);
}

export function emitTurretMeta(target: Record<string, any>, turret: any): void {
  const meta = pickDefined<keyof IstrongTurretMeta>(turret, META_FIELD_KEYS.turret);
  attachMeta(target, meta);
}

export function emitProjectileMeta(target: Record<string, any>, projectileType: any): void {
  const meta = pickDefined<keyof IstrongProjectileMeta>(projectileType, META_FIELD_KEYS.projectile);
  attachMeta(target, meta);
}

export function emitBodyLayerMeta(target: Record<string, any>, layer: any): void {
  const meta = pickDefined<keyof IstrongBodyLayerMeta>(layer, META_FIELD_KEYS.bodyLayer);
  attachMeta(target, meta);
}

export function emitProjectileMetaInline(target: Record<string, any>, projectileType: any): void {
  const meta = pickDefined<keyof IstrongProjectileMeta>(projectileType, META_FIELD_KEYS.projectile);
  attachMeta(target, meta, ISTRONG_INLINE_PROJECTILE_KEY);
}

export function emitOuterBodyLayerMeta(target: Record<string, any>, layer: any): void {
  const meta = pickDefined<keyof IstrongBodyLayerMeta>(layer, META_FIELD_KEYS.bodyLayer);
  attachMeta(target, meta, ISTRONG_OUTER_BODY_KEY);
}
import type { IstrongTurret, TankData } from '../types/istrong.js';
import type { ArrasClassEmit, ArrasGunEmit } from '../types/warnings.js';
import type { WarningCollector } from '../warnings/collector.js';
import { invertSpinSpeed } from './physicsInverter.js';
import { arrasColorOf } from './colorInverter.js';
import { invertTurretsWithDependencies } from './turretInverter.js';
import { emitBodyLayerMeta } from './istrongMetaEmitter.js';

const OUTER_BODY_ARRAS_SIZE = 20;

interface BodyLayer {
  id?: string;
  label?: string;
  sides?: number;
  sizeRatio?: number;
  color?: string;
  colorMap?: number;
  useInheritColor?: boolean;
  spinEnabled?: boolean;
  spinDirection?: number;
  spinSpeed?: number;
  copies?: number;
  initialAngle?: number;
  starDepth?: number;
  intangible?: boolean;
  stationary?: boolean;
  turretIds?: string[];
  renderOrder?: number;
  maxAliveEnabled?: boolean;
  maxAlive?: number;
}

function isTrueLayer(layer: BodyLayer): boolean {
  const turretCount = Array.isArray(layer.turretIds) ? layer.turretIds.length : 0;
  const intangible = layer.intangible !== false;
  return turretCount > 0 || !intangible;
}

function buildFacingType(spinEnabled: boolean | undefined, spinSpeed: number | undefined, spinDirection: number | undefined): any | undefined {
  if (!spinEnabled || typeof spinSpeed !== 'number') return undefined;
  const arrasSpeed = invertSpinSpeed(spinSpeed) * (spinDirection === -1 ? -1 : 1);
  return ['spin', { speed: arrasSpeed }];
}

export interface LayeredBossInversionResult {
  isLayeredBoss: boolean;
  mainClassOverrides: {
    SHAPE?: number;
    COLOR?: any;
    FACING_TYPE?: any;
    extraTurrets: { POSITION: number[]; TYPE: string }[];
    outerBodyLayer?: BodyLayer;
  };
  outerBodyTurretIds: Set<string>;
  dependencies: ArrasClassEmit[];
  consumedTurretIds: Set<string>;
}

export function invertLayeredBoss(
  tank: TankData,
  bodyLayers: BodyLayer[] | null | undefined,
  parentClassName: string,
  warn: WarningCollector,
): LayeredBossInversionResult {
  const empty: LayeredBossInversionResult = {
    isLayeredBoss: false,
    mainClassOverrides: { extraTurrets: [] },
    outerBodyTurretIds: new Set<string>(),
    dependencies: [],
    consumedTurretIds: new Set<string>(),
  };

  if (!Array.isArray(bodyLayers) || bodyLayers.length === 0) return empty;

  const trueLayers = bodyLayers.filter(isTrueLayer);
  if (trueLayers.length < 2) return empty;

  trueLayers.sort((a, b) => (a.renderOrder ?? 0) - (b.renderOrder ?? 0));

  const outerLayer = trueLayers[0]!;
  const outerSizeRatio = outerLayer.sizeRatio ?? 1;
  if (outerSizeRatio <= 0) return empty;
  const innermostArrasSize = OUTER_BODY_ARRAS_SIZE / outerSizeRatio;

  const turretsById = new Map<string, IstrongTurret>();
  for (const t of tank.turrets ?? []) {
    if (t.id) turretsById.set(t.id, t);
  }

  const consumedTurretIds = new Set<string>();
  const outerBodyTurretIds = new Set<string>();
  const dependencies: ArrasClassEmit[] = [];
  const mainTurrets: { POSITION: number[]; TYPE: string }[] = [];

  for (const tid of outerLayer.turretIds ?? []) {
    if (turretsById.has(tid)) {
      outerBodyTurretIds.add(tid);
      consumedTurretIds.add(tid);
    }
  }

  const innerLayers = trueLayers.slice(1);
  for (let i = 0; i < innerLayers.length; i++) {
    const layer = innerLayers[i]!;
    const layerClassName = `${parentClassName}Layer${i + 1}`;
    const layerArrasSize = (layer.sizeRatio ?? 1) * innermostArrasSize;
    const renderLayerPos = i + 1;

    mainTurrets.push({
      POSITION: [layerArrasSize, 0, 0, (layer.initialAngle ?? 0) * 180 / Math.PI, 360, renderLayerPos],
      TYPE: layerClassName,
    });

    const layerTurrets: IstrongTurret[] = [];
    for (const tid of layer.turretIds ?? []) {
      const t = turretsById.get(tid);
      if (t) {
        layerTurrets.push(t);
        consumedTurretIds.add(tid);
      }
    }
    const inner = invertTurretsWithDependencies(layerTurrets, layerClassName, warn);
    dependencies.push(...inner.dependencies);

    const classDef: ArrasClassEmit = {
      className: layerClassName,
      PARENT: 'genericTank',
      LABEL: layer.label ?? layerClassName,
    };
    if (typeof layer.sides === 'number') classDef.SHAPE = layer.sides;
    if (layer.color && layer.color !== 'inherit' && !layer.useInheritColor) {
      classDef.COLOR = arrasColorOf(layer.color, layer.colorMap, warn);
    } else if (layer.useInheritColor) {
      classDef.COLOR = -1;
    }
    const facing = buildFacingType(layer.spinEnabled, layer.spinSpeed, layer.spinDirection);
    if (facing) classDef.FACING_TYPE = facing;
    if (inner.GUNS.length > 0) classDef.GUNS = inner.GUNS;
    if (inner.TURRETS.length > 0) classDef.TURRETS = inner.TURRETS;
    if (layer.maxAliveEnabled && (layer.maxAlive ?? 0) > 0) classDef.MAX_CHILDREN = layer.maxAlive;
    classDef.INTANGIBLE = true;
    classDef.DRAW_HEALTH = false;
    emitBodyLayerMeta(classDef as any, layer);
    dependencies.push(classDef);
  }

  const innermostClassName = `${parentClassName}Layer${innerLayers.length + 1}`;
  const innermostTurrets: IstrongTurret[] = [];
  for (const t of tank.turrets ?? []) {
    if (t.id && !consumedTurretIds.has(t.id)) {
      innermostTurrets.push(t);
      consumedTurretIds.add(t.id);
    }
  }
  if (innermostTurrets.length > 0 || tank.tankSides) {
    const innermostFacing = buildFacingType(tank.baseSpinEnabled, tank.baseSpinSpeed, tank.baseSpinDirection);
    mainTurrets.push({
      POSITION: [innermostArrasSize, 0, 0, 0, 360, innerLayers.length + 1],
      TYPE: innermostClassName,
    });
    const inner = invertTurretsWithDependencies(innermostTurrets, innermostClassName, warn);
    dependencies.push(...inner.dependencies);
    const classDef: ArrasClassEmit = {
      className: innermostClassName,
      PARENT: 'genericTank',
      LABEL: innermostClassName,
    };
    if (typeof tank.tankSides === 'number' && tank.tankSides !== 0) classDef.SHAPE = tank.tankSides;
    const innerColor = arrasColorOf(tank.tankColor, tank.tankColorMap, warn);
    if (innerColor !== 'inherit' && innerColor !== -1) classDef.COLOR = innerColor;
    if (innermostFacing) classDef.FACING_TYPE = innermostFacing;
    if (inner.GUNS.length > 0) classDef.GUNS = inner.GUNS;
    if (inner.TURRETS.length > 0) classDef.TURRETS = inner.TURRETS;
    classDef.INTANGIBLE = true;
    classDef.DRAW_HEALTH = false;
    dependencies.push(classDef);
  }

  const outerFacing = buildFacingType(outerLayer.spinEnabled, outerLayer.spinSpeed, outerLayer.spinDirection);
  const outerColor = outerLayer.useInheritColor
    ? arrasColorOf(tank.tankColor, tank.tankColorMap, warn)
    : arrasColorOf(outerLayer.color ?? '#a7a7af', outerLayer.colorMap, warn);

  warn.info('layeredBoss', `LayeredBoss reconstructed as ${innerLayers.length + 1} child class${innerLayers.length === 0 ? '' : 'es'} (${innerLayers.length + 1} kronos-style layer files).`, {
    original: { layerCount: trueLayers.length, innermostArrasSize },
    recovered: { mainClass: parentClassName, layerClasses: innerLayers.map((_, i) => `${parentClassName}Layer${i + 1}`) },
  });

  return {
    isLayeredBoss: true,
    mainClassOverrides: {
      SHAPE: outerLayer.sides,
      COLOR: outerColor,
      FACING_TYPE: outerFacing,
      extraTurrets: mainTurrets,
      outerBodyLayer: outerLayer,
    },
    outerBodyTurretIds,
    dependencies,
    consumedTurretIds,
  };
}
import { ARRAS_BASE, ARRAS_TICK_RATE, ARRAS_RUN_SPEED, OSA_STAT_PER_TANK_SLIDER, OSA_STAT_PER_ROUND_SLIDER, OSA_DRIVE_PER_FILE_SPEED, OSA_BLOCK_PUSH_TICK, ENGINE_BLOCK_CRUISE_SHARE, OSA_BOOMERANG_BODY_SPEED, ENGINE_BOOMERANG_DAMP_LN, ENGINE_BOOMERANG_PUSH_SHARE, ENGINE_SUBFRAME } from '../constants/physics.js';
import { BODY_SPEED, engineWidthOfSlider, convertBarrelWidth, BASIC_LEVEL45_GROWTH } from '../forward/physicsCalibrator.js';
import type { WarningCollector } from '../warnings/collector.js';

const RECOIL_SCALE = 40 / 1.4;
const DAMAGE_SCALE = 2.0;

const ENTITY_BASE_RANGE: Record<string, number> = {
  bullet: 90,
  trap: 450,
  swarm: 105,
  drone: 90,
  minion: 90,
  hive: 90,
  boomerang: 120,
};

export function invertRecoil(istrongKnockback: number): number {
  return istrongKnockback / RECOIL_SCALE;
}

export function invertBulletSpeed(istrongSpeed: number, _warn?: WarningCollector): number {
  const safe = Math.max(0, istrongSpeed);
  if (safe >= 5) {
    return safe;
  }
  return (safe + 5) / 2;
}

export function invertTankBarrelSpeed(istrongSpeed: number): number {
  return (istrongSpeed + 5) * OSA_STAT_PER_TANK_SLIDER;
}

export function invertRoundBarrelSpeed(istrongSpeed: number): number {
  return istrongSpeed * OSA_STAT_PER_ROUND_SLIDER;
}

export function invertBPSToReload(istrongBPS: number): number {
  if (istrongBPS <= 0) return 1;
  return ARRAS_TICK_RATE / (istrongBPS * ARRAS_RUN_SPEED);
}

export function invertDamage(istrongDamage: number): number {
  return istrongDamage / DAMAGE_SCALE;
}

export function invertBulletHealth(istrongHealth: number): number {
  return istrongHealth / DAMAGE_SCALE;
}

export function invertPenetration(istrongPen: number): number {
  return istrongPen;
}

export function invertLifetime(istrongLifetimeSec: number, entityType: string = 'bullet'): number {
  const baseRange = ENTITY_BASE_RANGE[entityType] ?? 90;
  if (baseRange === 0) return 0;
  return (istrongLifetimeSec * ARRAS_TICK_RATE) / baseRange;
}

const ARRAS_SPD_NO_POINTS = 1.5;
export const OSA_CLASS_RANGE: Readonly<Record<string, number>> = { bullet: 90, swarm: 225, trap: 450, boomerang: 120, drone: 200, minion: 90, hive: 90 };
const OSA_RANGE_KEPT: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['sustained', 'sustainedLowspeed', 'trap', 'block']);
export function invertRoundLifetime(istrongLifetimeSec: number, entityType: string, statCalc: string | undefined): number {
  const classRange = OSA_CLASS_RANGE[entityType] ?? OSA_CLASS_RANGE.bullet;
  let ticks = istrongLifetimeSec * ARRAS_TICK_RATE;
  const kept = OSA_RANGE_KEPT.has(statCalc ?? (entityType === 'trap' ? 'trap' : 'bullet')) || entityType === 'trap' || entityType === 'boomerang';
  if (!kept) ticks = (Math.round(ticks) + 0.5) * Math.sqrt(ARRAS_SPD_NO_POINTS);
  return ticks / classRange;
}

export function invertSpread(istrongSpread: number): number {
  return istrongSpread;
}

export function invertTankSize(istrongSlider: number, levelsUp: boolean = true): number {
  const size = 12 * engineWidthOfSlider(istrongSlider) / engineWidthOfSlider(9);
  const rounded = Math.round(size * 100) / 100;
  return levelsUp ? rounded : Math.round(size * BASIC_LEVEL45_GROWTH * 100) / 100;
}

export function invertBodyHP(istrongHP: number, isBoss: boolean, warn?: WarningCollector): { health: number; healthWithLevel: boolean; level?: number } {
  const healthWithLevel = true;
  const arrasHealth = istrongHP / 2 - 90;
  if (warn) {
    if (isBoss) {
      warn.warn('BODY.HEALTH', 'Boss arras LEVEL is not stored in iStrong data, so LEVEL=45 is assumed (matches iStrong default). If the original boss used a different level, edit BODY.HEALTH and LEVEL by hand.', {
        original: istrongHP,
        recovered: arrasHealth,
        context: 'iStrong level 0 corresponds to arras player level 45. Arras tanks add 90 HP at max level; reverse subtracts that to recover raw HEALTH.',
      });
    } else {
      warn.info('BODY.HEALTH', 'Player tank HP recovered assuming iStrong level 0 = arras level 45 (arras player starting level). No edit needed.', {
        original: istrongHP,
        recovered: arrasHealth,
      });
    }
  }
  return {
    health: Math.max(0, arrasHealth),
    healthWithLevel,
    level: isBoss ? 45 : undefined,
  };
}

export function invertBodyDamage(istrongDamage: number): number {
  return istrongDamage;
}

export function invertMovementSpeed(istrongSpeed: number): number {
  return istrongSpeed * (ARRAS_BASE.SPEED / 3);
}

const DRIVE_BACK_DECIMALS = 1e4;
export function invertDrive(istrongSpeed: number, pushShare: number | undefined): { speed: number; acceleration?: number } {
  const share = (typeof pushShare === 'number' && pushShare >= 0 && pushShare < 1) ? pushShare : ARRAS_BASE.ACCEL / (ARRAS_BASE.SPEED + ARRAS_BASE.ACCEL);
  pushShare = share;
  const whole = istrongSpeed * OSA_DRIVE_PER_FILE_SPEED;
  const back = (v: number) => Math.round(v * DRIVE_BACK_DECIMALS) / DRIVE_BACK_DECIMALS;
  return { speed: back(whole * (1 - pushShare)), acceleration: back(whole * pushShare) };
}

export function invertShieldCapacity(istrongShield: number, isBoss: boolean, warn?: WarningCollector): { shield: number; healthWithLevel: boolean } {
  const healthWithLevel = true;
  const arrasShield = istrongShield / 2 - 27;
  if (isBoss && warn) {
    warn.warn('BODY.SHIELD', 'Shield LEVEL bonus baked in (level 45 assumed).', {
      original: istrongShield,
      recovered: arrasShield,
    });
  }
  return {
    shield: Math.max(0, arrasShield),
    healthWithLevel,
  };
}

export function invertShieldRegen(istrongRegen: number): number {
  return istrongRegen * (ARRAS_BASE.REGEN / 3);
}

export function invertFOV(istrongFOV: number): number {
  return istrongFOV * ARRAS_BASE.FOV;
}

export function invertPushability(istrongPush: number | undefined): number | undefined {
  if (istrongPush === undefined || istrongPush === null) return undefined;
  return istrongPush;
}

export function invertBarrelLength(istrongLength: number): number {
  return ((istrongLength - 1) * 10.49 / 99 + 0.01) * 20;
}

export function invertBarrelWidth(istrongWidth: number): number {
  return istrongWidth * (20 * 0.96) / 50;
}

export function invertBarrelX(istrongX: number): number {
  return istrongX * 10;
}

export function invertBarrelY(istrongY: number): number {
  return istrongY * 10;
}

export function invertBulletSize(istrongSize: number, arrasWidth?: number, arrasAspect: number = 1): number {
  if (!(typeof arrasWidth === 'number' && arrasWidth > 0)) return istrongSize;
  const raw = arrasWidth * 50 / (20 * 0.96);
  const written = convertBarrelWidth(arrasAspect < 0 ? arrasWidth * Math.abs(arrasAspect) : arrasWidth);
  if (!(written > 0)) return istrongSize;
  const k = raw / written;
  return k === 1 ? istrongSize : istrongSize / k;
}

export function invertTopSpeedRatio(arrasSpeed: number, topSpeedRatio: number, entityType: string): number {
  const bodySpeed = BODY_SPEED[entityType] ?? 3.75;
  if (bodySpeed === 0) return 0;
  return (topSpeedRatio * arrasSpeed) / bodySpeed;
}

export function invertBlockTopSpeed(arrasSpeed: number, topSpeedRatio: number | undefined): number {
  const share = typeof topSpeedRatio === 'number' && topSpeedRatio > 0 ? topSpeedRatio : ENGINE_BLOCK_CRUISE_SHARE;
  return Math.max(0, share * arrasSpeed - OSA_BLOCK_PUSH_TICK / (ARRAS_RUN_SPEED * 1.5));
}

export function invertBoomerangDrive(arrasSpeed: number, topSpeedRatio: number | undefined, motorDampLn: number | undefined): { maxSpeed: number; acceleration: number } {
  const share = typeof topSpeedRatio === 'number' && topSpeedRatio > 0 ? topSpeedRatio : 1;
  const own = typeof motorDampLn === 'number' && motorDampLn < -0.001;
  const ln = own ? motorDampLn! : ENGINE_BOOMERANG_DAMP_LN;
  const pushShare = own ? Math.exp(-ln) - 1 : ENGINE_BOOMERANG_PUSH_SHARE;
  const keep = Math.exp(2 * ln);
  const cruise = ARRAS_RUN_SPEED * 1.5 * arrasSpeed * share * pushShare * ENGINE_SUBFRAME / (1 - Math.exp(ln * ENGINE_SUBFRAME));
  return { maxSpeed: keep * cruise / (ARRAS_RUN_SPEED * 1.5 * OSA_BOOMERANG_BODY_SPEED), acceleration: (1 - keep) * cruise / ARRAS_RUN_SPEED };
}

export function invertAutoTurretSize(istrongCircleSize: number): number {
  return istrongCircleSize / 1.86;
}

export function invertSpinSpeed(istrongSpin: number): number {
  const ARRAS_SPIN_MULTIPLIER = 2500 / 3;
  return istrongSpin / ARRAS_SPIN_MULTIPLIER;
}
import type { IstrongTurret, TankData } from '../types/istrong.js';
import type { ArrasClassEmit, ArrasGunEmit } from '../types/warnings.js';
import type { WarningCollector } from '../warnings/collector.js';
import { invertSpinSpeed } from './physicsInverter.js';
import { arrasColorOf } from './colorInverter.js';
import { invertTurretsWithDependencies, withFrame, withMount, holderFrame } from './turretInverter.js';
import { emitBodyLayerMeta } from './istrongMetaEmitter.js';
import { ISTRONG_PLATE_KEY as PLATE_KEY, ISTRONG_MAIN_BODY_KEY as MAIN_BODY_KEY, plateRecord } from '../types/istrongMeta.js';
import { plateShape, osaPolygonShape } from './plateShape.js';

export interface PlateResult {
  K: number;
  anchor: any | null;
  anchorIndex: number;
  before: any[];
  after: any[];
  anchorGuns: ArrasGunEmit[];
  anchorTurrets: any[];
  dependencies: ArrasClassEmit[];
  onPlates: Set<string>;
}

const facingOf = (layer: any): any => {
  if (layer.spinEnabled && typeof layer.spinSpeed === 'number' && layer.spinSpeed) {
    return ['spin', { speed: invertSpinSpeed(layer.spinSpeed) * (layer.spinDirection === -1 ? -1 : 1) }];
  }
  return null;
};
export function turnedShape(shape: number | number[][], angle: number): number | number[][] {
  if (!angle) return shape;
  if (Array.isArray(shape)) {
    const c = Math.cos(angle), s = Math.sin(angle);
    return shape.map(([x, y]) => [+(x! * c - y! * s).toFixed(4), +(x! * s + y! * c).toFixed(4)]);
  }
  if (!(shape >= 3)) return shape;
  const n = Math.floor(shape);
  const frac = ((((shape - n) + angle / (2 * Math.PI)) % 1) + 1) % 1;
  return +(n + frac).toFixed(6);
}

export function followsBody(l: any, tank: TankData): boolean {
  if (l.useInheritColor) return true;
  if (l.teamColour === false) return false;
  return (l.teamColour === true || !l.intangible) && tank.keepOwnColor !== true;
}

export function plateFacing(layer: any): any {
  return facingOf(layer) ?? undefined;
}

export function widestSolidPlate(tank: TankData): { K: number; anchor: any | null } {
  let K = 1, anchor: any = null;
  for (const l of Array.isArray(tank.bodyLayers) ? tank.bodyLayers : []) {
    if (l && l.intangible === false && typeof l.sizeRatio === 'number' && l.sizeRatio > K) { K = l.sizeRatio; anchor = l; }
  }
  return { K, anchor };
}

export function invertPlates(tank: TankData, className: string, warn: WarningCollector, mainMount: number | null): PlateResult {
  const layers: any[] = Array.isArray(tank.bodyLayers) ? tank.bodyLayers : [];
  const res: PlateResult = { K: 1, anchor: null, anchorIndex: -1, before: [], after: [], anchorGuns: [], anchorTurrets: [], dependencies: [], onPlates: new Set() };
  const byId = new Map<string, IstrongTurret>();
  for (const t of tank.turrets ?? []) if (t && t.id) byId.set(t.id, t);
  const partsOf = new Map<any, IstrongTurret[]>();
  for (const l of layers) {
    const list: IstrongTurret[] = [];
    for (const id of Array.isArray(l.turretIds) ? l.turretIds : []) {
      const t = byId.get(id);
      if (t && !res.onPlates.has(id)) { list.push(t); res.onPlates.add(id); }
    }
    partsOf.set(l, list);
  }
  ({ K: res.K, anchor: res.anchor } = widestSolidPlate(tank));
  res.anchorIndex = res.anchor ? layers.indexOf(res.anchor) : -1;
  const K = res.K;
  const mountOf = (share: number) => (typeof mainMount === 'number' ? mainMount * K * share : null);

  const plateTurret = (l: any, li: number): any => {
    const share = (typeof l.sizeRatio === 'number' ? l.sizeRatio : 1) / K;
    const name = `${className}_layer${li}Body`;
    const sides = typeof l.sides === 'number' ? l.sides : 6;
    const cls: any = {
      className: name, LABEL: '', SHAPE: turnedShape(plateShape(l, sides, warn), l.initialAngle ?? 0),
      COLOR: followsBody(l, tank) ? 'mirror' : arrasColorOf(l.color ?? '#484848', l.colorMap, warn),
    };
    const spin = facingOf(l);
    if (spin) cls.FACING_TYPE = spin;
    else if (l.stationary) cls.FACING_TYPE = ['noFacing', { angle: 0 }];
    else cls.MIRROR_MASTER_ANGLE = true;
    const parts = partsOf.get(l) ?? [];
    if (parts.length) {
      const inner = withMount(mountOf(share), () => withFrame(holderFrame(share), () => invertTurretsWithDependencies(parts, name, warn)));
      res.dependencies.push(...inner.dependencies);
      cls.PARENT = 'genericTank';
      cls.INTANGIBLE = true;
      cls.DRAW_HEALTH = false;
      if (inner.GUNS.length) cls.GUNS = inner.GUNS;
      if (inner.TURRETS.length) cls.TURRETS = inner.TURRETS;
      if (l.maxAliveEnabled && (l.maxAlive ?? 0) > 0) cls.MAX_CHILDREN = l.maxAlive;
    } else {
      cls.INDEPENDENT = true;
    }
    emitBodyLayerMeta(cls, l);
    cls[PLATE_KEY] = plateRecord(l, li);
    res.dependencies.push(cls);
    return { POSITION: [+(20 * share).toFixed(6), 0, 0, 0, 360, 0], TYPE: name };
  };

  const ordered = (sel: (l: any) => boolean) => layers.map((l, i) => ({ l, i })).filter((x) => sel(x.l))
    .sort((a, b) => (a.l.renderOrder ?? 0) - (b.l.renderOrder ?? 0) || a.i - b.i);
  const under = ordered((l) => (l.renderOrder ?? 0) >= 0);
  const over = ordered((l) => (l.renderOrder ?? 0) < 0);

  if (!res.anchor) {
    for (const { l, i } of under) res.before.push(plateTurret(l, i));
    for (const { l, i } of over) {
      const turret = plateTurret(l, i);
      res.after.push({ ...turret, POSITION: [...turret.POSITION.slice(0, 5), 1] });
    }
    return res;
  }

  const units = [...under.map((x) => ({ kind: 'plate', ...x })), { kind: 'main', l: null, i: -1 }, ...over.map((x) => ({ kind: 'plate', ...x }))];
  const at = units.findIndex((u) => u.l === res.anchor);
  units.forEach((u, n) => {
    if (n === at) return;
    const turret = u.kind === 'main' ? mainTurret(tank, className, K, warn, mountOf(1 / K), res, byId) : plateTurret(u.l, u.i);
    if (n < at) res.before.push(turret);
    else res.after.push({ ...turret, POSITION: [...turret.POSITION.slice(0, 5), 1] });
  });
  const anchorParts = partsOf.get(res.anchor) ?? [];
  const inner = withMount(mountOf(1), () => invertTurretsWithDependencies(anchorParts, className, warn));
  res.anchorGuns = inner.GUNS;
  res.anchorTurrets = inner.TURRETS;
  res.dependencies.push(...inner.dependencies);
  return res;
}

function mainTurret(tank: TankData, className: string, K: number, warn: WarningCollector, mount: number | null, res: PlateResult, byId: Map<string, IstrongTurret>): any {
  const name = `${className}_mainBody`;
  const parts = (tank.turrets ?? []).filter((t) => t && !(t.id && res.onPlates.has(t.id)));
  void byId;
  const inner = withMount(mount, () => withFrame(holderFrame(1 / K), () => invertTurretsWithDependencies(parts, name, warn)));
  res.dependencies.push(...inner.dependencies);
  const sides = typeof tank.tankSides === 'number' ? tank.tankSides : 0;
  const cls: any = {
    className: name, PARENT: 'genericTank', LABEL: '', INTANGIBLE: true, DRAW_HEALTH: false, [MAIN_BODY_KEY]: 1,
    COLOR: tank.keepOwnColor === true && !(res.anchor && followsBody(res.anchor, tank)) ? arrasColorOf(tank.tankColor, tank.tankColorMap, warn) : 'mirror',
  };
  if (sides >= 3) cls.SHAPE = osaPolygonShape(sides, (tank.tankShapeDepth ?? 0) > 0, true);
  if (tank.baseSpinEnabled && typeof tank.baseSpinSpeed === 'number') {
    cls.FACING_TYPE = ['spin', { speed: invertSpinSpeed(tank.baseSpinSpeed * (tank.baseSpinDirection ?? 1)) }];
  } else cls.MIRROR_MASTER_ANGLE = true;
  if (inner.GUNS.length) cls.GUNS = inner.GUNS;
  if (inner.TURRETS.length) cls.TURRETS = inner.TURRETS;
  res.dependencies.push(cls);
  return { POSITION: [+(20 / K).toFixed(6), 0, 0, 0, 360, 0], TYPE: name };
}
import type { WarningCollector } from '../warnings/collector.js';

export function osaPolygonShape(sides: number, star: boolean, evenTurn: boolean): number {
  const n = Math.floor(sides);
  let frac = sides - n;
  if (evenTurn && n >= 4 && n % 2 === 0) frac = (((frac - 1 / (2 * n)) % 1) + 1) % 1;
  const s = +(n + frac).toFixed(6);
  return star ? -s : s;
}

export function realSizeFactor(sides: number): number {
  if (!(sides >= 3)) return 1;
  const c = (2 * Math.PI) / Math.floor(sides);
  return Math.sqrt(c / Math.sin(c));
}

export function plateShape(layer: any, sides: number, warn: WarningCollector): number | number[][] {
  if (Array.isArray(layer.outline) && layer.outline.length >= 3) return layer.outline.map((p: number[]) => [p[0], p[1]]);
  const depth = typeof layer.starDepth === 'number' ? layer.starDepth : 0;
  if (depth > 0 && sides >= 3) {
    if (layer.starCurved) warn.warn('bodyLayers', `layer "${layer.label ?? ''}": a curved star goes to OSA with straight sides`);
    const k = realSizeFactor(sides);
    const pts: number[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < sides * 2; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI * i) / sides, r = (i % 2 ? 1 - depth : 1) * k;
      pts.push([+(r * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(4), +(r * Math.sin(a)).toFixed(4)]);
    }
    return pts;
  }
  return sides;
}
import type { IstrongProjectileType } from '../types/istrong.js';
import type { WarningCollector } from '../warnings/collector.js';

const VISUAL_TO_TYPE: Record<string, string> = {
  bullet: 'bullet',
  drone: 'drone',
  swarm: 'swarm',
  trap: 'setTrap',
  minion: 'minion',
  hive: 'hive',
  boomerang: 'boomerang',
  bomb: 'bomb',
  rocket: 'rocket',
  missile: 'missile',
};

export interface InvertedProjectileType {
  typeName: string;
  hasCustomProjectile: boolean;
  customProjectileChildClass?: string;
}

export function invertProjectileType(pt: IstrongProjectileType, parentTankName: string, gunIndex: number, warn: WarningCollector): InvertedProjectileType {
  if (pt.customProjectileDesign) {
    const childName = `${parentTankName}Projectile${gunIndex}`;
    warn.info('projectile.custom', `Custom projectile design extracted to child class "${childName}"`, {
      original: pt.customProjectileDesign,
      recovered: childName,
    });
    return {
      typeName: childName,
      hasCustomProjectile: true,
      customProjectileChildClass: childName,
    };
  }

  const visual = (pt.visual || 'bullet').toLowerCase();
  const typeName = VISUAL_TO_TYPE[visual] ?? 'bullet';

  if (!VISUAL_TO_TYPE[visual]) {
    warn.warn('projectile.visual', `Unknown projectile visual "${pt.visual}" mapped to 'bullet'`, {
      original: pt.visual,
      recovered: 'bullet',
    });
  }

  return {
    typeName,
    hasCustomProjectile: false,
  };
}

export function getEntityTypeFromVisual(visual: string | undefined): string {
  if (!visual) return 'bullet';
  const lower = visual.toLowerCase();
  if (lower === 'trap') return 'trap';
  if (lower === 'drone') return 'drone';
  if (lower === 'swarm') return 'swarm';
  if (lower === 'minion') return 'minion';
  if (lower === 'hive') return 'hive';
  if (lower === 'boomerang') return 'boomerang';
  return 'bullet';
}
import type { IstrongSkillCaps } from '../types/istrong.js';
import type { WarningCollector } from '../warnings/collector.js';

const SKILL_NAME_ORDER: (keyof IstrongSkillCaps)[] = [
  'reload',
  'bulletPenetration',
  'bulletHealth',
  'bulletDamage',
  'bulletSpeed',
  'shieldCapacity',
  'bodyDamage',
  'maxHealth',
  'shieldRegen',
  'movementSpeed',
];

export interface InvertedSkills {
  SKILL_CAP?: number[];
  SKILL?: (number | null)[];
  EXTRA_SKILL?: number;
}

export function invertSkills(
  skillCaps: IstrongSkillCaps | undefined,
  preDefinedSkills: Record<string, number> | undefined,
  canEarnSkillPoints: boolean | undefined,
  bonusSkillPoints: number | undefined,
  warn?: WarningCollector,
  levelPoints: number = 0,
): InvertedSkills {
  const result: InvertedSkills = {};

  if (skillCaps) {
    const cap: number[] = [];
    for (const name of SKILL_NAME_ORDER) {
      cap.push(skillCaps[name] ?? 9);
    }
    result.SKILL_CAP = cap;
  }

  if (preDefinedSkills && Object.keys(preDefinedSkills).length > 0) {
    const skill: (number | null)[] = [];
    for (const name of SKILL_NAME_ORDER) {
      const val = preDefinedSkills[name];
      skill.push(typeof val === 'number' ? val : null);
    }
    result.SKILL = skill;
  } else if (canEarnSkillPoints === false) {
    result.SKILL = SKILL_NAME_ORDER.map(() => 0);
    if (warn) {
      warn.info('SKILL', 'canEarnSkillPoints=false detected. Emitting SKILL=[0, ...]: a boss or another entity that does not gain skills.');
    }
  }

  const extra = typeof bonusSkillPoints === 'number' ? bonusSkillPoints - levelPoints : 0;
  if (extra > 0) {
    result.EXTRA_SKILL = extra;
  }

  return result;
}
